entry.summary: Develops custom SIMD kernels for ternary neural networks that replace matrix multiplication with addition/subtraction operations, enabling LLM inference on consumer CPUs without GPUs.

entry.title: Cited but Not Verified: Parsing and Evaluating Source Attribution in LLM Deep Research Agents

author.name: Hailey Onweller, Elias Lumer, Austin Huber, Pia Ramchandani, Vamse Kumar Subbiah, Corey Feld

entry.summary: Introduces a source attribution evaluation framework using AST parsing to extract and verify inline citations in LLM-generated reports at scale, closing the loop by retrieving actual cited content for verification.

entry.title: StraTA: Incentivizing Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Strategic Trajectory Abstraction

author.name: Xiangyuan Xue, Yifan Zhou, Zidong Wang, Shengji Tang, Philip Torr, Wanli Ouyang, Lei Bai, Zhenfei Yin

entry.summary: Introduces StraTA, which adds explicit trajectory-level strategy to agentic RL by sampling compact strategies from initial states, conditioning actions on strategies, and training both jointly with hierarchical GRPO.

entry.title: ReFlect: An Effective Harness System for Complex Long-Horizon LLM Reasoning

author.name: Fan Huang

entry.summary: Introduces ReFlect, a deterministic wrapper system for LLM reasoning that provides standalone error detection and recovery logic for long-horizon tasks. Shows that standard prompt-level self-critique fails (flags no issues in 90/100 cases) while their external harness approach improves error recovery.

entry.title: On Time, Within Budget: Constraint-Driven Online Resource Allocation for Agentic Workflows

author.name: Xinglin Wang, Zishen Liu, Shaoxiong Feng, Peiwen Yuan, Yiwei Li, Jiayi Shi, Yueqi Zhang, Chuyi Tan, Ji Zhang, Boyuan Pan, Yao Hu, Kan Li

entry.summary: Studies constraint-driven online resource allocation for agentic workflows where tasks must be completed within specific budgets and deadlines. Shifts focus from average efficiency to maximizing probability of workflow completion under explicit constraints.

entry.title: iTRIALSPACE: Programmable Virtual Lesion Trials for Controlled Evaluation of Lung CT Models

author.name: Fakrul Islam Tushar, Umme Hafsa Momy, Joseph Y. Lo, Geoffrey D. Rubin

entry.summary: Introduces iTRIALSPACE, a programmable evaluation framework for lung CT models that creates controlled virtual lesion trials using ControlNet-conditioned CT synthesis. Enables systematic evaluation across 54 nodule attributes from 13,140 annotated nodules.

entry.title: VideoRouter: Query-Adaptive Dual Routing for Efficient Long-Video Understanding

author.name: Kuanwei Lin, Wenhao Zhang, Ge Li

entry.summary: Presents VideoRouter, a query-adaptive dual-router framework for efficient long-video understanding that allocates visual tokens based on where evidence is distributed temporally. Uses semantic and image routers for budget-aware evidence allocation.

entry.title: Think, then Score: Decoupled Reasoning and Scoring for Video Reward Modeling

author.name: Yuan Wang, Ouxiang Li, Yulong Xu, Borui Liao, Jiajun Liang, Jinghan Li, Meng Wang, Xintao Wang, Pengfei Wang, Kuien Liu, Xiang Wang

entry.summary: Proposes decoupled reasoning and scoring for video reward models, separating Chain-of-Thought reasoning from reward prediction. Aims to combine interpretability of generative RMs with accuracy of discriminative RMs.

entry.title: Whole-body CT attenuation and volume charts from routine clinical scans via evidence-grounded LLM report filtering

author.name: Christian Wachinger, Bernhard Renger, Christopher Sp\"ath, Jan Kirschke, Marcus Makowski

entry.summary: Uses an LLM ensemble to filter pathological findings from 350,000+ CT radiology reports, enabling construction of healthy reference distributions for organ volume and tissue attenuation across age and sex.

entry.title: Metonymy in vision models undermines attention-based interpretability

author.name: Ananthu Aniraj, Cassio F. Dantas, Dino Ienco, Massimiliano Mancini, Diego Marcos

entry.summary: Demonstrates that modern vision models exhibit 'metonymy' - the latent representation of an object part encodes information about distant parts, violating the locality assumption that underpins attention-based interpretability methods.

entry.title: MedHorizon: Towards Long-context Medical Video Understanding in the Wild

author.name: Bodong Du, Bowen Liu, Yang Yu, Xinpeng Ding, Zhiheng Wu, Shuning Wang, Shuo Nie, Naiming Liu, Qifeng Chen, Yangqiu Song, Xiaomeng Li

entry.summary: MedHorizon is a benchmark for long-context medical video understanding preserving 759 hours of full-length clinical procedures with 1,253 evidence-grounded questions requiring temporal localization before reasoning.

entry.title: Large Vision-Language Models Get Lost in Attention

author.name: Gongli Xi, Ye Tian, Mengyu Yang, Huahui Yi, Liang Lin, Xiaoshuai Hao, Kun Wang, Wendong Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a unified information-theoretic and geometric framework to analyze attention and MLP modules in LVLMs, revealing that attention preserves subspaces while MLPs inject new information, providing theoretical grounding for optimization.

entry.title: OA-WAM: Object-Addressable World Action Model for Robust Robot Manipulation

author.name: Yushan Liu, Peibo Sun, Shoujie Li, Yifan Xie, Lingfeng Zhang, Xintao Chao, Shiyuan Dong, Fang Chen, Xiao-Ping Zhang, Wenbo Ding

entry.summary: Proposes OA-WAM, which decomposes world action model predictions into object-addressable slot states (robot slot + N object slots) with persistent address vectors and time-varying content vectors, enabling robust object-referenced manipulation under scene shifts.

entry.title: Structural Correspondence and Universal Approximation in Diagonal plus Low-Rank Neural Networks

author.name: Ying Chen, Aoxi Li, Jihun Kim, Javad Lavaei

entry.summary: Studies the expressive power of diagonal plus low-rank neural networks, showing that purely low-rank layers collapse for function approximation but diagonal+low-rank structure achieves universal approximation with parameter efficiency.

entry.title: Do Neural Operators Forget Geometry? The Forgetting Hypothesis in Deep Operator Learning

author.name: Yanming Xia, Angelica I. Aviles-Rivero

entry.summary: Formalizes the Geometric Forgetting Hypothesis: neural operators progressively lose access to domain geometry with depth due to Markovian structure, and proposes geometric residual injection to counteract it.

entry.title: MANTRA: Synthesizing SMT-Validated Compliance Benchmarks for Tool-Using LLM Agents

author.name: Ashwani Anand, Ivi Chatzi, Ritam Raha, Anne-Kathrin Schmuck

entry.summary: Presents MANTRA, a framework for automatically synthesizing SMT-validated compliance benchmarks from natural-language manuals and tool schemas to evaluate tool-using LLM agents.

entry.title: CAR: Query-Guided Confidence-Aware Reranking for Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Zhipeng Song, Yizhi Zhou, Xiangyu Kong, Jiulong Jiao, Xuezhou Ye, Chunqi Gao, Xueqing Shi, Yuhang Zhou, Heng Qi

entry.summary: Proposes CAR, a training-free reranking framework for RAG that uses generator confidence change as a document usefulness signal, promoting documents that increase answer confidence and demoting those that decrease it.

entry.title: Adaptive Q-Chunking for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Nandiraju Gireesh, Yuanliang Ju, He Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Q-Chunking (AQC) for offline-to-online RL that dynamically selects action chunk sizes based on state context, using advantage comparison to resolve discount-scale mismatch between different chunk lengths.

entry.title: Matrix-Decoupled Concentration for Autoregressive Sequences: Dimension-Free Guarantees for Sparse Long-Context Rewards

author.name: Pei-Sen Li

entry.summary: Establishes sharp McDiarmid-type concentration bounds for autoregressive LLM sequences that avoid the O(N) variance inflation of classical methods for sparse terminal rewards.

entry.title: Geometry-Aware Simplicial Message Passing

author.name: Elena Xinyi Wang, Bastian Rieck

entry.summary: Introduces Geometric Simplicial Weisfeiler-Lehman (GSWL) test that incorporates vertex coordinates into simplicial complex color refinement, enabling geometry-aware message passing beyond standard WL.

entry.title: Taming the Entropy Cliff: Variable Codebook Size Quantization for Autoregressive Visual Generation

author.name: Bowen Zheng, Weijian Luo, Guang Yang, Colin Zhang, Tianyang Hu

entry.summary: Proposes variable codebook sizes across token positions for visual tokenizers, identifying the 'Entropy Cliff' phenomenon where conditional entropy drops to near-zero after the first few positions, making large fixed codebooks wasteful.

entry.title: A$^2$TGPO: Agentic Turn-Group Policy Optimization with Adaptive Turn-level Clipping

author.name: Dingwei Chen, Zefang Zong, Zhipeng Ma, Leo Luo, Yang Li, Chengming Li, Peng Chen, Jie Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes A²TGPO for agentic LLM RL that uses turn-group policy optimization with adaptive clipping and Information Gain signals for better credit assignment in multi-turn tool-calling interactions.

entry.title: EgoEMG: A Multimodal Egocentric Dataset with Bilateral EMG and Vision for Hand Pose Estimation

author.name: Ziheng Xi, Jiayi Yu, Yitao Wang, Yanbo Duan, Jianjiang Feng, Jie Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces EgoEMG, the first dataset synchronizing bilateral wrist EMG with egocentric video for bimanual hand pose estimation, covering 41 participants performing 60 gestures with comprehensive sensor suite.

entry.title: Render, Don't Decode: Weight-Space World Models with Latent Structural Disentanglement

author.name: Roussel Desmond Nzoyem, Mauro Comi

entry.summary: NOVA represents world model states as weights of implicit neural representations (INRs), enabling analytical rendering without decoder networks while providing compactness, portability, and zero-shot super-resolution.

entry.title: Temporal Reasoning Is Not the Bottleneck: A Probabilistic Inconsistency Framework for Neuro-Symbolic QA

author.name: Tran Quang Liem

entry.summary: Challenges the prevailing narrative that temporal reasoning is the fundamental bottleneck in LLMs, arguing instead that the failure lies in unstructured text-to-event representation. Introduces a neuro-symbolic QA framework with a Probabilistic Inconsistency Signal that decouples perceptual errors from reasoning failures.

entry.title: Executable World Models for ARC-AGI-3 in the Era of Coding Agents

author.name: Sergey Rodionov

entry.summary: Evaluates a coding-agent system for ARC-AGI-3 that maintains an executable Python world model, verifies against observations, refactors toward simpler abstractions (MDL-like bias), and plans through the model. Reports results on 25 public ARC-AGI-3 games.

entry.title: FASQ: Flexible Accelerated Subspace Quantization for Calibration-Free LLM Compression

author.name: Ye Qiao, Yian Wang, Zhiheng Chen, Hyoukjun Kwon, Sitao Huang

entry.summary: Presents FASQ, a calibration-free LLM compression framework using product quantization that provides continuous compression ratios (27-49% model size) beyond fixed bit-width schemes. Surpasses 4-bit GPTQ and AWQ on Llama-3-8B.

entry.title: LLMs Uncertainty Quantification via Adaptive Conformal Semantic Entropy

author.name: Hamed Karimi, Vaishali Meyappan, Reza Samavi

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Conformal Semantic Entropy (ACSE) for LLM uncertainty quantification, adaptively measuring semantic dispersion by clustering semantic entropy of diverse responses to the same prompt.

entry.title: Worst-Case Discovery and Runtime Protection for RL-Based Network Controllers

author.name: Hongyu H\`e, Minhao Jin, Maria Apostolaki

entry.summary: Presents ReGuard, a framework that discovers worst-case scenarios for RL-based network controllers and protects them at inference time without retraining. Uses bilevel regret-maximization to find failure cases and provides certified lower bounds on worst-case performance.

entry.title: Average Attention Transformers and Arithmetic Circuits

author.name: Lena Ehrmuth, Laura Strieker

entry.summary: Analyzes the computational power of average attention transformers, showing they can simulate arithmetic circuits given as input, establishing connections between transformer expressiveness and circuit complexity classes.

entry.title: Evolving Idea Graphs with Learnable Edits-and-Commits for Multi-Agent Scientific Ideation

author.name: Jiangwen Dong, Bo Li, Wanyu Lin

entry.summary: Introduces Evolving Idea Graphs (EIG), a graph-based multi-agent framework for scientific ideation where nodes capture claims and edges encode relations, with learnable edit-and-commit operations for iterative refinement.

entry.title: When Does Gene Regulatory Network Inference Break? A Controlled Diagnostic Study of Causal and Correlational Methods on Single-Cell Data

author.name: Miguel Fernandez-de-Retana, Ruben Sanchez-Corcuera, Unai Zulaika, Aritz Bilbao-Jayo, Aitor Almeida

entry.summary: Introduces a controlled diagnostic framework to understand when and why causal methods fail compared to correlation-based baselines for gene regulatory network inference from single-cell data, isolating seven biologically motivated pathologies.

entry.title: Why Geometric Continuity Emerges in Deep Neural Networks: Residual Connections and Rotational Symmetry Breaking

author.name: Kyungwon Jeong, Won-Gi Paeng, Honggyo Suh

entry.summary: Explains why weight matrices in deep networks exhibit geometric continuity (similar singular vectors across layers) through two mechanisms: residual connections creating gradient coherence and symmetry-breaking nonlinearities constraining layers to a shared coordinate frame.

entry.title: Piper: Efficient Large-Scale MoE Training via Resource Modeling and Pipelined Hybrid Parallelism

author.name: Sajal Dash, Feiyi Wang

entry.summary: Develops Piper, a system for efficient large-scale MoE training that addresses memory, communication, and workload imbalance challenges through mathematical resource modeling and pipelined hybrid parallelism on HPC platforms.

entry.title: Continual Knowledge Updating in LLM Systems: Learning Through Multi-Timescale Memory Dynamics

author.name: Andreas Pattichis, Constantine Dovrolis

entry.summary: Proposes Memini, a bio-inspired external memory system for LLMs using coupled multi-timescale dynamics (fast/slow variables based on Benna-Fusi synaptic consolidation) that enables episodic sensitivity, gradual consolidation, and selective forgetting.

entry.title: SAT: Sequential Agent Tuning for Coordinator Free Plug and Play Multi-LLM Training with Monotonic Improvement Guarantees

author.name: Yi Xie, Yangyang Xu, Yi Fan, Bo Liu

entry.summary: Introduces Sequential Agent Tuning (SAT), a coordinator-free training paradigm for teams of smaller LLMs that uses block-coordinate updates with monotonic improvement guarantees, avoiding distribution shift issues of joint training.

entry.title: Structural Instability of Feature Composition

author.name: Yunpeng Zhou

entry.summary: Analyzes the instability of compositional steering with Sparse Autoencoders through a geometric framework, deriving a compositional-collapse threshold and characterizing conditions where simultaneously activating multiple features breaks down.

entry.title: Information Theoretic Adversarial Training of Large Language Models

author.name: Yiwei Zhang, Jeremiah Birrell, Reza Ebrahimi, Rouzbeh Behnia, Jason Pacheco, Elisa Bertino

entry.summary: Proposes WARDEN, a distributionally robust adversarial training framework for LLMs that dynamically reweights adversarial examples using information-theoretic principles to improve robustness against jailbreaks.

entry.title: GRALIS: A Unified Canonical Framework for Linear Attribution Methods via Riesz Representation

author.name: Raimondo Fanale

entry.summary: Presents GRALIS, a unified mathematical framework using Riesz Representation Theorem to prove that SHAP, IG, LIME and linearized GradCAM all admit a canonical representation, enabling formal comparison and simultaneous guarantees.

entry.title: Shortcut Solutions Learned by Transformers Impair Continual Compositional Reasoning

author.name: William T. Redman, Erik C. Johnson, Brian Robinson

entry.summary: Investigates how Transformers develop shortcut solutions that impair their ability to continually learn compositional reasoning tasks. Extends the LEGO framework to a continual learning setting to systematically study representation reuse across related tasks.

entry.title: Towards Scalable One-Step Generative Modeling for Autoregressive Dynamical System Forecasting

author.name: Tianyue Yang, Xiao Xue

entry.summary: Proposes MeLISA, a latent-free autoregressive generative surrogate for physical dynamics forecasting built on pixel-space MeanFlow, designed for one-step generation that preserves long-term statistical structure.

entry.title: Optimal Contextual Pricing under Agnostic Non-Lipschitz Demand

author.name: Jianyu Xu, Yu-Xiang Wang

entry.summary: Achieves optimal O(T^{2/3}) regret for contextual dynamic pricing with non-Lipschitz demand curves, improving over previous O(T^{3/4}) results and matching known lower bounds.

entry.title: A Measure-Theoretic Finite-Sample Theory for Adaptive-Data Fitted Q-Iteration

author.name: Manuel Haussmann, Mustafa Mert \c{C}elikok, Melih Kandemir

entry.summary: Bridges the gap between theoretical RL foundations and practical deep RL by combining measure-theoretic MDP analysis, deterministic error propagation, and PAC generalization bounds for fitted Q-iteration.

entry.title: Multi-agent decision making: A Blackwell's informativeness approach

author.name: Zheng Zhang, Cuong C. Nguyen, Kevin Wells, Gustavo Carneiro

entry.summary: Applies Blackwell's informativeness framework to analyze multi-agent LLM decision making, proving that voting and debate are no more informative than pooled Bayesian posterior maximization.

entry.title: One Algorithm, Two Goals: Dual Scoring for Parameter and Data Selection in LLM Fine-Tuning

author.name: Xinrui Chen, Liu Yang, Ou Wu

entry.summary: Casts parameter and data selection in LLM fine-tuning as bilevel optimization problems sharing a common scoring rule, showing parameter importance and data utility are row-wise and column-wise aggregations of a single gradient interaction matrix.

entry.title: Topological Signatures of Grokking

author.name: Yifan Tang, Qiquan Wang, In\'es Garc\'ia-Redondo, Anthea Monod

entry.summary: Studies grokking through persistent homology, identifying a topological signature (sharp increase in H1 persistence) that coincides with grokking on modular arithmetic tasks and reflects emergence of cyclic structure.

entry.title: Memory Efficient Full-gradient Attacks (MEFA) Framework for Adversarial Defense Evaluations

author.name: Yuan Du, Mitchel Hill, HanQin Cai

entry.summary: Shows that gradient checkpointing enables exact full-gradient attacks through long diffusion purification trajectories, providing more rigorous robustness evaluation of stochastic purification defenses than approximate backpropagation.

entry.title: MinMax Recurrent Neural Cascades

author.name: Alessandro Ronca

entry.summary: Shows that MinMax algebra provides recurrence that is expressively powerful (all regular languages), efficiently parallelizable (log-time), and free from vanishing/exploding gradients, forming MinMax Recurrent Neural Cascades.

entry.title: Efficient Serving for Dynamic Agent Workflows with Prediction-based KV-Cache Management

author.name: Haoyu Zheng, Fangcheng Fu, Jia Wu, Binhang Yuan, Yongqiang Zhang, Hao Wang, Yuanyuan Zhu, Xiao Yan, Jiawei Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes PBKV for efficient LLM agent workflow serving that predicts agent invocation sequences in dynamic workflows and manages KV-Cache reuse accordingly, addressing limitations of static workflow assumptions.

entry.title: PACZero: PAC-Private Fine-Tuning of Language Models via Sign Quantization

author.name: Murat Bilgehan Ertan, Xiaochen Zhu, Phuong Ha Nguyen, Marten van Dijk, Srinivas Devadas

entry.summary: Introduces PACZero, a PAC-private zeroth-order mechanism for fine-tuning LLMs that achieves zero mutual information privacy while maintaining usable utility. This achieves MIA resistance that differential privacy only matches at epsilon=0.

entry.title: Diffusion-Based Posterior Sampling: A Feynman-Kac Analysis of Bias and Stability

author.name: Matias G. Delgadino, Sebastien Motsch, Advait Parulekar, William Porteous, Sanjay Shakkottai

entry.summary: Provides theoretical characterization of bias in diffusion-based posterior samplers using Feynman-Kac analysis. Identifies which posterior geometries concentrate bias and derives explicit path expectation corrections.

entry.title: Weight-Decay Turns Transformer Loss Landscapes Villani: Functional-Analytic Foundations for Optimization and Generalization

author.name: Abhijit Das, Sayantan Dutta

entry.summary: Provides the first rigorous functional-analytic proof that the standard Transformer loss with weight decay satisfies Villani's criteria for coercive energy functions, deriving exponential convergence guarantees for Langevin training.

entry.title: When No Benchmark Exists: Validating Comparative LLM Safety Scoring Without Ground-Truth Labels

author.name: Sushant Gautam, Finn Schwall, Annika Willoch Olstad, Fernando Vallecillos Ruiz, Birk Torpmann-Hagen, Sunniva Maria Stordal Bj{\o}rklund, Leon Moonen, Klas Pettersen, Michael A. Riegler

entry.summary: Formalizes 'benchmarkless comparative safety scoring' for LLMs when no labeled safety benchmark exists for the target language/sector. Proposes an instrumental-validity chain using controlled contrasts and variance analysis.

entry.title: DexSim2Real: Foundation Model-Guided Sim-to-Real Transfer for Generalizable Dexterous Manipulation

author.name: Zijian Zeng, Fei Ding, Huiming Yang, Xianwei Li, Yuhao Liao

entry.summary: Presents DexSim2Real, a framework using vision-language foundation models to bridge sim-to-real transfer for dexterous manipulation, combining FM-guided domain randomization with visual realism criticism.

entry.title: Architecture Matters: Comparing RAG Systems under Knowledge Base Poisoning

author.name: Samuel Korn

entry.summary: Evaluates four RAG architectures (vanilla, agentic, MADAM-RAG, recursive LMs) under adversarial knowledge base poisoning, finding that architecture significantly affects robustness to attacks.

entry.title: DBMSolver: A Training-free Diffusion Bridge Sampler for High-Quality Image-to-Image Translation

author.name: Sankarshana Venugopal (Seoul National University), Mohammad Mostafavi (Seoul National University), Jonghyun Choi (Seoul National University)

entry.summary: Introduces DBMSolver, a training-free sampler for Diffusion Bridge Models that uses exponential integrators to reduce function evaluations by up to 5x while improving quality (53% FID reduction) for image-to-image translation tasks.

entry.title: Gaming the Metric, Not the Harm: Certifying Safety Audits against Strategic Platform Manipulation

author.name: Florian A. D. Burnat, Brittany I. Davidson

entry.summary: Formalizes how online safety platforms can game audit metrics by routing through semantically equivalent content variants, and proves that any metric scoring variants directly is manipulable. Proposes class-level aggregation as a defense.

entry.title: Beyond the Independence Assumption: Finite-Sample Guarantees for Deep Q-Learning under $\tau$-Mixing

author.name: Leon Halgryn (University of Twente), Sophie Langer (Ruhr-Universit\"at Bochum), Janusz M. Meylahn (University of Twente), E. Moritz Hahn (University of Twente)

entry.summary: Extends DQN finite-sample analysis to dependent data by modeling replay buffer minibatches as τ-mixing processes, providing the first risk bounds for deep Q-learning that don't assume independence.

entry.title: ReActor: Reinforcement Learning for Physics-Aware Motion Retargeting

author.name: David M\"uller, Agon Serifi, Sammy Christen, Ruben Grandia, Espen Knoop, Moritz B\"acher

entry.summary: Proposes a bilevel optimization framework (ReActor) that jointly adapts human reference motions to robot morphology while training a tracking policy via RL. It eliminates manual tuning by using approximate gradients and sparse semantic correspondences, addressing physical inconsistencies like foot sliding and self-collisions.

entry.title: Superintelligent Retrieval Agent: The Next Frontier of Information Retrieval

author.name: Zeyu Yang, Qi Ma, Jason Chen, Anshumali Shrivastava

entry.summary: Introduces SIRA (SuperIntelligent Retrieval Agent), which compresses multi-round exploratory search into single corpus-discriminative retrieval actions by building strong priors about terminology and evidence locations in large knowledge bases.

entry.title: A Few Good Clauses: Comparing LLMs vs Domain-Trained Small Language Models on Structured Contract Extraction

author.name: Nicole Lincoln, Nick Whitehouse, Jaron Mar, Rivindu Perera

entry.summary: Demonstrates that a domain-trained small language model (Olava Extract) can outperform frontier LLMs on structured contract extraction with 78-97% lower inference cost and higher precision, reducing hallucinations in legal workflows.

entry.title: SEQUOR: A Multi-Turn Benchmark for Realistic Constraint Following

author.name: Beatriz Canaverde, Duarte M. Alves, Jos\'e Pombal, Giuseppe Attanasio, Andr\'e F. T. Martins

entry.summary: Introduces SEQUOR, a benchmark for evaluating constraint adherence in long multi-turn conversations, showing that instruction-following accuracy drops over 11% as conversations grow longer, even for single constraints.

entry.title: PRAISE: Prefix-Based Rollout Reuse in Agentic Search Training

author.name: Erhan Zhang, Yiqun Chen, Zechun Niu, Wei Yang, Xiaochi Wei, Yan Gao, Yi Wu, Yao Hu, Jiaxin Mao

entry.summary: Presents PRAISE, which reuses prefix rollouts from complete search trajectories and introduces intermediate step rewards to improve data efficiency and credit assignment in agentic search training with RL.

entry.title: FinRAG-12B: A Production-Validated Recipe for Grounded Question Answering in Banking

author.name: Denys Katerenchuk, Pablo Duboue, Keelan Evanini, David Gondek, Nithin Govindugari, Olivier Allauzen, Joshua Baptiste, David J More, Joshua Schechter

entry.summary: Presents FinRAG-12B, a production-validated 12B model for grounded QA in banking that outperforms GPT-4.1 on citation grounding, trained with only 143M tokens using LLM-as-Judge filtering and curriculum learning.

entry.title: MobileEgo Anywhere: Open Infrastructure for long horizon egocentric data on commodity hardware

author.name: Senthil Palanisamy, Abhishek Anand, Satpal Singh Rathor, Pratyush Patnaik, Shubhanshu Khatana

entry.summary: Introduces MobileEgo Anywhere, a framework for collecting hour-plus egocentric trajectories using commodity smartphones for training Vision Language Action models. Addresses the gap between short-episode existing datasets and the long-horizon data needs of robotic task learning.

entry.title: MASPO: Joint Prompt Optimization for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Zhexuan Wang, Xuebo Liu, Li Wang, Zifei Shan, Yutong Wang, Zhenxi Song, Min Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces MASPO, a framework for jointly optimizing prompts across multiple agents in multi-agent LLM systems. Uses a joint evaluation mechanism that assesses prompts by their capacity to facilitate downstream success for successor agents, not just local validity.

entry.title: Query2Uncertainty: Robust Uncertainty Quantification and Calibration for 3D Object Detection under Distribution Shift

author.name: Till Beemelmanns, Alexey Nekrasov, Stefan Vilceanu, Jonas Steinhaus, Timo Woopen, Bastian Leibe, Lutz Eckstein

entry.summary: Introduces density-aware calibration for 3D object detection that uses feature density of latent object queries from DETR-style detectors to adjust confidences under distribution shift. Addresses poor calibration of modern 3D detectors in out-of-distribution scenarios.

entry.title: RealCam: Real-Time Novel-View Video Generation with Interactive Camera Control

author.name: Youcan Xu, Jiaxin Shi, Zhen Wang, Wensong Song, Feifei Shao, Chen Liang, Jun Xiao, Long Chen

entry.summary: Introduces RealCam, an autoregressive framework for real-time camera-controlled video-to-video generation that overcomes the limitations of bidirectional attention approaches. Enables interactive viewpoint synthesis from monocular footage with streaming compatibility.

entry.title: DynT2I-Eval: A Dynamic Evaluation Framework for Text-to-Image Models

author.name: Juntong Wang, Jiarui Wang, Huiyu Duan, Lewei Li, Guangtao Zhai, Xiongkuo Min

entry.summary: DynT2I-Eval proposes a dynamic evaluation framework for text-to-image models that continuously generates fresh prompts via structured visual semantic spaces and difficulty-aware sampling, avoiding benchmark contamination.

entry.title: EA-WM: Event-Aware Generative World Model with Structured Kinematic-to-Visual Action Fields

author.name: Zhaoyang Yang, Yurun Jin, Lizhe Qi, Cong Huang, Kai Chen

entry.summary: EA-WM presents an Event-Aware Generative World Model for robotics that uses structured kinematic-to-visual action fields to close the loop between kinematic control and visual perception in video diffusion-based world models.

entry.title: DCR: Counterfactual Attractor Guidance for Rare Compositional Generation

author.name: Taewon Kang, Matthias Zwicker

entry.summary: DCR (Default Completion Repulsion) identifies and addresses 'default completion bias' in diffusion models where rare but valid compositions collapse toward common alternatives, using counterfactual guidance to suppress this tendency.

entry.title: Creative Robot Tool Use by Counterfactual Reasoning

author.name: M. Tuluhan Akbulut, Varun Satheesh, Ahmed Jaafar, Alper Ahmetoglu, Shane Parr, Aditya Ganeshan, Shivam Vats, George Konidaris

entry.summary: Proposes a causal reasoning framework for creative robot tool use, combining VLM-based feature suggestion with counterfactual tool generation to identify causal features and transfer tool-use skills to novel objects.

entry.title: RobotEQ: Transitioning from Passive Intelligence to Active Intelligence in Embodied AI

author.name: Kuofei Fang, Xinyi Che, Haomin Ouyang, Shufan Zhang, Xuehao Wang, Qi Liu, Liyi Liu, Chenqi Zhang, Wenxi Cai, Wenyu Dai, Jinyang Wu, Fan Zhang, Haoyu Chen, Bin He, Zheng Lian

entry.summary: Introduces RobotEQ, the first benchmark for 'active intelligence' in embodied AI, testing whether robots can understand and follow social norms without explicit user instructions. The dataset includes 1,900 egocentric images across 10 embodied categories and 56 subcategories.

entry.title: Detecting Changes in Causal Dependence with Kernels and Copulas

author.name: Shakeel Gavioli-Akilagun, Kieran Wood, Francesco Quinzan

entry.summary: Proposes a fully non-parametric framework for detecting whether the causal dependence of an outcome Y on a covariate X changes at a given time point, using kernels and copulas to handle unknown causal mechanisms and confounders.

entry.title: Does Synthetic Data Help? Empirical Evidence from Deep Learning Time Series Forecasters

author.name: Hugo Cazaux, Eyj\'olfur Ingi \'Asgeirsson, Hlynur Stef\'ansson

entry.summary: Large-scale empirical study showing synthetic data augmentation for time series forecasting is architecture-conditional: channel-mixing models benefit while channel-independent models are degraded.

entry.title: Budget-aware Auto Optimizer Configurator

author.name: Kang Liu, Wei Peng, Jianchen Hu

entry.summary: Proposes Budget-Aware Optimizer Configurator (BAOC) that assigns different optimizer configurations to individual network blocks based on gradient behavior analysis, reducing memory costs while maintaining performance.

entry.title: A Foundation Model for Zero-Shot Logical Rule Induction

author.name: Yin Jun Phua

entry.summary: Introduces Neural Rule Inducer (NRI), a pretrained model for zero-shot rule induction in ILP that uses domain-agnostic statistical properties rather than literal identities. Features a statistical encoder and parallel slot-based decoder that generalizes across tasks without retraining.

entry.title: RetentiveKV: State-Space Memory for Uncertainty-Aware Multimodal KV Cache Eviction

author.name: Sihao Liu, YuFan Xiong, Zhonghua Jiang, Zhaode Wang, chengfei lv Shengyu Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes RetentiveKV, an entropy-driven KV cache optimization for multimodal LLMs that addresses 'deferred importance' of visual tokens and spatial continuity of visual cues, using state-space memory for uncertainty-aware eviction.

entry.title: Detecting Deepfakes via Hamiltonian Dynamics

author.name: Harry Cheng, Ming-Hui Liu, Tianyi Wang, Weili Guan, Liqiang Nie, Mohan Kankanhalli

entry.summary: Proposes a physics-inspired deepfake detection approach using Hamiltonian dynamics and stability analysis. Hypothesizes that natural images settle near stable low-energy equilibria while deepfakes occupy unstable high-energy states, moving from static pattern recognition to dynamical analysis.

entry.title: Predictive and Prescriptive AI toward Optimizing Wildfire Suppression

author.name: Leonard Boussioux, Alexandre Jacquillat, Ryne Reger, Jacob Wachspress

entry.summary: Develops a predictive and prescriptive AI approach for wildfire suppression resource allocation, formulating an integer optimization model with crew assignments on time-space-rest networks and wildfire dynamics, solved via branch-and-price-and-cut.

entry.title: Dream-MPC: Gradient-Based Model Predictive Control with Latent Imagination

author.name: Jonathan Spieler, Sven Behnke

entry.summary: Proposes Dream-MPC, combining gradient-based Model Predictive Control with learned world models in latent space. Addresses the empirical underperformance of gradient-based methods compared to gradient-free alternatives in model-based RL.

entry.title: Beyond Retrieval: A Multitask Benchmark and Model for Code Search

author.name: Siqiao Xue, Zihan Liao, Jin Qin, Ziyin Zhang, Yixiang Mu, Fan Zhou, Hang Yu

entry.summary: Introduces CoREB, a contamination-limited multitask code retrieval and reranking benchmark with graded relevance judgments across five programming languages, addressing data contamination and binary relevance limitations of existing benchmarks.

entry.title: StoryAlign: Evaluating and Training Reward Models for Story Generation

author.name: Haotian Xia, Hao Peng, Yunjia Qi, Xiaozhi Wang, Bin Xu, Lei Hou, Juanzi Li

entry.summary: Introduces StoryRMB, the first benchmark for assessing reward models on story preferences with 1,133 human-verified instances, and studies systematic evaluation of human story preference modeling for LLM-generated narratives.

entry.title: Horizon-Constrained Rashomon Sets for Chaotic Forecasting

author.name: Gauri Kale, Rahul Vishwakarma, Holly Diamond, Ava Hedayatipour, Amin Rezaei

entry.summary: Introduces horizon-constrained Rashomon sets that characterize how model multiplicity evolves with prediction horizon in chaotic systems, proving exponential contraction of equivalent models with lead time governed by Lyapunov exponents.

entry.title: MACS: Modality-Aware Capacity Scaling for Efficient Multimodal MoE Inference

author.name: Bo Li, Chuan Wu, shaolin Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes MACS, a training-free inference framework for MoE multimodal LLMs that addresses the straggler effect by using entropy-weighted load balancing to handle information heterogeneity and modality dynamics.

entry.title: Neural Co-state Policies: Structuring Hidden States in Recurrent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: David Leeftink, Max Hinne, Marcel van Gerven

entry.summary: Establishes formal connection between hidden states in recurrent RL policies and Pontryagin co-states from optimal control, enabling interpretation of latent representations as Hamiltonian minimization.

entry.title: MOSAIC: Module Discovery via Sparse Additive Identifiable Causal Learning for Scientific Time Series

author.name: Shicheng Fan, Nour Elhendawy, Jianle Sun, Ke Fang, Kun Zhang, Yihang Wang, Lu Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes MOSAIC for causal representation learning in scientific time series, aiming to discover interpretable modular structure from observational data rather than relying on post-hoc alignment with ground truth factors.

entry.title: Adversarial Graph Neural Network Benchmarks: Towards Practical and Fair Evaluation

author.name: Tran Gia Bao Ngo, Zulfikar Alom, Federico Errica, Murat Kantarcioglu, Cuneyt Gurcan Akcora

entry.summary: Provides a comprehensive benchmark for adversarial attacks and defenses on Graph Neural Networks, demonstrating that inconsistent experimental settings in the literature lead to contradictory conclusions.

entry.title: Distributionally Robust Multi-Objective Optimization

author.name: Yufeng Yang, Fangning Zhuo, Ziyi Chen, Heng Huang, Yi Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces distributionally robust multi-objective optimization (DR-MOO) that minimizes multiple objectives under worst-case distributions, with multi-gradient descent algorithms achieving O(ε^{-4}) sample complexity.

entry.title: HCInfer: An Efficient Inference System via Error Compensation for Resource-Constrained Devices

author.name: Shen Xu, Xiangwen Zhuge, Zhe Xu, Yingkun Hu, Zheng Yang, Yunhao Liu

entry.summary: Proposes HCInfer, a heterogeneous inference system that offloads error compensation (LoRA-style branches) to CPU while executing the compressed main model on GPU, achieving accuracy recovery with efficient throughput.

entry.title: Hypothesis generation and updating in large language models

author.name: Hua-Dong Xiong

entry.summary: Studies how LLMs perform hypothesis generation and updating in controlled settings (the number game), comparing LLM behavior against Bayesian baselines for inferring rules from positive examples.

entry.title: Quadratic Objective Perturbation: Curvature-Based Differential Privacy

author.name: Daniel Cortild, Coralia Cartis

entry.summary: Introduces Quadratic Objective Perturbation (QOP) for differentially private ERM that perturbs the objective with a random quadratic form instead of a linear term, removing the bounded gradient assumption.

entry.title: Sharper Guarantees for Misspecified Kernelized Bandit Optimization

author.name: Davide Maran, Csaba Szepesv\'ari

entry.summary: Provides sharper guarantees for misspecified kernelized bandit optimization, reducing the misspecification amplification from polynomial to logarithmic growth for a large class of kernels.

entry.title: Playing the network backward: A Game Theoretic Attribution Framework

author.name: Jakob Paul Zimmermann, Jim Berend, Georg Loho, Sebastian Lapuschkin, Wojciech Samek

entry.summary: Recasts backward attribution methods (gradients, LRP, etc.) as two-player games on extended network graphs, providing a unified framework where attribution maps emerge as projections of trajectory distributions under specific equilibria.

entry.title: The Weight Gram Matrix Captures Sequential Feature Linearization in Deep Networks

author.name: Taehun Cha, Daniel Beaglehole, Adityanarayanan Radhakrishnan, Donghun Lee

entry.summary: Proposes the Feature Learning Equation identifying the weight Gram matrix as the key object capturing feature dynamics in neural network training, introducing Target Linearity to measure linear alignment of features across layers.

entry.title: A Flow Matching Algorithm for Many-Shot Adaptation to Unseen Distributions

author.name: Tyler Ingebrand, Ruihan Zhao, Kushagra Gupta, David Fridovich-Keil, Sandeep P. Chinchali, Ufuk Topcu

entry.summary: Proposes Function Projection for Flow Matching (FP-FM) that adapts generative models to new target distributions via least-squares projection onto learned basis functions spanning velocity fields, enabling efficient many-shot adaptation without retraining.

entry.title: When Does $\ell_2$-Boosting Overfit Benignly? High-Dimensional Risk Asymptotics and the $\ell_1$ Implicit Bias

author.name: Ye Su, Jian Li, Yong Liu

entry.summary: Characterizes high-dimensional risk of continuous-time l2-Boosting, proving that benign overfitting fails at the linear rate under l1 implicit bias—greedy coordinate selection prevents the benign interpolation seen in l2 geometry.

entry.title: Is Escalation Worth It? A Decision-Theoretic Characterization of LLM Cascades

author.name: Dylan Bouchard

entry.summary: Develops a decision-theoretic framework for LLM cascades, establishing piecewise concavity of the cost-quality frontier and characterizing optimal deferral strategies for model pools beyond two models.

entry.title: A Unified Pair-GRPO Family: From Implicit to Explicit Preference Constraints for Stable and General RL Alignment

author.name: Hao Yu

entry.summary: Proposes a unified Pair-GRPO framework for LLM alignment with implicit (Soft) and explicit (Hard) pairwise preference constraints, proving gradient properties and addressing instability in standard RLHF.

entry.title: Efficient Techniques for Data Reconstruction, with Finite-Width Recovery Guarantees

author.name: Edward Tansley, Roy Makhlouf, Estelle Massart, Coralia Cartis

entry.summary: Proposes a unified optimization formulation for data reconstruction attacks on neural networks and proves finite-width recovery guarantees using PAC-style bounds. Shows reduced width requirements when data lies in low-dimensional subspaces.

entry.title: Diverse Sampling in Diffusion Models with Marginal Preserving Particle Guidance

author.name: Gal Vinograd, Idan Achituve, Ethan Fetaya

entry.summary: Introduces EDDY, a guidance mechanism for diffusion models that promotes sample diversity while preserving marginal quality. Exploits symmetries of the Fokker-Planck equation using divergence-free dynamics with kernel-based anti-symmetric fields.

entry.title: Transformers Efficiently Perform In-Context Logistic Regression via Normalized Gradient Descent

author.name: Chenyang Zhang, Yuan Cao

entry.summary: Proves that transformers with softmax attention can perform in-context logistic regression, with each layer executing one step of normalized gradient descent. Shows this can be obtained through gradient descent training.

entry.title: BALAR : A Bayesian Agentic Loop for Active Reasoning

author.name: Aymen Echarghaoui, Dongxia Wu, Emily B. Fox

entry.summary: Proposes BALAR, a Bayesian agentic loop for active reasoning that maintains structured beliefs, selects questions via mutual information maximization, and dynamically expands state representations for multi-turn LLM interactions.

entry.title: Polarizable atomic multipoles for learning long-range electrostatics

author.name: Dongjin Kim, Daniel S. King, Yoonjae Park, Roya Savoj, Sebastien Hamel, Xiaoyu Wang, Bingqing Cheng

entry.summary: Introduces a semi-local framework for learning long-range electrostatics in machine learning interatomic potentials using polarizable atomic multipoles with linear response for non-local effects. Shows systematic improvements across four benchmarks and four MLIP architectures.

entry.title: Learning Discrete Autoregressive Priors with Wasserstein Gradient Flow

author.name: Bowen Zheng, Yihong Luo, Tianyang Hu

entry.summary: Proposes using Wasserstein gradient flow to jointly optimize discrete tokenizers and autoregressive priors, addressing the mismatch where tokens good for reconstruction may be hard for AR models to predict.

entry.title: The Interplay of Data Structure and Imbalance in the Learning Dynamics of Diffusion Models

author.name: Flavio Nicoletti, Chenxiao Ma, Enrico Ventura, Luca Saglietti, Stefano Sarao Mannelli

entry.summary: Develops analytical framework for understanding how class imbalance and data heterogeneity affect per-class learning dynamics in diffusion models, showing how these factors can exacerbate disparities between classes.

entry.title: Reconstruction or Semantics? What Makes a Latent Space Useful for Robotic World Models

author.name: Nilaksh, Saurav Jha, Artem Zholus, Sarath Chandar

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates reconstruction-based vs. semantic latent spaces for action-conditioned latent diffusion world models in robotics, comparing six encoders under a fixed protocol on BridgeV2 dataset.

entry.title: ActCam: Zero-Shot Joint Camera and 3D Motion Control for Video Generation

author.name: Omar El Khalifi, Thomas Rossi, Oscar Fossey, Thibault Fouque, Ulysse Mizrahi, Philip Torr, Ivan Laptev, Fabio Pizzati, Baptiste Bellot-Gurlet

entry.summary: Presents ActCam, a zero-shot method for video generation that jointly controls character motion transfer and per-frame camera parameters, building on pretrained image-to-video diffusion models with geometrically consistent conditioning.

entry.title: AdaGATE: Adaptive Gap-Aware Token-Efficient Evidence Assembly for Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Yilin Guo, Yinshan Wang, Yixuan Wang

entry.summary: Proposes AdaGATE, a training-free evidence controller for multi-hop RAG that frames evidence selection as a token-constrained repair problem, combining entity-centric gap tracking with utility-based selection to handle noisy retrieval.

entry.title: Decomposing the Basic Abilities of Large Language Models: Mitigating Cross-Task Interference in Multi-Task Instruct-Tuning

author.name: Bing Wang, Ximing Li, Changchun Li, Jinjin Chi, Gang Niu, Masashi Sugiyama

entry.summary: Proposes BADIT, which decomposes LLM capabilities into basic abilities and mitigates cross-task interference in multi-task instruction tuning by better managing shared vs. task-specific parameters.

entry.title: BioTool: A Comprehensive Tool-Calling Dataset for Enhancing Biomedical Capabilities of Large Language Models

author.name: Xin Gao, Ruiyi Zhang, Meixi Du, Peijia Qin, Pengtao Xie

entry.summary: Introduces BioTool, a comprehensive biomedical tool-calling dataset with 34 tools for fine-tuning LLMs to effectively leverage biomedical tools that clinical experts use in daily workflows.

entry.title: TableVista: Benchmarking Multimodal Table Reasoning under Visual and Structural Complexity

author.name: Zheyuan Yang, Liqiang Shang, Junjie Chen, Xun Yang, Chenglong Xu, Bo Yuan, Chenyuan Jiao, Yaoru Sun, Yilun Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces TableVista, a benchmark of 3,000 table reasoning problems expanded to 30,000 samples through visual variants, evaluating 29 foundation models on multimodal table reasoning under visual and structural complexity.

entry.title: Uncovering Entity Identity Confusion in Multimodal Knowledge Editing

author.name: Shu Wu, Xiaotian Ye, Xinyu Mou, Dongsheng Liu, Xiaohan Wang, Mengqi Zhang

entry.summary: Identifies Entity Identity Confusion (EIC) as a systemic failure in multimodal knowledge editing where text queries about original entities incorrectly return new entity information, and constructs EC-Bench to diagnose this issue.

entry.title: STALE: Can LLM Agents Know When Their Memories Are No Longer Valid?

author.name: Hanxiang Chao, Yihan Bai, Rui Sheng, Tianle Li, Yushi Sun

entry.summary: Introduces STALE, a benchmark of 400 expert-validated implicit conflict scenarios testing whether LLM agents can detect when stored memories are invalidated by new evidence without explicit negation.

entry.title: TheraAgent: Self-Improving Therapeutic Agent for Precise and Comprehensive Treatment Planning

author.name: Junkai Li, Yunghwei Lai, Tianyi Zhu, Zheng Long Lee, Weizhi Ma, Yang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes TheraAgent, an agentic framework for medical treatment planning that replaces one-shot LLM generation with an iterative generate-judge-refine pipeline. Mirrors human expert reasoning by progressively refining treatment plans for precision, completeness, and safety.

entry.title: EchoXFlow: A Beamspace Echocardiography Dataset for Cardiac Motion, Flow, and Function

author.name: Elias Stenhede, Joanna Sulkowska, Eivind Bj{\o}rkan Orstad, Henrik Schirmer, Arian Ranjbar

entry.summary: Introduces EchoXFlow, a clinical echocardiography dataset preserving native acquisition geometry (beamspace) rather than scan-converted Cartesian videos. Contains 37,125 recordings from 666 examinations with separable modality-specific streams.

entry.title: Sparse-to-Complete: From Sparse Image Captures to Complete 3D Scenes

author.name: Yiyang Shen, Yin Yang, Kun Zhou, Tianjia Shao

entry.summary: Introduces S2C-3D for complete 3D scene reconstruction from 6-8 sparse views using a specialized diffusion model for scene-specific image restoration and camera trajectory planning for comprehensive coverage.

entry.title: The autoPET3 Challenge -- Automated Lesion Segmentation in Whole-Body PET/CT - Multitracer Multicenter Generalization

author.name: Jakob Dexl, Katharina Jeblick, Andreas Mittermeier, Balthasar Schachtner, Anna Theresa St\"uber, Johanna Topalis, Maximilian Rokuss, Fabian Isensee, Klaus H. Maier-Hein, Hamza Kalisch, Jens Kleesiek, Constantin M. Seibold, Hussain Alasmawi, Lap Yan Lennon Chan, Yixuan Yuan, Alexander Jaus, Rainer Stiefelhagen, Pauline Ornela Megne Choudja, Konstantin Nikolaou, Christian La Foug\`ere, Sergios Gatidis, Matthias P. Fabritius, Maurice Heimer, Gizem Abaci, Lalith Kumar Shiyam Sundar, Rudolf A. Werner, Jens Ricke, Clemens C. Cyran, Thomas K\"ustner, Michael Ingrisch

entry.summary: Reports the autoPET3 challenge results for automated PET/CT lesion segmentation under compositional generalization (unseen tracer-center combinations), with 17 participating teams and the largest publicly available PSMA PET/CT dataset.

entry.title: Detecting AI-Generated Videos with Spiking Neural Networks

author.name: Minsuk Jang, Yujin Yang, Heeseon Kim, Minseok Son, Younghun Kim, Changick Kim

entry.summary: Proposes using spiking neural networks for detecting AI-generated videos, identifying that generated videos have smoother temporal residuals. Leverages neuromorphic computing for energy-efficient detection.

entry.title: LARGO: Low-Rank Hypernetwork for Handling Missing Modalities

author.name: Niels Vyncke, Pooya Ashtari, Aleksandra Pi\v{z}urica

entry.summary: LARGO uses a hypernetwork with Canonical Polyadic tensor decomposition to handle missing modalities in multimodal image segmentation, compressing 2^N-1 dedicated models into a single network by operating in weight space rather than feature space.

entry.title: VISD: Enhancing Video Reasoning via Structured Self-Distillation

author.name: Hao Lin, Kunyang Lv, Xu Jiang, Jingqi Tian, Zhongjing Du, Jiayu Ding, Qiaoman Zhang, Hongbo Jin

entry.summary: VISD introduces structured self-distillation for VideoLLM reasoning, using a video-aware judge model to provide diagnostically meaningful privileged information that addresses the sparse reward problem in video reasoning RL training.

entry.title: Spark3R: Asymmetric Token Reduction Makes Fast Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction

author.name: Zecheng Tang, Jiaye Fu, Qiankun Gao, Haijie Li, Yanmin Wu, Jiaqi Zhang, Siwei Ma, Jian Zhang

entry.summary: Spark3R proposes asymmetric token reduction for feed-forward 3D reconstruction, discovering that query tokens are compression-sensitive while key-value tokens are compression-tolerant, enabling efficient scaling to hundreds of frames.

entry.title: Continuous-Time Distribution Matching for Few-Step Diffusion Distillation

author.name: Tao Liu, Hao Yan, Mengting Chen, Taihang Hu, Zhengrong Yue, Zihao Pan, Jinsong Lan, Xiaoyong Zhu, Ming-Ming Cheng, Bo Zheng, Yaxing Wang

entry.summary: Introduces Continuous-Time Distribution Matching (CDM) for diffusion model distillation, migrating distribution matching from discrete timesteps to continuous time to reduce visual artifacts without requiring auxiliary GANs or reward models.

entry.title: Secure Seed-Based Multi-bit Watermarking for Diffusion Models from First Principles

author.name: Enoal Gesny, Eva Giboulot

entry.summary: Provides rigorous theoretical analysis of seed-based watermarking for diffusion models, decoupling model-dependent components from the watermarking decision mechanism to establish provable security guarantees.

entry.title: When to Trust Imagination: Adaptive Action Execution for World Action Models

author.name: Rui Wang, Yue Zhang, Jiehong Lin, Kuncheng Luo, Jianan Wang, Zhongrui Wang, Xiaojuan Qi

entry.summary: Proposes adaptive execution for World Action Models that verifies whether imagined futures remain consistent with reality, using Future Forward Dynamics Causal Attention to decide when to replan vs. continue executing predicted actions.

entry.title: Toward Visually Realistic Simulation: A Benchmark for Evaluating Robot Manipulation in Simulation

author.name: Yixin Zhu, Zixiong Wang, Jian Yang, Jin Xie, Jingyi Yu, Jiayuan Gu, Beibei Wang

entry.summary: Introduces VISER, a visually realistic benchmark for evaluating robot manipulation that systematically addresses the sim-to-real visual gap by focusing on lighting and material properties. Shows these factors critically affect geometric reasoning and spatial grounding.

entry.title: From Beats to Breaches:How Offensive AI Infers Sensitive User Information from Playlists

author.name: Stefano Cecconello, Mauro Conti, Luca Pajola, Luca Pasa, Pier Paolo Tricomi

entry.summary: Introduces musicPIIrate, a tool demonstrating that AI can infer sensitive personal information (PII) from public music playlists using deep learning architectures including set-based approaches and graph methods.

entry.title: VisMMOE: Exploiting Visual-Expert Affinity for Efficient Visual-Language MoE Offloading

author.name: Cheng Xu, Xiaofeng Hou, Jiacheng Liu, Chao Li

entry.summary: Presents VisMMoE, a VL-MoE offloading system that exploits visual-expert affinity - the observation that pruning visual tokens makes expert accesses more concentrated and predictable for efficient offloading.

entry.title: The Scaling Properties of Implicit Deductive Reasoning in Transformers

author.name: Enrico Vompa, Tanel Tammet

entry.summary: Investigates scaling properties of implicit deductive reasoning in Transformers over Horn clauses. Finds that sufficiently deep models with bidirectional prefix masks can approach explicit Chain-of-Thought performance, though CoT remains necessary for depth extrapolation.

entry.title: Strat-Reasoner: Reinforcing Strategic Reasoning of LLMs in Multi-Agent Games

author.name: Yidong He, Yutao Lai, Pengxu Yang, Jiarui Gan, Jiexin Wang, Yi Cai, Mengchen Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes Strat-Reasoner, an RL framework that improves LLMs' strategic reasoning in multi-agent games through recursive reasoning where agents model other agents' strategies in their reasoning process and use multi-agent credit assignment.

entry.title: AsymmetryZero: A Framework for Operationalizing Human Expert Preferences as Semantic Evals

author.name: Tadhg Looram, Lucas Nuzzi, Kyle Waters, Steven Dillmann

entry.summary: Presents AsymmetryZero, a framework for converting human expert preferences into semantic evaluations that serve as both benchmarks and reward signals for RL. Represents tasks as stable evaluation contracts with explicit grading criteria.

entry.title: Learning reveals invisible structure in low-rank RNNs

author.name: Yoav Ger, Omri Barak

entry.summary: Derives gradient-descent dynamics for low-rank RNNs in a reduced overlap space, formulating closed-form ODEs for learning. Distinguishes 'loss-visible' from 'loss-invisible' overlaps, showing invisible structure emerges during learning.

entry.title: Awaking Spatial Intelligence in Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation

author.name: Lin Song, Wenbo Li, Guoqing Ma, Wei Tang, Bo Wang, Yuan Zhang, Yijun Yang, Yicheng Xiao, Jianhui Liu, Yanbing Zhang, Guohui Zhang, Wenhu Zhang, Hang Xu, Nan Jiang, Xin Han, Haoze Sun, Maoquan Zhang, Haoyang Huang, Nan Duan

entry.summary: Presents JoyAI-Image, a unified multimodal foundation model coupling a spatially enhanced MLLM with a Multimodal Diffusion Transformer for visual understanding, text-to-image generation, and instruction-guided editing in a shared interface.

entry.title: NoisyCausal: A Benchmark for Evaluating Causal Reasoning Under Structured Noise

author.name: Zhi Xu, Yun Fu

entry.summary: Introduces NoisyCausal, a benchmark for evaluating LLM causal reasoning under structured noise conditions including irrelevant distractors, value perturbations, and partially incorrect observations. Generated from ground-truth causal graphs with controllable noise injection.

entry.title: Ilov3Splat: Instance-Level Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding in Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Binh Long Nguyen, Kien Nguyen, Sridha Sridharan, Clinton Fookes, Peyman Moghadam

entry.summary: Introduces Ilov3Splat for instance-level open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding built on 3D Gaussian Splatting. Uses multi-resolution hash embeddings for CLIP feature encoding and trains instance feature fields for coherent 3D reasoning.

entry.title: Knowledge-Free Correlated Agreement for Incentivizing Federated Learning

author.name: Leon Witt, Togrul Abbasli, Kentaroh Toyoda, Wojciech Samek, Lucy Klinger

entry.summary: Introduces Knowledge-Free Correlated Agreement (KFCA) for rewarding federated learning client contributions without ground truth, public test sets, or distribution knowledge. Addresses label-flipping vulnerability of standard Correlated Agreement.

entry.title: Almost-Orthogonality in Lp Spaces: A Case Study with Grok

author.name: Ziang Chen, Jaume de Dios Pont, Paata Ivanisvili, Jose Madrid, Haozhu Wang

entry.summary: Presents mathematical results on almost-orthogonality in Lp spaces including a counterexample to Carbery's conjecture, with the second part describing mathematical discoveries made using Grok AI.

entry.title: Taming Outlier Tokens in Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Xiaoyu Wu, Yifei Wang, Tsu-Jui Fu, Liang-Chieh Chen, Zhe Gan, Chen Wei

entry.summary: Studies outlier tokens in Diffusion Transformers, showing they appear in both encoder and denoiser of RAE-DiT pipelines, and proposes methods to tame them for improved generation quality.

entry.title: Adaptive Computation Depth via Learned Token Routing in Transformers

author.name: Ahmed Abdelmuniem Abdalla Mohammed

entry.summary: Presents Token-Selective Attention (TSA), a learned per-token gate that enables adaptive computation depth in transformers, showing that even without explicit depth regularization, task loss alone drives meaningful token-layer skipping.

entry.title: Conditional Diffusion Under Linear Constraints: Langevin Mixing and Information-Theoretic Guarantees

author.name: Ahmad Aghapour, Erhan Bayraktar, Asaf Cohen

entry.summary: Analyzes conditional sampling with pretrained diffusion models for linear inverse problems, showing projection-based samplers can produce biased samples, and providing Langevin mixing and information-theoretic guarantees.

entry.title: MEMOA: Massive Mixtures of Online Agents via Mean-Field Decentralized Nash Equilibria

author.name: Xuwei Yang, David B. Emerson, Fatemeh Tavakoli, Anastasis Kratsios

entry.summary: Derives closed-form optimal decentralized policies for massive populations of online AI agents using mean-field game theory, minimizing worst-case regret without central coordination.

entry.title: Online Localized Conformal Prediction

author.name: Yuheng Lai, Garvesh Raskutti

entry.summary: Proposes Online Localized Conformal Prediction (OLCP) that combines online adaptation with covariate-dependent localization for better uncertainty quantification under distribution shift. Includes OLCP-Hedge for automatic bandwidth selection via online expert aggregation.

entry.title: Measuring Learning Progress via Gradient-Momentum Coupling

author.name: Samuel Blad, Martin L\"angkvist, Amy Loutfi

entry.summary: Proposes Gradient-Momentum Coupling (GMC) as a measure of learning progress for curiosity-driven exploration, leveraging the natural noise filtering of optimizer momentum to identify learnable patterns.

entry.title: Retain-Neutral Surrogates for Min-Max Unlearning

author.name: Junhao Cai, Dohun Kim, Dowon Kim, Sung Il Choi, Chengjun Jin, Juhyun Park, Changhee Joo

entry.summary: Proposes ROSU for machine unlearning that constrains forget-maximizing perturbations to be retain-orthogonal, yielding a closed-form perturbation direction that prevents retain loss degradation.

entry.title: A Fine-Grained Understanding of Uniform Convergence for Halfspaces

author.name: Aryeh Kontorovich, Kasper Green Larsen

entry.summary: Studies fine-grained uniform convergence for halfspaces beyond worst-case VC bounds, showing tight separation between homogeneous and inhomogeneous cases with novel localization arguments.

entry.title: TFM-Retouche: A Lightweight Input-Space Adapter for Tabular Foundation Models

author.name: Duong Nguyen, Mohammed Jawhar, Nicolas Chesneau

entry.summary: Introduces TFM-Retouche, a lightweight input-space residual adapter for tabular foundation models that is architecture-agnostic and operates by transforming inputs rather than modifying model weights.

entry.title: SymDrift: One-Shot Generative Modeling under Symmetries

author.name: Samir Darouich, Vinh Tong, Llu\'is Pastor-P\'erez, Tanja Bien, Loay Mualem, Mathias Niepert

entry.summary: Introduces SymDrift for single-step generative modeling under symmetries (e.g., rotations for molecules), addressing a symmetry-specific challenge where equivariant generators don't produce the same drifting field as symmetry-projected targets.

entry.title: Structure-Preserving Gaussian Processes Via Discrete Euler-Lagrange Equations

author.name: Jan-Hendrik Ewering, Kathrin Fla{\ss}kamp, Niklas Wahlstr\"om, Thomas B. Sch\"on, Thomas Seel

entry.summary: Proposes Lagrangian Gaussian Processes that learn dynamics via discrete forced Euler-Lagrange equations, preserving geometric structure and enabling stable long-term predictions without energy drift.

entry.title: Inference-Time Refinement Closes the Synthetic-Real Gap in Tabular Diffusion

author.name: Eugenio Lomurno, Filippo Balzarini, Francesco Benelle, Francesca Pia Panaccione, Matteo Matteucci

entry.summary: Introduces TARDIS, an inference-time refinement framework for tabular diffusion models that operates on frozen pre-trained backbones using Tree-structured Parzen Estimator search, closing the synthetic-real data quality gap.

entry.title: Attributions All the Way Down? The Metagame of Interpretability

author.name: Hubert Baniecki, Przemyslaw Biecek, Fabian Fumagalli

entry.summary: Introduces the 'metagame' framework for quantifying second-order interaction effects of explanations, computing meta-attributions (how feature j influences feature i's attribution) via Shapley values of the attribution method itself.

entry.title: Hyperbolic Concept Bottleneck Models

author.name: Daniel Uyterlinde, Swasti Shreya Mishra, Pascal Mettes

entry.summary: Proposes Hyperbolic Concept Bottleneck Models that reformulate concept activation as asymmetric geometric containment in hyperbolic space, naturally encoding semantic hierarchies rather than treating concepts as independent orthogonal dimensions.

entry.title: Q-MMR: Off-Policy Evaluation via Recursive Reweighting and Moment Matching

author.name: Xiang Li, Nan Jiang

entry.summary: Presents Q-MMR, a theoretical framework for off-policy evaluation learning scalar weights via recursive moment matching, achieving dimension-free finite-sample guarantees under only Q-function realizability.

entry.title: Agentic AIs Are the Missing Paradigm for Out-of-Distribution Generalization in Foundation Models

author.name: Xin Wang, Haibo Chen, Wenxuan Liu, Wenwu Zhu

entry.summary: Position paper arguing that agentic AI systems are the missing paradigm for addressing out-of-distribution generalization in foundation models, since model-centric approaches cannot handle the structural distinctness of OOD problems in open-world deployments.

entry.title: On the Safety of Graph Representation Learning

author.name: Xiaoguang Guo, Zehong Wang, Ziming Li, Shawn Spitzel, Soonwoo Kwon, Tianyi Ma, Yanfang Ye, Chuxu Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces GRL-Safety, a multi-axis safety evaluation benchmark for graph representation learning methods including GNNs and graph foundation models, testing 12 methods across 25 datasets under various deployment stresses.

entry.title: Direct From Darwin: Deriving Advanced Optimizers From Evolutionary First Principles

author.name: Daniel Grimmer

entry.summary: Derives advanced gradient-based optimizers (equivalent to Adam, momentum SGD) directly from evolutionary first principles, proving Fisher's and Wright's views of evolution are formally equivalent in asexual populations.

entry.title: Estimating Implicit Regularization in Deep Learning

author.name: Joseph H. Rudoler, Kevin Tan, Giles Hooker, Konrad P. Kording

entry.summary: Addresses the problem of estimating implicit regularization in deep learning, developing methods to quantify the equivalent penalty that training procedures (early stopping, dropout, etc.) implicitly impose.

entry.title: Saliency-Aware Regularized Quantization Calibration for Large Language Models

author.name: Yanlong Zhao, Xiaoyuan Cheng, Huihang Liu, Baihua He, Xinyu Zhang, Harrison Bo Hua Zhu, Wenlong Chen, Li Zeng, Zhuo Sun

entry.summary: Proposes a saliency-aware regularization approach for post-training quantization of LLMs that addresses generalization risk from limited calibration data. The method prevents quantized weights from drifting too far from originals, improving downstream performance.

entry.title: Relay Buffer Independent Communication over Pooled HBM for Efficient MoE Inference on Ascend

author.name: Tianlun Hu, Tiancheng Hu, Shengsheng Litang, Sheng Wang, Xiaoming Bao, Yuxing Li, Wei Wang, Zhongzhe Hu, Lijun Li, Hongwei Sun, Jingbin Zhou\\

entry.summary: Presents a relay-buffer-free communication design for MoE inference on Ascend hardware using globally pooled HBM, eliminating explicit inter-process relay buffers to accelerate dispatch and combine operations.

entry.title: Expressivity of Bi-Lipschitz Normalizing Flows: A Score-Based Diffusion Perspective

author.name: Meira Iske, Carola-Bibiane Sch\"onlieb

entry.summary: Studies expressivity of bi-Lipschitz normalizing flows through the lens of score-based diffusion, showing that Lipschitz regularity of the score induces bi-Lipschitz transport maps, providing convergence guarantees for diffusion-based transport.

entry.title: A Benchmark for Strategic Auditee Gaming Under Continuous Compliance Monitoring

author.name: Florian A. D. Burnat, Brittany I. Davidson

entry.summary: Proposes a benchmark and formalization for strategic auditee gaming under continuous compliance monitoring, showing structural impossibility results for static auditor designs.

entry.title: Decoupled PFNs: Identifiable Epistemic-Aleatoric Decomposition via Structured Synthetic Priors

author.name: Richard Bergna, Stefan Depeweg, Jos\'e Miguel Hern\'andez-Lobato

entry.summary: Shows that Prior-Fitted Networks can achieve identifiable epistemic-aleatoric uncertainty decomposition by exploiting control over the synthetic data-generating process, enabling better acquisition functions for active learning and Bayesian optimization.

entry.title: MARBLE: Multi-Aspect Reward Balance for Diffusion RL

author.name: Canyu Zhao, Hao Chen, Yunze Tong, Yu Qiao, Jiacheng Li, Chunhua Shen

entry.summary: Proposes MARBLE for multi-aspect reward balancing in diffusion RL fine-tuning, addressing the failure of naive weighted-sum reward aggregation when optimizing multiple criteria simultaneously.

entry.title: Cross-Modal Navigation with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Shuo Liu, Xinzichen Li, Christopher Amato

entry.summary: Introduces CRONA, a multi-agent RL framework for cross-modal navigation where modality-specialized lightweight agents collaborate. Uses auxiliary beliefs and centralized training to improve coordination among agents handling different sensory inputs.

entry.title: Chainwash: Multi-Step Rewriting Attacks on Diffusion Language Model Watermarks

author.name: Mohd Ruhul Ameen, Akif Islam, Nadim Mahmud, Md. Ekramul Hamid

entry.summary: Studies the vulnerability of diffusion language model watermarks to multi-step rewriting attacks (Chainwash), showing that iterative paraphrasing can degrade watermark detection for LLaDA 8B even when a single rewrite is insufficient.

entry.title: Minimizing Modality Gap from the Input Side: Your Speech LLM Can Be a Prosody-Aware Text LLM

author.name: Wenqian Cui, Xiao-Hui Li, Daxin Tan, Qiyong Zheng, Irwin King

entry.summary: Proposes TextPro-SLM, a speech LLM that bridges the modality gap from the input side by making speech input resemble prosody-aware text via a unified encoder producing synchronized text tokens and prosody embeddings.

entry.title: MemReranker: Reasoning-Aware Reranking for Agent Memory Retrieval

author.name: Chunyu Li, Jingyi Kang, Ding Chen, Mengyuan Zhang, Jiajun Shen, Bo Tang, Xuanhe Zhou, Feiyu Xiong, Zhiyu Li

entry.summary: Proposes MemReranker, a reasoning-aware reranking model for agent memory retrieval that handles temporal constraints, causal reasoning, and calibrated relevance scoring better than generic semantic similarity matchers.

entry.title: Quantifying the Statistical Effect of Rubric Modifications on Human-Autorater Agreement

author.name: Jessica Huynh, Alfredo Gomez, Athiya Deviyani, Renee Shelby, Jeffrey P. Bigham, Fernando Diaz

entry.summary: Quantifies how rubric modifications (holistic vs. analytic) affect agreement between human raters and LLM-as-judge autoraters, finding complex interactions between rubric design and scoring agreement.

entry.title: GATHER: Convergence-Centric Hyper-Entity Retrieval for Zero-Shot Cell-Type Annotation

author.name: Zhonghui Zhang, Feng Jiang, Shaowei Qin, Jiahao Zhao, Min Yang

entry.summary: Proposes GATHER, a convergence-centric retriever for zero-shot cell-type annotation that handles hyper-entity queries (tens to hundreds of genes) through graph-aware traversal rather than individual gene exploration.

entry.title: Algospeak, Hiding in the Open: The Trade-off Between Legible Meaning and Detection Avoidance

author.name: Jan Fillies, Ronald E. Robertson, Jeffrey Hancock

entry.summary: Formalizes Algospeak dynamics (linguistic evasion of content moderation) through a joint action model, introducing Majority Understandable Modulation (MUM) as the tipping point where evasion gain exceeds comprehension loss.

entry.title: Beyond BLEU: A Semantic Evaluation Method for Code Translation

author.name: Julius N\"aumann, Sven Keidel, Amir Molzam Sharifloo, Mira Mezini

entry.summary: Proposes a semantic evaluation methodology for code translation emphasizing execution correctness over BLEU-style surface similarity, applying compiler testing methodology to assess LLM decompilation tasks.

entry.title: Novelty-based Tree-of-Thought Search for LLM Reasoning and Planning

author.name: Leon Hamm, Zlatan Ajanovic

entry.summary: Proposes novelty-based tree-of-thought search inspired by width-based planning, using a measurable concept of novelty to prune redundant thought paths. Aims to reduce computational costs while improving reasoning performance.

entry.title: Two Steps Are All You Need: Efficient 3D Point Cloud Anomaly Detection with Consistency Models

author.name: Pranav A, Shashank B, Pranav Siddappa, Dominik Seuss, Minal Moharir, Subramanya KN

entry.summary: Applies consistency models to 3D point cloud anomaly detection, reducing iterative diffusion denoising to one or two network evaluations while maintaining detection accuracy for manufacturing quality assurance.

entry.title: MotionGRPO: Overcoming Low Intra-Group Diversity in GRPO-Based Egocentric Motion Recovery

author.name: Nanjie Yao, Junlong Ren, Wenhao Shen, Hao Wang

entry.summary: Proposes MotionGRPO for full-body 3D motion recovery from head-mounted devices, using GRPO-based reinforcement learning to inject fine-grained guidance into diffusion-based motion generation with hybrid rewards.

entry.title: Ray-Aware Pointer Memory with Adaptive Updates for Streaming 3D Reconstruction

author.name: Feifei Li, Qi Song, Chi Zhang, Rui Huang

entry.summary: Proposes ray-aware pointer memory for streaming 3D reconstruction that explicitly models spatial location and viewing direction in memory representation, avoiding redundant accumulation from appearance-only similarity.

entry.title: X-OmniClaw Technical Report: A Unified Mobile Agent for Multimodal Understanding and Interaction

author.name: Xiaoming Ren, Ru Zhen, Chao Li, Yang Song, Qiuxia Hou, Yanhao Zhang, Peng Liu, Qi Qi, Quanlong Zheng, Qi Wu, Zhenyi Liao, Binqiang Pan, Haobo Ji, Haonan Lu

entry.summary: Introduces X-OmniClaw, a unified mobile agent for Android with multimodal perception (UI, vision, speech), temporal memory, and action capabilities. Features Omni Perception, Omni Memory, and Omni Action modules.

entry.title: Adding Thermal Awareness to Visual Systems in Real-Time via Distilled Diffusion Models

author.name: Yuchen Guo, Junli Gong, Wenjun Dong, Yiuming Cheung, Weifeng Su

entry.summary: Proposes FusionProxy, a real-time RGB-infrared image fusion module distilled from diffusion-based teacher ensemble. Designed as plug-and-play for edge deployment with diffusion-level quality at real-time speed.

entry.title: Arena as Offline Reward: Efficient Fine-Grained Preference Optimization for Diffusion Models

author.name: Zhikai Li, Yue Zhao, Edward Zhongwei Zhang, Xuewen Liu, Jing Zhang, Qingyi Gu, Zhen Dong

entry.summary: Proposes ArenaPO, leveraging Arena scores as offline rewards for fine-grained preference optimization of text-to-image diffusion models, avoiding both explicit reward modeling and the coarse binary feedback limitation of DPO.

entry.title: NavOne: One-Step Global Planning for Vision-Language Navigation on Top-Down Maps

author.name: Dijia Zhan, Jinyi Li, Chenxi Zheng, Shaoyu Huang, Yong Li, Jie Tang, Xuemiao Xu

entry.summary: NavOne reformulates vision-language navigation as one-step global path planning on pre-built top-down maps, directly predicting dense path probabilities in a single end-to-end forward pass instead of step-by-step egocentric navigation.

entry.title: GeoStack: A Framework for Quasi-Abelian Knowledge Composition in VLMs

author.name: Pranav Mantini, Shishir K. Shah

entry.summary: GeoStack is a modular framework for composing independently trained domain experts into VLMs while preserving base model knowledge, achieving constant-time inference regardless of expert count through a weight-folding property.

entry.title: 3DSS: 3D Surface Splatting for Inverse Rendering

author.name: Mae Younes, Adnane Boukhayma

entry.summary: 3DSS presents the first differentiable surface splatting renderer for physically-based inverse rendering, deriving coverage-based compositing from reconstruction kernels for anti-aliased rendering with informative visibility gradients.

entry.title: DexSynRefine: Synthesizing and Refining Human-Object Interaction Motion for Physically Feasible Dexterous Robot Actions

author.name: Hyesung Lee, Hyunwoo Jung, Si-Hwan Heo, Sungwook Yang

entry.summary: DexSynRefine learns dexterous manipulation from sparse human-object interaction data through motion synthesis, residual RL for physical grounding, and contact-dynamics adaptation for sim-to-real transfer.

entry.title: Dissociating spatial frequency reliance from adversarial robustness advantages in neurally guided deep convolutional neural networks

author.name: Zhenan Shao, Tianyu Ren, Chengxiao Wang, Leyla Isik, Diane M. Beck

entry.summary: Investigates whether adversarial robustness gains from neural alignment in deep CNNs are driven by spatial frequency biases. Finds that robustness is not simply attributable to low-frequency bias but involves more complex mechanisms related to mid-frequency processing.

entry.title: JASTIN: Aligning LLMs for Zero-Shot Audio and Speech Evaluation via Natural Language Instructions

author.name: Leying Zhang, Bowen Shi, Haibin Wu, Bach Viet Do, Yanmin Qian

entry.summary: Proposes JASTIN, an instruction-driven audio evaluation framework that formulates audio assessment as a self-instructed reasoning task, combining a frozen audio encoder with a fine-tuned LLM backbone for zero-shot audio and speech evaluation.

entry.title: AeroJEPA: Learning Semantic Latent Representations for Scalable 3D Aerodynamic Field Modeling

author.name: Francisco Giral, Abhijeet Vishwasrao, Andrea Arroyo Ramo, Mahmoud Golestanian, Federica Tonti, Adrian Lozano-Duran, Steven L. Brunton, Sergio Hoyas, Hector Gomez, Soledad Le Clainche, Ricardo Vinuesa

entry.summary: Introduces AeroJEPA, a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for 3D aerodynamic field modeling that scales to realistic CFD fields and produces useful latent representations for design applications.

entry.title: Information-Preserving Domain Transfer with Unlabeled Data in Misspecified Simulation-Based Inference

author.name: Joon Jang, Eunho Jeong, Kyu Sung Choi, Hyeonjin Kim

entry.summary: Proposes SPIN for simulation-based inference that preserves parameter-relevant information during domain transfer from simulator to real-world data, rather than just aligning marginal distributions.

entry.title: Adaptive Selection of LoRA Components in Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning

author.name: Myoungjun Kim, Sangwoo Park, Yoseob Han, Jin-Hyun Ahn

entry.summary: Proposes AS-LoRA for differentially private federated LoRA fine-tuning that adaptively selects which LoRA components to update per layer and per round using curvature-aware scoring.

entry.title: RepFlow: Representation Enhanced Flow Matching for Causal Effect Estimation

author.name: Yifei Xie, Jian Huang

entry.summary: Proposes RepFlow, combining representation learning with Conditional Flow Matching for causal effect estimation, using entropically regularized Wasserstein distance to mitigate selection bias.

entry.title: DiBA: Diagonal and Binary Matrix Approximation for Neural Network Weight Compression

author.name: Nobutaka Ono

entry.summary: Proposes DiBA, a matrix factorization D₁B₁D₂B₂D₃ using diagonal and binary matrices for neural network weight compression, reducing floating-point multiplications to element-wise scaling and binary mixing.

entry.title: Molecules Meet Language: Confound-Aware Representation Learning and Chemical Property Steering in Transformer-VAE Latent Spaces

author.name: Zakaria Elabid, Jan Andrzejewski, Bartosz Brzoza, Attila Cangi

entry.summary: Studies molecular generation with Transformer-VAEs and proposes confound-aware evaluation to separate genuine chemical signal from SELFIES string artifacts in latent space, revealing that many apparent steering directions are actually SELFIES shortcuts.

entry.title: FRInGe: Distribution-Space Integrated Gradients with Fisher--Rao Geometry

author.name: Gabriele Martino, Sebastian Tschiatschek

entry.summary: Proposes Fisher-Rao Integrated Gradients (FRInGe), defining attribution baselines and interpolation in predictive distribution space via Fisher-Rao geodesics, replacing heuristic input-space baselines with maximum-entropy references.

entry.title: MINER: Mining Multimodal Internal Representation for Efficient Retrieval
