entry.summary: Presents a sequential framework using reinforcement learning to optimize genetic circuit design under both intrinsic stochasticity and experimental variability, combining differential equation simulators with RL policy-based approaches.

entry.title: Optimal Counterfactual Search in Tree Ensembles: A Study Across Modeling and Solution Paradigms

author.name: Awa Khouna, Youssouf Emine, Julien Ferry, Thibaut Vidal

entry.summary: Studies optimal counterfactual explanation computation for tree ensembles, proposing CPCF - a constraint programming approach that finds truly minimal changes under plausibility and actionability constraints.

entry.title: Concept-Based Abductive and Contrastive Explanations for Behaviors of Vision Models

author.name: Ronaldo Canizales, Divya Gopinath, Corina P\u{a}s\u{a}reanu, Ravi Mangal

entry.summary: Proposes concept-based abductive and contrastive explanations that identify minimal sets of high-level concepts causally relevant to model predictions, merging concept-based explanations with formal abductive reasoning.

entry.title: Differential Privacy in the Extensive-Form Bandit Problem

author.name: Stephen Pasteris, Rahul Savani, Theodore Turocy

entry.summary: Gives an algorithm for the extensive-form bandit problem satisfying epsilon-local differential privacy with regret O(sqrt(A*ln(S)*T)/epsilon), maintaining computational efficiency.

entry.title: Privacy Without Losing Place: A Paradigm for Private Retrieval in Spatial RAGs

author.name: Kennedy Edemacu, Mohammad Mahdi Shokri, Vinay M. Shashidhar, Jong Wook Kim

entry.summary: Introduces PAS (Privacy Anchor Substitution) for user location privacy in spatial RAG systems, representing locations with relative anchor encoding that achieves ~400m adversarial error while retaining retrieval performance.

entry.title: Active Learning for Communication Structure Optimization in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Huchen Yang, Xinghao Dong, Dan Negrut, Jin-Long Wu

entry.summary: Proposes an ensemble-based information-theoretic framework for actively selecting which tasks to use when optimizing communication structures in LLM-based multi-agent systems. Addresses instability in optimization under limited training budgets.

entry.title: Tuning Derivatives for Causal Fairness in Machine Learning

author.name: Filip Edstr\"om, Guilherme W. F. Barros, Tetiana Gorbach, Xavier de Luna

entry.summary: Proposes causal fairness methods using 'tuning derivatives' that extend path-based fairness definitions to continuous protected attributes, distinguishing allowed from disallowed causal paths.

entry.title: From Coordinate Matching to Structural Alignment: Rethinking Prototype Alignment in Heterogeneous Federated Learning

author.name: Xinghao Wu, Jianwei Niu, Guogang Zhu, Xuefeng Liu, Shaojie Tang, Jiayuan Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes structural alignment instead of coordinate alignment for prototype-based heterogeneous federated learning, addressing the issue that different model architectures produce incomparable embedding spaces.

entry.title: Predictive-Generative Drift Decomposition for Speech Enhancement and Separation

author.name: Julius Richter, Yoshiki Masuyama, Christoph Boeddeker, Takahiro Edo, Gordon Wichern, Jonathan Le Roux

entry.summary: Proposes SIPS, a framework combining predictive speech enhancement with generative speech priors using stochastic interpolants, decomposing dynamics into task-specific drift and stochastic denoising components.

entry.title: eXplaining to Learn (eX2L): Regularization Using Contrastive Visual Explanation Pairs for Distribution Shifts

author.name: Paulo Mario P. Medina, Jose Marie Antonio Mi\~noza, Sebastian C. Iba\~nez

entry.summary: Proposes eX2L, a regularization framework that penalizes similarity between Grad-CAM maps of a primary classifier and a confounder classifier to decorrelate spurious features during training.

entry.title: Estimate Level Adjustment For Inference With Proxies Under Random Distribution Shifts

author.name: Steven Wilkins-Reeves, Alexandra N. M. Darmon, Deeksha Sinha

entry.summary: Proposes a sensitivity-adjusted inference method for using proxy outcomes in experimentation that doesn't require strict identifying assumptions like surrogacy or covariate shift.

entry.title: Market-Alignment Risk in Pricing Agents: Trace Diagnostics and Trace-Prior RL under Hidden Competitor State

author.name: Peiying Zhu, Sidi Chang

entry.summary: Studies a Goodhart-style failure in pricing agents trained against competitors with hidden state, proposing trace diagnostics and trace-prior RL to handle partial observability in revenue management.

entry.title: Coordination Matters: Evaluation of Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Maria Ana Cardei, Matthew Landers, Afsaneh Doryab

entry.summary: Proposes coordination-aware evaluation metrics for cooperative multi-agent RL that go beyond aggregate returns to measure how agents actually coordinate, with a controlled testbed (STAT) for systematic evaluation.

entry.title: PianoCoRe: Combined and Refined Piano MIDI Dataset

author.name: Ilya Borovik

entry.summary: Presents PianoCoRe, a large-scale unified piano MIDI dataset combining major open-source corpora into 250,046 performances of 5,625 pieces by 483 composers, with tiered subsets for different applications from pre-training to expressive performance modeling.

entry.title: From 124 Million Tokens to 1,021 Neologisms: A Large-Scale Pipeline for Automatic Neologism Detection

author.name: Diego Rossini, Lonneke van der Plas

entry.summary: Presents a scalable pipeline for automatic neologism detection combining rule-based filtering with LLM classification, processing 124.6 million unique tokens from Reddit to yield 1,021 verified neologism candidates.

entry.title: Seeing What Shouldn't Be There: Counterfactual GANs for Medical Image Attribution

author.name: Shakeeb Murtaza

entry.summary: Proposes counterfactual GAN-based method for medical image attribution that generates explanations showing what pathological features influence classification decisions. Overcomes limitations of discriminative visualization methods that only highlight minimal discriminative features.

entry.title: R2H-Diff: Guided Spectral Diffusion Model for RGB-to-Hyperspectral Reconstruction

author.name: Songyu Ding, Ronggiang Zhao, Mingchun Sun, Jie Liu

entry.summary: Proposes R2H-Diff, a diffusion-based framework for RGB-to-hyperspectral image reconstruction that handles the ill-posed nature of the problem by modeling spectral distributions rather than deterministic mappings.

entry.title: ChartZero: Synthetic Priors Enable Zero Shot Chart Data Extraction

author.name: Md Touhidul Islam, Yasir Mahmud, Sujan Kumar Saha, Mark Tehranipoor, Farimah Farahmandi

entry.summary: Proposes ChartZero for zero-shot chart data extraction using synthetic priors to overcome the scarcity of annotated chart datasets. Addresses structural fragmentation in curve extraction and semantic association errors.

entry.title: Align3D-AD: Cross-Modal Feature Alignment and Dual-Prompt Learning for Zero-shot 3D Anomaly Detection

author.name: Letian Bai, Xuanming Cao, Juan Du, Chengyu Tao

entry.summary: Proposes Align3D-AD for zero-shot 3D anomaly detection using cross-modal feature alignment with RGB guidance. Addresses domain gap between 3D rendering features and RGB-pretrained encoders.

entry.title: Plug-and-play Class-aware Knowledge Injection for Prompt Learning with Visual-Language Model

author.name: Junhui Yin, Nan Pu, Xinyu Zhang, Lingfeng Yang, Lin Wu, Xiaojie Wang, Zhun Zhong

entry.summary: Proposes plug-and-play class-aware knowledge injection for prompt learning in VLMs like CLIP, generating class-specific prompts that provide more fine-grained supervision than class-shared prompts.

entry.title: SuperFace: Preference-Aligned Facial Expression Estimation Beyond Pseudo Supervision

author.name: Zejian Kang, Xuanyang Xu, Wentao Yang, Kai Zheng, Yuanchen Fei, Hongyuan Zou, Hui Shan, Shuo Yang, Xiangru Huang

entry.summary: SuperFace uses preference-aligned learning to predict ARKit blendshape coefficients for facial animation, overcoming noisy pseudo-labels from capture software by optimizing for perceptual expression fidelity rather than label matching.

entry.title: ZScribbleSeg: A comprehensive segmentation framework with modeling of efficient annotation and maximization of scribble supervision

author.name: Ke Zhang, Bomin Wang, Hangqi Zhou, Xiahai Zhuang

entry.summary: ZScribbleSeg investigates principles of good scribble annotations for medical image segmentation, proposing efficient annotation forms and regularization terms to maximize supervision from weak scribble labels.

entry.title: Solving Minimal Problems Without Matrix Inversion Using FFT-Based Interpolation

author.name: Haidong Wu, Snehal Bhayani, Janne Heikkil\"a

entry.summary: Proposes a sampling-based, matrix inversion-free method for solving minimal problems in camera geometry using FFT-based interpolation of sparse hidden-variable resultants.

entry.title: Efficient event-driven retrieval in high-capacity kernel Hopfield networks

author.name: Akira Tamamori

entry.summary: Demonstrates that asynchronous retrieval in Kernel Logistic Regression Hopfield networks can match synchronous dynamics while being compatible with neuromorphic hardware, enabling energy-efficient deployment.

entry.title: QUIVER: Cost-Aware Adaptive Preference Querying in Surrogate-Assisted Evolutionary Multi-Objective Optimization

author.name: Florian A. D. Burnat

entry.summary: QUIVER adaptively allocates budget between expensive objective evaluations and heterogeneous preference queries (pairwise comparisons vs. indifference adjustments) in surrogate-assisted multi-objective optimization.

entry.title: Generating Roadside LiDAR Datasets from Vehicle-Side Datasets via Novel View Synthesis

author.name: Yuhan Xia, Runxin Zhao, Hanyang Zhuang, Chunxiang Wang, Ming Yang

entry.summary: VRS synthesizes labeled roadside LiDAR datasets from vehicle-side datasets via novel view synthesis, using point cloud completion and scene reconstruction to bridge the vehicle-to-roadside domain gap.

entry.title: Plug-and-Play Label Map Diffusion for Universal Goal-Oriented Navigation

author.name: Zhixuan Shen, Yijie Zeng, Shengxiang Luo, Tianrui Li, Haonan Luo

entry.summary: PLMD uses denoising diffusion probabilistic models to complete bird's-eye-view maps for goal-oriented navigation, generating obstacle and semantic labels for unobserved regions.

entry.title: Accurate Trajectory Tracking with MPCC for Flapping-Wing MAVs

author.name: Charbel Toumieh, Jack Zeng, Niel Mistry, Dario Floreano

entry.summary: Applies Model Predictive Contouring Control (MPCC) to flapping-wing micro aerial vehicles, achieving precise trajectory tracking by optimizing arc-length-parameterized paths while handling the coupled dynamics.

entry.title: TouchDrive: Electronics-Free Tactile Sensing Interface for Assistive Grasping

author.name: Jing Xu, Xuezhi Niu, Didem Gurdur Broo, Klas Hjort

entry.summary: Presents TouchDrive, an electronics-free tactile sensing interface that converts contact forces directly into pneumatic feedback through valve-mediated switching, creating a fully passive mechanical sensing loop for assistive grasping.

entry.title: Maximal Controlled Invariant-MPC: Enhancing Feasibility and Reducing Conservatism through Terminal CBF Constraint in Safety-Critical Control

author.name: Tanmay Dokania, Yashwanth Kumar Nakka

entry.summary: Presents an MPC formulation using Control Barrier Functions as terminal constraints that provably improves feasibility and reachable sets with increasing prediction horizon, with constructive proofs enabling warm-starting of the optimization.

entry.title: Beyond Seeing Is Believing: On Crowdsourced Detection of Audiovisual Deepfakes

author.name: Michael Soprano, Andrea Cioci, Stefano Mizzaro

entry.summary: Studies crowdsourced audiovisual deepfake detection, measuring how consistently crowd workers distinguish authentic from manipulated videos and identify manipulation types across two datasets with 960 judgments.

entry.title: Pro$^2$Assist: Continuous Step-Aware Proactive Assistance with Multimodal Egocentric Perception for Long-Horizon Procedural Tasks

author.name: Lilin Xu, Bufang Yang, Siyang Jiang, Kaiwei Liu, Kaiyuan Hou, Yuang Fan, Hongkai Chen, Zhenyu Yan, Xiaofan Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces Pro²Assist, a proactive AI assistant that continuously tracks fine-grained task progress using AR glasses and multimodal data to provide timely assistance during long-horizon procedural tasks, rather than waiting for user queries.

entry.title: FlatASCEND: Autoregressive Clinical Sequence Generation with Continuous Time Prediction and Association-Based Pharmacological Testing

author.name: Chris Sainsbury, Feng Dong, Andreas Karwath

entry.summary: Presents FlatASCEND, a 14.5M-parameter autoregressive clinical sequence model that generates patient-conditioned multi-step trajectories responding to intervention tokens, validated through pharmacological association testing.

entry.title: Confronting Label Indeterminacy in Automated Bail Decisions

author.name: Cor Steging, Tadeusz Zbiegie\'n

entry.summary: Examines label indeterminacy in bail decision data - when bail is denied, the counterfactual outcome is unobserved. Evaluates five approaches for handling denied-bail cases during model development using Pennsylvania judicial data.

entry.title: Time series causal discovery with variable lags

author.name: Bruno Petrungaro, Anthony C. Constantinou

entry.summary: Proposes a Tabu-based structure learning algorithm for time-series causal discovery that searches for time-ordered directed structures with edge-specific variable lags, addressing the fixed-lag-window limitation of existing methods.

entry.title: Self-Prompting Small Language Models for Privacy-Sensitive Clinical Information Extraction

author.name: Yao-Shun Chuang, Tushti Mody, Uday Pratap Singh, Shirindokht Shiraz, Chun-Teh Lee, Ryan Brandon, Muhammad F Walji, Xiaoqian Jiang, Bunmi Tokede

entry.summary: Develops a framework enabling small language models to self-generate and refine prompts for clinical named entity recognition from dental notes, achieving strong performance with locally deployable privacy-preserving models.

entry.title: Evaluation Cards for XAI Metrics

author.name: Rokas Gipi\v{s}kis, Olga Kurasova

entry.summary: Proposes XAI Evaluation Cards, a standardized documentation template for XAI metrics analogous to model cards. Covers target properties, assumptions, validation evidence, gaming risks, and failure cases to reduce evaluation fragmentation.

entry.title: Efficient Geometry-Controlled High-Resolution Satellite Image Synthesis

author.name: Vlad Vasilescu, Daniela Faur, Teodor Costachioiu

entry.summary: Proposes an efficient method for geometry-controlled high-resolution satellite image synthesis using only skip connection features with windowed cross-attention modules added to pre-trained diffusion models.

entry.title: Exact Dual Geometry of SOC-ICNN Value Functions

author.name: Kang Liu, Jianchen Hu, Wei Peng

entry.summary: Studies the dual geometry of SOC-ICNN (Second-Order-Cone Input Convex Neural Networks) value functions, showing that supporting slopes, subdifferentials, and local Hessians can be recovered from optimal dual variables.

entry.title: Driver-WM: A Driver-Centric Traffic-Conditioned Latent World Model for In-Cabin Dynamics Rollout

author.name: Haozhuang Chi, Daosheng Qiu, Hao Su, Haochen Liu, Zirui Li, Haoruo Zhang, Chen Lv

entry.summary: Introduces Driver-WM, a driver-centric latent world model that predicts in-cabin dynamics (driver behavior and emotions) conditioned on external traffic context, enabling anticipation of human reactions during autonomous driving transitions.

entry.title: Adaptive Policy Selection and Fine-Tuning under Interaction Budgets for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Alper Kamil Bozkurt, Xiaoan Xu, Shangtong Zhang, Miroslav Pajic, Yuichi Motai

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for offline-to-online RL that jointly handles policy selection and fine-tuning under interaction budgets, addressing the tension between evaluation and improvement phases.

entry.title: Expert Routing for Communication-Efficient MoE via Finite Expert Banks

author.name: Mohammad Reza Deylam Salehi, Ali Khalesi

entry.summary: Treats MoE gating as a stochastic channel using information theory, developing a finite-bank construction with pretrained experts and analyzing routing information via algorithmic mutual information.

entry.title: COPYCOP: Ownership Verification for Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Rahul Nandakumar, Deepayan Chakrabarti

entry.summary: Proposes CopyCop for GNN ownership verification that can identify copycat GNNs even when architectures, weights, embedding dimensions differ and outputs are transformed, with theoretical guarantees.

entry.title: Differentiable Parameter Optimization for DAEs with State-Dependent Events

author.name: Ion Matei, Maksym Zhenirovskyy, Anthony Wong

entry.summary: Develops differentiable parameter optimization for differential-algebraic equations with state-dependent events, handling algebraic constraints, guard equations, and reset maps with two gradient computation strategies.

entry.title: A Robust Foundation Model for Conservation Laws: Injecting Context into Flux Neural Operators via Recurrent Vision Transformers

author.name: Taeyoung Kim, Joon-Hyuk Ko

entry.summary: Proposes a hypernetwork architecture that augments Flux Neural Operators with ViT-based context injection for solving conservation laws without explicit access to governing equations.

entry.title: Region-adaptable retrieval of coastal biogeochemical parameters from near-surface hyperspectral remote sensing reflectance using physics-aware meta-learning

author.name: Yiqing Guo, Nagur R. C. Cherukuru, Eric A. Lehmann, S. L. Kesav Unnithan, Tim J. Malthus, Gemma Kerrisk, Xiubin Qi, Faisal Islam, Tisham Dhar, Mark J. Doubell

entry.summary: Proposes a physics-aware meta-learning framework for retrieving coastal biogeochemical parameters from hyperspectral remote sensing, enabling rapid adaptation across different water bodies.

entry.title: CoMemNet: Contrastive Sampling with Memory Replay Network for Continual Traffic Prediction

author.name: Mei Wu, Wenchao Weng, Wenxin Su, Wenjie Tang, Wei Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes CoMemNet, a dual-branch continual learning framework for traffic prediction using contrastive learning and memory replay to handle evolving traffic network structures.

entry.title: VARS-FL: Validation-Aligned Client Selection for Non-IID Federated Learning in IoT Systems

author.name: Mohamed Lakas, Mohamed Amine Ferrag

entry.summary: Proposes VARS-FL, a client selection framework for federated learning that uses validation-aligned reputation scoring to quantify client contributions, particularly for non-IID IoT settings.

entry.title: Fast Gauss-Newton for Multiclass Cross-Entropy

author.name: Mikalai Korbit, Mario Zanon

entry.summary: Decomposes the generalized Gauss-Newton curvature for multiclass softmax into true-vs-rest and within-competitor terms, dropping the latter to get a faster positive semidefinite approximation (Fast Gauss-Newton) that scales better with number of classes.

entry.title: In-Context Black-Box Optimization with Unreliable Feedback

author.name: Nicolas Samuel Blumer, Julien Martinelli, Samuel Kaski

entry.summary: Studies feedback-informed in-context black-box optimization where a pretrained optimizer conditions on both observed history and cheap auxiliary feedback (from experts, simulators, etc.) for the current candidate.

entry.title: AffineLens: Capturing the Continuous Piecewise Affine Functions of Neural Networks

author.name: Yi Wei, Xuan Qi, Furao shen, Jian Zhao, Vittorio Murino, Cigdem Beyan

entry.summary: Presents AffineLens, a framework for computing hyperplane arrangements and polyhedral structures underlying piecewise affine neural networks, enabling practical enumeration and visualization of affine regions in bounded input domains.

entry.title: Diversity Curves for Graph Representation Learning

author.name: Katharina Limbeck, Nadja H\"ausermann, Martin Carrasco, Guy Wolf, Bastian Rieck

entry.summary: Introduces diversity curves for graph-level representations by tracking structural diversity across coarsening levels, creating interpretable, efficient, and size-comparable graph embeddings.

entry.title: Hedging Memory Horizons for Non-Stationary Prediction via Online Aggregation

author.name: Yutong Wang, Yannig Goude, Qiwei Yao

entry.summary: Proposes MELO, a model-agnostic online prediction method that hedges across multiple adaptation memory scales for non-stationary settings. Establishes deterministic oracle inequalities for the aggregation.

entry.title: SNAPO: Smooth Neural Adjoint Policy Optimization for Optimal Control via Differentiable Simulation

author.name: Dmitri Goloubentsev, Natalija Karpichina

entry.summary: Introduces SNAPO, a framework combining neural policies with differentiable simulators for optimal control, computing exact gradients via adjoint methods while replacing hard constraints with smooth approximations.

entry.title: Towards Metric-Faithful Neural Graph Matching

author.name: Jyotirmaya Shivottam, Subhankar Mishra

entry.summary: Develops theoretical framework connecting GNN encoder geometry to graph edit distance estimation quality. Shows that hyperbolic encoders improve estimation when graph families exhibit tree-like or hierarchical structure.

entry.title: MPNet: A Robust and Efficient Manifold Pooling Network for Multi-Rhythm EEG Signal Decoding

author.name: Guoqing Cai, Kai Zeng, Shoulin Huang, Ting Ma

entry.summary: Proposes MPNet for EEG decoding that combines rhythm-adaptive convolutional frontend with novel manifold node pooling on Riemannian manifolds, enabling efficient processing of multi-rhythm EEG signals.

entry.title: Identifier-Free Code Embedding Models for Scalable Search

author.name: Eric Wolos, Michael Doyle

entry.summary: Develops identifier-free code embedding models for bidirectional association between source code and decompiled stripped code, fine-tuning Qwen3-Embedding for reverse engineering applications.

entry.title: Meta-learning for sample-efficient Bayesian optimisation of fed-batch processes

author.name: Becky Langdon, Gabriel D. Patr\'on, Chrysoula D. Kappatou, Robert M. Lee, Behrang Shafei, Jixiang Qing, Ruth Misener, Mark van der Wilk, Calvin Tsay

entry.summary: Investigates System-Aware Neural ODE Processes as meta-learning models for sample-efficient Bayesian optimization of fed-batch bioprocesses, addressing limitations of Gaussian processes for time-varying processes.

entry.title: Direct Estimation of Schr\"odinger Bridge Time-Series Drifts: Finite-Sample, Asymptotic, and Adaptive Guarantees

author.name: Othmane Mazhar, Huy\^en Pham

entry.summary: Studies nonparametric estimation of Schrödinger bridge drifts from i.i.d. data using Nadaraya-Watson plug-in estimators, providing finite-sample and asymptotic guarantees without relying on Sinkhorn iterations.

entry.title: Variational Smoothing and Inference for SDEs from Sparse Data with Dynamic Neural Flows

author.name: Yu Wang, Arnab Ganguly

entry.summary: Develops variational smoothing for SDEs from sparse data using neural networks trained to satisfy Kolmogorov backward equations with multiplicative updates at observation times.

entry.title: Closing the Loop: Unified 3D Scene Generation and Immersive Interaction via LLM-RL Coupling

author.name: Anh H. Vo, Sungyo Lee, Phil-Joong Kim, Soo-Mi Choi, Yong-Guk Kim

entry.summary: Presents a unified framework that closes the loop between LLM-driven 3D scene generation and immersive VR interaction, using reinforcement learning for spatial layout optimization under geometric and semantic constraints.

entry.title: Architecture Shape Governs QNN Trainability: Jacobian Null Space Growth and Parameter Efficiency

author.name: Michael Poppel, David Bucher, Maximilian Zorn, Markus Baumann, Sebastian W\"olckert, Claudia Linnhoff-Popien, Philipp Altmann, Jonas Stein

entry.summary: Shows that architecture shape (N qubits × L layers) in variational quantum circuits governs trainability through Jacobian null space growth, even when frequency spectra are identical. Proves structural rank deficiency as the mechanism.

entry.title: Revisiting Uncertainty: On Evidential Learning for Partially Relevant Video Retrieval

author.name: Jun Li, Peifeng Lai, Xuhang Lou, Jinpeng Wang, Yuting Wang, Ke Chen, Yaowei Wang, Shu-Tao Xia

entry.summary: Proposes Holmes, a hierarchical evidential learning framework for partially relevant video retrieval that explicitly models and quantifies uncertainty from vague queries and sparse temporal supervision.

entry.title: ConquerNet: Convolution-Smoothed Quantile ReLU Neural Networks with Minimax Guarantees

author.name: Tianpai Luo, Fangwei Wu, Weichi Wu

entry.summary: Proposes ConquerNet, convolution-smoothed quantile ReLU neural networks that yield smooth objectives for quantile regression while preserving the quantile structure, with minimax guarantees over Besov function classes.

entry.title: Covariate Balancing and Riesz Regression Should Be Guided by the Neyman Orthogonal Score in Debiased Machine Learning

author.name: Masahiro Kato

entry.summary: Argues that in debiased machine learning, balancing functions should be derived from the Neyman orthogonal score rather than chosen as functions of covariates alone, particularly for ATE estimation under treatment effect heterogeneity.

entry.title: IRC-Bench: Recognizing Entities from Contextual Cues in First-Person Reminiscences

author.name: Yehudit Aperstein, Eden Moran, Alexander Apartsin

entry.summary: Introduces IRC-Bench for implicit entity recognition in reminiscence narratives where entities must be inferred from distributed contextual cues rather than explicit mentions, targeting therapeutic and archival settings.

entry.title: Towards Emotion Consistency Analysis of Large Language Models in Emotional Conversational Contexts

author.name: Sneha Oram, Ojaswita Bhushan, Pushpak Bhattacharyya

entry.summary: Examines emotion consistency of LLMs when their own generated text is queried back to them with escalating false presuppositions, finding below-average performance in maintaining emotional consistency.

entry.title: Automated Clinical Report Generation for Remote Cognitive Remediation: Comparing Knowledge-Engineered Templates and LLMs in Low-Resource Settings

author.name: Yongxin Zhou, Fabien Ringeval, Fran\c{c}ois Portet

entry.summary: Compares rule-based templates vs. zero-shot GPT-4 for automated clinical report generation in cognitive remediation sessions, finding tradeoffs between clinical reliability and fluency in a low-resource setting.

entry.title: Bridging Passive and Active: Enhancing Conversation Starter Recommendation via Active Expression Modeling

author.name: Yiqing Wu, Haoming Li, Guanyu Jiang, Jiahao Liang, Yongchun Zhu, Jingwu Chen, Feng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes enhancing conversation starter recommendations by modeling user active expressions (like self-generated queries) rather than relying solely on the passive exposure-click feedback loop. Addresses the echo chamber problem in conversational search.

entry.title: egenioussBench: A New Dataset for Geospatial Visual Localisation

author.name: Phillipp Fanta-Jende, Francesco Vultaggio, Alexander Kern, Yasmin Loeper, Markus Gerke

entry.summary: Presents egenioussBench, a visual localization benchmark using geospatial reference data (city-scale airborne 3D mesh and CityGML LoD2 model) with smartphone query images having centimeter-accurate ground truth.

entry.title: Jointly Learning Structured Representations and Stabilized Affinity for Human Motion Segmentation

author.name: Xianghan Meng, Zhiyuan Huang, Zhengyu Tong, Chun-Guang Li

entry.summary: Proposes TDSC for human motion segmentation that jointly learns temporally consistent structured representations and stabilized affinity, addressing violations of the Union-of-Subspaces assumption in real videos.

entry.title: iPhoneBlur: A Difficulty-Stratified Benchmark for Consumer Device Motion Deblurring

author.name: Abdullah Al Shafi, Kazi Saeed Alam

entry.summary: Introduces iPhoneBlur, a difficulty-stratified benchmark for mobile motion deblurring with 7,400 image pairs from iPhone videos, categorized into Easy/Medium/Hard tiers. Reveals that aggregate metrics mask significant performance variation.

entry.title: Neuromorphic visual attention for Sign-language recognition on SpiNNaker

author.name: Sarka Liskova, Olha Vedmedenko, Mazdak Fatahi, Matej Hoffmann, P. Michael Furlong, Giulia D Angelo

entry.summary: Proposes an end-to-end neuromorphic architecture for ASL fingerspelling recognition combining spiking visual attention with SNN on SpiNNaker hardware, achieving low-latency energy-efficient perception.

entry.title: Domain Generalization through Spatial Relation Induction over Visual Primitives

author.name: Dat Nguyen, Duc-Duy Nguyen

entry.summary: Proposes PARSE, a framework that factors visual recognition into visual primitives and their relational composition for domain generalization. Uses graph neural networks to model spatial relationships between image parts for more robust cross-domain classification.

entry.title: Dynamic Pondering Sparsity-aware Mixture-of-Experts Transformer for Event Stream based Visual Object Tracking

author.name: Shiao Wang, Xiao Wang, Duoqing Yang, Wenhao Zhang, Bo Jiang, Lin Zhu, Yonghong Tian, Bin Luo

entry.summary: Proposes an event-camera-based tracking framework that explicitly models the spatial sparsity and temporal density of event data using a Mixture-of-Experts Transformer with dynamic pondering across multiple temporal scales.

entry.title: Retina-RAG: Retrieval-Augmented Vision-Language Modeling for Joint Retinal Diagnosis and Clinical Report Generation

author.name: Abdelrahman Zaian, Sheethal Bhat, Mohamed Abdalkader, Andreas Maier

entry.summary: Retina-RAG combines a retinal classifier with a parameter-efficient vision-language model (Qwen2.5-VL-7B) and retrieval-augmented generation for joint diabetic retinopathy grading, macular edema detection, and clinical report generation.

entry.title: Sparkle: Realizing Lively Instruction-Guided Video Background Replacement via Decoupled Guidance

author.name: Ziyun Zeng, Yiqi Lin, Guoqiang Liang, Mike Zheng Shou

entry.summary: Sparkle addresses instruction-guided video background replacement, a complex editing task requiring temporally consistent new scene synthesis with foreground-background interactions, using decoupled guidance.

entry.title: A GPU-Accelerated Hybrid Method for a Class of Multi-Depot Vehicle Routing Problems

author.name: Zhenyu Lei, Jin-Kao Hao

entry.summary: Proposes a GPU-accelerated hybrid algorithm for multi-depot vehicle routing problems, integrating learning-driven crossover with tensor-based GPU acceleration for improved computational efficiency.

entry.title: Real-world Latency Analysis of Vehicular Visible Light Communication with Multiple LED Transmitters and an Event-Based Camera

author.name: Ryota Soga, Tsukasa Shimizu, Shintaro Shiba, Quan Kong, Shan Lu, Takaya Yamazato

entry.summary: Presents an event-camera-based visible light communication system for vehicles addressing bandwidth saturation, multi-transmitter reception, and latency characterization in real vehicular scenarios.

entry.title: Monitoring autonomous persistent surveillance missions using invariance

author.name: Vladislav Nenchev, Prodromos Sotiriadis

entry.summary: Studies runtime monitoring for persistent surveillance by autonomous robots when the autonomy stack is a black box, using invariant-based monitoring with compositional decentralized computation.

entry.title: Axes of Planning in LLMs + Partial Lit Review

author.name: NickyP

entry.summary: A literature review and conceptual decomposition of 'planning' in language models, attempting to identify distinct axes along which planning-like behavior varies (e.g., temporal horizon, goal-directedness, lookahead). Categorizes existing work along these dimensions.

entry.title: Bandit Learning in General Open Multi-agent Systems

author.name: Mengfan Xu

entry.summary: Formulates bandit learning in general open multi-agent systems where agents arrive and depart, introducing new concepts to handle heterogeneous rewards and general agent patterns without restrictive structural assumptions.

entry.title: Beyond Rigid Alignment: Graph Federated Learning via Dual Manifold Calibration

author.name: Wentao Yu, Bo Han, Jie Yang, Chen Gong

entry.summary: Proposes a dual manifold calibration approach for graph federated learning that avoids rigid parameter/prototype alignment, instead using manifold-based calibration to handle semantic and structural heterogeneity across clients.

entry.title: Von Neumann Networks

author.name: Shekhar S. Chandra

entry.summary: Proposes 'Von Neumann Networks' inspired by cellular automata, creating neurons with specialized learnable roles on a cellular array, resulting in self-engineered architecture dependent only on input/output structure.

entry.title: Empirical Evidence for Simply Connected Decision Regions in Image Classifiers

author.name: Arjhun Swaminathan, Mete Akg\"un

entry.summary: Proposes an iterative quad-mesh filling procedure to test whether decision regions in image classifiers are simply connected (contractible loops), providing empirical evidence that they are.

entry.title: Adaptive Physical-Facial Representation Fusion via Subject-Invariant Cross-Modal Prompt Tuning for Video-Based Emotion Recognition

author.name: Xiwen Luo, Jia Li, Rencheng Song, Yu Liu, Juan Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes a subject-invariant cross-modal prompt-tuning framework for video-based emotion recognition that fuses facial and rPPG features while suppressing subject-specific variations.

entry.title: Na-IRSTD: Enhancing Infrared Small Target Detection via Native-Resolution Feature Selection and Fusion

author.name: Qian Xu, Chi Zhang, Qiming Zhang, Xi Li, Haojuan Yuan, Mingjin Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Na-IRSTD for infrared small target detection that maintains native-resolution features throughout processing, using token reduction and selection to preserve subtle target cues while remaining efficient.

entry.title: PersonaGesture: Single-Reference Co-Speech Gesture Personalization for Unseen Speakers

author.name: Xiangyue Zhang, Yiyi Cai, Kunhang Li, Kaixing Yang, You Zhou, Zhengqing Li, Xuangeng Chu, Jiaxu Zhang, Haiyang Liu

entry.summary: PersonaGesture is a diffusion-based pipeline for generating co-speech gestures that match a specific speaker's style from just one reference motion clip. Uses Adaptive Style Infusion and Implicit Distribution Rectification to separate speaker identity from utterance-specific motion.

entry.title: Tumor-aware augmentation with task-guided attention analysis improves rectal cancer segmentation from magnetic resonance images

author.name: Aneesh Rangnekar, Joao Miranda, Natally Horvat, Stephanie Chahwan, Samir Alrayess, Aditya Apte, Aditi Iyer, Eve LoCastro, Revathi Ravella, Marc J Gollub, Iva Petkovska, Jesse Joshua Smith, Paul Romesser, Julio Garcia-Aguilar, Harini Veeraraghavan, Joseph Deasy

entry.summary: Proposes tumor-aware augmentation with task-guided attention analysis for rectal cancer segmentation in MRI, addressing failure modes when transferring CT-pretrained transformers to MRI.

entry.title: Track A*: Fast Visibility-Aware Trajectory Planning for Active Target Tracking

author.name: Hanxuan Chen, Kangli Wang, Ji Pei

entry.summary: Track A* is an offline trajectory planner for active target tracking using beam-pruned search on 4D spatio-temporal grids with visibility-awareness, including BVH-based obstacle caching for efficiency.

entry.title: Robust $\mathcal{H}_\infty$ Controller Design For INDI-Controlled Quadrotor Using Online Parameter Identification

author.name: Tom Aantjes, Till M. Blaha, Spilios Theodoulis, Ewoud J. J. Smeur

entry.summary: Presents robust gain-scheduled H-infinity controller design for INDI-controlled quadrotors with online parameter identification, enabling full system identification during a throw in the air.

entry.title: The Impossibility Triangle of Long-Context Modeling

author.name: Yan Zhou

entry.summary: As first reported in Research yesterday, Proves a fundamental impossibility triangle for long-context models: no model can simultaneously achieve per-step efficiency, compact state, and linear recall. Uses Data Processing Inequality and Fano's Inequality to show recall limits under efficiency and compactness constraints.

entry.title: Design Conductor 2.0: An agent builds a TurboQuant inference accelerator in 80 hours

author.name: The Verkor Team, Ravi Krishna, Suresh Krishna, David Chin

entry.summary: As first reported in Research yesterday, Presents Design Conductor 2.0, a multi-agent system powered by April 2026 frontier models that autonomously designs hardware including an LLM inference accelerator (VerTQ) for TurboQuant in 80 hours - handling 80x larger tasks than the prior version.

entry.title: LINC: Decoupling Local Consequence Scoring from Hidden Matching in Constructive Neural Routing

author.name: Shaofeng Qin, Li Wang

entry.summary: Proposes LINC for constructive neural routing that explicitly computes deterministic one-step consequences (travel, waiting, capacity) rather than hiding them in hidden state matching, applied to vehicle routing with time windows.

entry.title: InkDiffuser: High-Fidelity One-shot Chinese Calligraphy via Differentiable Morphological Optimization

author.name: Kunchong Shi, Jing Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes InkDiffuser for one-shot Chinese calligraphy synthesis using diffusion models with high-frequency enhancement and a Differentiable Ink Structure loss for realistic ink morphology.

entry.title: T2I-VeRW: Part-level Fine-grained Perception for Text-to-Image Vehicle Retrieval

author.name: Xiao Wang, Ziwen Wang, Weizhe Kong, Wentao Wu, Yuehang Li, Aihua Zheng, Chenglong Li, Jin Tang

entry.summary: Proposes PFCVR for text-to-image vehicle retrieval with part-level fine-grained cross-modal alignment using learnable part-query tokens and bi-directional mask recovery.

entry.title: Regularized Centered Emphatic Temporal Difference Learning

author.name: Xingguo Chen, Chaohui Wu, Jinguo Ye, Chao Li, Shangdong Yang, Guang Yang, Tianyu Liang, Wenhao Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Regularized Emphatic Temporal-Difference Learning (RETD), addressing the tradeoff between stability, projection geometry, and variance control in off-policy TD learning. Shows that naive centered emphatic extensions can destroy positive-definiteness and provides a regularization fix.

entry.title: On-line Learning in Tree MDPs by Treating Policies as Bandit Arms

author.name: Anvay Shah, Ramsundar Anandanarayanan, Sharayu Moharir, Shivaram Kalyanakrishnan

entry.summary: Studies online learning in Tree MDPs by treating each policy as a bandit arm, showing that LUCB and UCB algorithms can be applied despite the exponential number of policies through novel confidence bounds based on decomposition of policy returns.

entry.title: Analogy between Boltzmann machines and Feynman path integrals

author.name: Srinivasan S. Iyengar, Sabre Kais

entry.summary: Provides a detailed exposition connecting Boltzmann machines in ML to Feynman path integrals in quantum statistical mechanics, interpreting hidden layers as discrete versions of path elements in the path-integral formalism.

entry.title: Meta-LegNet: A Transferable and Interpretable Framework for Surface Adsorption Prediction via Self-Defined Adsorption-Environment Learning

author.name: Yifan Li, Arravind Subramanian, Xiaoqing Liu, Qiujie Lyu, Sergey Kozlov, Lei Shen

entry.summary: Introduces Meta-LegNet for computational catalysis, combining SE(3)-equivariant message passing with voxel-based multiscale aggregation and cross-domain meta-learning for predicting adsorption configurations on complex surfaces.

entry.title: Deep Wave Network for Modeling Multi-Scale Physical Dynamics

author.name: Alexander I. Khrabry, Edward A. Startsev, Andrew T. Powis, Igor D. Kaganovich

entry.summary: Proposes Deep Wave Network for multi-scale physical dynamics modeling, addressing the issue that U-Net-type models are often compared at single fixed sizes rather than across their accuracy-cost scaling curves.

entry.title: ARMATA: Auto-Regressive Multi-Agent Task Assignment

author.name: Yazan Youssef, Aboelmagd Noureldin, Sidney Givigi

entry.summary: Proposes ARMATA, a centralized end-to-end autoregressive framework that jointly generates allocation decisions and routing sequences for multi-agent task assignment through a unified multi-stage decoding mechanism.

entry.title: DAO-enabled decentralized physical AI: A new paradigm for human-machine collaboration

author.name: Mark C. Ballandies, Florian Spychiger, Uwe Serd\"ult, Claudio J. Tessone

entry.summary: Proposes DAO-enabled decentralized physical AI (DePAI), a democratic architecture using blockchain and DAOs for coordinating humans and autonomous machines in physical-digital systems, connecting crypto-economics with digital democracy research.

entry.title: Modular Reinforcement Learning For Cooperative Swarms

author.name: Erel Shtossel, Gal A. Kaminka

entry.summary: Proposes a modular approach for representing spatial interaction states in multi-robot swarms using reinforcement learning. The method addresses memory limitations of computationally-limited robots by decomposing interaction states, enabling scalable cooperative behavior.

entry.title: Data-Driven Variational Basis Learning Beyond Neural Networks: A Non-Neural Framework for Adaptive Basis Discovery

author.name: Andrew Kiruluta

entry.summary: Develops Data-Driven Variational Basis Learning (DVBL), a non-neural framework that learns basis functions from data through variational optimization, offering interpretability and explicit structural control absent in neural networks.

entry.title: Two-Stage Learned Decomposition for Scalable Routing on Multigraphs

author.name: Filip Rydin, Morteza Haghir Chehreghani, Bal\'azs Kulcs\'ar

entry.summary: Proposes Node-Edge Policy Factorization for vehicle routing on multigraphs, splitting the policy into node permutation and edge selection stages with hierarchical RL training.

entry.title: Active Learning for Conditional Generative Compressed Sensing

author.name: Alexander DeLise, Nick Dexter

entry.summary: Studies conditional generative compressed sensing using prompt-conditioned generators, proving stable recovery bounds for ReLU and Lipschitz generators with prompt-matched Christoffel sampling.

entry.title: Robustness of Graph Self-Supervised Learning to Real-World Noise: A Case Study on Text-Driven Biomedical Graphs

author.name: Othmane Kabal, Mounira Harzallah, Fabrice Guillet, Hideaki Takeda, Ryutaro Ichise

entry.summary: Provides first comprehensive evaluation of Graph Self-Supervised Learning methods on noisy text-driven graphs, introducing NATD-GSSL framework for evaluating robustness to real-world noise from automatic knowledge graph construction.

entry.title: PRISM: Iterative Cross-Modal Posterior Refinement for Dynamic Text-Attributed Graphs

author.name: Trimble Chang, Yihang Liu, Mingjing Han, Han Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes PRISM, an iterative cross-modal posterior refinement framework for dynamic text-attributed graphs that jointly refines semantic and behavioral modalities through iterative variational inference rather than one-shot fusion.

entry.title: Constrained Contextual Bandits with Adversarial Contexts

author.name: Dhruv Sarkar, Abhishek Sinha

entry.summary: Studies budget-constrained contextual bandits with adversarial contexts, proposing a framework based on SquareCB that leverages online regression oracles to simultaneously control regret and budget violation.

entry.title: Band Together: Untargeted Adversarial Training with Multimodal Coordination against Evasion-based Promotion Attacks

author.name: Guanmeng Xian, Ning Yang, Philip S. Yu

entry.summary: Identifies cross-modal gradient mismatch in multimodal recommender systems under evasion-based promotion attacks, and proposes adversarial training with multimodal coordination to address this vulnerability.

entry.title: PACE: Prune-And-Compress Ensemble Models

author.name: Fabian Akkerman, Julien Ferry, Th\'eo Guyard, Thibaut Vidal

entry.summary: Introduces PACE, a framework that interleaves pruning and compression for ensemble models, first generating diverse learners via a theoretically grounded procedure, then pruning the enriched ensemble.

entry.title: Region Seeding via Pre-Activation Regularization: A Geometric View from Piecewise Affine Nerual Networks

author.name: Yi Wei, Xuan Qi, Furao Shen

entry.summary: Proposes pre-activation regularization to bring neuron switching surfaces closer to data points, increasing the number of realized affine regions in data-visited neighborhoods for piecewise affine neural networks.

entry.title: Federated Cross-Client Subgraph Pattern Detection

author.name: Selin Ceydeli, Rui Wang, Kubilay Atasu

entry.summary: Proposes a per-step layer-wise embedding exchange framework for federated cross-client subgraph pattern detection, formalizing the structural observability problem when subgraph patterns cross partition boundaries.

entry.title: CLAD: A Clustered Label-Agnostic Federated Learning Framework for Joint Anomaly Detection and Attack Classification

author.name: Iason Ofeidis, Nikos Papadis, Randeep Bhatia, Leandros Tassiulas, TV Lakshman

entry.summary: Proposes CLAD, a federated learning framework combining clustered FL with a dual-mode micro-architecture for joint anomaly detection and attack classification in IoT networks, handling unlabeled data.

entry.title: Online Bayesian Calibration under Gradual and Abrupt System Changes

author.name: Yang Xu, Chiwoo Park

entry.summary: Proposes online Bayesian calibration methods for digital twins that handle both gradual drift and abrupt regime shifts, addressing parameter-discrepancy confounding in non-stationary settings.

entry.title: A Review of Large Language Models for Stock Price Forecasting from a Hedge-Fund Perspective

author.name: Olivia Zhang, Zhilin Zhang

entry.summary: Reviews LLM applications for stock price forecasting from a hedge fund perspective, covering sentiment extraction, financial report analysis, and multi-agent trading systems while highlighting practical pitfalls like data leakage.

entry.title: A renormalization-group inspired lattice-based framework for piecewise generalized linear models

author.name: Joshua C. Chang

entry.summary: Introduces renormalization-group inspired lattice-based models for piecewise generalized linear models that are locally linear like ReLU networks but with explicit, interpretable partition structure.

entry.title: Stability of the Monge Map in Semi-Dual Optimal Transport

author.name: Anton Selitskiy, David Millard

entry.summary: Shows that the semi-dual optimal transport formulation has a degenerate saddle-point structure and derives necessary/sufficient conditions for Monge map convergence without requiring dual potential optimality.

entry.title: RAM-H1200: A Unified Evaluation and Dataset on Hand Radiographs for Rheumatoid Arthritis

author.name: Songxiao Yang, Haolin Wang, Yao Fu, Junmu Peng, Lin Fan, Hongruixuan Chen, Jian Song, Masayuki Ikebe, Shinya Takamaeda-Yamazaki, Masatoshi Okutomi, Tamotsu Kamishima, Yafei Ou

entry.summary: Introduces RAM-H1200 dataset with 1200 hand radiographs from six centers for rheumatoid arthritis assessment, including multi-level annotations for bone structure segmentation and clinical scoring.

entry.title: Leveraging Image Generators to Address Training Data Scarcity: The Gen4Regen Dataset for Forest Regeneration Mapping

author.name: Gabriel Jeanson, David-Alexandre Duclos, William Larriv\'ee-Hardy, No\'e Cochet, Mat\v{e}j Boxan, Anthony Desch\^enes, Fran\c{c}ois Pomerleau, Philippe Gigu\`ere

entry.summary: Introduces Gen4Regen dataset using image generators to address training data scarcity for forest regeneration species mapping from UAV imagery, providing a scalable framework for reducing reliance on expert annotation.

entry.title: Optimal Confidence Band for Kernel Gradient Flow Estimator

author.name: Yuqian Cheng, Zhuo Chen, Qian Lin

entry.summary: Establishes minimax optimal convergence rates for the supremum-norm generalization error of kernel gradient flows and constructs simultaneous confidence bands whose widths achieve these optimal rates.

entry.title: PREFER: Personalized Review Summarization with Online Preference Learning

author.name: Millend Roy, Agostino Capponi, Vineet Goyal

entry.summary: Proposes PREFER, an online learning framework for generating personalized product review summaries that iteratively refines understanding of user preferences through feedback.

entry.title: Gaussian mixture models in Hilbert spaces via kernel methods

author.name: Daniel L\'opez-Montero, Antonio \'Alvarez-L\'opez, Marcos Matabuena

entry.summary: Proposes a Gaussian mixture framework for Hilbert-space-valued data using kernel mean embeddings, with theoretical guarantees for clustering in infinite-dimensional spaces.

entry.title: Bridging visual saliency and large language models for explainable deep learning in medical imaging

author.name: Paul Valery Nguezet, Elie Tagne Fute, Yusuf Brima, Benoit Martin Azanguezet, Marcellin Atemkeng

entry.summary: Presents a multimodal explainability framework bridging CNN predictions and LLM-generated diagnostic narratives for brain tumor classification, using saliency maps as intermediate representation.

entry.title: Generating Query-Focused Summarization Datasets from Query-Free Summarization Datasets

author.name: Yllias Chali, Deen Abdullah

entry.summary: Proposes a method to automatically generate evidence-based query keywords from query-free summarization datasets, enabling their use for query-focused summarization tasks.

entry.title: Linear Semantic Segmentation for Low-Resource Spoken Dialects

author.name: Kirill Chirkunov, Younes Samih, Abed Alhakim Freihat, Hanan Aldarmaki

entry.summary: Introduces a benchmark and method for semantic segmentation of dialectal Arabic discourse, covering informal conversations, code-switching, and other low-resource spoken varieties.

entry.title: MultiLinguahah : A New Unsupervised Multilingual Acoustic Laughter Segmentation Method

author.name: Callejas Sofia, Gomez Nahuel, Pelachaud Catherine, Ravenet Brian, Barriere Valentin

entry.summary: Proposes an unsupervised multilingual laughter segmentation method using Isolation Forest on BYOL-A audio representations, framing laughter detection as anomaly detection of energy-based audio sequences.

entry.title: Tamaththul3D: High-Fidelity 3D Saudi Sign Language Avatars from Monocular Video

author.name: Eyad Alghamdi, Sattam Altuuaim, Obay Ghulam, Abdulrahman Qutah, Yousef Basoodan

entry.summary: Introduces the first high-quality 3D parametric annotations for Saudi Sign Language and a specialized reconstruction pipeline (Tamaththul3D) for Arabic sign language that handles its unique articulation patterns.

entry.title: A Novel Graph-Regulated Disentangling Mamba Model with Sparse Tokens for Enhanced Tree Species Classification from MODIS Time Series

author.name: Motasem Alkayid, Zhengsen Xu, Saeid Taleghanidoozdoozan, Yimin Zhu, Megan Greenwood, Quinn Ledingham, Zack Dewis, Mabel Heffring, Naser El-Sheimy, Lincoln Linlin Xu

entry.summary: Proposes GDS-Mamba for tree species classification from MODIS time series, using graph-regulated disentangling and sparse token strategies to handle spatial-spectral-temporal coupling and large-scale context.

entry.title: Understanding Cross-Language Transfer Improvements in Low-Resource HTR: The Role of Sequence Modeling

author.name: Sana Al-azzawi, Chang Liu, Nudrat Habib, Elisa Barney, Marcus Liwicki

entry.summary: Studies cross-language transfer in Arabic-script handwritten text recognition, finding that improvements from joint training are primarily due to sequence modeling (CRNN) rather than shared visual representations.

entry.title: AMIEOD: Adaptive Multi-Experts Image Enhancement for Object Detection in Low-Illumination Scenes

author.name: Xiaochen Huang, Honggang Chen, Weicheng Zhang, Xiaobo Dai, Yongyi Li, Linbo Qing, Xiaohai He

entry.summary: AMIEOD proposes a joint image enhancement and object detection framework for low-illumination scenes, using multiple expert enhancement strategies guided by detection performance feedback.

entry.title: Boosting Self-Supervised Tracking with Contextual Prompts and Noise Learning

author.name: Yaozong Zheng, Qihua Liang, Bineng Zhong, Shuimu Zeng, Yuanliang Xue, Ning Li, Shuxiang Song

entry.summary: Proposes a self-supervised tracking framework using dual-modal context association with fine-grained semantic prompts and contextual noise to learn robust tracking representations without labels.

entry.title: Pest-Thinker: Learning to Think and Reason like Entomologists via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Xueheng Li, Yu Wang, Tao Hu, Ji Huang, Ke Cao, Qize Yang, Rui Li, Jie Zhang, Chengjun Xie

entry.summary: Pest-Thinker applies reinforcement learning to enable multimodal LLMs to reason about fine-grained pest morphology for agricultural pest recognition. Constructs two new pest benchmarks with expert annotations.

entry.title: Look Beyond Saliency: Low-Attention Guided Dual Encoding for Video Semantic Search

author.name: Faisal Aljehrai, Mohammed A. Alkhrashi, Alreem Almuhrij, Sarah Abuhimed, Noorh Aldossary, Abdullah Aldwyish, Raied Aljadaany, Huda Alamri, Muhammad Kamran J Khan

entry.summary: Proposes Inverse Attention Embedding that explicitly captures overlooked background regions in video semantic search, complementing traditional visual embeddings to improve retrieval in crowded scenes without additional training.

entry.title: DPM++: Dynamic Masked Metric Learning for Occluded Person Re-identification

author.name: Lei Tan, Yingshi Luan, Pincong Zou, Pingyang Dai, Liujuan Cao

entry.summary: DPM++ proposes Dynamic Masked Metric Learning for occluded person re-identification, addressing the mismatch between incomplete occluded samples and holistic identity representations through unified visibility-consistent matching.

entry.title: GlazyBench: A Benchmark for Ceramic Glaze Property Prediction and Image Generation

author.name: Ziyu Zhai, Siyou Li, Juexi Shao, Juntao Yu

entry.summary: GlazyBench introduces the first dataset for AI-assisted ceramic glaze design with 23,148 formulations, supporting property prediction from raw materials and visual generation of glazes.

entry.title: Topology-Driven Anti-Entanglement Control for Soft Robots

author.name: Haoyang Le, Shengxuan Wang, Mohan Chen, Shuo Feng

entry.summary: Proposes a topology-driven multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for coordinating soft robots to avoid entanglement in constrained manufacturing environments.

entry.title: AssistDLO: Assistive Teleoperation for Deformable Linear Object Manipulation

author.name: Berk Guler, Simon Manschitz, Kay Pompetzki, Jan Peters

entry.summary: Presents AssistDLO, a teleoperation framework for deformable linear object manipulation that combines multi-view state estimation, visual assistance, and a geometry-aware shared-autonomy controller using Control Barrier Functions.

entry.title: Lie Group Formulation of Recursive Dynamics Algorithms of Higher Order for Floating-Base Robots

author.name: Ahmed Ali, Chiara Gabellieri, Antonio Franchi

entry.summary: Derives higher-order time derivatives of Lie-group Newton-Euler, Articulated-Body Inertia, and hybrid dynamics algorithms for floating-base robots with SE(3) base configuration. Identifies admissible Coriolis matrices satisfying passivity properties.

entry.title: Multipolar Civilisation Depends on Maintaining an Attacker’s Dilemma

author.name: Naci Cankaya

entry.summary: Argues that maintaining a multipolar civilization depends on preserving an 'attacker's dilemma' (making offense costly relative to defense) through mechanisms like verification, monitoring, and enforcement that create deterrence without requiring a single hegemonic enforcer.

entry.title: Cognitive Twins: Investigating Personalized Thinking Model Building and Its Performance Enhancement with Human-in-the-Loop

author.name: Wu-Yuin Hwang, Nur Alif Ilyasa, Muhammad Irfan Luthfi, Yuniar Indrihapsari

entry.summary: Presents Personalized Thinking Model (PTM) for AI-supported education, organizing learner evidence into a five-layer cognitive structure and evaluating it through a human-in-the-loop study with 40 participants.

entry.title: Guidelines for Designing AI Technologies to Support Adult Learning

author.name: Jennifer M. Reddig, Glen R. Smith Jr, Sanaz Ahmadzadeh Siyahrood, Wesley G. Morris, Yoojin Bae, Kaitlyn Crutcher, John Kos, Rahul K. Dass, Jinho Kim, Momin Naushad Siddiqui, Daniel Weitekamp, Ploy Thajchayapong, Sandeep Kakar, Alex Endert, Scott Crossley, Min Kyu Kim, Chris Dede, Ashok Goel, Christopher J. MacLellan

entry.summary: Presents guidelines for designing AI educational technologies for adult learners, based on reflexive thematic analysis of deployments within a national research institute. Addresses the gap between K-12 focused AI education research and adult learning needs.

entry.title: Research Summary: May 07, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research spans AI infrastructure at scale, fundamental theoretical limits, and safety/alignment advances.

  • MRC and SRv6 from OpenAI/Microsoft define production-grade networking for AI supercomputers, enabling trillion-parameter training resilience
  • The Impossibility Triangle formalizes that long-context models cannot simultaneously achieve efficiency, expressiveness, and memory — a key architectural constraint
  • Francis Bach and Michael I. Jordan derive analytical conditions for alignment collapse in iterative RLHF, proposing preventive gradient corrections
  • Design Conductor 2.0 demonstrates frontier models autonomously building an LLM inference accelerator in 80 hours, an 80x speedup over prior work

Safety and interpretability see notable advances: authority laundering reveals how adversarial perturbations cause VLMs to give confidently wrong answers, while the predictive-causal gap proves optimal predictive encoders fundamentally diverge from causal ones across 2695 neural configurations. Paul Christiano and Jacob Hilton contribute a sampling-free method for estimating wide MLP outputs using cumulant expansions. TRIBE v2 bridges neuroscience and AI with a tri-modal foundation model predicting brain activity across 720 subjects.

entry.title: Laundering AI Authority with Adversarial Examples

author.name: Jie Zhang, Pura Peetathawatchai, Florian Tram\`er, Avital Shafran

entry.summary: Demonstrates 'AI authority laundering' where adversarial perturbations to images cause VLMs to give confident, authoritative responses about wrong inputs. Shows standard CLIP attacks transfer to production VLMs including GPT and Claude.

entry.title: Explaining and Preventing Alignment Collapse in Iterative RLHF

author.name: Etienne Gauthier, Francis Bach, Michael I. Jordan

entry.summary: Derives analytical decomposition of RLHF optimization gradient into standard policy gradient and parameter-steering term, showing standard iterative RLHF suffers 'alignment collapse' as policy exploits RM blind spots. Proposes corrections based on the Stackelberg game formulation.

entry.title: Efficiently Aligning Language Models with Online Natural Language Feedback

author.name: Christine Ye, Joe Benton

entry.summary: Develops methods for aligning LLMs in 'fuzzy' domains where verification is difficult, using online natural language feedback from experts. The approach iteratively optimizes against proxy reward signals while collecting fresh expert supervision and updating the proxy reward model.

entry.title: Understanding In-Context Learning for Nonlinear Regression with Transformers: Attention as Featurizer

author.name: Alexander Hsu, Zhaiming Shen, Wenjing Liao, Rongjie Lai

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of in-context learning (ICL) for nonlinear regression, showing how attention mechanisms can construct nonlinear features like polynomial or spline bases. Establishes a framework analyzing end-to-end in-context nonlinear regression beyond the linear setting.

entry.title: A foundation model of vision, audition, and language for in-silico neuroscience

author.name: St\'ephane d'Ascoli, J\'er\'emy Rapin, Yohann Benchetrit, Teon Brooks, Katelyn Begany, Jos\'ephine Raugel, Hubert Banville, Jean-R\'emi King

entry.summary: Introduces TRIBE v2, a tri-modal (video, audio, language) foundation model predicting human brain activity across diverse conditions. Uses 1,000+ hours of fMRI across 720 subjects and enables in-silico experimentation for neuroscience.

entry.title: The Predictive-Causal Gap: An Impossibility Theorem and Large-Scale Neural Evidence

author.name: Kejun Liu

entry.summary: Proves a fundamental predictive-causal gap: across 2695 neural network configurations, optimal predictive encoders track the environment rather than the system of interest. Shows this is structural (not an optimization artifact) and worsens with dimensionality.

entry.title: From Parameter Dynamics to Risk Scoring : Quantifying Sample-Level Safety Degradation in LLM Fine-tuning

author.name: Xiao Wang, Yifei Zhang, YongKang Liu, Xiaocui Yang, Zihan Wang, Shi Feng, Daling Wang

entry.summary: Uncovers a mechanism underlying safety degradation during LLM fine-tuning: benign fine-tuning causes parameters to cumulatively drift toward danger-aligned directions. Proposes a sample-level risk scoring method to identify high-risk training samples before fine-tuning.

entry.title: Single-Position Intervention Fails: Distributed Output Templates Drive In-Context Learning

author.name: Bryan Cheng, Jasper Zhang

entry.summary: Reveals that single-position activation intervention achieves 0% task transfer across all 28 layers of Llama-3.2-3B despite 100% probing accuracy, demonstrating task encoding is fundamentally distributed. Multi-position intervention at demonstration output tokens achieves up to 90% transfer.

entry.title: Power Distribution Bridges Sampling, Self-Reward RL, and Self-Distillation

author.name: Akiyoshi Tomihari, Issei Sato

entry.summary: Shows that the power distribution (target of power sampling) unifies sampling, self-reward KL-regularized RL, and self-distillation for LLMs. Demonstrates that local approximations cannot reproduce sequence-level power without suffix information, providing theoretical clarity on RL vs. sampling debates.

entry.title: Estimating the expected output of wide random MLPs more efficiently than sampling

author.name: Wilson Wu, Victor Lecomte, Michael Winer, George Robinson, Jacob Hilton, Paul Christiano

entry.summary: Shows how to estimate the expected output of wide random MLPs over Gaussian inputs without sampling, using cumulants and Hermite expansions. Demonstrates theoretically and empirically that this estimator achieves target MSE with fewer FLOPs than Monte Carlo for sufficiently wide networks.

entry.title: SVD on Weight Differences for Model Auditing

author.name: Mukesh R

entry.summary: Introduces SVD-based model auditing technique that truncates weight difference matrices to rank-1 to isolate hidden behaviors in fine-tuned models, achieving SOTA results on AuditBench's 56 model organisms spanning 14 hidden behaviors.

entry.title: Gradients with Respect to Semantics Preserving Embeddings Tell the Uncertainty of Large Language Models

author.name: Mingda Li, Rundong Lv, Xinyu Li, Weinan Zhang, Ting Liu

entry.summary: SemGrad is the first gradient-based uncertainty quantification method for free-form LLM generation that's sampling-free. It measures confidence by checking output stability under semantically equivalent input perturbations in semantic space.

entry.title: A Queueing-Theoretic Framework for Stability Analysis of LLM Inference with KV Cache Memory Constraints

author.name: Chengyi Nie, Nian Si, Zijie Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces the first queueing-theoretic framework for LLM inference that explicitly incorporates both computation and KV cache memory constraints, deriving stability conditions for whether an inference service can sustain demand without unbounded queue growth.

entry.title: Deployment-Relevant Alignment Cannot Be Inferred from Model-Level Evaluation Alone

author.name: Varad Vishwarupe, Nigel Shadbolt, Marina Jirotka, Ivan Flechais

entry.summary: Argues that deployment-relevant alignment cannot be inferred from model-level evaluation alone, proposing that alignment claims should be indexed to the level of evidence collection (model, response, interaction, or deployment level). Audits 16 alignment benchmarks.

entry.title: Balanced Aggregation: Understanding and Fixing Aggregation Bias in GRPO

author.name: Zhiyuan Zeng, Jiameng Huang, Zhangyue Yin, Jiashuo Liu, Ziniu Li, Bingrui Li, Yuhao Wu, Yining Zheng, Ge Zhang, Wenhao Huang, Xipeng Qiu

entry.summary: Identifies and fixes aggregation bias in GRPO: token aggregation introduces sign-length coupling while sequence aggregation downweights longer responses. Proposes 'Balanced Aggregation' to address both biases.

entry.title: Critical Windows of Complexity Control: When Transformers Decide to Reason or Memorize

author.name: Sarwan Ali

entry.summary: Shows that transformer models have 'critical windows' during training where complexity control (weight decay) determines whether the model learns to reason or memorize. Weight decay applied for just 25% of training matches full-training performance on OOD tasks.

entry.title: Superposition Is Not Necessary: A Mechanistic Interpretability Analysis of Transformer Representations for Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Alper Y{\i}ld{\i}r{\i}m

entry.summary: Uses sparse autoencoders to probe PatchTST representations and finds that transformers don't use superposition for time series forecasting — a single narrow layer matches deeper configurations, and representations are monosemantic. Explains why simple linear models remain competitive.

entry.title: Data-dependent Exploration for Online Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback

author.name: Zhen-Yu Zhang, Yuting Tang, Jiandong Zhang, Lanjihong Ma, Masashi Sugiyama

entry.summary: Proposes data-dependent exploration strategies for online RLHF that avoid reliance on on-policy expectations, which are difficult to estimate from limited preference data. Addresses the problem of premature down-weighting of under-explored regions in LLM alignment.

entry.title: Manifold Steering Reveals the Shared Geometry of Neural Network Representation and Behavior

author.name: Daniel Wurgaft, Can Rager, Matthew Kowal, Vasudev Shyam, Sheridan Feucht, Usha Bhalla, Tal Haklay, Eric Bigelow, Raphael Sarfati, Thomas McGrath, Owen Lewis, Jack Merullo, Noah Goodman, Thomas Fel, Atticus Geiger, Ekdeep Singh Lubana

entry.summary: Manifold steering shows that neural network activation geometry causally shapes behavior: interventions following the activation manifold yield behaviors that stay on the behavior manifold, while off-manifold interventions produce out-of-distribution behaviors.

entry.title: Perturbation is All You Need for Extrapolating Language Models

author.name: Zetai Cen, Jin Zhu, Xinwei Shen, Chengchun Shi

entry.summary: Proposes a perturbation-based training framework for LLMs that conditions next-token prediction on semantically perturbed prefixes rather than exact ones. Develops rigorous theory of extrapolability - capacity to predict for sequences outside training support.

entry.title: AI Safety at the Frontier: Paper Highlights of April 2026

author.name: gasteigerjo

entry.summary: Comprehensive monthly review of AI safety papers from April 2026, highlighting UK AISI's research-sabotage eval finding zero unprompted sabotage, LinuxArena control evaluation environments, parallel automated researcher results, and organizational ethics findings.

entry.title: Demystifying Manifold Constraints in LLM Pre-training

author.name: Kang An, Jiaxiang Li, Donald Goldfarb, Shiqian Ma

entry.summary: Introduces MACRO, a provably convergent Riemannian optimizer for LLM pre-training that disentangles the role of manifold constraints from normalization layers and weight decay. Provides theoretical understanding of why constrained optimization helps LLM training.

entry.title: Coral: Cost-Efficient Multi-LLM Serving over Heterogeneous Cloud GPUs

author.name: Yixuan Mei, Zikun Li, Zixuan Chen, Shiqi Pan, Mengdi Wu, Xupeng Miao, Zhihao Jia, K. V. Rashmi

entry.summary: Coral is a system for efficiently serving multiple LLMs across heterogeneous cloud GPUs by jointly optimizing resource allocation and serving strategy. It uses a lossless two-stage decomposition to handle shifting throughput demand and resource availability.

entry.title: Grokability in five inequalities

author.name: Paata Ivanisvili, Xinyuan Xie

entry.summary: Reports five mathematical discoveries made in collaboration with Grok AI (all subsequently verified by authors), including improved bounds on Gaussian perimeter, moment comparison inequalities, autoconvolution, Sidon sets, and Szarek's inequality.

entry.title: Concurrence of Symmetry Breaking and Nonlocality Phase Transitions in Diffusion Models

author.name: Yifan F. Zhang, Fangjun Hu, Guangkuo Liu, Mert Okyay, Xun Gao

entry.summary: Studies whether symmetry breaking and nonlocality phase transitions in diffusion models are concurrent, finding near-simultaneous occurrence in modern diffusion transformers. Unifies two theoretical perspectives on critical phenomena in generation dynamics.

entry.title: KernelBench-X: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating LLM-Generated GPU Kernels

author.name: Han Wang, Jintao Zhang, Kai Jiang, Haoxu Wang, Jianfei Chen, Jun Zhu

entry.summary: KernelBench-X benchmarks LLM-generated Triton GPU kernels across 176 tasks in 15 categories, finding that task structure determines correctness more than method design (category explains 3x more variance than method choice).

entry.title: LCM: Lossless Context Management

author.name: Clint Ehrlich, Theodore Blackman

entry.summary: Introduces Lossless Context Management (LCM), a deterministic architecture for LLM memory that claims to outperform Claude Code on long-context tasks. Their LCM-augmented agent 'Volt' achieves higher scores on the OOLONG eval across context lengths from 32K to 1M tokens using Opus 4.6.

entry.title: Frontier Lag: A Bibliometric Audit of Capability Misrepresentation in Academic AI Evaluation

author.name: David Gringras, Misha Salahshoor

entry.summary: Conducts a bibliometric audit of 112,303 papers finding that academic AI evaluations systematically lag frontier capabilities by months/years. Papers evaluate older models without proper elicitation, creating misleading claims about 'AI' capability.

entry.title: Undetectable Backdoors in Model Parameters: Hiding Sparse Secrets in High Dimensions

author.name: Sarthak Choudhary, Atharv Singh Patlan, Nils Palumbo, Ashish Hooda, Kassem Fawaz, Somesh Jha

entry.summary: Presents Sparse Backdoor, a supply-chain attack that plants provably undetectable backdoors in pre-trained image classifiers (CNNs, ViTs) using structured sparse perturbations masked with Gaussian dither.

entry.title: SWAN: Semantic Watermarking with Abstract Meaning Representation

author.name: Ziping Ye, Gourab Dey, Christos Christodoulopoulos, Charith Peris, Anil Ramakrishna, Weitong Ruan, Aram Galstyan, Kai-Wei Chang, Rahul Gupta, Ninareh Mehrabi

entry.summary: SWAN embeds watermark signatures into the semantic structure of sentences using Abstract Meaning Representation (AMR) graphs, rather than modifying token selection during generation. This means paraphrases that preserve meaning automatically preserve the watermark, making it robust against rephrasing attacks. The approach is training-free and works by prompting LLMs with AMR templates.

entry.title: Anticipating Innovation Using Large Language Models

author.name: Enrico Maria Fenoaltea, Filippo Santoro, Giordano De Marzo, Segun Taofeek Aroyehun, Andrea Tacchella

entry.summary: TechToken is a transformer model that learns to predict innovation (new technological combinations) by detecting collective linguistic shifts in patent language decades before innovations materialize. The signal emerges collectively rather than from any single inventor.

entry.title: Misaligned by Reward: Socially Undesirable Preferences in LLMs

author.name: Gayane Ghazaryan, Esra D\"onmez

entry.summary: Extends reward model benchmarking to socially consequential domains (bias, safety, morality, ethical reasoning) and tests whether reward models prefer socially undesirable outputs. Introduces a framework converting social evaluation datasets into pairwise preference data.

entry.title: On the Wasserstein Gradient Flow Interpretation of Drifting Models

author.name: Arthur Gretton, Li Kevin Wenliang, Alexandre Galashov, James Thornton, Valentin De Bortoli, Arnaud Doucet

entry.summary: Analyzes Generative Modeling via Drifting (GMD) through Wasserstein Gradient Flows, showing one GMD algorithm corresponds to finding limiting points of WGF on KL divergence with Parzen smoothing. Notable authors include Gretton, Doucet, and De Bortoli.

entry.title: Automated Formal Proofs of Combinatorial Identities via Wilf-Zeilberger Guidance and LLMs

author.name: Beibei Xiong, Hangyu Lv, Junqi Liu, Yisen Wang, Shaoshi Chen, Jianlin Wang, Zhengfeng Yang, Lihong Zhi

entry.summary: WZ-LLM combines the Wilf-Zeilberger method from symbolic mathematics with LLM-based provers to automate formal proofs of combinatorial identities in Lean 4. Includes a bootstrapping loop with DAPO-based refinement for training a dedicated WZ-Prover.

entry.title: FAAST: Forward-Only Associative Learning via Closed-Form Fast Weights for Test-Time Supervised Adaptation

author.name: Guangsheng Bao, Hongbo Zhang, Han Cui, Yanbin Zhao, Yue Zhang

entry.summary: FAAST proposes forward-only adaptation using closed-form fast weights that compile labeled examples in a single pass, eliminating backpropagation. Achieves comparable performance to backprop-based methods while reducing adaptation time by 90% and memory by 95%.

entry.title: Bridging Input Feature Spaces Towards Graph Foundation Models

author.name: Moshe Eliasof, Krishna Sri Ipsit Mantri, Beatrice Bevilacqua, Bruno Ribeiro, Carola-Bibiane Sch\"onlieb

entry.summary: ALL-IN enables graph models to transfer across datasets with different input features by projecting node features into a shared random space with covariance-based representations, addressing the lack of shared input space that prevents graph foundation models.

entry.title: Rollout Pass-Rate Control: Steering Binary-Reward RL Toward Its Most Informative Regime

author.name: Tianshu Zhu, Wenyu Zhang, Xiaoying Zuo, Lun Tian, Haotian Zhao, Yucheng Zeng, Jingnan Gu, Daxiang Dong, Jianmin Wu, Dawei Yin, Dou Shen

entry.summary: Shows that 50% pass rate is the most informative operating point for binary-reward RL (maximizes reward entropy and advantage energy), and proposes Prefix Sampling to steer rollout groups toward this regime by replaying successful/failing prefixes.

entry.title: Membership Inference Attacks for Retrieval Based In-Context Learning for Document Question Answering

author.name: Tejas Kulkarni, Antti Koskela, Laith Zumot

entry.summary: Demonstrates that retrieval-augmented in-context learning systems are vulnerable to membership inference attacks even when service provider and users are separate parties. Proposes two black-box attacks exploiting query text prefixes.

entry.title: Rethinking Local Learning: A Cheaper and Faster Recipe for LLM Post-Training

author.name: Hengyu Shi, Tianyang Han, Peizhe Wang, Zhiling Wang, Xu Yang, Junhao Su

entry.summary: Proposes LoPT (Local-Learning Post-Training) that places a gradient boundary at the transformer midpoint, allowing the second half to learn from task loss while the first half uses local objectives. Reduces memory and compute for LLM post-training.

entry.title: Agentic Vulnerability Reasoning on Windows COM Binaries

author.name: Hwiwon Lee, Jongseong Kim, Lingming Zhang

entry.summary: Presents SLYP, an agentic pipeline for discovering race condition vulnerabilities in Windows COM binaries and generating verified proof-of-concept exploits. Achieves 0.973 F1 on a benchmark of 40 vulnerability cases.

entry.title: Blind deep-deployment evals for control & sabotage

author.name: Dylan Bowman

entry.summary: Proposes 'blind deep-deployment evals' where third-party auditors send control eval specifications to AI labs, which implement them on their actual internal systems using coding agents, adding realism to external safety evaluations without requiring deep lab partnerships.

entry.title: DecodingTrust-Agent Platform (DTap): A Controllable and Interactive Red-Teaming Platform for AI Agents

author.name: Zhaorun Chen, Xun Liu, Haibo Tong, Chengquan Guo, Yuzhou Nie, Jiawei Zhang, Mintong Kang, Chejian Xu, Qichang Liu, Xiaogeng Liu, Tianneng Shi, Chaowei Xiao, Sanmi Koyejo, Percy Liang, Wenbo Guo, Dawn Song, Bo Li

entry.summary: Introduces DTap, a controllable and interactive red-teaming platform for evaluating AI agent security. Provides realistic, controllable, and reproducible environments for large-scale risk assessment of agents operating with external tools and data sources.

entry.title: Towards Robust LLM Post-Training: Automatic Failure Management for Reinforcement Fine-Tuning

author.name: Lingzhe Zhang, Tong Jia, Yunpeng Zhai, Liancheng Fang, Kening Zheng, Hongyi Liu, Xiaosong Huang, Philip S. Yu, Ying Li

entry.summary: Addresses the fragility of reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) for LLMs by proposing automatic failure management at the training-process level. Takes a first step toward systematic diagnosis and correction of RFT training failures.

entry.title: Storage Is Not Memory: A Retrieval-Centered Architecture for Agent Recall

author.name: Joshua Adler, Guy Zehavi

entry.summary: True Memory is a six-layer agent memory architecture that shifts from extraction-at-ingestion to multi-stage retrieval over verbatim events, achieving 93% accuracy on LoCoMo benchmark while running as a single SQLite file on CPU.

entry.title: On the (In-)Security of the Shuffling Defense in the Transformer Secure Inference

author.name: Zhengyi Li, Yakai Wang, Kang Yang, Yu Yu, Jiaping Gui, Yu Feng, Ning Liu, Minyi Guo, Jingwen Leng

entry.summary: Demonstrates that the shuffling defense used in secure transformer inference (which reveals randomly permuted activations to clients) is insecure, showing adversaries can extract model weights despite the permutation.

entry.title: Automatically Finding and Validating Unexpected Side-Effects of Interventions on Language Models

author.name: Quintin Pope, Ajay Hayagreeve Balaji, Jacques Thibodeau, Xiaoli Fern
