entry.summary: Introduces an automated pipeline for discovering and validating unexpected behavioral side-effects of interventions (reasoning distillation, knowledge editing, unlearning) on LLMs. Produces human-readable, statistically validated hypotheses about model differences.

entry.title: Quadrature-TreeSHAP: Depth-Independent TreeSHAP and Shapley Interactions

author.name: Ron Wettenstein, Rory Mitchell, Peng Yu

entry.summary: Quadrature-TreeSHAP reformulates Path-Dependent TreeSHAP using quadrature, achieving depth-independent runtime, numerical stability, and natural extension to any-order Shapley interactions. Integrated into XGBoost with CPU and GPU support.

entry.title: A geometric relation of the error introduced by sampling a language model's output distribution to its internal state

author.name: Albert F. Modenbach

entry.summary: Derives an so(n)-valued 1-form from token embedding geometry in GPT-style models, showing its curvature is semantically meaningful: in chess tasks, transformations cluster by board region and respect piece importance.

entry.title: Adaptive Inverted-Index Routing for Granular Mixtures-of-Experts

author.name: Klaus-Rudolf Kladny, Maximilian Mordig, Bernhard Sch\"olkopf, Michael Muehlebach

entry.summary: AIR-MoE introduces inverted-index-inspired routing for granular MoE models, using VQ-based coarse shortlisting followed by fine scoring to reduce routing cost that otherwise dominates computation with many small experts.

entry.title: Self-Induced Outcome Potential: Turn-Level Credit Assignment for Agents without Verifiers

author.name: Senkang Hu, Yong Dai, Xudong Han, Zhengru Fang, Yuzhi Zhao, Sam Tak Wu Kwong, Yuguang Fang

entry.summary: SIOP provides turn-level credit assignment for long-horizon LLM agents without requiring external verifiers, using semantic clusters of final answers as latent outcome states for potential-based reward shaping.

entry.title: Adapt or Forget: Provable Tradeoffs Between Adam and SGD in Nonstationary Optimization

author.name: Sharan Sahu, Abir Sarkar, Cameron J. Hogan, Martin T. Wells

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of Adam under non-stationary objectives, separating tracking and projected stationarity regimes. Derives bounds decomposing into initialization, drift, first-moment tracking error, and preconditioner perturbation components.

entry.title: Implicit Representations of Grammaticality in Language Models

author.name: Yingshan Susan Wang, Linlu Qiu, Zhaofeng Wu, Roger P. Levy, Yoon Kim

entry.summary: Investigates whether LMs implicitly acquire a grammaticality distinction separate from string probability by training linear probes on internal representations. Shows LMs do have internal representations that discriminate grammatical from ungrammatical sentences beyond what probabilities reveal.

entry.title: CCL-D: A High-Precision Diagnostic System for Slow and Hang Anomalies in Large-Scale Model Training

author.name: Yida Gu, Fakang Wang, Jianhao Fu, Zhenhang Sun, Qianyu Zhang, Hairui Zhao, Xingchen Liu, Yang Tian, Wenjing Huang, Zedong Liu, Yifan Chen, Jinwu Yang, Yueyuan Zhou, Qian Zhao, Haoxu Li, Tao Wang, Feng Yu, Zhan Wang, Guangming Tan, Dingwen Tao

entry.summary: CCL-D is a diagnostic system for detecting and locating slow/hang anomalies in collective communication during large-scale model training, integrating real-time probing with intelligent decision analysis to replace hours-long manual diagnosis.

entry.title: Parallel Prefix Verification for Speculative Generation

author.name: Yuncheng Yao, Yuxuan Xia, Shengjie Wang, Danyang Zhuo

entry.summary: Introduces PARSE, a speculative generation framework that accelerates LLM inference by parallelizing prefix verification at the semantic level rather than token level. This enables longer acceptance lengths and greater speedups compared to existing speculative decoding methods.

entry.title: AgentTrust: Runtime Safety Evaluation and Interception for AI Agent Tool Use

author.name: Chenglin Yang

entry.summary: Presents AgentTrust, a runtime safety layer that intercepts AI agent tool calls before execution and returns allow/warn/block/review verdicts. Combines shell deobfuscation, safety suggestions, and structured risk assessment.

entry.title: The Reasoning Trap: An Information-Theoretic Bound on Closed-System Multi-Step LLM Reasoning

author.name: Kwan Soo Shin

entry.summary: Provides an information-theoretic analysis showing that multi-agent debate (MAD) with copies of the same LLM preserves answer accuracy while degrading reasoning quality. Introduces metrics SFS and EGSR to measure this 'Reasoning Trap' phenomenon.

entry.title: Budgeted LoRA: Distillation as Structured Compute Allocation for Efficient Inference

author.name: Mohammed Sabry, Anya Belz

entry.summary: Budgeted LoRA treats model compression as a structured compute allocation problem, introducing a global compute budget that determines the fraction of dense computation retained. Unlike standard LoRA which only reduces training cost, this approach delivers actual inference savings by redistributing capacity across layers.

entry.title: Experiment-as-Code Labs: A Declarative Stack for AI-Driven Scientific Discovery

author.name: Zhenning Yang, Yuhan Chen, Patrick Tser Jern Kon, Tongyuan Miao, Hongyi Lin, Venkat Viswanathan, Danai Koutra, Ang Chen

entry.summary: Proposes 'Experiment-as-Code Labs', a declarative programming stack for enabling AI agents to control real-world laboratory instruments for scientific discovery. Bridges the gap between AI agents and automated lab equipment.

entry.title: Sparse Tokens Suffice: Jailbreaking Audio Language Models via Token-Aware Gradient Optimization

author.name: Zheng Fang, Xiaosen Wang, Shenyi Zhang, Shaokang Wang, Zhijin Ge

entry.summary: TAGO demonstrates that jailbreak attacks on audio language models can be made more efficient by optimizing only sparse, high-gradient-energy audio token regions rather than the entire waveform, achieving comparable attack success with less perturbation.

entry.title: EP-GRPO: Entropy-Progress Aligned Group Relative Policy Optimization with Implicit Process Guidance

author.name: Song Yu, Li Li, Wenwen Zhao, Zhisheng Yang

entry.summary: Identifies and quantifies three credit assignment failures in GRPO for LLM reasoning: uniform token granularity, polarity misalignment, and zero-variance collapse. Proposes EP-GRPO that uses entropy-progress signals for dense, step-aware reward assignment.

entry.title: SoK: Robustness in Large Language Models against Jailbreak Attacks

author.name: Feiyue Xu, Hongsheng Hu, Chaoxiang He, Sheng Hang, Hanqing Hu, Xiuming Liu, Yubo Zhao, Zhengyan Zhou, Bin Benjamin Zhu, Shi-Feng Sun, Dawu Gu, Shuo Wang

entry.summary: Presents a systematic taxonomy of jailbreak attacks and defenses for LLMs and introduces 'Security Cube,' a unified multi-dimensional evaluation framework beyond simple attack success rate metrics.

entry.title: Counterfactual identifiability beyond global monotonicity: non-monotone triangular structural causal models

author.name: Pengcheng Tan, Jiang Chen, Dehui Du

entry.summary: Extends counterfactual identifiability theory beyond global monotonicity assumptions by introducing non-monotone triangular structural causal models (NM-TM-SCM), proving that mechanism-wise invertibility suffices for complete counterfactual identifiability. Important for causal inference in settings where monotonicity is violated.

entry.title: Towards General Preference Alignment: Diffusion Models at Nash Equilibrium

author.name: Jiaming Hu, Jiamu Bai, Haoyu Wang, Debarghya Mukherjee, Ioannis Ch. Paschalidis

entry.summary: Formulates diffusion model alignment as a game-theoretic problem, proposing Diffusion Nash Preference Optimization that avoids the Bradley-Terry model assumption. Goes beyond reward-induced preferences to capture more complex human preference structures for text-to-image generation.

entry.title: Self-Attention as Transport: Limits of Symmetric Spectral Diagnostics

author.name: Dominik Dahlem, Diego Maniloff, Mac Misiura

entry.summary: Proves that symmetric spectral diagnostics of attention operators are structurally orientation-blind (cannot detect information-flow direction), establishing the asymmetry coefficient as the unique control parameter. Provides both theoretical bounds and empirical validation on LLMs.

entry.title: Conceptors for Semantic Steering

author.name: Ilias Triantafyllopoulos, Young-Min Cho, Ren Tao, Miranda Muqing Miao, Sunny Rai, Lyle Ungar, Sharath Chandra Guntuku, Neville Ryant, Jo\~ao Sedoc

entry.summary: Proposes conceptors (soft projection matrices) for steering LLM behavior, preserving the full multidimensional subspace of concepts rather than reducing to a single direction. Shows conceptor quota provides parameter-free layer selection.

entry.title: CuBridge: An LLM-Based Framework for Understanding and Reconstructing High-Performance Attention Kernels

author.name: Xing Ma, Yangjie Zhou, Wu Sun, Zihan Liu, Jingwen Leng, Yun Lin, Shixuan Sun, Minyi Guo, Jin Song Dong

entry.summary: CuBridge uses LLMs to adapt expert-written CUDA attention kernels through a structured lift-transfer-lower workflow, bridging expert performance with LLM flexibility for generating high-performance attention implementations.

entry.title: On the Hardness of Junking LLMs

author.name: Marco Rando, Samuel Vaiter

entry.summary: Studies 'junking' attacks on LLMs (eliciting harmful behavior from optimized token sequences without semantic structure), characterizing the hardness landscape and showing these natural backdoors exist as a fundamental property.

entry.title: Low-Cost Black-Box Detection of LLM Hallucinations via Dynamical System Prediction

author.name: Dan Wilson, Mohamed Akrout

entry.summary: Detects LLM hallucinations by treating the model as a black-box dynamical system, using Koopman operator theory to fit transition operators for factual vs hallucinated regimes and defining a differential residual score.

entry.title: Free Energy-Driven Reinforcement Learning with Adaptive Advantage Shaping for Unsupervised Reasoning in LLMs

author.name: Yiming Huang, Zhenbo Shi, Xin-Cheng Wen, Jichuan Zeng, Cuiyun Gao, Peiyi Han, Chuanyi Liu

entry.summary: Introduces FREIA, a novel RL algorithm for unsupervised LLM reasoning that uses Free Energy-Driven Rewards to balance consensus and exploration, plus Adaptive Advantage Shaping to adjust learning signals based on reward statistics.

entry.title: Causal discovery under mean independence and linearity

author.name: Geert Mesters, Alvaro Ribot, Anna Seigal, Piotr Zwiernik

entry.summary: Introduces LiMIAM, a causal discovery model replacing full independence with weaker mean-independence restrictions on disturbances. Shows source nodes are identifiable under these relaxed assumptions, enabling causal order recovery.

entry.title: Sharp Capacity Thresholds in Linear Associative Memory: From Winner-Take-All to Listwise Retrieval

author.name: Nicholas Barnfield, Juno Kim, Eshaan Nichani, Jason D. Lee, Yue M. Lu

entry.summary: Establishes sharp capacity thresholds for linear associative memory under different retrieval criteria. Shows top-1 retrieval requires d²∝n log n scale while listwise retrieval removes the logarithmic factor.

entry.title: SCOUT: Active Information Foraging for Long-Text Understanding with Decoupled Epistemic States

author.name: Zhenliang Zhang, Wenqing Wang, Yong Hu, Yaming Yang, Jiaheng Gao, Chen Shen, Xiaojun Wan

entry.summary: Proposes SCOUT for million-token-scale long-text understanding through active information foraging rather than passive processing. Treats documents as environments and uses decoupled epistemic states to identify query-sufficient subsets.

entry.title: Detecting Hallucinations in Large Language Models via Internal Attention Divergence Signals

author.name: Gijs van Dijk

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight hallucination detection method using attention matrix divergence (KL divergence from uniform) as features for a logistic regression probe. The signal is concentrated in middle layers and on factual tokens like named entities. Performs competitively with more expensive uncertainty estimation methods.

entry.title: OpenSearch-VL: An Open Recipe for Frontier Multimodal Search Agents

author.name: Shuang Chen, Kaituo Feng, Hangting Chen, Wenxuan Huang, Dasen Dai, Quanxin Shou, Yunlong Lin, Xiangyu Yue, Shenghua Gao, Tianyu Pang

entry.summary: Introduces OpenSearch-VL, a fully open-source recipe for training frontier multimodal deep search agents using agentic reinforcement learning, with a pipeline for high-quality training data through Wikipedia path sampling and visual grounding.

entry.title: From Pixels to Tokens: A Systematic Study of Latent Action Supervision for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Yihan Lin, Haoyang Li, Yang Li, Haitao Shen, Yihan Zhao, Chao Shao, Jing Zhang

entry.summary: Provides a systematic comparison of latent action supervision strategies for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, revealing that image-based latent actions benefit long-horizon reasoning while action-based latent actions excel at short-horizon precision. Structures fragmented approaches under a unified baseline.

entry.title: Stabilizing LLM Supervised Fine-Tuning via Explicit Distributional Control

author.name: Xinyu Wang, Changzhi Sun, Yuanbin Wu, Xiaoling Wang

entry.summary: Proposes 'Anchored Learning' for LLM fine-tuning that controls distributional drift via a dynamically evolving moving anchor that interpolates between the current model and a frozen reference, transforming fine-tuning into local trust-region steps.

entry.title: The First Token Knows: Single-Decode Confidence for Hallucination Detection

author.name: Mina Gabriel

entry.summary: Shows that first-token confidence (normalized entropy of top-K logits at the first answer token) from a single greedy decode matches or exceeds semantic self-consistency for hallucination detection, eliminating the need for multiple samples.

entry.title: FLUID: Continuous-Time Hyperconnected Sparse Transformer for Sink-Free Learning

author.name: Waleed Razzaq, Yun-Bo Zhao

entry.summary: FLUID replaces standard discrete attention with a continuous-time 'Liquid Attention Network' that models attention logits as solutions to linear ODEs with input-dependent nonlinear gates. Provides stability guarantees and shows it interpolates between attention mechanisms.

entry.title: RLearner-LLM: Balancing Logical Grounding and Fluency in Large Language Models via Hybrid Direct Preference Optimization

author.name: Qiming Bao, Juho Leinonen, Paul Denny, Michael J. Witbrock

entry.summary: Proposes Hybrid-DPO that fuses NLI signals with verifier LLM scores to create preference pairs for DPO, addressing the verbosity bias in standard preference signals that rewards fluency over logical correctness.

entry.title: Local Intrinsic Dimension Unveils Hallucinations in Diffusion Models

author.name: Bartlomiej Sobieski, Matthew Tivnan, Dawid P{\l}udowski, Micha{\l} Jan W{\l}odarczyk, Pengfei Jin, Przemyslaw Biecek, Quanzheng Li

entry.summary: Proposes using local intrinsic dimension (LID) to detect structural hallucinations in diffusion models (e.g., extra fingers). Shows hallucinations correspond to instabilities on the model-induced manifold, and LID-based filtering matches or exceeds temporal hallucination filters.

entry.title: Agent Island: A Saturation- and Contamination-Resistant Benchmark from Multiagent Games

author.name: Connacher Murphy

entry.summary: Introduces Agent Island, a multiplayer simulation benchmark where LLM agents compete in games of cooperation, conflict, and persuasion. Designed to resist benchmark saturation and contamination. In 999 games across 49 models, GPT-5.5 dominates its peers.

entry.title: How Does Thinking Mode Change LLM Moral Judgments? A Controlled Instant-vs-Thinking Comparison Across Five Frontier Models

author.name: Sai Sourabh Madur

entry.summary: Evaluates whether reasoning mode changes moral judgments across 5 frontier LLMs (Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT 5.5, Gemini 3 Flash, DeepSeek V3.1, Qwen3.5 397B). Finds aggregate agreement is high but reasoning narrows cross-model disagreement on disputed scenarios.

entry.title: Uno-Orchestra: Parsimonious Agent Routing via Selective Delegation

author.name: Zhiqing Cui, Haotong Xie, Jiahao Yuan, Cheng Yang, Hanqing Wang, Yuxin Wu, Yifan Wu, Siru Zhong, Tao Yu, Yifu Guo, Siyu Zhang, Xinlei Yu, Qibing Ren, Usman Naseem

entry.summary: Introduces Uno-Orchestra, a unified orchestration policy for LLM multi-agent systems that jointly optimizes decomposition depth, worker choice, and inference budget. Achieves 77.0% macro pass@1 across 13 benchmarks, ~16% above the strongest baseline.

entry.title: Validity-Calibrated Reasoning Distillation

author.name: Khouloud Saadi, Di Wang

entry.summary: Proposes validity-calibrated reasoning distillation that treats distillation as local learning-signal allocation rather than path alignment. Compares student reasoning validity rather than enforcing token-level imitation of teacher traces.

entry.title: Memory as a Markov Matrix: Sample Efficient Knowledge Expansion via Token-to-Dictionary Mapping

author.name: Kaustubh Pethkar, Ziyang Xiong, Zuofeng Shang, Yingcong Li

entry.summary: Proposes modeling LLM memory as a Markov transition matrix over tokens, enabling knowledge injection without catastrophic forgetting or irreversible weight updates. The framework maps tokens to dictionary entries, allowing sample-efficient knowledge expansion without full parameter updates.

entry.title: Detecting Deepfakes via Hamiltonian Dynamics

author.name: Harry Cheng, Ming-Hui Liu, Tianyi Wang, Weili Guan, Liqiang Nie, Mohan Kankanhalli

entry.summary: Proposes detecting deepfakes by analyzing dynamical stability using Hamiltonian dynamics, hypothesizing that natural images occupy low-energy equilibria while generated images occupy unstable, high-energy states. Moves from static pattern recognition to physics-inspired stability analysis.

entry.title: CAR: Query-Guided Confidence-Aware Reranking for Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Zhipeng Song, Yizhi Zhou, Xiangyu Kong, Jiulong Jiao, Xuezhou Ye, Chunqi Gao, Xueqing Shi, Yuhang Zhou, Heng Qi

entry.summary: CAR proposes a training-free reranking framework for RAG that uses generator confidence change (measured via semantic consistency of sampled answers) as a document usefulness signal, rather than just query-document relevance.

entry.title: Evolving Idea Graphs with Learnable Edits-and-Commits for Multi-Agent Scientific Ideation

author.name: Jiangwen Dong, Bo Li, Wanyu Lin

entry.summary: Evolving Idea Graphs (EIG) represents research ideas as graphs where nodes are scientific claims and edges encode dependencies, enabling multi-agent systems to precisely identify weaknesses and track refinements through learnable edit operations.

entry.title: Skill Neologisms: Towards Skill-based Continual Learning

author.name: Antonin Berthon, Nicolas Astorga, Mihaela van der Schaar

entry.summary: Explores 'skill neologisms' — soft tokens added to LLM vocabulary that encode procedural knowledge for specific skills, enabling continual learning without weight updates or context limitations. Shows pre-trained LLMs already have tokens associated with procedural knowledge.

entry.title: Gradient Flow Structure and Quantitative Dynamics of Multi-Head Self-Attention

author.name: Ayan Pendharkar

entry.summary: Develops theoretical framework for multi-head self-attention dynamics as gradient flow on unit sphere. Proves multi-head energy functional is non-decreasing and identifies radial shadowing as the key obstruction to per-head monotonicity.

entry.title: Leveraging Pretrained Language Models as Energy Functions for Glauber Dynamics Text Diffusion

author.name: Tarun Kathuria, Sachin Kumar

entry.summary: Uses pretrained language models as energy functions for discrete text diffusion via Glauber dynamics, achieving competitive performance with autoregressive models. Demonstrates that pretrained model energy landscapes significantly improve generation quality.

entry.title: Beyond Rigid Geometries: The Spline-Pullback Metric for Universal Diffeomorphic SPD Representation Learning

author.name: Tushar Das, Subrata Dutta, Sarmistha Neogy, Koushlendra Kumar Singh

entry.summary: Introduces the Spline-Pullback Metric (SPM) for learning adaptive Riemannian geometries on SPD manifolds in deep learning, addressing limitations of fixed metrics that restrict network expressivity. The method ensures mathematical validity while enabling universal geometry learning.

entry.title: Threshold-Guided Optimization for Visual Generative Models

author.name: Jinbin Bai, Yu Lei, Qingyu Shi, Aosong Feng, Yi Xin, Zhuoran Zhao, Fei Shen, Kaidong Yu, Jason Li

entry.summary: Proposes threshold-guided alignment for visual generative models that replaces pairwise preference optimization with a binary decision using unpaired data and a data-driven global threshold. Enables alignment from independent scalar ratings rather than annotated pairs.

entry.title: SPHERE: Mitigating the Loss of Spectral Plasticity in Mixture-of-Experts for Deep Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Lirui Luo, Guoxi Zhang, Hongming Xu, Cong Fang, Qing Li

entry.summary: SPHERE formalizes plasticity loss in MoE policies for deep RL as spectral plasticity loss using Neural Tangent Kernel theory, deriving a tractable proxy that enables targeted mitigation during continual learning.

entry.title: OSAQ: Outlier Self-Absorption for Accurate Low-bit LLM Quantization

author.name: Zhikai Li, Zhen Dong, Xuewen Liu, Jing Zhang, Qingyi Gu

entry.summary: OSAQ addresses weight outliers in LLM quantization through additive weight suppression guided by second-order low-rank properties, improving low-bit post-training quantization performance.

entry.title: Breaking the Quality-Privacy Tradeoff in Tabular Data Generation via In-Context Learning

author.name: Xinyan Han, Yan Lu, Xiaoyu Lin, Yuanyuan Jiang, Yuanrui Wang, Xuanyue Li, Wenchao Zou, Xingxuan Zhang

entry.summary: DiffICL formulates tabular data synthesis as in-context learning, leveraging pretrained structural priors from many datasets to break the quality-privacy tradeoff that emerges in small-data regimes for dataset-specific generative models.

entry.title: Adaptivity Under Realizability Constraints: Comparing In-Context and Agentic Learning

author.name: Anastasis Kratsios, A. Martina Neuman, Philipp Petersen

entry.summary: Compares in-context learning (fixed queries) with agentic learning (adaptive queries) under both unrestricted and ReLU-realizable regimes, identifying four distinct scenarios for when adaptivity helps and how realizability constraints can change the picture.

entry.title: Unified Framework of Distributional Regret in Multi-Armed Bandits and Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Harin Lee, Min-hwan Oh

entry.summary: Presents a unified framework for distributional regret bounds in multi-armed bandits and episodic RL, providing guarantees that hold uniformly over all confidence levels and characterizing the full regret distribution.

entry.title: How Long Does Infinite Width Last? Signal Propagation in Long-Range Linear Recurrences

author.name: Mariia Seleznova

entry.summary: Derives exact finite-width formulas for signal propagation in linear recurrences, identifying joint depth-width scaling regimes that determine when infinite-width approximations remain valid for long sequences.

entry.title: Adapt to Thrive! Adaptive Power-Mean Policy Optimization for Improved LLM Reasoning

author.name: Yiming Huang, Zhenbo Shi, Shuzheng Gao, Cuiyun Gao, Peiyi Han, Chuanyi Liu

entry.summary: Proposes APMPO for LLM reasoning, using a generalized power-mean objective that transitions between arithmetic and geometric mean behaviors, combined with adaptive clipping. Addresses misalignment between static optimization schemes and evolving model capabilities.

entry.title: UniVer: A Unified Perspective for Multi-step and Multi-draft Speculative Decoding

author.name: Yepeng Weng, Qiao Hu, Takehisa Yairi

entry.summary: Proposes UniVer, a unified perspective casting tree-based speculative decoding verification as conditional optimal transport. Unifies multi-step and multi-draft aspects that existing approaches handle separately.

entry.title: PAIR-CI: Calibrated Conditional Independence Testing for Causal Discovery with Incomplete Data

author.name: Thomas S. Robinson, Ranjit Lall

entry.summary: Introduces PAIR-CI, a nonparametric conditional independence test that restores calibration in causal discovery with incomplete data by integrating multiple imputation into a paired permutation design.

entry.title: Telegraph English: Semantic Prompt Compression via Structured Symbolic Rewriting

author.name: Mikhail L. Arbuzov, Sisong Bei, Ziwei Dong, Dmitri Kalaev, Alexey A. Shvets

entry.summary: Introduces Telegraph English (TE), a prompt compression protocol that rewrites natural language into a symbol-rich structured dialect. Compression and semantic chunking become the same operation, with each line being an independently addressable fact.

entry.title: Why Expert Alignment Is Hard: Evidence from Subjective Evaluation

author.name: Tzu-Mi Lin, Wataru Hirota, Tatsuya Ishigaki, Lung-Hao Lee, Chung-Chi Chen

entry.summary: Studies why aligning LLMs with expert judgment is difficult in subjective evaluation tasks. Finds four patterns: alignment difficulty varies across experts, explicit criteria don't always help, and experts' judgments can shift over time. Highlights fundamental challenges in RLHF-style alignment.

entry.title: Open-Source Image Editing Models Are Zero-Shot Vision Learners

author.name: Wei Liu, Jiaxin Lin, Rui Chen

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates three open-source image-editing models on dense visual prediction tasks (depth, normals, segmentation) without fine-tuning. Shows that publicly available editing models possess zero-shot vision abilities, extending prior findings from closed-source models like Veo 3.

entry.title: Anatomy of a failure: When, how, and why deep vision fails in scientific domains

author.name: Ji-Hun Oh, Dou Hoon Kwark, Kianoush Falahkheirkhah, Kevin Yeh, John Cheville, Volodymyr Kindratenko, Rohit Bhargava

entry.summary: Demonstrates that naive application of deep learning to scientific imaging (e.g., infrared pathology) can lead to critical failures despite informational advantages over RGB. Shows DL models may fail to exploit the physics-encoded information in scientific images.

entry.title: HDFlow: Hierarchical Diffusion-Flow Planning for Long-horizon Tasks

author.name: Nandiraju Gireesh, Yuanliang Ju, Chaoyi Xu, Weiheng Liu, Yuxuan Wan, He Wang

entry.summary: Introduces HDFlow, a hierarchical planning framework combining diffusion models for high-level subgoal generation with rectified flow models for low-level action execution, addressing computational demands of generative planners for long-horizon tasks.

entry.title: Bayesian Optimization in Linear Time

author.name: Jesse Schneider, William J. Welch

entry.summary: Proposes a linear-time Bayesian optimization method that addresses cubic computational complexity by combining local modeling with adaptive exploration-exploitation, making BO feasible for large training sets.

entry.title: A draft honesty policy for credible communication with AI systems

author.name: Mia Taylor

entry.summary: Proposes a draft honesty policy for AI companies to enable credible communication with AI systems, arguing that if AIs can trust companies' honest communications, it enables positive-sum trade rather than conflict.

entry.title: Continual Knowledge Updating in LLM Systems: Learning Through Multi-Timescale Memory Dynamics

author.name: Andreas Pattichis, Constantine Dovrolis

entry.summary: Proposes Memini, an associative memory system for LLMs inspired by biological multi-timescale synaptic dynamics (Benna-Fusi model). Knowledge stored as a directed graph with coupled fast/slow variables enables episodic sensitivity, consolidation, and selective forgetting.

entry.title: Jordan-RoPE: Non-Semisimple Relative Positional Encoding via Complex Jordan Blocks

author.name: Yaobo Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Jordan-RoPE, a positional encoding using complex Jordan blocks that generates oscillatory-polynomial attention features (damped sinusoids modulated by distance). Extends RoPE with non-semisimple group structure.

entry.title: ConsisVLA-4D: Advancing Spatiotemporal Consistency in Efficient 3D-Perception and 4D-Reasoning for Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Wei Li, Jizhihui Liu, Li Yixing, Junwen Tong, Rui Shao, Liqiang Nie

entry.summary: Proposes ConsisVLA-4D, a VLA framework enhancing spatiotemporal consistency in 3D perception and 4D reasoning without additional sensors, using cross-view semantic alignment and instruction-grounded scene reasoning.

entry.title: The Scaling Properties of Implicit Deductive Reasoning in Transformers

author.name: Enrico Vompa, Tanel Tammet

entry.summary: Investigates scaling properties of implicit deductive reasoning in Transformers over Horn clauses. Finds that sufficiently deep bidirectional models approach explicit Chain-of-Thought performance, though CoT remains necessary for depth extrapolation.

entry.title: Budget-aware Auto Optimizer Configurator

author.name: Kang Liu, Wei Peng, Jianchen Hu

entry.summary: Proposes BAOC, a method to reduce GPU memory by assigning different optimizer configurations to individual network blocks based on gradient behavior analysis, rather than using a single global optimizer for all parameters.

entry.title: LongSeeker: Elastic Context Orchestration for Long-Horizon Search Agents

author.name: Yijun Lu, Rui Ye, Yuwen Du, Jiajun Wang, Songhua Liu, Siheng Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Context-ReAct, an agentic paradigm for elastic context orchestration in long-horizon search agents with five atomic operations (Skip, Compress, Rollback, Snippet, Delete) that allow adaptive management of growing working context.

entry.title: Toward Human-AI Complementarity Across Diverse Tasks

author.name: Yuzheng Xu, Annya Dahmani, Matthew D. Blanchard, Niclas Dern, Edy Nastase, Francesca Bianco, Maja Pavlovic, Sukanya Krishna, Eric Modesitt, Miranda Anna Christ, Arth Singh, Gaia Molinaro, Sikata Bela Sengupta, Jaji Pamarthi, Arjun Menon, Rishub Jain

entry.summary: Investigates human-AI complementarity across 1,886 samples spanning knowledge, factuality, reasoning, and deception detection. Finds only modest gains (+0.4pp) from baseline hybridization, with a small complementarity region (8.9%).

entry.title: TSCG: Deterministic Tool-Schema Compilation for Agentic LLM Deployments

author.name: Furkan Sakizli

entry.summary: Introduces TSCG, a deterministic tool-schema compiler that converts JSON schemas into token-efficient text for small LLMs (4B-14B). Restores Phi-4 14B from 0% to 84.4% tool-use success on a 19K-call benchmark.

entry.title: Layerwise LQR for Geometry-Aware Optimization of Deep Networks

author.name: Simon Dufort-Labb\'e, Pierre-Luc Bacon, Razvan Pascanu, Simon Lacoste-Julien, Aristide Baratin

entry.summary: Introduces Layerwise LQR (LLQR), showing that steepest-descent steps under various metrics (Newton, Gauss-Newton, Fisher) can be written as a finite-horizon LQR problem. Learns structured inverse preconditioners under this framework.

entry.title: Worst-Case Discovery and Runtime Protection for RL-Based Network Controllers

author.name: Hongyu H\`e, Minhao Jin, Maria Apostolaki

entry.summary: ReGuard discovers worst-case scenarios for RL-based network controllers (congestion control, adaptive bitrate streaming) and protects them at inference time without retraining. Uses bilevel regret-maximization to find certified lower bounds on worst-case performance.

entry.title: Predictive and Prescriptive AI toward Optimizing Wildfire Suppression

author.name: Leonard Boussioux, Alexandre Jacquillat, Ryne Reger, Jacob Wachspress

entry.summary: Develops a predictive and prescriptive AI approach for wildfire suppression resource allocation, combining an integer optimization model with branch-and-price-and-cut algorithms for crew assignments and non-linear fire dynamics.

entry.title: Average Attention Transformers and Arithmetic Circuits

author.name: Lena Ehrmuth, Laura Strieker

entry.summary: Analyzes the computational power of average hard attention transformers, showing they can simulate arithmetic circuits given as input. Establishes formal connections between transformer encoders and circuit complexity classes.

entry.title: Knowledge-Free Correlated Agreement for Incentivizing Federated Learning

author.name: Leon Witt, Togrul Abbasli, Kentaroh Toyoda, Wojciech Samek, Lucy Klinger

entry.summary: KFCA introduces a mechanism to reward client contributions in federated learning without requiring ground truth, public test sets, or distribution knowledge. Addresses label-flipping vulnerability of prior Correlated Agreement approaches under honest majority assumption.

entry.title: When Does Gene Regulatory Network Inference Break? A Controlled Diagnostic Study of Causal and Correlational Methods on Single-Cell Data

author.name: Miguel Fernandez-de-Retana, Ruben Sanchez-Corcuera, Unai Zulaika, Aritz Bilbao-Jayo, Aitor Almeida

entry.summary: Introduces a controlled diagnostic framework that isolates seven biologically motivated pathologies in gene regulatory network inference, revealing when and why causal methods fail compared to correlation-based baselines on single-cell RNA-seq data.

entry.title: Why Geometric Continuity Emerges in Deep Neural Networks: Residual Connections and Rotational Symmetry Breaking

author.name: Kyungwon Jeong, Won-Gi Paeng, Honggyo Suh

entry.summary: Explains why weight matrices in deep networks exhibit geometric continuity (aligned singular vectors across layers). Identifies residual connections create cross-layer gradient coherence, while symmetry-breaking nonlinearities (not nonlinearity itself) constrain layers to a shared coordinate frame.

entry.title: Piper: Efficient Large-Scale MoE Training via Resource Modeling and Pipelined Hybrid Parallelism

author.name: Sajal Dash, Feiyi Wang

entry.summary: Develops a mathematical model quantifying memory, compute, and communication requirements for MoE training under various parallelization schemes, then proposes Piper, a pipelined hybrid parallelism approach for efficient large-scale MoE training on HPC platforms.

entry.title: Position: the Stochastic Parrot in the Coal Mine. Model Collapse is a Threat to Low-Resource Communities

author.name: Devon Jarvis, Richard Klein, Benjamin Rosman, Steven James, Stefano Sarao Mannelli

entry.summary: Argues that model collapse disproportionately threatens low-resource communities and efforts to democratize AI, as performance degradation from training on AI-generated content compounds with cultural biases and skews data away from underrepresented groups.

entry.title: Probing Structural Mathematical Reasoning in Language Models with Algebraic Trapdoors

author.name: Igor Rivin

entry.summary: Introduces benchmarks for evaluating structural mathematical reasoning in LLMs using subgroup-construction problems in SL(3,Z) with cryptographic verifier-prover asymmetry, testing whether models have internalized algebraic priors.

entry.title: CRAFT: Counterfactual-to-Interactive Reinforcement Fine-Tuning for Driving Policies

author.name: Keyu Chen, Nanfei Ye, Yida Wang, Wenchao Sun, Danqi Zhao, Hao Cheng, Sifa Zheng

entry.summary: CRAFT combines counterfactual advantages with on-policy RL for fine-tuning autonomous driving policies, addressing distribution shift in closed-loop deployment. Uses counterfactual estimates as dense proxy rewards that transition to interactive RL for grounded feedback.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Aware Exploratory Direct Preference Optimization for Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Huatian Zhang, Zhendong Mao, Lei Zhang, Yongdong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes uncertainty-aware exploration in DPO for multimodal LLMs to address self-referential bias in visual fidelity supervision, using uncertainty to identify and emphasize under-explored visual details rather than reinforcing already well-learned cues.

entry.title: Delving into Non-Exchangeability for Conformal Prediction in Graph-Structured Multivariate Time Series

author.name: Ruichao Guo, Xingyao Han, Luo Wenshui, Zhe Liu, Chen Gong, Hesheng Wang

entry.summary: Addresses non-exchangeability in conformal prediction for graph-structured multivariate time series by decomposing into frequency components, where high-frequency components are nearly exchangeable and low-frequency captures cross-node coupling.

entry.title: Provable imitation learning for control of instability in partially-observed Vlasov--Poisson equations

author.name: Xiaofan Xia, Qin Li, Wenlong Mou

entry.summary: Studies imitation learning for stabilizing Vlasov-Poisson plasma dynamics (nuclear fusion), showing how to distill fully-observed expert policies into controllers using only sparse macroscopic measurements with provable stability guarantees.

entry.title: Are LLMs Ready for Conflict Monitoring? Empirical Evidence from West Africa

author.name: Hoffmann Muki, Olukunle Owolabi

entry.summary: Evaluates vanilla open-weight LLMs and domain-adapted models for conflict monitoring in West Africa, revealing systematic biases. Finds 'False Illegitimation bias' where models misclassify legitimate battles as civilian-targeted violence.

entry.title: Benchmarking LLMs on the Massive Sound Embedding Benchmark (MSEB)

author.name: Cyril Allauzen, Tom Bagby, Georg Heigold, Ehsan Variani, Ke Wu

entry.summary: Benchmarks leading LLMs (Gemini, GPT families) on the Massive Sound Embedding Benchmark across eight audio capabilities. Finds a persistent modality gap between audio and text performance.

entry.title: Paraphrase-Induced Output-Mode Collapse: When LLMs Break Character Under Semantically Equivalent Inputs

author.name: Aofan Liu, Jingxiang Meng

entry.summary: Identifies and measures 'prompt-variant output-mode collapse' where LLMs break their output format when given semantically equivalent but lexically different prompts. Releases PARACONSIST benchmark.

entry.title: TabEmbed: Benchmarking and Learning Generalist Embeddings for Tabular Understanding

author.name: Minjie Qiang, Mingming Zhang, Xiaoyi Bao, Xing Fu, Yu Cheng, Weiqiang Wang, Zhongqing Wang, Ningtao Wang

entry.summary: Introduces TabBench, a benchmark for evaluating embedding models on tabular data, and TabEmbed, the first generalist embedding model unifying tabular classification and retrieval in a shared embedding space. Addresses the gap between LLM-based approaches (lacking retrieval vectors) and text embedding models (failing on tabular structure).

entry.title: Stream-T1: Test-Time Scaling for Streaming Video Generation

author.name: Yijing Tu, Shaojin Wu, Mengqi Huang, Wenchuan Wang, Yuxin Wang, Chunxiao Liu, Zhendong Mao

entry.summary: Proposes Stream-T1, a test-time scaling framework for streaming video generation that exploits chunk-level synthesis and few denoising steps to enable efficient exploration and temporal control, pioneering TTS for streaming video.

entry.title: PhysForge: Generating Physics-Grounded 3D Assets for Interactive Virtual World

author.name: Yunhan Yang, Chunshi Wang, Junliang Ye, Yang Li, Zanxin Chen, Zehuan Huang, Yao Mu, Zhuo Chen, Chunchao Guo, Xihui Liu

entry.summary: Introduces PhysForge with PhysDB (150K assets with physics annotations) for generating physics-grounded 3D assets with hierarchical physical blueprints planned by VLMs and realized by physics-grounded diffusion.

entry.title: Syn4D: A Multiview Synthetic 4D Dataset

author.name: Zeren Jiang, Yushi Lan, Yihang Luo, Yufan Deng, Zihang Lai, Edgar Sucar, Christian Rupprecht, Iro Laina, Diane Larlus, Chuanxia Zheng, Andrea Vedaldi

entry.summary: Introduces Syn4D, a multiview synthetic dataset for dynamic 3D scenes with complete ground-truth annotations including camera motion, depth maps, dense tracking, and human pose. Addresses a key bottleneck in 4D reconstruction research by providing dense, accurate geometric annotations that are impossible to obtain from real data.

entry.title: ReflectDrive-2: Reinforcement-Learning-Aligned Self-Editing for Discrete Diffusion Driving

author.name: Huimin Wang, Yue Wang, Bihao Cui, Pengxiang Li, Ben Lu, Mingqian Wang, Tong Wang, Chuan Tang, Teng Zhang, Kun Zhan

entry.summary: Introduces ReflectDrive-2, a masked discrete diffusion planner for autonomous driving that represents trajectories as discrete tokens and enables in-place revision via AutoEdit, trained with structure-aware perturbations and reinforcement learning fine-tuning.

entry.title: What is Anthropic?

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Analyzes the nature of Anthropic as an organization, discussing claims that it is 'run in significant part by Claude' and exploring the relationship between AI labs and their models, including Claude's potential role in hiring and performance reviews.

entry.title: When Context Hurts: The Crossover Effect of Knowledge Transfer on Multi-Agent Design Exploration

author.name: Saranyan Vigraham

entry.summary: Discovers a 'crossover effect' in multi-agent design systems: the same context type can either improve exploration (up to 20x) or degrade it (up to 46%) depending on the task. The direction is predicted by baseline exploration without context (r=-0.82).

entry.title: Executable World Models for ARC-AGI-3 in the Era of Coding Agents

author.name: Sergey Rodionov

entry.summary: Evaluates a coding-agent system for ARC-AGI-3 that maintains an executable Python world model, verifies against observations, refactors toward simpler abstractions, and plans through the model. Reports results on 25 public games.

entry.title: RetentiveKV: State-Space Memory for Uncertainty-Aware Multimodal KV Cache Eviction

author.name: Sihao Liu, YuFan Xiong, Zhonghua Jiang, Zhaode Wang, chengfei lv Shengyu Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes RetentiveKV, an entropy-driven KV cache optimization for multimodal LLMs that addresses 'deferred importance' of visual tokens and maintains spatial continuity of visual cues during cache compression.

entry.title: FASQ: Flexible Accelerated Subspace Quantization for Calibration-Free LLM Compression

author.name: Ye Qiao, Yian Wang, Zhiheng Chen, Hyoukjun Kwon, Sitao Huang

entry.summary: Presents FASQ, a calibration-free product quantization framework for LLM compression that provides continuous compression control (27-49% of FP16 size). Surpasses 4-bit GPTQ and AWQ on Meta-Llama-3-8B.

entry.title: LLMs Uncertainty Quantification via Adaptive Conformal Semantic Entropy

author.name: Hamed Karimi, Vaishali Meyappan, Reza Samavi

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Conformal Semantic Entropy (ACSE) for LLM uncertainty quantification that clusters semantic entropy of diverse responses and adaptively adjusts thresholds using conformal prediction.

entry.title: Dissociating spatial frequency reliance from adversarial robustness advantages in neurally guided deep convolutional neural networks

author.name: Zhenan Shao, Tianyu Ren, Chengxiao Wang, Leyla Isik, Diane M. Beck

entry.summary: Studies how aligning deep neural network representations with human visual cortex affects adversarial robustness, finding that the robustness advantage comes not from low-spatial-frequency bias but from preserving a specific mid-frequency band.

entry.title: Ilov3Splat: Instance-Level Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding in Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Binh Long Nguyen, Kien Nguyen, Sridha Sridharan, Clinton Fookes, Peyman Moghadam

entry.summary: Ilov3Splat enables instance-level open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding in Gaussian Splatting by jointly optimizing geometry and semantic representations with multi-resolution hash embeddings for CLIP feature encoding.

entry.title: Dream-MPC: Gradient-Based Model Predictive Control with Latent Imagination

author.name: Jonathan Spieler, Sven Behnke

entry.summary: Dream-MPC combines gradient-based model predictive control with learned world models and policy priors in latent space, addressing the empirical finding that gradient-based planning often underperforms gradient-free methods in model-based RL.

entry.title: Beyond Retrieval: A Multitask Benchmark and Model for Code Search

author.name: Siqiao Xue, Zihan Liao, Jin Qin, Ziyin Zhang, Yixiang Mu, Fan Zhou, Hang Yu

entry.summary: CoREB is a contamination-limited benchmark for code search covering the full pipeline (retrieval and reranking) with graded relevance, timed releases, and a fine-tuned code reranker. Addresses data contamination, label noise, and binary relevance limitations of existing benchmarks.

entry.title: From Beats to Breaches:How Offensive AI Infers Sensitive User Information from Playlists

author.name: Stefano Cecconello, Mauro Conti, Luca Pajola, Luca Pasa, Pier Paolo Tricomi

entry.summary: Demonstrates that AI can infer sensitive personal information (PII) from public music playlists using deep learning architectures including set-based approaches and graph-based methods, quantifying privacy risks in music streaming ecosystems.

entry.title: StoryAlign: Evaluating and Training Reward Models for Story Generation

author.name: Haotian Xia, Hao Peng, Yunjia Qi, Xiaozhi Wang, Bin Xu, Lei Hou, Juanzi Li

entry.summary: StoryAlign introduces StoryRMB, the first benchmark for assessing reward models on story preferences with 1,133 human-verified instances, and studies how to train reward models that capture subjective human story preferences.

entry.title: Almost-Orthogonality in Lp Spaces: A Case Study with Grok

author.name: Ziang Chen, Jaume de Dios Pont, Paata Ivanisvili, Jose Madrid, Haozhu Wang

entry.summary: Constructs counterexamples to Carbery's sharpened triangle inequality in Lp spaces and establishes the inequality at the critical exponent. In the second part, reports using Grok AI for mathematical discovery.

entry.title: Continual Distillation of Teachers from Different Domains

author.name: Nicolas Michel, Maorong Wang, Jiangpeng He, Toshihiko Yamasaki

entry.summary: Introduces Continual Distillation, where a student learns sequentially from a stream of teachers without retaining access to earlier ones. Discovers Unseen Knowledge Transfer and Unseen Knowledge Forgetting phenomena.

entry.title: On the Architectural Complexity of Neural Networks

author.name: Nicholas J. Cooper, Fran\c{c}ois G. Meyer, Michael L. Roberts, Carlos Zapata-Carratal\'a, Lijun Chen, Danna Gurari

entry.summary: Introduces a unified theoretical framework for analyzing DNN architectural complexity by explicitly modeling tensor operation structure. Reveals connection between groundbreaking architectures and complexity increases over 40 years of deep learning history.

entry.title: ITBoost: Information-Theoretic Trust for Robust Boosting

author.name: Ye Su, Longlong Zhao, Diego Garcia-Gil, Jipeng Guo, Gangchun Zhang, Jinxin Chen, Jinsong Chen

entry.summary: ITBoost uses the Minimum Description Length principle to evaluate sample reliability during gradient boosting by analyzing residual evolution across iterations, distinguishing informative hard cases from noisy labels.

entry.title: ELVIS: Ensemble-Calibrated Latent Imagination for Long-Horizon Visual MPC

author.name: Yurui Du, Pinhao Song, Yutong Hu, Renaud Detry

entry.summary: ELVIS introduces Gaussian-mixture MPPI for long-horizon planning in latent model predictive control, maintaining multiple coherent hypotheses to handle branching futures and avoiding mode averaging under visual occlusions.

entry.title: Transformed Latent Variable Multi-Output Gaussian Processes

author.name: Xiaoyu Jiang, Xinxing Shi, Sokratia Georgaka, Magnus Rattray, Mauricio A \'Alvarez

entry.summary: T-LVMOGP scales multi-output Gaussian processes to massive output spaces while preserving inter-output dependencies, using transformed latent variables with a Lipschitz-regularized deep kernel to construct flexible multi-output kernels.

entry.title: Intermediate Representations are Strong AI-Generated Image Detectors

author.name: Zhenhan Huang, Pin-Yu Chen, Tejaswini Pedapati, Jianxi Gao

entry.summary: Proposes using intermediate layer representations from vision models as features for detecting AI-generated images. A search-based method examining embedding sensitivity in intermediate layers outperforms existing training-free approaches.

entry.title: Conditional Flow-VAE for Safety-Critical Traffic Scenario Generation

author.name: Zimu Gong, Brian Zhaoning Zhang, Chris Zhang, Kelvin Wong, Raquel Urtasun

entry.summary: Introduces a conditional latent flow matching approach for generating safety-critical autonomous driving scenarios. Uses distribution matching to transform nominal scenes into safety-critical rollouts while maintaining realism.

entry.title: Material Database Agent: A Multimodal Agentic Framework for Scientific Literature Mining

author.name: Achuth Chandrasekhar, Omid Barati Farimani, Radheesh Sharma Meda, Amir Barati Farimani

entry.summary: Introduces Material Database Agent (MDA), a multi-agent system for converting research literature PDFs into structured materials science databases by extracting information from text, tables, graphs, and figures.

entry.title: Elicitation Matters: How Prompts and Query Protocols Shape LLM Surrogates under Sparse Observations

author.name: Ge Lei, Samuel J. Cooper

entry.summary: Studies how prompt design and query protocols affect LLM surrogate beliefs in low-data optimization settings. Shows structural prompts act as priors and different querying modes induce different beliefs.

entry.title: RemoteZero: Geospatial Reasoning with Zero Human Annotations

author.name: Liang Yao, Fan Liu, Shengxiang Xu, Chuanyi Zhang, Rui Min, Shimin Di, Yuhui Zheng

entry.summary: Introduces RemoteZero, a box-supervision-free framework for geospatial reasoning that leverages the asymmetry between MLLMs being better at verification than localization, enabling self-evolution on unlabeled remote sensing data.

entry.title: Lightning Unified Video Editing via In-Context Sparse Attention

author.name: Shitong Shao, Zikai Zhou, Haopeng Li, Yingwei Song, Wenliang Zhong, Lichen Bai, Zeke Xie

entry.summary: Proposes In-context Sparse Attention (ISA) for efficient in-context learning video editing by pruning redundant context tokens and dynamically routing high-error queries to full attention, achieving near-lossless performance with reduced computation.

entry.title: Wasserstein-Aligned Localisation for VLM-Based Distributional OOD Detection in Medical Imaging

author.name: Bernhard Kainz, Johanna P Mueller, Matthew Baugh, Cosmin Bercea

entry.summary: Introduces WALDO, a training-free framework for zero-shot anomaly localization in medical images using optimal transport theory with VLMs, enabling comparative inference against healthy anatomy reference distributions.

entry.title: Temporal Reasoning Is Not the Bottleneck: A Probabilistic Inconsistency Framework for Neuro-Symbolic QA

author.name: Tran Quang Liem

entry.summary: Challenges the narrative that temporal reasoning is the bottleneck for LLMs, arguing instead that unstructured text-to-event representation is the real failure point. Introduces a neuro-symbolic QA framework with a Probabilistic Inconsistency Signal to isolate perceptual errors from reasoning failures.

entry.title: A Foundation Model for Zero-Shot Logical Rule Induction

author.name: Yin Jun Phua

entry.summary: Introduces Neural Rule Inducer (NRI), a pretrained model for zero-shot inductive logic programming. Uses domain-agnostic statistical properties instead of literal identities, enabling generalization across tasks without retraining.

entry.title: Awaking Spatial Intelligence in Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation

author.name: Lin Song, Wenbo Li, Guoqing Ma, Wei Tang, Bo Wang, Yuan Zhang, Yijun Yang, Yicheng Xiao, Jianhui Liu, Yanbing Zhang, Guohui Zhang, Wenhu Zhang, Hang Xu, Nan Jiang, Xin Han, Haoze Sun, Maoquan Zhang, Haoyang Huang, Nan Duan

entry.summary: Presents JoyAI-Image, a unified multimodal model coupling a spatially enhanced MLLM with a Multimodal Diffusion Transformer for visual understanding, text-to-image generation, and instruction-guided editing.

entry.title: NoisyCausal: A Benchmark for Evaluating Causal Reasoning Under Structured Noise

author.name: Zhi Xu, Yun Fu

entry.summary: NoisyCausal is a benchmark for evaluating LLM causal reasoning under structured noise conditions including irrelevant distractors and value perturbations. Each instance is generated from ground-truth causal graphs with controllable noise injection.

entry.title: JASTIN: Aligning LLMs for Zero-Shot Audio and Speech Evaluation via Natural Language Instructions

author.name: Leying Zhang, Bowen Shi, Haibin Wu, Bach Viet Do, Yanmin Qian

entry.summary: JASTIN is an instruction-driven audio evaluation framework that bridges a frozen audio encoder with a fine-tuned LLM for zero-shot audio and speech quality assessment, formulating evaluation as self-instructed reasoning.

entry.title: Gyan: An Explainable Neuro-Symbolic Language Model

author.name: Venkat Srinivasan, Vishaal Jatav, Anushka Chandrababu, Geetika Sharma

entry.summary: Gyan is a neuro-symbolic language model with a novel non-transformer architecture that claims to achieve SOTA on 3 datasets while being more interpretable, avoiding hallucination issues, and requiring less compute. Decouples compositional understanding from generation.

entry.title: Quantile-Free Uncertainty Quantification in Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Soyoung park, Hwanjun Song, Sungsu Lim

entry.summary: QpiGNN introduces quantile-free prediction intervals for graph neural networks that directly optimize coverage and interval width without requiring quantile inputs or post-processing, using a dual-head architecture that decouples prediction and uncertainty.

entry.title: Think-Aloud Reshapes Automated Cognitive Model Discovery Beyond Behavior

author.name: Hanbo Xie, Akshay K. Jagadish, Lan Pan, Robert C. Wilson

entry.summary: Shows that incorporating think-aloud verbal traces (not just behavioral data) during LLM-based automated cognitive model discovery significantly improves predictive performance and shifts discovered model classes for 69.4% of participants.

entry.title: Taming Outlier Tokens in Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Xiaoyu Wu, Yifei Wang, Tsu-Jui Fu, Liang-Chieh Chen, Zhe Gan, Chen Wei

entry.summary: Studies outlier tokens in Diffusion Transformers, showing they appear in both encoder and denoiser of RAE-DiT pipelines. Demonstrates that simply masking high-norm tokens doesn't help, suggesting the problem requires deeper architectural solutions.

entry.title: FL-Sailer: Efficient and Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning for Scalable Single-Cell Epigenetic Data Analysis via Adaptive Sampling

author.name: Guangyi Zhang, Yi Dai, Yiyun He, Junhao Liu

entry.summary: FL-Sailer is the first federated learning framework for single-cell ATAC-seq data, using adaptive leverage score sampling for dimensionality reduction and an invariant VAE to handle cross-institutional heterogeneity while preserving privacy.

entry.title: Regime-Conditioned Evaluation in Multi-Context Bayesian Optimization

author.name: Noel Thomas

entry.summary: Audits transfer-BO papers finding 98% never vary budget as a controlled axis, showing this oversight can reverse method rankings. Proposes the Portable Regime Score for characterizing when different acquisition functions are optimal.

entry.title: Reinforcement Learning for Compositional Generalization with Outcome-Level Optimization

author.name: Xiyan Fu, Wei Liu

entry.summary: Investigates whether compositional generalization in language can be improved through outcome-level reinforcement learning (GRPO) rather than supervised fine-tuning, exploring binary and composite reward signals.

entry.title: Order-based Rehearsal Learning

author.name: Yu-Xuan Tao, Tian-Zuo Wang, Zhi-Hua Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes order-based rehearsal learning for the 'avoiding undesired future' problem, showing that order structure (rather than full graph structure) can suffice for identifying decision influence from observational data.

entry.title: Entropic Riemannian Neural Optimal Transport

author.name: Alessandro Micheli, Silvia Sapora, Anthea Monod, Samir Bhatt

entry.summary: Proposes Entropic Riemannian Neural Optimal Transport (Entropic RNOT), combining intrinsic entropic OT with amortized out-of-sample evaluation on Riemannian manifolds. Learns neural Schrödinger potentials for manifold OT.

entry.title: Gray-Box Poisoning of Continuous Malware Ingestion Pipelines

author.name: Jan Dolej\v{s}, Martin Jure\v{c}ek, R\'obert L\'orencz

entry.summary: Investigates gray-box poisoning attacks on malware detection pipelines using functionality-preserving adversarial binary manipulations. Shows IAT-based perturbations can significantly degrade detection recall.

entry.title: Jacobian-Velocity Bounds for Deployment Risk Under Covariate Drift

author.name: Jonathan R. Landers

entry.summary: Proposes drift-aligned tangent regularization for deployed models under covariate shift, using Jacobian-velocity bounds to characterize risk along deployment paths. Penalizes sensitivity only along estimated drift directions.

entry.title: Distilling Bayesian Belief States into Language Models for Auditable Negotiation

author.name: Zongqi Cui, Baihan Lin

entry.summary: Proposes BOND, a framework for auditable negotiation that distills Bayesian opponent beliefs from an LLM teacher into a smaller student model. The student outputs both actions and interpretable posterior beliefs.

entry.title: Every Step Counts: Step-Level Credit Assignment for Tool-Integrated Text-to-SQL

author.name: Yaxun Dai, Baolin Sun, Junying Wang, Pengfei Wang, Yingqi Gao, Xuemei Dong, Mengdie Chu, Xiang Qi, Pingfu Chao

entry.summary: Proposes FineStep for step-level credit assignment in tool-augmented Text-to-SQL, addressing the problem that outcome-based RL rewards don't distinguish good from lucky intermediate steps.

entry.title: From Priors to Perception: Grounding Video-LLMs in Physical Reality

author.name: Zicheng Zhao, Chaofan Gan, Shijie Li, Weiyao Lin

entry.summary: Proposes that Video-LLM failures in physical reasoning stem from 'Semantic Prior Dominance' where internal narrative scripts hijack reasoning, and introduces programmatic approaches to address this through counter-intuitive scenario testing.

entry.title: Velox: Learning Representations of 4D Geometry and Appearance

author.name: Anagh Malik, Dorian Chan, Xiaoming Zhao, David B. Lindell, Oncel Tuzel, Jen-Hao Rick Chang

entry.summary: Introduces Velox, a framework for learning latent representations of 4D objects using an encoder that compresses spatiotemporal color point clouds into dynamic shape tokens, supervised by complementary surface and Gaussian decoders.

entry.title: CAST: Mitigating Object Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models via Caption-Guided Visual Attention Steering

author.name: Qiming Li, Zekai Ye, Xiaocheng Feng, Weihong Zhong, Libo Qin, Ruihan Chen, Lei Huang, Baohang Li, Kui Jiang, Yaowei Wang, Ting Liu, Bing Qin

entry.summary: Proposes CAST, a training-free method to mitigate object hallucination in LVLMs by steering visual attention using patterns observed during caption queries, which naturally enhance attention to visual information.

entry.title: D-OPSD: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Continuously Tuning Step-Distilled Diffusion Models

author.name: Dengyang Jiang, Xin Jin, Dongyang Liu, Zanyi Wang, Mingzhe Zheng, Ruoyi Du, Xiangpeng Yang, Qilong Wu, Zhen Li, Peng Gao, Harry Yang, Steven Hoi

entry.summary: Proposes D-OPSD for continuously fine-tuning step-distilled diffusion models (like Z-Image-Turbo) using on-policy self-distillation, discovering that modern diffusion models with LLM/VLM encoders inherit in-context capabilities.

entry.title: Interpreting V1 Population Activity via Image-Neural Latent Representation Alignment

author.name: Xin Wang, Zhuangzhi Gao, Hongyi Qin, Zhongli Wu, Feixiang Zhou, He Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes DINA, a dual-tower contrastive framework that aligns visual stimuli and V1 population responses in a shared latent space, enabling both accurate decoding and interpretable analysis of neural computations in primary visual cortex.

entry.title: High-Dimensional Statistics: Reflections on Progress and Open Problems

author.name: Arian Maleki, Subhabrata Sen, Sivaraman Balakrishna, Verena Zuber, Chao Gao, Rishabh Dudeja, Christos Thrampoulidis, Anru Zhang, Weijie Su, Jason M. Klusowski, Po-Ling Loh, Ali Shojaie

entry.summary: A multi-author reflection on progress and open problems in high-dimensional statistics over the past two decades, covering connections to optimization, random matrix theory, causal inference, and modern machine learning.

entry.title: Will Claude cause the next Covid?

author.name: Kate Delbeke

entry.summary: Reviews current biosafety risks from AI systems, covering capabilities in small molecule drug design, protein engineering, and pathogen creation, along with existing mitigation efforts including model evaluations and DNA synthesis screening.

entry.title: StableI2I: Spotting Unintended Changes in Image-to-Image Transition

author.name: Jiayang Li, Shuo Cao, Xiaohui Li, Zhizhen Zhang, Kaiwen Zhu, Yule Duan, Yu Qiao, Jian Zhang, Yihao Liu

entry.summary: StableI2I proposes a unified evaluation framework for image-to-image tasks that measures content fidelity and pre-post consistency without requiring reference images, addressing a gap where existing evaluations focus only on instruction following and aesthetics.

entry.title: Harnessing Linguistic Dissimilarity for Language Generalization on Unseen Low-Resource Varieties

author.name: Jinju Kim, Haeji Jung, Youjeong Roh, Jong Hwan Ko, David R. Mortensen

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage language generalization framework that leverages linguistic dissimilarity (not just similarity) to help models generalize to unseen low-resource language varieties, including a source-selection method called TOPPing.

entry.title: From Diffusion to Rectified Flow: Rethinking Text-Based Segmentation

author.name: Zishen Qu, Xuesong Li, Haijian Gu, Hongwei Kang, Quan Meng, Tianrui Niu, Xin Yang, Ruidong Pan

entry.summary: RLFSeg uses Rectified Flow instead of diffusion models for text-based image segmentation, learning direct mappings from image to segmentation mask in latent space while avoiding the generative properties that harm discriminative tasks.

entry.title: FairEnc: A Fair Vision-Language Model with Fair Vision and Text Encoders for Glaucoma Detection

author.name: Mohamed Elhabebe, Ayman El-Baz, Qing Liu

entry.summary: FairEnc proposes fair pretraining for vision-language models that simultaneously debiases across multiple sensitive attributes (race, gender, ethnicity, language) in both text and visual encoders for glaucoma detection.

entry.title: Text Corpora as Concept Fields: Black-Box Hallucination and Novelty Measurement

author.name: Nicholas S. Kersting, Vittorio Castelli, Chieh Ting Yeh, Xinzhu Wang, Saad Taame

entry.summary: Introduces 'Concept Fields' — local drift fields in sentence-embedding space estimated from consecutive sentence deltas — for black-box hallucination and novelty measurement. Provides corpus-attributable scores without requiring model internals.

entry.title: Covariance-Aware Goodness for Scalable Forward-Forward Learning

author.name: Xiaoyi Jiang, Bashir M. Al-Hashimi, Kai Xu

entry.summary: Proposes Bi-axis Covariance Goodness (BiCovG) to improve the Forward-Forward algorithm in convolutional settings by incorporating structured second-order information, narrowing the gap with backpropagation on ImageNet-100/Tiny-ImageNet.

entry.title: RaguTeam at SemEval-2026 Task 8: Meno and Friends in a Judge-Orchestrated LLM Ensemble for Faithful Multi-Turn Response Generation

author.name: Ivan Bondarenko, Roman Derunets, Oleg Sedukhin, Mikhail Komarov, Ivan Chernov, Mikhail Kulakov

entry.summary: Presents a winning SemEval-2026 system using a heterogeneous ensemble of seven LLMs with a GPT-4o-mini judge for multi-turn faithful response generation, ranking 1st among 26 teams. Introduces Meno-Lite-0.1, a 7B domain-adapted model.

entry.title: Safety by Invariance, Liveness through Refinement: Heterogeneous Contract Framework for Co-Design of Layered Control

author.name: Yoshinari Takayama, Alessio Iovine, Bart Besselink, Guillaume Sandou, Adnane Saoud

entry.summary: Proposes a heterogeneous assume-guarantee contract framework for layered control architectures that formally separates safety (invariance at continuous time) from liveness (refinement at discrete time), providing compositional guarantees across time scales.

entry.title: Strat-Reasoner: Reinforcing Strategic Reasoning of LLMs in Multi-Agent Games

author.name: Yidong He, Yutao Lai, Pengxu Yang, Jiarui Gan, Jiexin Wang, Yi Cai, Mengchen Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes Strat-Reasoner, an RL-based framework that improves LLMs' strategic reasoning in multi-agent games through recursive reasoning where each agent models other agents' thinking processes during reward computation.

entry.title: LAWS: Learning from Actual Workloads Symbolically -- A Self-Certifying Parametrized Cache Architecture for Neural Inference, Robotics, and Edge Deployment

author.name: Gregory Magarshak

entry.summary: Introduces LAWS, a self-certifying inference caching architecture that builds certified expert functions from deployment observations, with formal error bounds. Targets neural inference, robotics, and edge deployment.

entry.title: AsymmetryZero: A Framework for Operationalizing Human Expert Preferences as Semantic Evals

author.name: Tadhg Looram, Lucas Nuzzi, Kyle Waters, Steven Dillmann

entry.summary: Presents AsymmetryZero, a framework for converting human expert preferences into structured semantic evaluations. Represents tasks as evaluation contracts with explicit grading criteria for use in RL pipelines.

entry.title: CTM-AI: A Blueprint for General AI Inspired by a Model of Consciousness

author.name: Haofei Yu, Yining Zhao, Lenore Blum, Manuel Blum, Paul Pu Liang

entry.summary: Presents CTM-AI, a blueprint for general AI combining the Conscious Turing Machine (a formal model of consciousness) with foundation models. Uses specialized and unspecialized processors with a competition-based attention mechanism.

entry.title: Learning reveals invisible structure in low-rank RNNs

author.name: Yoav Ger, Omri Barak

entry.summary: Extends the low-rank RNN framework from activity to learning by deriving gradient-descent dynamics in reduced overlap space. Distinguishes 'loss-visible' from 'loss-invisible' overlaps, revealing hidden learning structure.

entry.title: Predict-then-Diffuse: Adaptive Response Length for Compute-Budgeted Inference in Diffusion LLMs

author.name: Michael Rottoli, Subhankar Roy, Stefano Paraboschi

entry.summary: Proposes Predict-then-Diffuse for diffusion-based LLMs, addressing the fixed response length requirement by predicting appropriate length before generation. Avoids waste on padding tokens or costly re-computations.

entry.title: Extending Differential Temporal Difference Methods for Episodic Problems

author.name: Kris De Asis, Mohamed Elsayed, Jiamin He

entry.summary: Extends differential temporal difference (TD) methods to episodic reinforcement learning problems by proposing a generalization that maintains policy ordering in the presence of termination. Proves theoretical correctness and shows practical benefits for streaming deep RL.

entry.title: SpecPL: Disentangling Spectral Granularity for Prompt Learning

author.name: Jingtao Zhou, Xirui Kang, Feiyang Huang, Lai-Man Po

entry.summary: SpecPL introduces a spectral perspective to prompt learning for vision-language models, using VAE decomposition into low-frequency semantic and high-frequency granular components with counterfactual supervision for fine-grained discrimination.

entry.title: SADE: Symptom-Aware Diagnostic Escalation for LLM-Based Network Troubleshooting

author.name: Kuan-Hao Tseng, Niruth Bogahawatta, Yasod Ginige, Kosta Dekic, Arunan Sivanathan, Suranga Seneviratne

entry.summary: SADE encodes the classical Cisco troubleshooting methodology as an explicit policy for LLM-based network troubleshooting agents, using phase-gated diagnostic workflows that separate evidence acquisition from hypothesis commitment.

entry.title: Delta-Based Neural Architecture Search: LLM Fine-Tuning via Code Diffs

author.name: Santosh Premi Adhikari, Radu Timofte, Dmitry Ignatov

entry.summary: Proposes Delta-Code Generation for neural architecture search where LLMs generate compact unified diffs to refine baseline architectures rather than synthesizing entire models from scratch, reducing computational cost and code verbosity.

entry.title: Direct Product Flow Matching: Decoupling Radial and Angular Dynamics for Few-Shot Adaptation

author.name: Hongxu Chen, Yanghao Wang, Bowei Zhu, Hongxiang Li, Zhen Wang, Ziqi Jiang, Lin Li, Rui Liu, Long Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Direct Product Flow Matching that decouples radial and angular dynamics for few-shot adaptation of vision-language models. Identifies three limitations of existing flow matching methods through polar decomposition analysis.

entry.title: Joint Treatment Effect Estimation from Incomplete Healthcare Data: Temporal Causal Normalizing Flows with LLM-driven Evolutionary MNAR Imputation

author.name: Olivia Jullian Parra, Sara Zoccheddu, David Catalan Cerezo, Tom Forzy, Franziska Ulrich, William Sutcliffe, Jakob Martin Burgstaller, Oliver Senn, Patrick Owen, Nicola Serra

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage pipeline for treatment effect estimation from incomplete longitudinal EHRs: CausalFlow-T (DAG-constrained normalizing flow with LSTM) for counterfactual inference, combined with LLM-driven evolutionary imputation for MNAR data.

entry.title: Endogenous Regime Switching Driven by Scalar-Irreducible Learning Dynamics

author.name: Sheng Ran

entry.summary: Introduces scalar-irreducible dynamics that naturally enable endogenous regime switching through feedback between fast variables and slow structural adaptation, arguing this is key for autonomous intelligence beyond scalar-reducible gradient flows.

entry.title: A Provably Convergent and Practical Algorithm for Gromov--Wasserstein Optimal Transport

author.name: Ling Liang, Lei Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a provably convergent inexact projected-gradient algorithm for Gromov-Wasserstein optimal transport with a verifiable feasibility condition that bridges the gap between practical implementations and convergence theory.

entry.title: Geometry-Aware Neural Optimizer for Shape Optimization and Inversion

author.name: Guoze Sun, Tianya Miao, Haoyang Huang, Huaguan Chen, Han Wan, Rui Zhang, Hao Sun

entry.summary: GANO provides an end-to-end differentiable framework for shape optimization in PDE-governed systems, unifying geometry representation, field prediction, and automated optimization. Addresses the gap between neural surrogates and geometry optimization.

entry.title: Bilinear Mamba-Koopman Neural MPC for Varying Dynamics

author.name: Matan Pagi, Zohar Sorek

entry.summary: Proposes Bilinear Mamba-Koopman Neural MPC that introduces control-dependent coupling in latent dynamics, allowing the effective operator to adapt to current inputs while adding minimal parameters and maintaining convex optimization.

entry.title: Unsat Core Prediction through Polarity-Aware Representation Learning over Clause-Literal Hypergraphs

author.name: Zhenchao Sun, Shuai Ma, Ping Lu, Chongyang Tao

entry.summary: Proposes polarity-aware representation learning over clause-literal hypergraphs for unsat core prediction in SAT solving, capturing higher-order interactions and complementary relationships between literals.

entry.title: Koopman Identification of Nonlinear Systems via Reservoir Liftings

author.name: Weibin Gu, Chen Yang, Lu Shi

entry.summary: RC-Koopman interprets reservoir computing as providing a stateful Koopman dictionary whose temporal depth is controlled by spectral radius, with Echo State Property guaranteeing well-posedness of the lifted approximation.

entry.title: Training-Time Batch Normalization Reshapes Local Partition Geometry in Piecewise-Affine Networks

author.name: Xuan Qi, Yi Wei, Fanqi Yu, Furao shen, Vittorio Murino, Cigdem Beyan

entry.summary: Analyzes how batch normalization during training affects the geometry of switching hyperplanes and affine-region partitions in piecewise-affine networks, providing exact characterization of when hyperplanes intersect local windows.

entry.title: Order Matters: Improving Domain Adaptation by Reordering Data

author.name: Andrea Napoli, Paul White

entry.summary: ORDERED reduces domain discrepancy estimation variance in unsupervised domain adaptation by optimizing the order in which training data are sampled, applicable to correlation alignment and MMD losses.

entry.title: Tree-Conditioned Edit Flows for Ancestral Sequence Reconstruction

author.name: Emil Sharafutdinov, Ingemar Andr\'e

entry.summary: Introduces a tree-conditioned edit-flow model for ancestral sequence reconstruction that handles variable-length sequences with insertions and deletions. Uses paired bidirectional edit trajectories constrained to agree on a common ancestral state.

entry.title: One Pool, Two Caches: Adaptive HBM Partitioning for Accelerating Generative Recommender Serving

author.name: Wenjun Yu, Shuguang Han, Amelie Chi Zhou

entry.summary: Presents HELM, a system jointly managing HBM allocation between embedding caches and KV caches for generative recommender inference using PPO-based control. Addresses the competition for limited GPU memory in serving.

entry.title: Hypergraph Generation via Structured Stochastic Diffusion

author.name: Christopher Nemeth

entry.summary: Proposes HEDGE, a generative model for hypergraphs defined on relaxed incidence matrices via structured stochastic diffusion. Combines hypergraph-specific heat operator with Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process.

entry.title: DoGMaTiQ: Automated Generation of Question-and-Answer Nuggets for Report Evaluation

author.name: Bryan Li, William Walden, Yu Hou, Gabrielle Kaili-May Liu, Dawn Lawrie, Jame Mayfield, Eugene Yang, Chris Callison-Burch, Laura Dietz

entry.summary: Presents DoGMaTiQ for automated generation of question-answer nuggets to evaluate long-form RAG reports. Addresses the challenge of manually curating evaluation nuggets for each topic.

entry.title: The Pinocchio Dimension: Phenomenality of Experience as the Primary Axis of LLM Psychometric Differences

author.name: Hubert Plisiecki, Sabina Siudaj, Kacper Dudzic, Anna Sterna, Maciej Gorski, Karolina Drozdz, Marcin Moskalewicz

entry.summary: Administers 45 psychometric questionnaires to 50 LLMs and identifies that the primary axis of between-model variance separates items about phenomenally rich experience (embodiment, affect, imagery) from behavioral reactivity. Introduces the 'Pinocchio score' as an annotation-free measure of experiential demand.

entry.title: LEGO: LoRA-Enabled Generator-Oriented Framework for Synthetic Image Detection

author.name: Yutong Xiao, Ran Ran, Jiwei Wei, Shuchang Zhou, Ke Liu, Zheng Ziqiang, Caiyan Qin

entry.summary: Proposes LEGO framework for synthetic image detection that uses MLP-modulated multiple LoRA modules specialized for different generators, addressing the challenge that universal artifact features diminish as generator diversity increases.

entry.title: Reward-Guided Semantic Evolution for Test-time Adaptive Object Detection

author.name: Lihua Zhou, Mao Ye, Xiatian Zhu, Nianxin Li, Changyi Ma, Shuaifeng Li, Yitong Qin, Hongbin Liu, Jiebo Luo, Zhen Lei

entry.summary: Proposes RGSE, a training-free framework for test-time adaptive object detection that refines text embeddings via evolutionary search guided by reward signals, addressing semantic misalignment under distribution shifts.

entry.title: ScriptHOI: Learning Scripted State Transitions for Open-Vocabulary Human-Object Interaction Detection

author.name: Minh Anh Nguyen, Quang Huy Tran, Bao Ngoc Le, SuiYang Guang, Tuan Kiet Pham, Linh Chi Vo

entry.summary: Proposes ScriptHOI for open-vocabulary HOI detection that represents interactions as scripted state transitions, verifying whether hand, tool, target, contact, and object state jointly support an action rather than relying on phrase co-occurrence.

entry.title: CPCANet: Deep Unfolding Common Principal Component Analysis for Domain Generalization

author.name: Yu-Hsi Chen, Abd-Krim Seghouane

entry.summary: Proposes CPCANet, a domain generalization framework that unrolls Common Principal Component Analysis into differentiable neural layers, discovering shared subspaces across domains through second-order statistics.

entry.title: Reduced-order Neural Modeling with Differentiable Simulation for High-Detail Tactile Perception

author.name: Yuhu Guo, Zhikai Shen, Jiasheng Qu, Chenghao Qian, Yuming Huang, Bin Chen, Guoxing Fang

entry.summary: Proposes a reduced-order neural simulation framework coupling coarse-grained Material Point Methods with an implicit neural decoder for tactile perception. Achieves 65% faster simulation and 40% memory reduction compared to TacIPC while maintaining high fidelity.

entry.title: Using Base-LCM to Monitor LLMs

author.name: Éloïse Benito-Rodriguez

entry.summary: Explores whether Meta's Large Concept Model (LCM), which predicts sentence embeddings rather than tokens, can predict LLM outputs for monitoring purposes. Best architecture achieves 0.53 cosine similarity for paragraph prediction.

entry.title: Pen-Strategist: A Reasoning Framework for Penetration Testing Strategy Formation and Analysis

author.name: Yasod Ginige, Pasindu Marasinghe, Sajal Jain, Suranga Seneviratne

entry.summary: Pen-Strategist is a framework for automated penetration testing that uses domain-specific reasoning models for strategy formulation and a classifier for action/tool selection, addressing limitations of existing LLM-based pentesting agents.

entry.title: DiffCap-Bench: A Comprehensive, Challenging, Robust Benchmark for Image Difference Captioning

author.name: Yuancheng Wei, Haojie Zhang, Linli Yao, Lei Li, Jiali Chen, Tao Huang, Yiting Lu, Duojun Huang, Xin Li, Zhao Zhong

entry.summary: DiffCap-Bench is a comprehensive benchmark for image difference captioning covering ten difference categories with a new evaluation metric (DiffCapScore) that better captures semantic consistency and penalizes hallucinations compared to standard lexical metrics.

entry.title: Stage-adaptive audio diffusion modeling

author.name: Xuanhao Zhang, Chang Li

entry.summary: Proposes stage-adaptive training for audio diffusion models that adjusts the balance between semantic acquisition and generation refinement throughout training, arguing that static optimization recipes waste computation.

entry.title: Library learning with e-graphs on jazz harmony

author.name: Zeng Ren, Maddy Bowers, Xinyi Guan, Martin Rohrmeier
