entry.summary: Presents a computational model for learning jazz harmonic patterns using library learning with e-graphs, discovering concise generative explanations of harmonic progressions from a corpus by searching over programs composed of primitive harmonic relations.

entry.title: CodeEvolve: LLM-Driven Evolutionary Optimization with Runtime-Enriched Target Selection for Multi-Language Code Enhancement

author.name: Ajay Krishna Borra, Wenzhuo Yang, Samarth Arora, Akhilesh Deepak Gotmare, Gokulakrishnan Gopalakrishnan, Tharun Gali, Madhav Rathi, Doyen Sahoo, Manpreet Singh, Mayuresh Verma, Laksh Venka, Shuchita Singh

entry.summary: CodeEvolve extends evolutionary code optimization with LLMs by adding runtime-guided target selection using Java Flight Recorder profiles, MCTS search, and multi-language support for automated performance optimization.

entry.title: Preference-Based Self-Distillation: Beyond KL Matching via Reward Regularization

author.name: Xin Yu, Liuchen Liao, Yiwen Zhang, Yingchen Yu, Lingzhou Xue, Qinzhen Guo

entry.summary: Proposes preference-based self-distillation that moves beyond KL matching by incorporating reward regularization, providing exploratory diversity that same-model distillation typically lacks. Addresses training instability in existing self-distillation methods.

entry.title: Geometry-Aware State Space Model: A New Paradigm for Whole-Slide Image Representation

author.name: Enhui Chai, Sicheng Chen, Tianyi Zhang, Chad Wong, Kecheng Huang, Zeyu Liu, Fei Xia

entry.summary: Proposes a geometry-aware state space model for whole-slide image analysis that uses hyperbolic and spherical spaces to capture hierarchical tissue organization and regional heterogeneity, rather than standard Euclidean embeddings.

entry.title: Adaptive Consensus in LLM Ensembles via Sequential Evidence Accumulation: Automatic Budget Identification and Calibrated Commit Signals

author.name: Roberto Medina

entry.summary: Proposes DASE, an adaptive stopping heuristic for LLM ensemble deliberation that commits early on genuine consensus and applies fallback on fragmented evidence. Identifies performance boundaries beyond which additional deliberation degrades accuracy.

entry.title: From Video-to-PDE: Data-Driven Discovery of Nonlinear Dye Plume Dynamics

author.name: Cesar Acosta-Minoli, Sayantan Sarkar

entry.summary: Develops a video-to-PDE pipeline that converts grayscale recordings of ink plumes into governing equations using weak-form sparse regression. Addresses challenges of uncalibrated intensity and noisy differentiation in data-driven PDE discovery.

entry.title: Information Coordination as a Bridge: A Neuro-Symbolic Architecture for Reliable Autonomous Driving Scene Understanding

author.name: Shuo Liu, Lei Shi, Haowen Liu, Jing Xu, Yufei Gao, Yucheng Shi

entry.summary: Proposes InfoCoordiBridge, a BEV-centric neuro-symbolic architecture for autonomous driving that inserts an explicit coordination bridge between perception and language reasoning, preventing hallucinated entities from LLM reasoning over conflicting sensor outputs.

entry.title: ULF-Loc: Unbiased Landmark Feature for Robust Visual Localization with 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Yingdong Gu, Shaocheng Yan, Zhenjun Zhao, Yuan Kou, Jianxin Luo, Pengcheng Shi, Jiayuan Li

entry.summary: Proposes ULF-Loc for visual localization with 3DGS, theoretically analyzing that α-blending optimization introduces bias in 3D features due to entanglement between neighboring Gaussians, and introducing unbiased landmark features for precise matching.

entry.title: Active Contact Sensing for Robust Robot-to-Human Object Handover

author.name: Linfeng Li, Lin Shao, David Hsu

entry.summary: Proposes active contact sensing for robot-to-human handover where the robot applies information-gathering motions to disambiguate firm grasp from incidental touch, enabling robust object release decisions.

entry.title: Symbolic Regression via Neural Networks

author.name: Nibodh Boddupalli, Timothy Matchen, Jeff Moehlis

entry.summary: Develops a neural network approach to symbolic regression that identifies governing equations for dynamical systems without requiring a fixed dictionary of basis functions, bridging deep learning's approximation power with interpretable mathematical models.

entry.title: Accountable Agents in Software Engineering: An Analysis of Terms of Service and a Research Roadmap

author.name: Christoph Treude

entry.summary: Analyzes Terms of Service for AI coding assistants and autonomous development agents to understand how accountability is allocated when AI generates or modifies code. Provides a research roadmap for accountable AI agents in software engineering.

entry.title: HeterSEED: Semantics-Structure Decoupling for Heterogeneous Graph Learning under Heterophily

author.name: Xinyi Li, Ming Li, Lu Bai, Lixin Cui, Feilong Cao, Ke Lv, Yunliang Jiang, Pietro Li\`o

entry.summary: HeterSEED addresses heterogeneous graph learning under heterophily by decoupling representation learning into semantic and structure-aware channels, preventing misleading message propagation when feature similarity doesn't align with relational semantics.

entry.title: Reference-based Category Discovery: Unsupervised Object Detection with Category Awareness

author.name: Yichen Li, Qiankun Liu, Ying Fu

entry.summary: RefCD proposes unsupervised category-aware object detection using feature similarity between predicted objects and unlabeled reference images, bridging the gap between unsupervised methods (no categories) and one-shot methods (require labels).

entry.title: A Harmonic Mean Formulation of Average Reward Reinforcement Learning in SMDPs

author.name: Erel Shtossel, Alicia Vidler, Uri Shaham, Gal A. Kaminka

entry.summary: Proposes a harmonic mean operator for computing reward rates in semi-Markov decision processes that correctly handles non-stationary rewards and durations in infinite-horizon settings, yielding model-free learning algorithms.

entry.title: When Life Gives You BC, Make Q-functions: Extracting Q-values from Behavior Cloning for On-Robot Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Lakshita Dodeja, Ondrej Biza, Shivam Vats, Stephen Hart, Stefanie Tellex, Robin Walters, Karl Schmeckpeper, Thomas Weng

entry.summary: Proposes Q2RL, an algorithm for offline-to-online robot learning that extracts Q-functions from behavior cloning policies and uses Q-Gating to switch between BC and RL actions, preventing distribution mismatch issues.

entry.title: MuCALD-SplitFed: Causal-Latent Diffusion for Privacy-Preserving Multi-Task Split-Federated Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Chamani Shiranthika, Hadi Hadizadeh, Parvaneh Saeedi

entry.summary: Proposes MuCALD-SplitFed, a multi-task split-federated learning framework integrating causal representation learning and latent diffusion for privacy-preserving medical image segmentation across institutions with different tasks.

entry.title: Computer-Aided Design Generation by Cascaded Discrete Diffusion Model

author.name: Honghu Pan, Xiaoling Luo, Yongyong Chen, Zhenyu He, Pengyang Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a cascaded discrete diffusion framework for CAD generation with separate command and parameter diffusion stages, addressing the mismatch between continuous diffusion and inherently discrete CAD tokens.

entry.title: From Reach to Insert: Tactile-Augmented Precision Assembly under Sub-Millimeter Tolerances

author.name: Xinpan Meng, Siyao Huang, JingPu Yang, Muyuan Ma, Zhenghua Ma, Lijun Han, Gao Yuan, Houcheng Li, Long Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes a tactile-augmented two-stage method combining imitation learning for reaching with reinforcement learning for precision insertion under sub-millimeter tolerances, introducing tactile group sampling for better contact feedback utilization.

entry.title: Augmented transfer regression learning for completely missing covariates

author.name: Huali Zhao, Tianying Wang

entry.summary: Proposes augmented transfer regression learning for settings where covariates are completely missing in the target population but available in source populations, under a sub-population shift assumption about conditional distributions.

entry.title: AuditRepairBench: A Paired-Execution Trace Corpus for Evaluator-Channel Ranking Instability in Agent Repair

author.name: Yuelin Hu, Zhenbo Yu, Zhengxue Cheng, Wei Liu, Li Song

entry.summary: Documents that agent-repair leaderboards reorder under evaluator reconfiguration, and releases AuditRepairBench, a 576K-cell paired-execution trace corpus to measure evaluator-channel ranking instability in code repair benchmarks.

entry.title: Curated AI beats frontier LLMs at pharma asset discovery

author.name: {\L}ukasz Kidzi\'nski, Kevin Thomas

entry.summary: Benchmarks a curated pharma AI platform (Gosset) against four frontier LLMs (Claude Opus 4.7, GPT 5.5, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Perplexity) on niche oncology/immunology targets. Gosset returns 3.2x more verified drugs per query at perfect precision.

entry.title: Structured Progressive Knowledge Activation for LLM-Driven Neural Architecture Search

author.name: Zhen Liu, Yuhan Liu, Jingwen Fu

entry.summary: Proposes SPARK, a framework for LLM-driven Neural Architecture Search that addresses 'functional entanglement' - where local code edits propagate into non-local performance shifts. Uses structured progressive knowledge activation to manage this.

entry.title: Evaluating Patient Safety Risks in Generative AI: Development and Validation of a FMECA Framework for Generated Clinical Content

author.name: Lydie Bednarczyk, Jamil Zaghir, Julien Ehrsam, Maria Tcherepanova, Christian Skalafouris, Karim Gariani, Catherine Geslin, Claire-B\'en\'edicte Rivara, Pascal Bonnabry, Laetitia Gosetto, Richard Dubos, Mina Bjelogrlic, Christophe Gaudet-Blavignac, Christian Lovis

entry.summary: Develops and validates a FMECA (Failure Mode, Effects, and Criticality Analysis) framework for assessing patient safety risks in LLM-generated clinical summaries, adapted from traditional risk analysis.

entry.title: MedFabric and EtHER: A Data-Centric Framework for Word-Level Fabrication Generation and Detection in Medical LLMs

author.name: Tung Sum Thomas Kwok, Qian Qian, Xiaofeng Lin, Dongxu Zhang, Jun Han, Zhichao Yang, Davin Hill, Tamer Soliman, Sanjit Singh Batra, Robert Tillman, Guang Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes MedFabric, a pipeline for generating realistic word-level medical fabrications (hallucinations) with stylistic fidelity, and EtHER for detecting them. Addresses limitations of existing medical hallucination datasets.

entry.title: Mitigating Label Shift in Tabular In-Context Learning via Test-Time Posterior Adjustment

author.name: Seunghan Lee, Jaehoon Lee, Jun Seo, Sungdong Yoo, Minjae Kim, Tae Yoon Lim, Dongwan Kang, Hwanil Choi, SoonYoung Lee, Wonbin Ahn

entry.summary: Proposes DistPFN, a test-time posterior adjustment method for TabPFN (a tabular foundation model) that addresses vulnerability to label shift by rescaling predicted class probabilities without architectural modification or retraining.

entry.title: VocalParse: Towards Unified and Scalable Singing Voice Transcription with Large Audio Language Models

author.name: Yukun Chen, Tianrui Wang, Zhaoxi Mu, Xinyu Yang, EngSiong Chng

entry.summary: VocalParse is a unified singing voice transcription model built on a Large Audio Language Model that handles note, lyric, and alignment transcription in a single model, avoiding complex multi-stage pipelines.

entry.title: Multi-Level Bidirectional Biomimetic Learning for EEG-Based Visual Decoding

author.name: Jingtao Liu, Peiliang Gong, Chuhang Zheng, Yiheng Liu, Qi Zhu

entry.summary: MB2L proposes a biomimetic framework for EEG-based visual decoding that incorporates physiological priors including retinotopic mapping and frequency-specific processing to improve cross-modal alignment between neural responses and visual stimuli.

entry.title: FaithfulFaces: Pose-Faithful Facial Identity Preservation for Text-to-Video Generation

author.name: Yuanzhi Wang, Xuhua Ren, Jiaxiang Cheng, Bing Ma, Kai Yu, Sen Liang, Wenyue Li, Tianxiang Zheng, Qinglin Lu, Zhen Cui

entry.summary: FaithfulFaces addresses identity distortion under large pose variations in identity-preserving text-to-video generation through a pose-shared identity aligner that maps single-view inputs into a global facial pose representation with Euler angle constraints.

entry.title: Beyond Seeing Is Believing: On Crowdsourced Detection of Audiovisual Deepfakes

author.name: Michael Soprano, Andrea Cioci, Stefano Mizzaro

entry.summary: Studies crowdsourced deepfake detection using audiovisual stimuli, finding that crowd workers reliably identify authentic videos but struggle to correctly identify specific manipulation types and pinpoint manipulation timestamps.

entry.title: Reliable Modeling of Distribution Shifts via Displacement-Reshaped Optimal Transport

author.name: Philip Naumann, Jacob Kauffmann, Klaus-Robert M\"uller, Gr\'egoire Montavon

entry.summary: Proposes ReshapeOT, which improves optimal transport by replacing the Euclidean ground metric with a Mahalanobis distance estimated from observed sample displacements. This creates 'expressways' that better align transport solutions with actual distribution shifts.

entry.title: What Matters in Practical Learned Image Compression

author.name: Kedar Tatwawadi, Parisa Rahimzadeh, Zhanghao Sun, Zhiqi Chen, Ziyun Yang, Sanjay Nair, Divija Hasteer, Oren Rippel

entry.summary: Conducts comprehensive study of design choices for practical learned image codecs optimized for perceptual quality and runtime, including neural architecture search over millions of configurations for on-device deployment.

entry.title: Structural Equivalence and Learning Dynamics in Delayed MARL

author.name: Jules Sintes, Ana Bu\v{s}i\'c, Jiamin Zhu

entry.summary: Formally proves equivalence between observation delay and action delay in cooperative multi-agent systems, showing any mixed-delay configuration reduces to pure observation delay. Extends single-agent results to multi-agent Dec-POMDPs.

entry.title: GraphPI: Efficient Protein Inference with Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Zheng Ma, Jiazhen Chen, Lei Xin, Ali Ghodsi

entry.summary: GraphPI frames protein inference as a node classification problem on a protein-peptide-PSM graph using GNNs, addressing label scarcity with pseudo-labels from unlabeled public datasets. This approach could improve proteomics analysis pipelines by reducing dependence on expensive manual annotation.

entry.title: HEXST: Hexagonal Shifted-Window Transformer for Spatial Transcriptomics Gene Expression Prediction

author.name: Keunho Byeon, Jin Tae Kwak

entry.summary: HEXST is a geometry-aligned Transformer for predicting spatial gene expression from histology slides that respects the hexagonal sampling geometry of spot-array platforms, avoiding over-smoothed predictions.

entry.title: Trustworthy Federated Label Distribution Learning under Annotation Quality Disparity

author.name: Junxiang Wu, Zhiqiang Kou, Hongwei Zeng, Wenke Huang, Biao Liu, Hanlin Gu, Yuheng Jia, Di Jiang, Yang Liu, Xin Geng, Qiang Yang

entry.summary: FedQual addresses federated label distribution learning under heterogeneous annotation quality across clients, using quality-adaptive training with global semantic anchors and quality-aware aggregation to replace sample-size-based weighting.

entry.title: Replay-Based Continual Learning for Physics-Informed Neural Operators

author.name: Yizheng Wang, Mohammad Sadegh Eshaghi, Xiaoying Zhuang, Timon Rabczuk, Yinghua Liu

entry.summary: Introduces continual learning into physics-informed neural operators (specifically Transolver-based), using replay-based strategies to maintain performance on in-distribution data while adapting to out-of-distribution problems without labeled data.

entry.title: Learned Neighbor Trust for Collaborative Deployment in Model-Agnostic Decentralized Learning

author.name: Michael Lanier, Luise Ge, Sastry Kompella, Yevgeniy Vorobeychik

entry.summary: Proposes Learned Neighbor Trust for decentralized learning, where nodes learn trust functions over neighbors for collaborative inference-time deployment rather than training in isolation and deploying alone.

entry.title: BOOOM: Loss-Function-Agnostic Black-Box Optimization over Orthonormal Manifolds for Machine Learning and Statistical Inference

author.name: Beomchang Kim, Subhrajyoty Roy, Priyam Das

entry.summary: Proposes BOOOM, a black-box optimization framework for orthonormal manifolds (Stiefel manifold) using Givens rotation parametrization. Enables derivative-free optimization in multimodal settings without requiring gradients.

entry.title: Neural Discovery of Strichartz Extremizers

author.name: Nicol\'as Valenzuela, Ricardo Freire, Claudio Mu\~noz

entry.summary: Uses neural networks to search for Strichartz inequality extremizers in PDE theory. Recovers known Gaussian extremizers and provides new conjectural results for cases where analytical solutions are unknown.

entry.title: A Bayesian Approach for Task-Specific Next-Best-View Selection with Uncertain Geometry

author.name: Jingsen Zhu, Silvia Sell\'an, Alexander Terenin

entry.summary: Develops a Bayesian framework for task-specific active next-best-view selection in 3D reconstruction, using posterior distributions over implicit surfaces to optimize camera placement for intended downstream use.

entry.title: Unintended Negative Impacts of Promotional Language in Patent Evaluation

author.name: Bingkun Zhao, Chenwei Zhang, Hao Peng

entry.summary: Studies promotional language in patent applications and finds it negatively associated with grant probability, ownership transfer, and appeal success. Introduces concept of 'promotional penalty' in technological innovation.

entry.title: Hierarchical Visual Agent: Managing Contexts in Joint Image-Text Space for Advanced Chart Reasoning

author.name: Qihua Dong, Ruozhen He, Junwen Chen, Yizhou Wang, Xu Ma, Songyao Jiang, Yun Fu

entry.summary: Proposes HierVA, a hierarchical visual agent framework for chart reasoning that maintains working context in joint image-text space. A high-level manager generates plans while specialized workers perform reasoning, using zoom-in tools to restrict visual context to relevant subplots.

entry.title: Joint Semantic Token Selection and Prompt Optimization for Interpretable Prompt Learning

author.name: Yating Wang, Yaqi Zhao, Yongshun Gong, Yilong Yin, Haoliang Sun

entry.summary: Proposes Interpretable Prompt Learning (IPL) for CLIP that alternates between discrete semantic token selection (via submodular optimization) and continuous prompt optimization, balancing interpretability with performance.

entry.title: Ground4D: Spatially-Grounded Feedforward 4D Reconstruction for Unstructured Off-Road Scenes

author.name: Shuo Wang, Jilin Mei, Fuyang Liu, Wenfei Guan, Fanjie Kong, Zhihua Zhao, Shuai Wang, Chen Min, Yu Hu

entry.summary: Proposes Ground4D, a spatially-grounded feedforward 4D reconstruction framework for pose-free off-road autonomous driving scenes, using voxel-grounded temporal Gaussian aggregation to resolve conflicts from non-rigid dynamics and ego-motion jitter.

entry.title: DiCLIP: Diffusion Model Enhances CLIP's Dense Knowledge for Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Zhiwei Yang, Pengfei Song, Yucong Meng, Kexue Fu, Shuo Wang, Zhijian Song

entry.summary: Proposes DiCLIP, a WSSS framework leveraging diffusion models to enhance CLIP's dense knowledge across visual and text modalities through Visual Correlation Enhancement and Text Semantic Augmentation modules.

entry.title: Physical Adversarial Clothing Evades Visible-Thermal Detectors via Non-Overlapping RGB-T Pattern

author.name: Xiaopei Zhu, Guanning Zeng, Zhanhao Hu, Jun Zhu, Xiaolin Hu

entry.summary: Proposes physical adversarial clothing for attacking RGB-T object detectors using non-overlapping RGB-T patterns (NORP) with distinct visible and thermal materials, constructed on 3D human models for full-view simulation.

entry.title: CARD: A Multi-Modal Automotive Dataset for Dense 3D Reconstruction in Challenging Road Topography

author.name: Gasser Elazab, Frank Neuhaus, Tilman Ko{\ss}, Malte Splietker, Aditya Date, Michael Unterreiner, Maximilian Jansen, Olaf Hellwich

entry.summary: Introduces CARD, a multi-modal driving dataset with quasi-dense 3D ground truth across challenging road surfaces (speed bumps, potholes, off-road), addressing the gap that most driving datasets only cover well-paved flat roads.

entry.title: External Validation of Deep Learning Models for BI-RADS Breast Density Prediction from Ultrasound Images

author.name: Yuxuan Chen, Arianna Bunnell, Yanqi Xu, Haoyan Yang, Thomas K. Wolfgruber, John A. Shepherd, Yiqiu Shen

entry.summary: Externally validates deep learning models for predicting mammographic breast density from ultrasound images on 2,000 exams. Also evaluates downstream 10-year cancer risk prediction by incorporating AI-derived density into the Tyrer-Cuzick model.

entry.title: 3D Printing of Passively Actuated Self-Folding Robots with Integrated Functional Modules

author.name: Gaolin Ge, Qifeng Yang, Haoran Lu, Tingyu Cheng, Martin Nisser, Yiyue Luo

entry.summary: Introduces an elastic-driven self-folding robot fabrication approach using flat 3D-printed conductive PLA nets with elastic bands, enabling accurate electronics placement before deployment and including a closed-form folding model.

entry.title: Sculpted Interaction: a Design-First Approach to AI Alignment

author.name: magfrump

entry.summary: Proposes 'Sculpted Interaction' as a design-first approach to AI alignment, arguing that interface design is critical for maintaining healthy human-AI relationships and that standard chatbot formats don't scaffold positive interactions. Developed through AI Safety Camp.

entry.title: A Closed-Form Dual-Barrier CBF Safety Filter for Holonomic Robots on Incrementally Built Occupancy Grid Maps

author.name: Himanshu Paudel, Basanta Joshi, Dhirendra Raj Madai, Alina Bartaula, Biman Rimal, Sanjay Neupane

entry.summary: Presents a dual-barrier CBF safety filter for holonomic robots on incrementally built occupancy grids, enforcing both obstacle avoidance and unexplored region restriction with a closed-form solution requiring only a small linear solve.

entry.title: ANDRE: An Attention-based Neuro-symbolic Differentiable Rule Extractor

author.name: Iman Sharifi, Peng Wei, Saber Fallah

entry.summary: Presents ANDRE, an attention-based neuro-symbolic framework for Inductive Logic Programming that learns first-order logic programs by optimizing over a continuous rule space. Addresses scalability issues in noisy and probabilistic settings.

entry.title: Position: Embodied AI Requires a Privacy-Utility Trade-off

author.name: Xiaoliang Fan, Jiarui Chen, Zhuodong Liu, Ziqi Yang, Peixuan Xu, Ruimin Shen, Junhui Liu, Jianzhong Qi, Cheng Wang

entry.summary: A position paper arguing that embodied AI systems create a systemic privacy crisis when deployed in sensitive environments, as optimizing perception/planning/interaction components independently ignores coupled privacy implications.

entry.title: Lookahead Drifting Model

author.name: Guoqiang Zhang, Kenta Niwa, W. Bastiaan Kleijn

entry.summary: Proposes a lookahead variant of the drifting model paradigm for distribution mapping, computing sequential drifting terms at each iteration. Targets one-step image generation performance on ImageNet.

entry.title: EdgeRazor: A Lightweight Framework for Large Language Models via Mixed-Precision Quantization-Aware Distillation

author.name: Shu-Hao Zhang, Le-Tong Huang, Xiang-Sheng Deng, Xin-Yi Zou, Chen Wu, Nan Li, Shao-Qun Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes EdgeRazor, a framework for LLM compression combining quantization-aware training with knowledge distillation in a mixed-precision setting. Targets deployment on resource-constrained devices.

entry.title: Sparse Autoencoder Decomposition of Clinical Sequence Model Representations: Feature Complexity, Task Specialisation, and Mortality Prediction

author.name: Chris Sainsbury, Feng Dong, Andreas Karwath

entry.summary: Applies sparse autoencoders to a clinical sequence model (FlatASCEND), revealing progressive abstraction across transformer depth and showing SAE features outperform dense representations for discrete event prediction.

entry.title: Are Multimodal LLMs Ready for Clinical Dermatology? A Real-World Evaluation in Dermatology

author.name: Roy Jiang, Hyunjae Kim, Zhenyue Qin, Morten Lee, Margaret MacGibeny, Ailish Hanly, Angela Sadlowski, Shanin Chowdhury, Xuguang Ai, Jeffrey Gehlhausen, Qingyu Chen

entry.summary: Evaluates four open-weight MLLMs and GPT-4.1 on clinical dermatology tasks using 5,811 cases. Finds performance is modest on public datasets and drops further on real-world hospital data, quantifying the benchmark-to-bedside gap.

entry.title: ProtDBench: A Unified Benchmark of Protein Binder Design and Evaluation

author.name: Cong Liu, Milong Ren, Jiaqi Guan, Chengyue Gong, Jinyuan Sun, Xinshi Chen, Wenzhi Xiao

entry.summary: Introduces ProtDBench, a standardized benchmark for protein binder design that reveals substantial verifier-dependent bias in commonly used evaluation metrics. Uses a large wet-lab annotated dataset.

entry.title: GEM: Graph-Enhanced Mixture-of-Experts with ReAct Agents for Dialogue State Tracking

author.name: Ziqi Zhu, Adithya Suresh, Tomal Deb, Iman Abbasnejad

entry.summary: GEM combines graph neural networks with mixture-of-experts routing and ReAct agents for dialogue state tracking. Routes between specialized GNN and T5-Small experts, with ReAct agents handling complex value generation.

entry.title: Example-Based Object Detection

author.name: ZhiXin Sun

entry.summary: Proposes example-based object detection that uses feature similarity between predicted objects and unlabeled reference images to handle persistent false positives/negatives in open-vocabulary detectors without model retraining.

entry.title: Efficient Geometry-Controlled High-Resolution Satellite Image Synthesis

author.name: Vlad Vasilescu, Daniela Faur, Teodor Costachioiu

entry.summary: Proposes an efficient method for geometry-controlled satellite image synthesis using skip connection features with windowed cross-attention for controlling pre-trained diffusion models, achieving comparable performance with better geometric alignment.

entry.title: LineRides: Line-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Bicycle Robot Stunts

author.name: Seungeun Rho, Shamel Fahmi, Jeonghwan Kim, Arianna Ilvonen, Sehoon Ha, Gabriel Nelson

entry.summary: Presents LineRides, a framework enabling a bicycle robot to learn diverse stunt behaviors from user-provided spatial guidelines and sparse key-orientations without demonstrations. Handles physically infeasible guidelines via tracking margins.

entry.title: A Self-Attentive Meta-Optimizer with Group-Adaptive Learning Rates and Weight Decay

author.name: JiangBo Zhao, ZhaoXin Liu

entry.summary: Proposes MetaAdamW, an optimizer that uses a lightweight Transformer encoder to dynamically modulate per-group learning rates and weight decay based on gradient statistics, trained via meta-learning.

entry.title: Improving Medical VQA through Trajectory-Aware Process Supervision

author.name: Halil Ibrahim Gulluk, Olivier Gevaert

entry.summary: Generates reasoning trajectories for medical VQA benchmarks using COMCTS algorithm and proposes a two-stage training (SFT + GRPO) with trajectory-aware process rewards that measure similarity between generated and ground-truth reasoning.

entry.title: Sequential Strategic Classification with Multi-Stage Selective Classifiers

author.name: Ziyuan Huang, Lina Alkarmi, Mingyan Liu

entry.summary: Introduces multi-stage sequential strategic classification where agents progress through a sequence of different classifiers, modeling real-world decision pipelines (e.g., loan applications, hiring).

entry.title: YOTOnet: Zero-Shot Cross-Domain Fault Diagnosis via Domain-Conditioned Mixture of Experts

author.name: Zesen Wang, Zihao Wu, Yue Hu, Yang Gao, Fuzhen Xuan

entry.summary: YOTOnet enables zero-shot cross-domain fault diagnosis for mechanical equipment using physics-aware feature extraction, domain-conditioned mixture of experts, and meta-prompting. Inspired by foundation models for generalization without target domain data.

entry.title: Learning Time-Inhomogeneous Markov Dynamics in Financial Time Series via Neural Parameterization

author.name: Jan Rovirosa, Jesse Schmolze

entry.summary: Introduces a framework using neural networks to parameterize time-varying Markov transition matrices for financial time series, overcoming data sparsity that makes empirical counting degenerate at high resolution.

entry.title: Differentiable Chemistry in PINNs for Solving Parameterized and Stiff Reaction Systems

author.name: Milo\v{s} Babi\'c, Franz M. Rohrhofer, Stefan Posch

entry.summary: Integrates a differentiable chemistry solver into PINNs for solving parameterized stiff reaction systems, combining network architecture modifications with residual-based training strategies.

entry.title: MixINN: Accelerating Plant Breeding by Combining Mixed Models and Deep Learning for Interaction Prediction

author.name: Aike Potze, Fred van Eeuwijk, Ioannis N. Athanasiadis

entry.summary: MixINN combines mixed models with deep learning to predict genotype-environment interactions for plant breeding, first isolating interaction labels using mixed models then predicting for new crop varieties under future conditions.

entry.title: Hybrid Iterative Neural Low-Regularity Integrator for Nonlinear Dispersive Equations

author.name: Zhangyong Liang

entry.summary: HIN-LRI augments classical low-regularity integrators for nonlinear dispersive PDEs with a neural network that corrects truncation errors, providing stability guarantees through explicit time-step scaling on the neural correction.

entry.title: Graph-SND: Sparse Aggregation for Behavioral Diversity in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Shawn Ray

entry.summary: Graph-SND replaces the quadratic complete-graph average in System Neural Diversity measurement with sparse graph alternatives, providing concentration bounds and spectral refinements for efficient behavioral diversity estimation in multi-agent RL.

entry.title: Globally Solving Unbalanced Optimal Transport and Density Control for Gaussian Distributions

author.name: Haruto Nakashima, Siddhartha Ganguly, Kenji Kashima

entry.summary: Studies unbalanced optimal transport for Gaussian distributions and establishes a control-theoretic extension. Shows the infinite-dimensional problem admits exact Gaussian reduction to finite-dimensional optimization over masses, means, and covariances.

entry.title: To Fuse or to Drop? Dual-Path Learning for Resolving Modality Conflicts in Multimodal Emotion Recognition

author.name: Yangchen Yu, Qian Chen, Jia Li, Zhenzhen Hu, Jinpeng Hu, Lizi Liao, Erik Cambria, Richang Hong

entry.summary: Proposes DCR framework for multimodal emotion recognition that learns when to fuse and when to drop conflicting modalities. Distinguishes between resolvable (benign) and irresolvable (severe) conflicts like sarcasm.

entry.title: The Impact of Vocabulary Overlaps on Knowledge Transfer in Multilingual Machine Translation

author.name: Oona Itkonen, J\"org Tiedemann

entry.summary: Systematically studies how vocabulary overlap affects knowledge transfer in multilingual NMT by comparing joint and disjoint vocabularies with related and unrelated auxiliary languages in an out-of-domain setup.

entry.title: Nsanku: Evaluating Zero-Shot Translation Performance of LLMs for Ghanaian Languages

author.name: Stephen E. Moore, Mich-Seth Owusu, Akwasi Asare, Lawrence Adu Gyamfi, Paul Azunre, Joel Budu, Jonathan Asiamah, Elias Dzobo, Kelvin Newman, Edmund O. Benefo, Gerhardt Datsomor, Onesimus Addo Appiah, Ama Branoa Banful, Lucas Woedem Kpatah, Saani Mustapha Deishini, John Ayernor

entry.summary: Presents Nsanku, a benchmark evaluating 19 LLMs on zero-shot translation for 43 Ghanaian languages paired with English. Uses Bible text as evaluation source with BLEU and chrF metrics.

entry.title: Beyond Semantics: An Evidential Reasoning-Aware Multi-View Learning Framework for Trustworthy Mental Health Prediction

author.name: Yucheng Ruan, Ling Huang, Qika Lin, Kai He, Mengling Feng

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-view learning framework combining encoder-only semantic representations with decoder-only reasoning for mental health prediction. Uses evidential reasoning for uncertainty estimation to avoid overconfident predictions in high-stakes settings.

entry.title: Disentangled Learning Improves Implicit Neural Representations for Medical Reconstruction

author.name: Qing Wu, Xuanyu Tian, Chenhe Du, Haonan Zhang, Xiao Wang, Le Lu, Yuyao Zhang

entry.summary: Presents DisINR, a framework that disentangles shared population-level and subject-specific representations in implicit neural representations for medical image reconstruction, avoiding catastrophic forgetting during fine-tuning.

entry.title: Structured 3D Latents Are Surprisingly Powerful: Unleashing Generalizable Style with 2D Diffusion

author.name: Yiran Qiao, Yiren Lu, Yunlai Zhou, Disheng Liu, Linlin Hou, Rui Yang, Yu Yin, Jing Ma

entry.summary: Introduces DiLAST for 3D style transfer that uses a pretrained 2D diffusion model as a teacher to enable style-controllable 3D generation, addressing out-of-distribution style failures in existing methods.

entry.title: SAMIC: A Lightweight Semantic-Aware Mamba for Efficient Perceptual Image Compression

author.name: Jiaqian Zhang, Hao Wei, Chenyang Ge, Yanhui Zhou

entry.summary: Presents SAMIC, a lightweight perceptual image compression method using semantic-aware Mamba blocks with dynamic clustering-guided scanning, exploiting Mamba's linear complexity while maintaining semantic coherence.

entry.title: Anny-Fit: All-Age Human Mesh Recovery

author.name: Laura Bravo-S\'anchez, Matthieu Armando, Romain Br\'egier, Gr\'egory Rogez, Serena Yeung-Levy, Fabien Baradel

entry.summary: Introduces Anny-Fit, a multi-person camera-space optimization framework for all-age 3D human mesh recovery that jointly optimizes all individuals using VLM-derived semantic priors, metric depth, and 2D keypoints.

entry.title: QuadBox: Accelerating 3D Gaussian Splatting with Geometry-Aware Boxes

author.name: Xinze Li, Bohan Yang, Pengxu Chen, Yiyuan Wang, Hongcheng Luo, Wentao Cheng, Weifeng Su

entry.summary: Proposes QuadBox using four axis-aligned bounding boxes to tightly encapsulate projected Gaussians for efficient rasterization in 3DGS, with QPass single-pass tile traversal algorithm.

entry.title: Prompt-Anchored Vision-Text Distillation for Lifelong Person Re-identification

author.name: Wen Wen, Hao Chen, Shiliang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Prompt-Anchored vision-text Distillation (PAD) for lifelong person re-identification, using CLIP's frozen text encoder as a stable semantic anchor across domains to prevent catastrophic forgetting.

entry.title: FlowDIS: Language-Guided Dichotomous Image Segmentation with Flow Matching

author.name: Andranik Sargsyan, Shant Navasardyan

entry.summary: Presents FlowDIS for dichotomous image segmentation using flow matching to learn time-dependent vector fields transporting image distributions to mask distributions, optionally conditioned on text prompts.

entry.title: LoViF 2026 The First Challenge on Holistic Quality Assessment for 4D World Model (PhyScore)

author.name: Wei Luo, Yiting Lu, Xin Li, Haoran Li, Fengbin Guan, Chen Gao, Xin Jin, Yong Li, Zhibo Chen, Sijing Wu, Kang Fu, Yunhao Li, Ziang Xiao, Huiyu Duan, Jing Liu, Qiang Hu, Xiongkuo Min, Guangtao Zhai, Manxi Sun, Zixuan Guo, Yun Li, Ziyang Chen, Manabu Tsukada, Zhengyang Li, Zhenglin Du, Yi Wen, Licheng Jiao, Fang Liu, Lingling Li, Yiwen Ren, Zhilong Song, Dubing Chen, Yucheng Zhou, Tianyi Yan, Huan Zheng

entry.summary: Reports on the LoViF 2026 PhyScore challenge for holistic quality assessment of world-model-generated videos across physical realism, temporal consistency, and condition alignment, with 1,554 videos and physical anomaly timestamp localization.

entry.title: phys-MCP: A Control Plane for Heterogeneous Physical Neural Networks

author.name: Stefan Fischer, Maliheh Hariri, Sebastian Otte

entry.summary: Proposes phys-MCP, a control plane architecture for orchestrating heterogeneous physical neural networks (molecular, photonic, memristive, etc.) into edge-cloud software stacks. Addresses the systems integration challenge of PNNs with substrate-aware orchestration.

entry.title: From Language to Logic: A Theoretical Architecture for VLM-Grounded Safe Navigation

author.name: Kristy Sakano, Kalonji Harrington, Mumu Xu

entry.summary: Proposes a theoretical architecture for translating natural-language safety rules into Signal Temporal Logic specifications for autonomous robot navigation, using VLMs for zero-shot scene understanding in unstructured outdoor environments.

entry.title: Right Model, Right Time: Real-Time Cascaded-Fidelity MPC for Bipedal Walking

author.name: Franek Stark, Felix Wiebe, Shubham Vyas, Dennis Mronga, Frank Kirchner

entry.summary: Presents a multi-phase whole-body MPC for bipedal walking that combines detailed whole-body model in near horizon with simplified single-rigid-body model further out, solved via SQP in acados. Validated on 18-DoF bipedal robot.

entry.title: Dr-PoGO: Direct Radar Pose-Graph Optimization

author.name: Cedric Le Gentil, Weican Li, Leonardo Brizi, Timothy D. Barfoot

entry.summary: Introduces Dr-PoGO, a SLAM method for 2D spinning radar that uses direct registration for odometry and loop closure, with a coarse-to-fine approach for loop closure without requiring point cloud extraction.

entry.title: Pro$^2$Assist: Continuous Step-Aware Proactive Assistance with Multimodal Egocentric Perception for Long-Horizon Procedural Tasks

author.name: Lilin Xu, Bufang Yang, Siyang Jiang, Kaiwei Liu, Kaiyuan Hou, Yuang Fan, Hongkai Chen, Zhenyu Yan, Xiaofan Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces Pro²Assist, a proactive assistant using AR glasses and multimodal LLMs that continuously tracks task progress and provides timely assistance for long-horizon procedural tasks, going beyond reactive query-based systems.

entry.title: A large language model-type architecture for high-dimensional molecular potential energy surfaces

author.name: Xiao Zhu, Srinivasan S. Iyengar

entry.summary: Designs an LLM-type architecture for computing high-dimensional molecular potential energy surfaces. Represents molecules as graphs and uses neural networks with interactions between subsystems to construct surfaces in 51 nuclear dimensions.

entry.title: MP-ISMoE: Mixed-Precision Interactive Side Mixture-of-Experts for Efficient Transfer Learning

author.name: Yutong Zhang, Zimeng Wu, Shangcai Liao, Shujiang Wu, Jiaxin Chen

entry.summary: Proposes MP-ISMoE, a Mixed-Precision Interactive Side Mixture-of-Experts framework for memory-efficient transfer learning. Uses Gaussian Noise Perturbation and MoE architecture to improve learning capacity of side networks.

entry.title: FlatASCEND: Autoregressive Clinical Sequence Generation with Continuous Time Prediction and Association-Based Pharmacological Testing

author.name: Chris Sainsbury, Feng Dong, Andreas Karwath

entry.summary: Presents FlatASCEND, a 14.5M-parameter autoregressive clinical sequence model using flat composite tokens and a zero-inflated log-normal time head. Demonstrates patient-conditioned generation that preserves pharmacological associations.

entry.title: A Physics-Aware Framework for Short-Term GPU Power Forecasting of AI Data Centers

author.name: Mohammad AlShaikh Saleh, Sanjay Chawla, Sertac Bayhan, Haitham Abu-Rub, Ali Ghrayeb

entry.summary: Proposes the first physics-informed DLinear model for short-term GPU power forecasting in AI data centers (5-80 minutes). Uses a thermal resistance-capacitance network based on Newton's law of cooling.

entry.title: Evaluation Cards for XAI Metrics

author.name: Rokas Gipi\v{s}kis, Olga Kurasova

entry.summary: Proposes XAI Evaluation Cards, a standardized documentation template for explainable AI metrics analogous to model cards. Covers target properties, assumptions, validation evidence, gaming risks, and failure cases.

entry.title: Exact Dual Geometry of SOC-ICNN Value Functions

author.name: Kang Liu, Jianchen Hu, Wei Peng

entry.summary: Studies the exact dual geometry of SOC-ICNN value functions, showing that subdifferentials, directional derivatives, and local Hessians can be recovered from optimal dual variables of the underlying second-order cone programs.

entry.title: Driver-WM: A Driver-Centric Traffic-Conditioned Latent World Model for In-Cabin Dynamics Rollout

author.name: Haozhuang Chi, Daosheng Qiu, Hao Su, Haochen Liu, Zirui Li, Haoruo Zhang, Chen Lv

entry.summary: Introduces Driver-WM, a driver-centric latent world model that predicts in-cabin dynamics (driver behavior, emotions) conditioned on external traffic context. Unifies physical kinematics forecasting with behavioral/emotional recognition for L2/L3 driving automation.

entry.title: Adaptive Policy Selection and Fine-Tuning under Interaction Budgets for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Alper Kamil Bozkurt, Xiaoan Xu, Shangtong Zhang, Miroslav Pajic, Yuichi Motai

entry.summary: Proposes an approach for offline-to-online RL that adaptively allocates limited interaction budgets between policy evaluation and fine-tuning, addressing the tension between identifying good policies and improving them.

entry.title: Simultaneous CNN Approximation on Manifolds with Applications to Boundary Value Problems

author.name: Hanfei Zhou, Lei Shi

entry.summary: Develops CNN approximation theory on compact Riemannian manifolds and proposes physics-informed CNNs for boundary value problems that avoid the curse of dimensionality.

entry.title: Hierarchical Support Vector State Partitioning for Distilling Black Box Reinforcement Learning Policies

author.name: Senne Deproost, Mehrdad Asadi, Ann Now\'e

entry.summary: Introduces State Vector Space Partitioning (SVSP) to distill black-box RL policies into interpretable subpolicies using SVM splits, improving returns by 7.4% over prior methods while reducing subpolicies by 82%.

entry.title: LUCAS-MEGA: A Large-Scale Multimodal Dataset for Representation Learning in Soil-Environment Systems

author.name: Kuangdai Leng, Simon Jeffery, Panos Panagos, Tarje Nissen-Meyer

entry.summary: Introduces LUCAS-MEGA, a large-scale multimodal dataset of 70,000+ samples with 1,000+ features for soil-environment systems, created through SoilFuser (multi-agent data fusion) from 68 source datasets.

entry.title: Counter-Dyna: Data-Efficient RL-Based HVAC Control using Counterfactual Building Models

author.name: Jan Marco Ruiz de Vargas, Fabian Raisch, Zoltan Nagy, Pierre Pinson, Christoph Goebel

entry.summary: Counter-Dyna improves data efficiency in model-based RL for HVAC control by building counterfactual surrogate models that only predict variables affected by control actions, rather than the entire state space including uncontrollable weather.

entry.title: Using Common Random Numbers for Simulation-based Planning with Rollouts

author.name: Sandarbh Yadav, Frederic J Maliakkal, Harshad Khadilkar, Shivaram Kalyanakrishnan

entry.summary: Examines using common random numbers in simulation-based planning with rollouts, providing a recipe for provably reducing variance in relative utility estimation when simulations use a rollout policy.

entry.title: BenCSSmark: Making the Social Sciences Count in LLM Research

author.name: Arnault Chatelain, \'Etienne Ollion, Qianwen Guan, Diandra Fabre, Lorraine Goeuriot, Emile Chapuis, Abdelkrim Beloued, Marie Candito, Nicolas Herv\'e, Didier Schwab

entry.summary: Position paper arguing that social science tasks are under-represented in LLM benchmarks, limiting both evaluation advances and social scientific inquiry. Proposes integrating social science datasets.

entry.title: Physics-Guided Regime Unmixing

author.name: Paula Pacheco, Pablo Granitto, Juan B. Cabral

entry.summary: Proposes Physics-Guided Regime Unmixing (PGRU) that estimates pixel-wise mixing regime scalars to activate nonlinear spectral unmixing only where justified, rather than applying fixed nonlinear models uniformly across scenes.

entry.title: Deep Reprogramming Distillation for Medical Foundation Models

author.name: Siyuan Du, Yuhang Zhou, Haolin Li, Jiangchao Yao, Haishuai Wang, Hui Lin, Ya Zhang, Yanfeng Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Deep Reprogramming Distillation for adapting medical foundation models to specific scenarios, addressing gaps between pre-training and downstream tasks while enabling lightweight deployment beyond standard knowledge distillation and PEFT.

entry.title: InterMesh: Explicit Interaction-Aware End-to-End Multi-Person Human Mesh Recovery

author.name: Kaili Zheng, Kaiwen Wang, Xun Zhu, Chenyi Guo, Ji Wu

entry.summary: Proposes InterMesh for multi-person human mesh recovery that explicitly incorporates human-object interaction information from a HOI detector into the mesh recovery pipeline, going beyond implicit self-attention modeling.

entry.title: Advancing Aesthetic Image Generation via Composition Transfer

author.name: Kai Zou, Zhiwei Zhao, Bin Liu, Nenghai Yu

entry.summary: Introduces Composer, a framework for composition transfer in image generation that models photographic composition in a semantic-agnostic manner rooted in aesthetic theory, enabling composition-aware generation without coupling to specific content.

entry.title: VTAgent: Agentic Keyframe Anchoring for Evidence-Aware Video TextVQA

author.name: Haibin He, Maoyuan Ye, Jing Zhang, Juhua Liu, Bo Du

entry.summary: Proposes VTAgent, an agentic framework for Video TextVQA that identifies keyframes containing question-relevant text evidence, addressing the localization bottleneck revealed through upper-bound frame-wise analysis.

entry.title: Height-Guided Projection Reparameterization for Camera-LiDAR Occupancy

author.name: Yuan Wu, Zhiqiang Yan, Jiawei Lian, Zhengxue Wang, Jian Yang

entry.summary: Proposes HiPR for camera-LiDAR occupancy prediction with height-guided projection reparameterization, using LiDAR-derived BEV height maps to guide non-uniform 3D reference point sampling.

entry.title: Segmenting proto-halos with vision transformers

author.name: Toka Alokda, Cristiano Porciani

entry.summary: Applies vision transformers to segment proto-halo regions in cosmological density fields, finding transformer-based U-Net significantly outperforms CNNs and perturbation theory models. Achieves sub-percent error in total segmented mass per halo class.

entry.title: Constraint-Enhanced Reinforcement Learning Based on Dynamic Decoupled Spherical Radial Squashing

author.name: Qijun Liao, Zhaoxin Yu, Jue Yang

entry.summary: Proposes DD-SRad for handling heterogeneous actuator rate constraints in robot RL, correctly parameterizing the box-shaped feasible region rather than approximating with isotropic balls.

entry.title: InterFuserDVS: Event-Enhanced Sensor Fusion for Safe RL-Based Decision Making

author.name: Mustafa Sakhaia, Kaung Sithua, Min Khant Soe Okea, Maciej Wielgosza

entry.summary: Extends the InterFuser autonomous driving model by integrating Dynamic Vision Sensors (event cameras) as an additional modality via token-based fusion in the transformer backbone, enhancing perception in high-dynamic-range scenarios.

entry.title: Autonomous Laparoscope Control through Unified Mechanics-Based Representation of Multimodal Intraoperative Information

author.name: Xiaojian Li, Jin Fang, Yudong Shi, Xilin Xiao, Kai Yan, Kang Min, Ling Li, Hua Tang, Hangjie Mo

entry.summary: Proposes a unified mechanics-based representation for multimodal intraoperative signals (position, force/torque, images) to control a laparoscope-holding robot, enabling automatic FOV adjustment during surgery.

entry.title: ipc_shared_ptr: A Publish/Subscribe-Aware Smart Pointer for Cross-Process Object Lifetime Management

author.name: Takahiro Ishikawa-Aso, Atsushi Yano, Koichi Imai, Takuya Azumi, Shinpei Kato

entry.summary: Proposes ipc_shared_ptr, a pub/sub-aware smart pointer for zero-copy IPC in ROS 2 that achieves order-of-magnitude reduction in global communication by exploiting pub/sub structural properties for lifecycle management.

entry.title: Cognitive Twins: Investigating Personalized Thinking Model Building and Its Performance Enhancement with Human-in-the-Loop

author.name: Wu-Yuin Hwang, Nur Alif Ilyasa, Muhammad Irfan Luthfi, Yuniar Indrihapsari

entry.summary: Presents a Personalized Thinking Model (PTM) that builds 'cognitive twins' of learners using a five-layer hierarchical structure derived from journals, constructed via LLM inference and clustering to model individual learning patterns.

entry.title: Practical validation of synthetic pre-crash scenarios

author.name: Jian Wu, Ulrich Sander, Carol Flannagan, Jonas B\"argman

entry.summary: Extends equivalence testing frameworks for validating synthetic pre-crash driving scenarios using a Bayesian ROPE-based approach, addressing whether synthetic scenarios are practically equivalent to real-world counterparts for safety assessment.

entry.title: Regularized Centered Emphatic Temporal Difference Learning

author.name: Xingguo Chen, Chaohui Wu, Jinguo Ye, Chao Li, Shangdong Yang, Guang Yang, Tianyu Liang, Wenhao Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Regularized Emphatic Temporal-Difference Learning (RETD), which addresses the tradeoff between stability, projection geometry, and variance in off-policy TD learning. Shows that naive centering can destroy positive-definiteness and introduces a regularization fix.

entry.title: Reward-Decomposed Reinforcement Learning for Immersive Video Role-Playing

author.name: Miao Wang, Yuling Shi, Yijiang Li, Yeheng Chen, Xiaodong Gu, Bin Li, Bo Gao, Yaduan Ruan

entry.summary: Introduces EBM-RL, a framework for video-grounded role-playing dialogue that explicitly separates perception, reasoning, and utterance generation. Uses GRPO-based RL with four complementary rewards including CLIP-based scene-text alignment.

entry.title: Analogy between Boltzmann machines and Feynman path integrals

author.name: Srinivasan S. Iyengar, Sabre Kais

entry.summary: Draws formal connections between Boltzmann machines in ML and Feynman path integrals in quantum mechanics. Interprets hidden layers as discrete versions of path elements within the Feynman formalism.

entry.title: Time series causal discovery with variable lags

author.name: Bruno Petrungaro, Anthony C. Constantinou

entry.summary: Proposes a Tabu-based structure learning algorithm for time-series causal discovery that searches for edge-specific lags, rather than assuming fixed lag windows as in existing methods.

entry.title: Self-Prompting Small Language Models for Privacy-Sensitive Clinical Information Extraction

author.name: Yao-Shun Chuang, Tushti Mody, Uday Pratap Singh, Shirindokht Shiraz, Chun-Teh Lee, Ryan Brandon, Muhammad F Walji, Xiaoqian Jiang, Bunmi Tokede

entry.summary: Develops a locally deployable framework for clinical NER from dental notes using small language models that self-generate and refine prompts. Achieves good performance with Qwen2.5-14B without external API calls.

entry.title: DAO-enabled decentralized physical AI: A new paradigm for human-machine collaboration

author.name: Mark C. Ballandies, Florian Spychiger, Uwe Serd\"ult, Claudio J. Tessone

entry.summary: Proposes a DAO-enabled decentralized physical AI architecture for coordinating humans and autonomous machines, connecting blockchain governance with physical infrastructure networks across energy, sensing, compute, and robotics layers.

entry.title: Guidelines for Designing AI Technologies to Support Adult Learning

author.name: Jennifer M. Reddig, Glen R. Smith Jr, Sanaz Ahmadzadeh Siyahrood, Wesley G. Morris, Yoojin Bae, Kaitlyn Crutcher, John Kos, Rahul K. Dass, Jinho Kim, Momin Naushad Siddiqui, Daniel Weitekamp, Ploy Thajchayapong, Sandeep Kakar, Alex Endert, Scott Crossley, Min Kyu Kim, Chris Dede, Ashok Goel, Christopher J. MacLellan

entry.summary: Provides design guidelines for AI-powered educational technologies supporting adult learners, based on reflexive thematic analysis of longitudinal deployment data from multiple AI learning systems.

entry.title: Hybrid Congestion Classification Framework Using Flow-Guided Attention and Empirical Mode Decomposition

author.name: Eugene Kofi Okrah Denteh, Blessing Agyei Kyem, Joshua Kofi Asamoah, Armstrong Aboah

entry.summary: Proposes FLO-EMD, a hybrid traffic congestion classification framework combining flow-guided attention (linking motion to spatial features) with Empirical Mode Decomposition for temporal characterization.

entry.title: Modular Reinforcement Learning For Cooperative Swarms

author.name: Erel Shtossel, Gal A. Kaminka

entry.summary: Proposes a modular approach for representing spatial interaction states in cooperative robot swarms using multi-agent reinforcement learning. The method addresses memory limitations by decomposing combinatorial interaction states into modular components that fit within resource-constrained robots.

entry.title: HERCULES: Hardware-Efficient, Robust, Continual Learning Neural Architecture Search

author.name: Matteo Gambella, Fabrizio Pittorino, Manuel Roveri

entry.summary: Proposes HERCULES, a taxonomy of NAS approaches addressing the triple objective of efficiency, robustness, and continual learning for edge AI deployment.

entry.title: $p$-adic Manifold Learning and Benchmark Tasks from Impartial Games

author.name: Tomoki Mihara

entry.summary: Introduces p-adic manifold learning with algorithms and benchmark tasks derived from impartial games.

entry.title: Discovering Sparse Counterfactual Factors via Latent Adjustment for Survey-based Community Intervention

author.name: Fatima Ashraf, Muhammad Ayub Sabir, Junbiao Pang, Yufang Zhou, Yan Shang

entry.summary: Proposes a method for deriving sparse, policy-feasible intervention strategies from transportation survey data using counterfactual analysis with latent representations. Moves beyond descriptive analysis to actionable recommendations for community interventions.

entry.title: Gradient Scaling Effects in Adaptive Spectral PINNs for Stiff Nonlinear ODEs

author.name: Isabela M. Yepes, Pavlos Protopapas

entry.summary: Studies how IC gating functions in adaptive spectral PINNs induce time-dependent gradient scaling, affecting training on stiff ODEs. Shows interaction between IC embedding choice and spectral representations creates stiffness-dependent training dynamics.

entry.title: Ensuring Reliability in Programming Knowledge Tracing: A Re-evaluation of Attention-augmented Models and Experimental Protocols

author.name: Jaewook Kim, Hyeoncheol Kim

entry.summary: Revisits programming knowledge tracing models and shows that reported gains are sensitive to implementation details like attention dimensions and temporal ordering of student attempts, highlighting reproducibility concerns.

entry.title: AxMoE: Characterizing the Impact of Approximate Multipliers on Mixture-of-Experts DNN Architectures

author.name: Omkar B Shende, Marcello Traiola, Gayathri Ananthanarayanan

entry.summary: AxMoE is the first study of how approximate multiplication affects MoE DNN architectures, evaluating three MoE variants against dense baselines across CNN architectures for edge inference efficiency.

entry.title: Heterogeneous Ordinal Structure Learning with Bayesian Nonparametric Complexity Discovery

author.name: Amir Rafe, Subasish Das

entry.summary: Introduces a heterogeneous ordinal structure learning framework combining Gaussian score embedding, Bayesian nonparametric complexity discovery, and cluster-specific sparse DAG learning. Applied to understanding heterogeneous public attitudes toward AI.

entry.title: Generative Quantum-inspired Kolmogorov-Arnold Eigensolver

author.name: Yu-Cheng Lin, Yu-Chao Hsu, I-Shan Tsai, Chun-Hua Lin, Kuo-Chung Peng, Jiun-Cheng Jiang, Yun-Yuan Wang, Tzung-Chi Huang, Tai-Yue Li, Kuan-Cheng Chen, Samuel Yen-Chi Chen, Nan-Yow Chen

entry.summary: Presents GQKAE, a generative quantum-inspired eigensolver using Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks within a GPT-style framework for quantum chemistry. Reduces parameter count while maintaining performance.

entry.title: Temporal Structure Matters for Efficient Test-Time Adaptation in Wearable Human Activity Recognition

author.name: Zishu Zhou, Zaipeng Xie, Xuanyao Jie

entry.summary: Revisits temporal structure in wearable human activity recognition for test-time adaptation, proposing to use inter-window temporal continuity as a feature-conditioned inference signal rather than just output smoothing.

entry.title: Gaze4HRI: Zero-shot Benchmarking Gaze Estimation Neural-Networks for Human-Robot Interaction

author.name: Berk Sezer, Ali G\"orkem K\"u\c{c}\"uk, Erol \c{S}ahin, Sinan Kalkan

entry.summary: Introduces Gaze4HRI, a large-scale dataset (50+ subjects, 600K+ frames) for evaluating gaze estimation in human-robot interaction settings with dynamic cameras and moving targets.

entry.title: Scalable inference of spatial regions and temporal signatures from time series

author.name: Jiayu Weng, Alec Kirkley

entry.summary: Proposes a nonparametric framework for spatial time series regionalization using minimum description length principle. Jointly infers contiguous spatial regions and temporal signatures without pre-specifying region count.

entry.title: Not All That Is Fluent Is Factual: Investigating Hallucinations of Large Language Models in Academic Writing

author.name: Humam Khan, Md Tabrez Nafis, Shahab Saquib Sohail, Aqeel Khalique, Rehan Hasan Khan

entry.summary: Evaluates four popular LLMs (ChatGPT, Grok, Gemini, Copilot) for hallucinations in academic writing across reference generation, factual explanation, abstract generation, and writing improvement. Introduces a Hallucination Index metric.

entry.title: Graph-Augmented LLMs for Swiss MP Ideology Prediction

author.name: Yifei Yuan, Luis Salamanca, Sophia Schlosser, Laurence Brandenberger

entry.summary: Proposes PG-RAG, an LLM framework that queries a political knowledge graph and retrieves structured political context to predict Swiss MPs' ideological positions.

entry.title: CHE-TKG: Collaborative Historical Evidence and Evolutionary Dynamics Learning for Temporal Knowledge Graph Reasoning

author.name: Shuai-long Lei, Xiaobin Zhu, Jiarui Liang, Guoxi Sun, Zhiyu Fang, Xu-Cheng Yin

entry.summary: Proposes CHE-TKG, a collaborative dual-view learning framework for temporal knowledge graph reasoning that jointly models historical evidence and evolutionary dynamics.

entry.title: Measuring Psychological States Through Semantic Projection: A Theory-Driven Approach to Language-Based Assessment

author.name: Maria Luongo, Davide Marocco, Nicola Milano

entry.summary: Introduces an unsupervised framework for measuring psychological states from natural language using semantic projection onto interpretable axes derived from clinical scales.

entry.title: UFAL-CUNI at SemEval-2026 Task 11: An Efficient Modular Neuro-symbolic Method for Syllogistic Reasoning

author.name: Ivan Kart\'a\v{c}, Krist\'yna Onderkov\'a, Jan Bronec, Zden\v{e}k Kasner, Mateusz Lango, Ond\v{r}ej Du\v{s}ek

entry.summary: Describes a modular neuro-symbolic system for SemEval-2026 syllogistic reasoning task, combining symbolic prover with small 4B parameter LLMs for natural language to FOL translation.

entry.title: When Relations Break: Analyzing Relation Hallucination in Vision-Language Model Under Rotation and Noise

author.name: Philip Wootaek Shin, Ajay Narayanan Sridhar, Sivani Devarapalli, Rui Zhang, Jack Sampson, Vijaykrishnan Narayanan

entry.summary: Studies how visual perturbations (rotation, noise) affect relation hallucination in vision-language models. Shows even mild distortions significantly degrade relational reasoning, and prompt-based augmentation only partially helps.

entry.title: Densification and forecasting of Sentinel-2 time series from multimodal SAR and Optical satellite data using deep generative models

author.name: V\'eronique Defonte, Dawa Derksen, Alexandre Constantin, Bastien Nespoulous

entry.summary: Uses deep generative models to densify and forecast Sentinel-2 optical satellite image time series by fusing SAR and optical data, addressing cloud-caused gaps and enabling prediction of future observations.

entry.title: High-Fidelity Single-Image Head Modeling with Industry-Grade Topology

author.name: Yunmu Wang, Zoubin Bi, Bowen Cai, Chenchu Rong, Jinlong Wang, Junchen Deng, Aocheng Huang, Jidong Jia, Huan Fu

entry.summary: Presents a single-image head mesh reconstruction framework with industry-grade topology using coarse-to-fine optimization across rig, joint, and vertex stages, with geometry-aware constraints for topological regularity.

entry.title: Not Every Subject Should Stay: Machine Unlearning for Noisy Engagement Recognition

author.name: Alexander Vedernikov

entry.summary: Studies subject-level machine unlearning as a post-hoc sanitization mechanism for engagement recognition models, ranking problematic subjects and applying lightweight approximate unlearning without full retraining.

entry.title: Lightweight Cross-Spectral Face Recognition via Contrastive Alignment and Distillation

author.name: Anjith George, Sebastien Marcel

entry.summary: Introduces a lightweight cross-spectral face recognition framework adapting a hybrid CNN-Transformer model for heterogeneous face recognition with minimal paired data and contrastive alignment with knowledge distillation.

entry.title: Attention-Based Chaotic Self-Supervision for Medical Image Classification

author.name: Joao Batista Florindo, Amanda Pontes de Oliveira Ornelas

entry.summary: Proposes Chaotic Denoising Autoencoder (CDAE) for self-supervised pre-training in medical image classification, applying chaotic transformations instead of masking to force learning of robust domain-specific features.

entry.title: Low-Rank Adaptation of Geospatial Foundation Models for Wildfire Mapping Using Sentinel-2 Data

author.name: Ali Shibli, Andrea Nascetti, Yifang Ban

entry.summary: Evaluates three geospatial foundation models (Terramind, DINOv3, Prithvi-v2) for wildfire burned-area mapping using LoRA adaptation with Sentinel-2 data, testing spatial and temporal generalization across US and Canada.

entry.title: Optimal Uncertainty-Aware Calibration for the AX=YB Problem

author.name: Yanjia Chen, Xiangfei Li, Huan Zhao, Yiyuan Hong, Guanxiao Xia, Jiexin Zhang, Han Ding

entry.summary: Proposes an optimization framework for AX=YB hand-eye calibration using Lie algebra that preserves structural constraints, with uncertainty-aware approach that avoids explicit uncertainty modeling while handling real-world noise.

entry.title: Preliminary Evidence for Value Convergence in AI models

author.name: John Matrix

entry.summary: Tests whether AI models converge on similar values when given sufficient reasoning capability, using a fictional scenario about alien exploitation. Finds 90%+ of responses across 5 models reject exploitation, with reasoning quality correlating with ethical conclusions.

entry.title: A Mean Curvature Approach to Boundary Detection: Geometric Insights for Unsupervised Learning

author.name: Alexandre L. M. Levada

entry.summary: Introduces Mean Curvature Boundary Points (MCBP), using discrete approximation of the shape operator to compute pointwise mean curvature for boundary detection in high-dimensional data without explicit manifold parametrization.

entry.title: A Hybrid Method for Low-Resource Named Entity Recognition

author.name: Do Minh Duc, Quan Xuan Truong, Viet Tran Hong, Le Hoang Anh, Mac Thi Minh Tra, Nguyen Van Thuy, Le Hai Ha, Vinh Nguyen Van

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid neurosymbolic framework for Vietnamese Named Entity Recognition combining rule-based processing with deep learning in a two-stage pipeline. Addresses challenges of limited annotated data and heterogeneous label sets in low-resource languages.

entry.title: AICoFe: Implementation and Deployment of an AI-Based Collaborative Feedback System for Higher Education

author.name: Alvaro Becerra, Alejandra Palma, Ruth Cobos

entry.summary: AICoFe is a collaborative feedback system using multiple LLMs (GPT-4.1-mini, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Llama 3.1) with teacher-in-the-loop mediation to improve peer feedback quality in higher education through a multi-LLM synthesis pipeline.

entry.title: Online Nonstochastic Prediction: Logarithmic Regret via Predictive Online Least Squares

author.name: Chih-Fan Pai, Yang Zheng

entry.summary: Introduces an unconstrained online least squares method with predictive hints for nonstochastic prediction of marginally stable linear dynamical systems, achieving logarithmic regret.

entry.title: Gated Multimodal Learning for Interpretable Property Energy Performance Prediction and Retrofit Scenario Analysis

author.name: Yunfei Bai, Aaron Tesfa Tsion, Raul Rosales, Barbara Shollock, Wei He

entry.summary: Introduces a gated multimodal model combining EPC tabular data, assessor text, and GIS spatial features to predict building energy performance scores, enabling scalable assessment without on-site inspections.

entry.title: VL-UniTrack: A Unified Framework with Visual-Language Prompts for UAV-Ground Visual Tracking

author.name: Boyue Xu, Ruichao Hou, Tongwei Ren, Gangshan Wu

entry.summary: Proposes VL-UniTrack for UAV-ground visual tracking using a unified encoder with visual-language prompts to enable cross-view interaction and overcome appearance ambiguity in drastically different viewpoints.

entry.title: Contact Matrix: Enhancing Dance Motion Synthesis with Precise Interaction Modeling

author.name: Xuhai Chen, Zhi Cen, Huaijin Pi, Sida Peng, Xiaowei Zhou, Yong Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage framework for reactive dance motion synthesis using VQ-VAE with separate body-part encoders and a contact matrix representation for modeling intricate human interactions in duet dance.

entry.title: Morphology-Guided Cross-Task Coupling for Joint Building Height and Footprint Estimation

author.name: Jinzhen Han, JinByeong Lee, Jisung Kim, HongSik Yun

entry.summary: Proposes MorphoFormer for joint building height and footprint estimation from remote sensing, using BF-Guided Task Decoder and Morphology Consistency Loss to encode the physical coupling between vertical and horizontal building extent.

entry.title: A unified Benchmark for Multi-Frame Image Restoration under Severe Refractive Warping

author.name: Maxim V. Shugaev, Md Reshad Ul Hoque, Bridget Kennedy, Joseph T. Riley, Fiona Hwang, Justin Hagen, Harvir Ghuman, Ethan Garcia-O'Donnell, Syed Noor Qadri, Freddie Santiago, Mun Wai Lee

entry.summary: Presents a comprehensive benchmark for video restoration under severe refractive warping, covering turbulence-like mild distortions to strong discontinuous refractive deformations with both real and synthetic data.

entry.title: Tightly-Coupled Estimation and Guidance for Robust Low-Thrust Rendezvous via Adaptive Homotopy

author.name: Batu Candan, Simone Servadio

entry.summary: Presents a tightly-coupled estimation and guidance architecture for low-thrust spacecraft rendezvous where navigation confidence directly modulates the homotopy parameter of an optimal control solver, addressing brittleness of bang-bang control under estimation errors.

entry.title: On-line Learning in Tree MDPs by Treating Policies as Bandit Arms

author.name: Anvay Shah, Ramsundar Anandanarayanan, Sharayu Moharir, Shivaram Kalyanakrishnan

entry.summary: Studies online learning in Tree MDPs by treating policies as bandit arms. Shows that LUCB and UCB algorithms can be applied with confidence bounds based on decomposed per-state rewards, despite exponentially many policies.

entry.title: Confronting Label Indeterminacy in Automated Bail Decisions

author.name: Cor Steging, Tadeusz Zbiegie\'n

entry.summary: Addresses label indeterminacy in bail decisions - when bail is denied, outcomes are unobserved. Evaluates five approaches for handling these cases in a Pennsylvania bail dataset.

entry.title: Meta-LegNet: A Transferable and Interpretable Framework for Surface Adsorption Prediction via Self-Defined Adsorption-Environment Learning

author.name: Yifan Li, Arravind Subramanian, Xiaoqing Liu, Qiujie Lyu, Sergey Kozlov, Lei Shen

entry.summary: Introduces Meta-LegNet for surface adsorption prediction in catalysis, combining SE(3)-equivariant message passing with voxel-based aggregation and cross-domain meta-learning for transferable predictions.

entry.title: Deep Wave Network for Modeling Multi-Scale Physical Dynamics

author.name: Alexander I. Khrabry, Edward A. Startsev, Andrew T. Powis, Igor D. Kaganovich

entry.summary: Proposes Deep Wave Network for U-Net-type encoder-decoder models in physical dynamics, analyzing how architecture choices affect accuracy-cost scaling curves rather than comparing at single fixed sizes.

entry.title: ARMATA: Auto-Regressive Multi-Agent Task Assignment

author.name: Yazan Youssef, Aboelmagd Noureldin, Sidney Givigi

entry.summary: Proposes ARMATA, a centralized end-to-end autoregressive framework for multi-agent task assignment that jointly generates allocation and routing decisions in a single pass.

entry.title: Joint Optimization of Trajectory Control, Resource Allocation, and Task Offloading for Multi-UAV-Assisted IoV

author.name: Maoxin Ji, Qiong Wu, Pingyi Fan, Cui Zhang, Nan Cheng, Wen Chen, Khaled B. Letaief

entry.summary: Investigates multi-UAV task offloading for Internet of Vehicles using a hybrid framework combining deep reinforcement learning with LLMs for resource scheduling, along with SOCP-based trajectory optimization.

entry.title: Aes3D: Aesthetic Assessment in 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Chuanzhi Xu, Boyu Wei, Haoxian Zhou, Xuanhua Yin, Zihan Deng, Haodong Chen, Qiang Qu, Weidong Cai

entry.summary: Proposes Aes3D, the first framework for aesthetic assessment of 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes, addressing the lack of datasets with aesthetic annotations and the difficulty of capturing high-level features from low-level primitives.

entry.title: Evidence-based anomaly detection in clinical domains

author.name: Milos Hauskrecht, Michal Valko, Branislav Kveton, Shyam Visweswaran, Gregory Cooper

entry.title: DualTCN: A Physics-Constrained Temporal Convolutional Network for 2 Time-Domain Marine CSEM Inversion

author.name: Khaled Ahmed, Ghada Omar

entry.title: Conditional outlier detection for clinical alerting

author.name: Milos Hauskrecht, Michal Valko, Shyam Visweswaran, Iyad Batal, Gilles Clermont, Gregory Cooper

entry.summary: Develops data-driven anomaly detection for unusual patient-management actions in EHR systems, evaluating whether anomaly-based clinical alerts have acceptable false alert rates with expert panel validation.

entry.title: Multiscale Euclidean Network Trajectories: Second-Moment Geometry, Attribution, and Change Points

author.name: Haruka Ezoe, Ryohei Hisano

entry.summary: Develops MENT, a framework for multiscale temporal trajectory analysis of dynamic networks using second-moment geometry. Addresses identifiability issues in spectral network embeddings up to linear transformations.

entry.title: UAV as Urban Construction Change Monitor: A New Benchmark and Change Captioning Model

author.name: Yupeng Gao, Tianyu Li, Guoqing Wang, Yang Yang

entry.summary: Proposes PTNet for remote sensing image change captioning that explicitly models structured change semantics through prototypes, and introduces a new benchmark for high-resolution urban construction scenarios.

entry.title: MIRAGE: Retrieval and Generation of Multimodal Images and Texts for Medical Education

author.name: Miguel Diaz Benito, Cecilia Diana Albelda, Alvaro Garcia Martin, Jesus Bescos Cano, Marcos Escudero-Vinolo, Juan C. SanMiguel

entry.summary: Proposes MIRAGE, a multimodal medical image retrieval and generation system mapping text and images to a shared latent space for semantically meaningful clinical image queries from trustworthy sources.

entry.title: 3D Ultrasound-Derived Pseudo-CT Synthesis Using a Transformer-Augmented Residual Network for Real-Time Operator Guidance

author.name: Sapna Sachan, Amulya Kumar Mahto

entry.summary: Presents a 3D ultrasound-derived pseudo-CT synthesis framework using transformer-augmented residual networks for real-time operator guidance, generating CT-like reference volumes from US without aiming for physically accurate HU values.

entry.title: Agent Ontology: A Constraint-Based Approach

author.name: tamas.bartha

entry.summary: Proposes an agent ontology that inverts Friston's Free Energy Principle, arguing agents primarily maximize surprise exerted on their environment rather than minimizing internal surprise, claiming this resolves the Dark Room paradox.

entry.title: Actionable Real-Time Modeling of Surgical Team Dynamics via Time-Expanded Interaction Graphs

author.name: Vincenzo Marco De Luca, Antonio Longa, Giovanna Varni, Andrea Passerini

entry.summary: Proposes time-expanded interaction graphs for modeling surgical team dynamics in real-time, where team members are time-indexed nodes and communications define edges. Uses a static GNN for efficient inference to predict procedural efficiency.

entry.title: SensingAgents: A Multi-Agent Collaborative Framework for Robust IMU Activity Recognition

author.name: Naiyu Zheng, Tianlong Yu, Haochen Yin, Xiaoyi Fan, Xiping Hu, Zhimeng Yin

entry.summary: Proposes SensingAgents, a multi-agent LLM system for IMU-based human activity recognition that organizes agents into specialized roles (position-specific analysts, advocates, judges) to resolve sensor ambiguity with transparent reasoning.

entry.title: Modeling Subjective Urban Perception with Human Gaze

entry.title: Transformation Categorization Based on Group Decomposition Theory Using Parameter Division

author.name: Takayuki Komatsu, Yoshiyuki Ohmura, Yasuo Kuniyoshi

entry.title: Investigating Trustworthiness of Nonparametric Deep Survival Models for Alzheimer's Disease Progression Analysis

author.name: Jacob Thrasher, Kaitlyn Heintzelman, Peter Martone, David Kotlowski, Binod Bhattarai, Donald Adjeroh, Prashnna Gyawali

entry.summary: Studies fairness and trustworthiness of nonparametric deep survival models for Alzheimer's disease progression analysis, investigating potential biases toward marginalized groups in survival predictions.

entry.title: A Dialogue-Based Framework for Correcting Multimodal Errors in AI-Assisted STEM Education

author.name: Akshay Syal, Lawrence Swaminathan Xavier Prince, Evin Gultepe, Nik Bear Brown, Srinivas Sridhar

entry.title: AISSA: Implementation and Deployment of an AI-based Student Slides Analysis tool for Academic Presentations

author.name: Alvaro Becerra, Diego Gomez, Ruth Cobos

entry.summary: AISSA is a web-based tool that uses LLMs and learning analytics dashboards to provide scalable, rubric-based feedback on student presentation slides before oral presentations.

entry.title: Assessing Cognitive Effort in L2 Idiomatic Processing: An Eye-Tracking Dataset

author.name: Eduardo Santos, Juliana Carvalho, C\'esar Renn\'o-Costa

entry.title: Enabling Real-Time Training of a Wildfire-to-Smoke Map with Multilinear Operators

author.name: Zachary Morrow, Joseph Crockett, John D. Jakeman, Dan J. Krofcheck

entry.title: QUIVER: Cost-Aware Adaptive Preference Querying in Surrogate-Assisted Evolutionary Multi-Objective Optimization

author.name: Florian A. D. Burnat

author.name: Rebecca Clain, Eduardo Fernandes Montesuma, Fred Ngole Mboula

author.name: Rihuan Ke

entry.summary: Proposes a learning-based statistical refinement method for improving denoising results without knowing precise noise distribution, accessing clean images, or calibration data.

entry.title: Event-Based Early Warning of Vineyard Disease Risk from Environmental Time Series

author.name: Ivica Dimitrovski, Ivan Kitanovski, Danco Davcev, Slobodan Kalajdziski, Kosta Mitreski

entry.title: A Biased Nonnegative Block Term Tensor Decomposition Model for Dynamic QoS Prediction

author.name: Wenjing Liu, Yujia Lei, Qu Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a QoS prediction framework using Biased Nonnegative Block Term Tensor Decomposition to capture complex dynamic dependencies in user-service interactions beyond what CP or Tucker decomposition can model.

entry.title: Improving FMQA via Initial Training Data Design Considering Marginal Bit Coverage in One-Hot Encoding

author.name: Jules Exbrayat, Renan Bouis, Elie Sezestre, Viorel Balan, Arnaud Cornelis, Damien Hebras, Catherine Euvrard

author.name: Sahar Askari, Mohammad Mahdi Mirza Ali Mohammadi, Fatemeh Ensafdoust, Amin Golnari, Saeid Sanei

entry.title: A Consistency-Centric Approach to Set-Based Optimization with Multiple Models of Unranked Fidelity

entry.title: Contextual Memory-Enhanced Source Coding for Low-SNR Communications

author.name: Ziqiong Wang, Rongpeng Li

entry.summary: Proposes a contextual memory-enhanced source coding scheme for low-SNR text transmission that addresses the fragility of LLM-based arithmetic coding under residual channel errors.

entry.title: Neural-Guided Domain Restriction to Accelerate Pseudospectra Computation for Structured Non-normal Banded Matrices

author.name: Amit Punia, Rakesh Kumar, Madan Lal

entry.title: OPENJ: A Conceptual Framework for Open-Source Digital Human Modeling and Ergonomic Assessment in a CAD Environment

author.name: Sinan Bank, Casey E. Eaton

entry.summary: Presents OPENJ, a conceptual framework for open-source digital human modeling and ergonomic assessment in CAD environments, aiming to democratize access to tools like Jack that have been proprietary for decades.

author.name: Viliam

entry.summary: Philosophical discussion about problems with individual Coherent Extrapolated Volition (CEV), arguing that the order of knowledge acquisition and self-modification could lead to very different (potentially bad) outcomes depending on technical details.

entry.title: Learning Reconstructive Embeddings in Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces via the Representer Theorem

author.name: Enrique Feito-Casares, Francisco M. Melgarejo-Meseguer, Jos\'e-Luis Rojo-\'Alvarez

author.name: Enrique Feito-Casares, Francisco M. Melgarejo-Meseguer, Elena Casiraghi, Giorgio Valentini, Jos\'e-Luis Rojo-\'Alvarez

author.name: Vageesh Kumar Saxena

author.name: Julius Irion, Moritz Leugers, Paul Hartwig, Simon Kling, Tachmyrat Annayev, Alexander Schwind, Maria C. Borges, Sebastian Werner

author.name: Kavinda Athapaththu, Shiwei Chen, Yuan Fang, Sanchali Mitra, Yee Sin Ang, Yong Wang

entry.summary: Proposes SemiConLens, a visual analytics system combining human expertise with ML for 2D semiconductor material discovery. Addresses challenges like small datasets and reliability issues in existing DFT or ML-based approaches.

author.name: Stefano Bann\`o, Kate Knill, Mark Gales
