entry.title: GRAIL: A Deep-Granularity Hybrid Resonance Framework for Real-Time Agent Discovery via SLM-Enhanced Indexing

author.name: Jinliang Xu

entry.summary: Proposes GRAIL, a framework for real-time agent discovery in multi-agent systems achieving sub-400ms latency. Uses specialized small language models for intent parsing instead of heavy LLMs, with hierarchical indexing for fast retrieval.

entry.title: When Audio-Language Models Fail to Leverage Multimodal Context for Dysarthric Speech Recognition

author.name: Pehu\'en Moure, Niclas Pokel, Bilal Bounajma, Yingqiang Gao, Roman Boehringer, Longbiao Cheng, Shih-Chii Liu

entry.summary: Tests whether audio-language models can leverage clinical context (diagnosis labels, speech ratings) to improve dysarthric speech recognition. Finds current models do not meaningfully use this context, showing negligible improvement from clinical prompts.

entry.title: NAKUL-Med: Spectral-Graph State Space Models with Dynamics Kernels for Medical Signals

author.name: Badri N. Patro, Vijay S. Agneeswaran

entry.summary: Introduces NAKUL-Med, extending state space models for medical signals with dynamic kernel generation, spectral graph convolutions for electrode topology, and parallel multi-scale SSM branches for physiological signal analysis.

entry.title: Latent Space Probing for Adult Content Detection in Video Generative Models

author.name: Alizishaan Khatri, Chiquita Prabhu

entry.summary: Proposes latent space probing for detecting adult content in video generation by intercepting denoised latent representations during CogVideoX diffusion inference. Attaches lightweight classifiers for real-time detection without full decoding.

entry.title: CGM-JEPA: Learning Consistent Continuous Glucose Monitor Representations via Predictive Self-Supervised Pretraining

author.name: Hada Melino Muhammad, Zechen Li, Flora Salim, Ahmed A. Metwally

entry.summary: Proposes CGM-JEPA, a self-supervised pretraining framework for continuous glucose monitoring that predicts masked latent representations across multiple views (CGM time series, OGTT, Glucodensity). Addresses cross-view transfer for metabolic phenotyping.

entry.title: EventADL: Open-Box Anomaly Detection and Localization Framework for Events in Cloud-Based Service Systems

author.name: Luan Pham, Victor Nicolet, Joey Dodds, Hui Guan, Daniel Kroening

entry.summary: Proposes EventADL, the first open-box event-based anomaly detection and localization framework for cloud systems. Analyzes 520 real-world incidents to inform design of event semantic patterns for root cause localization.

entry.title: EmoMM: Benchmarking and Steering MLLM for Multimodal Emotion Recognition under Conflict and Missingness

author.name: Yueru Sun, Yimeng Zhang, Haoyu Gu, Nuo Chen, Dong She, Xianrong Yao, Yang Gao, Zhanpeng Jin

entry.summary: Introduces EmoMM benchmark for multimodal emotion recognition under modality conflict and missingness. Discovers Video Contribution Collapse phenomenon and proposes CHASE mechanism using conflict-aware attention steering.

entry.title: Forager: a lightweight testbed for continual learning with partial observability in RL

author.name: Steven Tang, Xinze Xiong, Anna Hakhverdyan, Andrew Patterson, Jacob Adkins, Jiamin He, Esraa Elelimy, Parham Mohammad Panahi, Martha White, Adam White

entry.summary: Introduces Forager, a lightweight testbed for continual reinforcement learning with partial observability. Addresses the gap between expensive partially-observable CRL environments and simpler fully-observable ones used for plasticity research.

entry.title: GraphSculptor: Sculpting Pre-training Coreset for Graph Self-supervised Learning

author.name: Chuang Liu, Zelin Yao, Xueqi Ma, Luzhi Wang, Mukun Chen, Pinghua Xu, Wenbin Hu

entry.summary: Introduces GraphSculptor for pre-training coreset construction in graph self-supervised learning. Shows 50% uniform subsampling retains 96% performance, and proposes label-free coreset selection via structural diversity and contextual semantics.

entry.title: SRGAN-CKAN: Expressive Super-Resolution with Nonlinear Functional Operators under Minimal Resources

author.name: Roberto Isai Navaro-Avi\~na, Eduardo Said Merin-Martinez, Andres Mendez-Vazquez, Eduardo Rodriguez-Tello

entry.summary: SRGAN-CKAN integrates Convolutional Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks into an adversarial super-resolution framework, reformulating convolution as nonlinear patch-based functional operators. Focuses on enhancing local operator expressivity under minimal computational resources. Combines KAN theory with practical image super-resolution.

entry.title: 6G Needs Agents: Toward Agentic AI-Native Networks for Autonomous Intelligence

author.name: Mohamed Amine Ferrag, Abderrahmane Lakas, Merouane Debbah

entry.summary: Argues for a paradigm shift toward Agentic AI-Native 6G networks using LLM-based agents as reasoning entities within a semantic control plane. Proposes a four-layer architecture integrating deterministic infrastructure, semantic abstraction, hierarchical reasoning, and distributed multi-agent fabric. From notable authors including Merouane Debbah.

entry.title: Less Interaction But More Explanation: A Communication Perspective on Agentic AI Interfaces

author.name: Eunchae Jang, S. Shyam Sundar

entry.summary: Examines agentic AI interfaces from a communication perspective, arguing that while routine interaction decreases, communication for oversight and explanation increases. Discusses how users perceive AI communicative roles (source vs channel) and how this shapes trust. Proposes design principles for agentic AI interfaces.

entry.title: Missingness-aware Data Imputation via AI-powered Bayesian Generative Modeling

author.name: Qiao Liu

entry.summary: MissBGM proposes a Bayesian generative approach to missing data imputation that jointly models data-generating and missingness mechanisms. Provides posterior uncertainty over imputations rather than point estimates. Uses stochastic optimization with alternating updates among missing values, model parameters, and missingness mechanism.

entry.title: Quality-Aware Exploration Budget Allocation for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Dahyun Oh, Minhyuk Yoon, H. Jin Kim

entry.summary: Proposes quality-aware exploration budget allocation for cooperative multi-agent RL that adapts exploration intensity globally over training and allocates budgets across agents based on intrinsic reward reliability. Addresses the challenge that too much exploration causes coordination collapse while too little prevents strategy discovery.

entry.title: A Multimodal Dataset for Visually Grounded Ambiguity in Machine Translation

author.name: Jingheng Pan, Xintong Wang, Longyue Wang, Liang Ding, Weihua Luo, Chris Biemann

entry.summary: VIDA presents a curated dataset of 2,500 instances for multimodal machine translation where resolving ambiguous source text genuinely requires visual evidence, addressing quality issues in prior disambiguation benchmarks.

entry.title: HELIX: Hybrid Encoding with Learnable Identity and Cross-dimensional Synthesis for Time Series Imputation

author.name: Fengming Zhang, Wenjie Du, Huan Zhang, Ke Yu, Shen Qu

entry.summary: HELIX proposes learnable feature identities as persistent embeddings for time series imputation, allowing consistent feature representations throughout the network without requiring predefined topology.

entry.title: Privacy Preserving Machine Learning Workflow: from Anonymization to Personalized Differential Privacy Budgets in Federated Learning

author.name: Judith S\'ainz-Pardo D\'iaz, \'Alvaro L\'opez Garc\'ia

entry.summary: Presents a comprehensive privacy-preserving federated learning workflow including anonymization, differential privacy with personalized budgets, and a formal definition of client drift for detecting poisoning attacks.

entry.title: Is It Novel and Why? Fine-Grained Patent Novelty Prediction Based on Passage Retrieval

author.name: Valentin Knappich, Anna H\"atty, Simon Razniewski, Annemarie Friedrich

entry.summary: FiNE-Patents introduces a fine-grained patent novelty dataset with feature-level prior art references, moving beyond binary claim-level classification to more practical patent examination support.

entry.title: LLM-Assisted Repository-Level Generation with Structured Spec-Driven Engineering

author.name: Shuzhao Feng, Boqi Chen, Brett H Meyer, Gunter Mussbacher

entry.summary: Proposes structured spec-driven engineering (SSDE) for LLM-assisted repository-level code generation, using structured artifacts rather than natural language prompts to guide generation with better verifiability.

entry.title: The Design and Composition of Structural Causal Decision Processes

author.name: Sebastian Benthall, Alan Lujan

entry.summary: Presents Structural Causal Decision Models (SCDMs) and Structural Causal Decision Processes (SCDPs) for modeling composed decision-making systems with cognitive resource limits and value discounting.

entry.title: SpecKV: Adaptive Speculative Decoding with Compression-Aware Gamma Selection

author.name: Shikhar Shukla

entry.summary: Presents SpecKV, a lightweight adaptive controller that selects speculation length γ per step in speculative decoding based on signals from the draft model. Profiles across 4 task categories and 3 KV cache compression levels showing fixed γ is suboptimal.

entry.title: ISAAC: Auditing Causal Reasoning in Deep Models for Drug-Target Interaction

author.name: Barbara Tarantino, Sun Kim, Yijingxiu Lu, Paolo Giudici

entry.summary: Introduces ISAAC, a post-hoc framework for auditing causal reasoning in drug-target interaction models through matched mechanistic and spurious interventions. Reveals ~25% differences in reasoning scores among models with comparable accuracy.

entry.title: Beyond Activation Alignment: The Geometry of Neural Sensitivity

author.name: Amirhossein Yavari, Farnaz Zamani Esfahlani

entry.summary: Proposes a framework based on local decodable information for comparing neural representations, complementing global alignment measures (RSA, CCA, CKA) by capturing sensitivity to local perturbations that global methods miss.

entry.title: Posterior-First Neural PDE Simulation: Inferring Hidden Problem State from a Single Field

author.name: Wenshuo Wang, Fan Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes posterior-first neural PDE simulation that first infers a posterior over hidden problem state before conditioning prediction, addressing the ambiguity barrier when multiple latent states map to the same observed field.

entry.title: Distributed Learning with Adversarial Gradient Perturbations

author.name: Nawapon Sangsiri, Yufei Tao

entry.summary: Establishes tight feasibility thresholds for learning convex smooth functions under adversarial gradient perturbations in distributed learning, with provable query complexity guarantees. This provides fundamental theoretical bounds on what's achievable in privacy-preserving distributed optimization.

entry.title: A Hierarchical Sampling Framework for bounding the Generalization Error of Federated Learning

author.name: Dario Filatrella, Ragnar Thobaben, Mikael Skoglund

entry.summary: Studies generalization bounds for hierarchical federated learning using Wasserstein distance, introducing a multi-layered tree structure that models dependencies among clients. Recovers and improves upon existing CMI bounds.

entry.title: Information Plane Analysis of Binary Neural Networks

author.name: Maximilian Nothnagel, Bernhard C. Geiger

entry.summary: Performs information plane analysis on binary neural networks where MI is finite and well-defined, characterizing regimes where plug-in entropy estimates are reliable vs. saturate to log₂N.

entry.title: Learning to Segment using Summary Statistics and Weak Supervision

author.name: Omkar Kulkarni, Edward Raff, Tim Oates

entry.summary: Proposes training segmentation models using only retained summary statistics (e.g., area) plus weak pixel-level supervision, using a novel loss combining reconstruction, statistics matching, and overlap terms.

entry.title: Sparse Memory Finetuning as a Low-Forgetting Alternative to LoRA and Full Finetuning

author.name: Prakhar Gupta, Garv Shah, Satyam Goyal, Anirudh Kanchi

entry.summary: Re-implements Sparse Memory Finetuning (SMF) on Qwen-2.5-0.5B-Instruct, comparing it with LoRA and full finetuning on MedMCQA. SMF improves task performance by 2.5 points while keeping forgetting within ~1 point of base model, whereas LoRA and full finetuning achieve larger gains but with more catastrophic forgetting.

entry.title: Stochastic Schr\"odinger Diffusion Models for Pure-State Ensemble Generation

author.name: Jian Xu, Wei Chen. Chao Li, Jingyuan Zheng, Delu Zeng, John Paisley, Qibin Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes Stochastic Schrödinger Diffusion Models (SSDMs) for generating quantum pure states on complex projective space, providing an intrinsic score-based generative framework that handles the non-Euclidean geometry of quantum state spaces.

entry.title: Predicting missing values: A good idea?

author.name: Stef van Buuren

entry.summary: Demonstrates that MSE-optimal imputation systematically biases downstream analyses (variance, correlation, slope) because imputed values are averages that reduce variability. Shows adding noise proportional to MSE eliminates these biases, advocating for proper imputation over predictive imputation.

entry.title: A Multi-View Media Profiling Suite: Resources, Evaluation, and Analysis

author.name: Muhammad Arslan Manzoor, Dilshod Azizov, Daniil Orel, Umer Siddique, Zain Muhammad Mujahid, Yufang Hou, Preslav Nakov

entry.summary: Introduces MBFC-2025, a large-scale media bias dataset covering ~2,600 outlets, and provides comprehensive evaluation of multiview representations for political bias and factuality detection. Addresses gaps in unified resources and systematic analysis of fusion strategies under label sparsity.

entry.title: ARGUS: Policy-Adaptive Ad Governance via Evolving Reinforcement with Adversarial Umpiring

author.name: Deyi Ji, Junyu Lu, Xuanyi Liu, Liqun Liu, Hailong Zhang, Peng Shu, Huan Yu, Jie Jiang, Tianru Chen, Lanyun Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes ARGUS, a policy-adaptive advertising governance system using multi-agent adversarial umpiring (Prosecutor-Defender-Umpire architecture) to handle evolving regulatory policies and label inconsistencies.

entry.title: LLM-Augmented Semantic Steering of Text Embedding Projection Spaces

author.name: Wei Liu, Eric Krokos, Kirsten Whitley, Rebecca Faust, Chris North

entry.summary: Introduces LLM-augmented semantic steering for text embedding projections, where analysts express intent by grouping documents and an LLM generates natural-language representations to steer the visualization.

entry.title: One Sequence to Segment Them All: Efficient Data Augmentation for CT and MRI Cross-Domain 3D Spine Segmentation

author.name: Nathan Molinier, Hendrik M\"oller, Thomas Dagonneau, Anna Curto-Vilalta, Robert Graf, Matan Atad, Daniel Rueckert, Jan S. Kirschke, Julien Cohen-Adad

entry.summary: Studies data augmentation techniques for cross-domain 3D spine segmentation across CT and MRI, quantitatively exploring impact on cross-modality generalization using a single training sequence.

entry.title: Synthetic Data Generation for Long-Tail Medical Image Classification: A Case Study in Skin Lesions

author.name: Jiaxiang Jiang, Mahesh Subedar, Omesh Tickoo

entry.summary: Proposes a diffusion-model-driven synthetic data augmentation pipeline to address long-tail class distributions in medical image classification, specifically for skin lesion diagnosis. Aims to generate realistic minority-class samples to improve tail-class accuracy.

entry.title: VL-SAM-v3: Memory-Guided Visual Priors for Open-World Object Detection

author.name: Chih-Chung Liu, Zhiwei Lin, Yongtao Wang

entry.summary: Proposes VL-SAM-v3, a unified framework augmenting open-world detection with retrieval-grounded external visual memory for both open-vocabulary and open-ended detection scenarios.

entry.title: MILE: Mixture of Incremental LoRA Experts for Continual Semantic Segmentation across Domains and Modalities

author.name: Shishir Muralidhara, Didier Stricker, Ren\'e Schuster

entry.summary: Introduces MILE, a Mixture of Incremental LoRA Experts framework for continual semantic segmentation across domains and modalities, keeping the base network frozen while adding lightweight task-specific experts.

entry.title: FluxFlow: Conservative Flow-Matching for Astronomical Image Super-Resolution

author.name: Shuhong Liu, Xining Ge, Ziteng Cui, Liuzhuozheng Li, Gengjia Chang, Jun Liu, Ziying Gu, Dong Li, Xuangeng Chu, Lin Gu, Tatsuya Harada

entry.summary: Proposes FluxFlow, a conservative flow-matching framework for astronomical image super-resolution that incorporates observation uncertainty and source-region importance weights with Wiener-regularized test-time correction.

entry.title: StateVLM: A State-Aware Vision-Language Model for Robotic Affordance Reasoning

author.name: Xiaowen Sun, Matthias Kerzel, Mengdi Li, Xufeng Zhao, Paul Striker, Stefan Wermter

entry.summary: Proposes StateVLM for robotic affordance reasoning, using an Auxiliary Regression Loss during VLM fine-tuning to improve numerical reasoning for object detection and state localization in robotics.

entry.title: FUS3DMaps: Scalable and Accurate Open-Vocabulary Semantic Mapping by 3D Fusion of Voxel- and Instance-Level Layers

author.name: Timon Homberger, Finn Lukas Busch, Jes\'us Gerardo Ortega Peimbert, Quantao Yang, Olov Andersson

entry.summary: FUS3DMaps presents an online dual-layer semantic mapping method combining dense voxel-level and instance-level open-vocabulary representations in a shared map. Addresses scalability limitations of existing training-free methods.

entry.title: Bayesian inference with sources of uncertainty: from confidence modelling to sparse estimation

author.name: Rafael Mouallem Rosa, Julyan Arbel, Hien Duy Nguyen

entry.summary: Introduces a framework extending Bayesian inference to explicitly encode confidence in each source of uncertainty, providing a new mechanism for model design and sparsity induction. Demonstrated on linear/logistic regression and Bayesian neural networks.

entry.title: Forbidden Backrooms: Self-Chat with a Refusal-Abliterated LLM

author.name: AlliedToasters

entry.summary: Experiments with self-chat between refusal-ablated (jailbroken) copies of Gemma-4, analyzing attractor states and emergent themes in unconstrained model conversations using embedding analysis.

entry.title: Arithmetic in the Wild: Llama uses Base-10 Addition to Reason About Cyclic Concepts

author.name: Sheridan Feucht, Tal Haklay, Usha Bhalla, Daniel Wurgaft, Can Rager, Rapha\"el Sarfati, Jack Merullo, Thomas McGrath, Owen Lewis, Ekdeep Singh Lubana, Thomas Fel, Atticus Geiger

entry.summary: As covered in Research yesterday, Reveals that Llama-3.1-8B computes cyclic concept arithmetic (e.g., months) by re-using a generic base-10 addition mechanism followed by mapping back to concept space, rather than computing modular arithmetic directly. Identifies task-agnostic Fourier features.

entry.title: Zero-Shot Signal Temporal Logic Planning with Disjunctive Branch Selection in Dynamic Semantic Maps

author.name: Bowen Ye, Ancheng Hou, Junyue Huang, Ruijia Liu, Xiang Yin

entry.summary: Proposes a zero-shot STL planning solver using a map-conditioned Transformer with Transitive Reinforcement Learning for handling complex disjunctive subformulas in variable environments without retraining.

entry.title: Valley3: Scaling Omni Foundation Models for E-commerce

author.name: Zeyu Chen, Guanghao Zhou, Qixiang Yin, Ziwang Zhao, Huanjin Yao, Pengjiu Xia, Min Yang, Cen Chen, Minghui Qiu

entry.summary: Presents Valley3, an omni multimodal LLM for e-commerce that handles text, images, video, and audio, with a four-stage pre-training pipeline enabling multilingual audio capabilities for short-video commerce.

entry.title: DiagramNet: An End-to-End Recognition Framework and Dataset for Non-Standard System-Level Diagrams

author.name: Jincheng Lou, Ruohan Xu, Jiapeng Li, Junyin Pi, Runzhe Tao, Weijian Fan, Xiao Tan, Guojie Luo, Yibo Lin

entry.summary: Introduces DiagramNet, the first multimodal dataset for system-level chip design diagrams with 10,977 annotations and 15,515 QA pairs, plus a multi-agent workflow for complex visual reasoning.

entry.title: CP-SynC: Multi-Agent Zero-Shot Constraint Modeling in MiniZinc with Synthesized Checkers

author.name: Yuliang Song, Eldan Cohen

entry.summary: Introduces CP-SynC, a multi-agent workflow for zero-shot constraint programming model generation in MiniZinc, using synthesized semantic checkers to validate and refine generated models without oracle validation.

entry.title: NeuroState-Bench: A Human-Calibrated Benchmark for Commitment Integrity in LLM Agent Profiles

author.name: Jia Xiao

entry.summary: Introduces NeuroState-Bench, a human-calibrated benchmark with 144 tasks and 306 side-query probes for evaluating commitment integrity in LLM agent profiles across eight failure families.

entry.title: Intervention Complexity as a Canonical Reward and a Measure of Intelligence

author.name: Brendan McCane

entry.summary: Proposes intervention complexity as a canonical, environment-derived reward function for the Legg-Hutter universal intelligence measure, proving five natural properties and eliminating the need for externally specified rewards.

entry.title: Shadow-Loom: Causal Reasoning over Graphical World Model of Narratives

author.name: David Wilmot

entry.summary: Shadow-Loom is an experimental framework that turns narratives into versioned graphical world models, combining Pearl's causal calculus with narrative physics scoring (mystery, irony, suspense, surprise). LLMs are used only at boundaries for text-to-graph and graph-to-text.

entry.title: ORPilot: A Production-Oriented Agentic LLM-for-OR Tool for Optimization Modeling

author.name: Guangrui Xie

entry.summary: Presents ORPilot, an open-source agentic system for translating business problems into solver-ready optimization models, designed for production conditions with ambiguous descriptions and large-scale raw data. Features conversational interview, data collection, and solver-agnostic intermediate representation.

entry.title: Standing on the Shoulders of Giants: Stabilized Knowledge Distillation for Cross--Language Code Clone Detection

author.name: Mohamad Khajezade, Fatemeh H. Fard, Mohamed Sami Shehata

entry.summary: Proposes knowledge distillation from DeepSeek-R1 into compact models for cross-language code clone detection, addressing issues with LLM cost, reproducibility, and unreliable output formatting for this task.

entry.title: Graph Query Generation with Constraint-guided Large Language Agents

author.name: Mengying Wang, Nicolaas Jedema, Rahul Pandey, RaviKiran Krishnan, Jens Lehmann, Yinghui Wu

entry.summary: Proposes UniQGen, a constraint-based framework using LLM agents for generating graph queries (Cypher/SPARQL) from natural language, extending Chase & Backchase algorithms with dynamic reasoning over query constraints.

entry.title: TRIP-Evaluate: An Open Multimodal Benchmark for Evaluating Large Models in Transportation

author.name: Han Gong, Zhen Zhou, Yunyang Shi, Yan Tan, Jinbiao Huo, Qi Hong, Zhiyuan Liu

entry.summary: Presents TRIP-Evaluate, a multimodal benchmark for evaluating LLMs and MLLMs on transportation tasks including regulation QA, engineering calculations, and traffic scene reasoning. Supports text, images, and point-cloud data.

entry.title: PhaseNet++: Phase-Aware Frequency-Domain Anomaly Detection for Industrial Control Systems via Phase Coherence Graphs

author.name: Raviteja Bommireddy, Varshith Bandaru, Lohith Pakala, Pradeep Kumar B

entry.summary: Presents PhaseNet++, a frequency-domain anomaly detection method for Industrial Control Systems that uses phase coherence graphs. Argues that phase spectrum information is an overlooked detection modality for ICS cybersecurity.

entry.title: Semantic Context-aware mOdality fUsion Transformer (SCOUT): A Context-Aware Multimodal Transformer for Concept-Grounded Pathology Report Generation

author.name: Suryakant Singh, Saarthak Kapse, Joel Saltz, Prateek Prasanna

entry.summary: Presents SCOUT, a context-aware multimodal transformer for concept-grounded pathology report generation from whole-slide images. Integrates fine-grained cellular patterns, tissue architecture, and diagnostic concepts.

entry.title: Autonomous Drift Learning in Data Streams: A Unified Perspective

author.name: Xiaoyu Yang, En Yu, Jie Lu

entry.summary: Proposes a three-dimensional taxonomy for autonomous drift learning in data streams, systematizing the field beyond traditional concept drift to include operational state dimensions of learning systems.

entry.title: VUDA: Breaking CUDA-Vulkan Isolation for Spatial Sharing of Compute and Graphics on the Same GPU

author.name: Bin Xu, Pengfei Hu, Wenxin Zheng, Jinyu Gu, Haibo Chen

entry.summary: Identifies 'execution isolation' problem between CUDA and Vulkan on GPUs used for embodied AI, and presents VUDA to enable spatial sharing of compute and graphics workloads for improved utilization.

entry.title: AMSnet-q: Unsupervised Circuit Identification and Performance Labeling for AMS Circuits

author.name: Ze Zhang, Junzhuo Zhou, Yichen Shi, Zhuofu Tao, Rui Ji, Zhiping Yu, Quan Chen, Ting-Jung Lin, Lei He

entry.summary: AMSnet-q presents a fully automated, unsupervised pipeline for converting schematic images into labeled analog/mixed-signal circuit databases, eliminating manual annotation. It automates the complete verification loop from image to functional identification and performance labeling. Addresses a key bottleneck in AI-driven circuit design automation.

entry.title: Quantifying Multimodal Capabilities: Formal Generalization Guarantees in Pairwise Metric Learning

author.name: Richeng Zhou, Xuelin Zhang, Liyuan Liu

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of generalization properties for multimodal metric learning, establishing hierarchical relationships between function classes for different modality subsets. Derives novel generalization bounds that quantify the impact of modality selection on performance. Addresses gaps in understanding incomplete or redundant modality data.

entry.title: LIE: LiDAR-only HD Map Construction with Intensity Enhancement via Online Knowledge Distillation

author.name: Kanak Mazumder, Fabian B. Flohr

entry.summary: LIE proposes a LiDAR-only HD map construction method using online knowledge distillation, where a teacher branch fuses LiDAR features with 2D intensity maps to provide dense supervision. Addresses the lack of dense semantic cues in LiDAR data without requiring camera inputs at inference. Outperforms existing single-modality methods for autonomous driving map segmentation.

entry.title: FEDIN: Frequency-Enhanced Deep Interest Network for Click-Through Rate Prediction

author.name: Zenan Dai, Jinpeng Wang, Junwei Pan, Dapeng Liu, Lei Xiao, Shu-Tao Xia

entry.summary: FEDIN observes that user attention scores exhibit distinct spectral entropy distributions conditioned on positive vs negative target items - true interests show concentrated low-entropy spectral patterns. Proposes frequency-enhanced deep interest network for CTR prediction leveraging this observation. Novel use of frequency-domain analysis for recommendation.

entry.title: Remote Action Generation: Remote Control with Minimal Communication

author.name: Szymon Kobus, Deniz G\"und\"uz

entry.summary: Addresses remote control under communication constraints where actors lack reward access. Introduces a framework leveraging remote generation - controller sends minimal information enabling actors to locally generate actions by sampling from the evolving target policy via importance sampling. Achieves rate-efficient communication for interactive learning.

entry.title: Disentangled Anatomy-Disease Diffusion (DADD) for Controllable Ulcerative Colitis Progression Synthesis

author.name: Umut Dundar, Alptekin Temizel

entry.summary: DADD proposes disentangled anatomy-disease diffusion for controllable ulcerative colitis progression synthesis in endoscopy images. Conditions latent diffusion on separate anatomy and ordinal disease severity embeddings with a Feature Purifier for cross-attention-based erasure. Enables controllable disease stage synthesis while preserving patient anatomy.

entry.title: Chart-FR1: Visual Focus-Driven Fine-Grained Reasoning on Dense Charts

author.name: Hongkun Pan, Yuwei Wu, Wanyi Hong, Shenghui Hu, Qitong Yan, Yi Yang, Rufei Han, Changju Zhou, Minfeng Zhu, Dongming Han, Wei Chen

entry.summary: Chart-FR1 proposes a focus-driven fine-grained reasoning model for high information density charts with multiple subplots and dense annotations. Addresses limited perception, redundant visual noise, and lack of adaptive deep reasoning in current MLLMs for chart understanding. Improves perception, focusing efficiency, and adaptive reasoning.

entry.title: Enhancing Judgment Document Generation via Agentic Legal Information Collection and Rubric-Guided Optimization

author.name: Weihang Su, Xuanyi Chen, Yueyue Wu, Qingyao Ai, Yiqun Liu

entry.summary: Judge-R1 proposes a framework for automated judgment document generation that combines agentic legal information collection with rubric-guided optimization to improve LLM-based legal reasoning. It addresses hallucinated statutory references and logically flawed reasoning in legal AI systems.

entry.title: Cripping AI: Reimagining AI Through Lived Disability Experiences

author.name: Xinru Tang, Ting-an Lin, Jingjin Li, Shaomei Wu

entry.summary: Proposes 'cripping AI' as a framework that centers lived disability experiences in AI research, moving beyond accessibility to reveal ableist assumptions in AI design and centering disabled ways of knowing through three case studies.

entry.title: Rethinking Electro-Optical Vision Foundation Models for Remote Sensing Retrieval: A Controlled Comparison with Generalist VFM

author.name: Hyobin Park, Minseok Seo, Dong-Geol Choi

entry.summary: Conducts a controlled comparison between remote sensing-specific and generalist vision foundation models for image retrieval, questioning whether domain-specific pretraining provides clear advantages.

entry.title: Entanglement is Half the Story: Post-Selection vs. Partial Traces

author.name: Gustav J L J\"ager, Krzysztof Bieniasz, Martin B Plenio, Hans-Martin Rieser

entry.summary: Combines tensor network methods from quantum physics and machine learning, identifying post-selection as the key property governing the interpolation between classical and quantum tensor network capabilities.

entry.title: Causal Software Engineering: A Vision and Roadmap

author.name: Roberto Pietrantuono, Luca Giamattei, Stefano Russo, Julien Siebert, Neil Walkinshaw

entry.summary: Proposes Causal Software Engineering as a paradigm where causal reasoning enables interventional and counterfactual questions in software engineering, going beyond correlational AI-driven support.

entry.title: Orchestrating Spatial Semantics via a Zone-Graph Paradigm for Intricate Indoor Scene Generation

author.name: Meisheng Zhang, Shizhao Sun, Yang Zhao, Ziyuan Liu, Zhijun Gao, Jiang Bian

entry.summary: ZoneMaestro shifts 3D indoor scene synthesis from object-centric to zone-graph orchestration, introducing Zone-Scene-10K dataset with explicit zone-graph annotations for robust synthesis in non-convex rooms.

entry.title: ViewSAM: Learning View-aware Cross-modal Semantics for Weakly Supervised Cross-view Referring Multi-Object Tracking

author.name: Jiawei Ge, Xintian Zhang, Jiuxin Cao, Bo Liu, Fabian Deuser, Chang Liu, Gong Wenkang, Siyou Li, Juexi Shao, Wenqing Wu, Chen Feng, Ioannis Patras

entry.summary: ViewSAM addresses cross-view referring multi-object tracking under weak supervision by leveraging foundation models (SAM2/SAM3) for tracklet generation, with view-aware cross-modal learning for consistent identities.

entry.title: Disease Is a Spectral Perturbation

author.name: John D. Mayfield, Matthew S. Rosen

entry.summary: Proposes modeling disease as spectral perturbation of biomarker covariance matrices, where disease transforms healthy 'Hamiltonian' eigenmodes. Enables mechanistic explanations of disease trajectories at molecular and individual patient levels.

entry.title: Finite-Size Gradient Transport in Large Language Model Pretraining: From Cascade Size to Intensive Transport Efficiency

author.name: Ping Wang, Yan-Qi Du

entry.summary: Introduces a finite-size gradient-transport framework for analyzing LLM training dynamics using five observables, revealing distinct transport regimes between Pico-LM and Pythia model families.

entry.title: Cascade Token Selection for Transformer Attention Acceleration

author.name: Stephen J. Thomas

entry.summary: Proposes cascade token selection for transformer attention that inherits representative sets across layers and validates via cross-Gram computation, reducing selection cost from O(T²d) to O(Trd) per layer.

entry.title: Moral Sensitivity in LLMs: A Tiered Evaluation of Contextual Bias via Behavioral Profiling and Mechanistic Interpretability

author.name: Yash Aggarwal, Atmika Gorti, Vinija Jain, Aman Chadha, Krishnaprasad Thirunarayan, Manas Gaur

entry.summary: Introduces a tiered evaluation framework for moral sensitivity in LLMs with the Moral Sensitivity Index (MSI), measuring bias emergence across seven stress levels from abstract to historically-rooted scenarios. Tests Claude 3.5, Qwen 3.5, Llama 3, and Gemini 1.5.

entry.title: Population-Aware Imitation Learning in Mean-field Games with Common Noise

author.name: Gr\'egoire Lambrecht, Mathieu Lauri\`ere

entry.summary: Addresses imitation learning in mean-field games with common noise, where population distributions evolve stochastically. Establishes finite-sample error bounds for behavioral cloning and adversarial divergence approaches.

entry.title: DynaTab: Dynamic Feature Ordering as Neural Rewiring for High-Dimensional Tabular Data

author.name: Al Zadid Sultan Bin Habib, Gianfranco Doretto, Donald A. Adjeroh

entry.summary: Proposes DynaTab, a neural rewiring-inspired architecture for high-dimensional tabular data that dynamically reorders features based on a lightweight complexity criterion, addressing the lack of natural feature ordering.

entry.title: Graph Neural Network based Hierarchy-Aware Embeddings of Knowledge Graphs: Applications to Yeast Phenotype Prediction

author.name: Filip Kronstr\"om, Alexander H. Gower, Daniel Brunns{\aa}ker, Ievgeniia A. Tiukova, Ross D. King

entry.summary: Presents hierarchy-aware GNN embeddings for knowledge graphs using semantic loss from ontologies, applied to predicting effects of gene deletions in yeast. Uses box embeddings for interpretable KG representations.

entry.title: When Should a Language Model Trust Itself? Same-Model Self-Verification as a Conditional Confidence Signal

author.name: Aditya Ajay Phalod

entry.summary: Evaluates same-model self-verification as a confidence signal against likelihood-based baselines for selective prediction, finding sharply task- and model-dependent results.

entry.title: Distributed Deep Variational Approach for Privacy-preserving Data Release

author.name: Zahir Alsulaimawi, Huaping Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Gaussian Privacy Protector (GPP) for federated data release that learns stochastic encoders trained against mutual information bounds with designated sensitive attributes.

entry.title: Intrinsic effective sample size for manifold-valued Markov chain Monte Carlo via kernel discrepancy

author.name: Kisung You

entry.summary: Proposes an intrinsic effective sample size for manifold-valued MCMC samples based on kernel discrepancy, providing a coordinate-free measure that doesn't depend on analyst-chosen summaries. Offers exact finite-sample risk interpretation and asymptotic integrated-autocorrelation representation.

entry.title: TsallisPGD: Adaptive Gradient Weighting for Adversarial Attacks on Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Alexander Matyasko, Xin Lou, Indriyati Atmosukarto, Wei Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces TsallisPGD, an adversarial attack on semantic segmentation using Tsallis cross-entropy to adaptively reshape gradient landscapes across pixels. Shows no single fixed parameter is universally optimal and proposes adaptive scheduling.

entry.title: Graph Neural Networks in the Wilson Loop Representation of Abelian Lattice Gauge Theories

author.name: Ali Rayat, Gia-Wei Chern

entry.summary: Introduces gauge-invariant GNN architecture for Abelian lattice gauge models using Wilson loops as inputs. Achieves accurate predictions of global and spatially resolved quantities while eliminating redundant gauge degrees of freedom.

entry.title: Teaching LLMs Brazilian Healthcare: Injecting Knowledge from Official Clinical Guidelines

author.name: Hugo Abonizio, Filipe Rocha Lopes, Roberto Lotufo, Rodrigo Nogueira

entry.summary: Adapts Qwen2.5-14B to Brazilian clinical domain using synthetic data from 178 official SUS guidelines (~70M tokens in 3 formats). Introduces HealthBench-BR benchmark and applies GRPO for alignment.

entry.title: OralMLLM-Bench: Evaluating Cognitive Capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models in Dental Practice

author.name: Rongyang Wang, Shuang Zhou, Jiashuo Wang, Wenya Xie, Xiaoxia Che

entry.summary: Presents OralMLLM-Bench for evaluating multimodal LLMs on dental radiographic analysis across 4 cognitive categories (perception, comprehension, prediction, decision-making) with 27 tasks and 3,820 clinician assessments.

entry.title: Artificial intelligence language technologies in multilingual healthcare: Grand challenges ahead

author.name: Vicent Briva-Iglesias

entry.summary: Narrative review synthesizing evidence on AI language technologies in multilingual healthcare, covering translation, documentation, and interpreting in language-discordant settings. Proposes Human-Centered AI Language Technology framework.

entry.title: Feedback-Normalized Developer Memory for Reinforcement-Learning Coding Agents: A Safety-Gated MCP Architecture

author.name: Mehmet Iscan

entry.summary: Presents RL Developer Memory, a local-first MCP-native memory architecture for RL coding agents that treats memory selection as a logged contextual decision process with feedback-driven rewards.

entry.title: NucEval: A Robust Evaluation Framework for Nuclear Instance Segmentation

author.name: Amirreza Mahbod, Ramona Woitek, Jeanne Shen

entry.summary: Identifies four key issues with nuclear instance segmentation evaluation and proposes NucEval framework with solutions including handling vague regions, score normalization, and overlapping instances.

entry.title: Dual-Foundation Models for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation

author.name: Yerin Cheon, Aruna Balasubramanian, Francois Rameau

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-foundation model approach for unsupervised domain adaptation in semantic segmentation, combining two foundation models to address limitations of pseudo-label reliability and feature-level alignment.

entry.title: Enhancing Self-Supervised Talking Head Forgery Detection via a Training-Free Dual-System Framework

author.name: Ke Liu, Jiwei Wei, Shuchang Zhou, Yutong Xiao, Ruikun Chai, Yitong Qin, Yuyang Zhou, Yang Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free dual-system framework for talking head forgery detection inspired by dual-process cognitive theory, enhancing self-supervised detectors' discriminative capacity on hard cases.

entry.title: Conditions for well-posed color recovery in scattering media

author.name: Grigory Solomatov, Derya Akkaynak

entry.summary: Presents sufficient conditions under which color recovery in scattering media becomes well-posed, identifying that sensor improvements alone cannot resolve medium-induced distortions and proposing recovery patterns as cross-pixel constraints.

entry.title: UnAC: Adaptive Visual Prompting with Abstraction and Stepwise Checking for Complex Multimodal Reasoning

author.name: Yifan Wang, Yun Fu

entry.summary: Presents UnAC, a multimodal prompting method for LMMs that combines adaptive visual prompting, image abstraction, and gradual self-checking to improve multi-step reasoning over visual evidence.

entry.title: A User-Centric Analysis of Explainability in AI-Based Medical Image Diagnosis

author.name: Julia Wagner, Tim Schlippe

entry.summary: Conducts a user-centric analysis of XAI methods for medical image diagnosis with 33 physicians, finding 88% agree AI should explain diagnoses and that bounding box + report combinations are preferred.

entry.title: Human-in-the-Loop Uncertainty Analysis in Self-Adaptive Robots Using LLMs

author.name: Hassan Sartaj, Jalil Boudjadar, Mirgita Frasheri, Shaukat Ali, Peter Gorm Larsen

entry.summary: Introduces RoboULM, a human-in-the-loop methodology using LLMs to help practitioners systematically identify and analyze uncertainties in self-adaptive robots at design stage, with a detailed uncertainty taxonomy.

entry.title: SOAR: Real-Time Joint Optimization of Order Allocation and Robot Scheduling in Robotic Mobile Fulfillment Systems

author.name: Yibang Tang, Yifan Yang, Jingyuan Wang, Junhua Chen, Zhen Zhao

entry.summary: SOAR is a unified deep RL framework for joint optimization of order allocation and robot scheduling in robotic warehouse fulfillment systems. Transforms coupled multi-phase decisions into a single sequential decision process.

entry.title: From Information Geometry to Jet Substructure: A Triality of Cumulant Tensors, Energy Correlators, and Hypergraphs

author.name: Aritra Bal, Markus Klute, Benedikt Maier, Michael Spannowsky

entry.summary: Establishes a triality connecting Fisher information tensors, energy correlator observables in particle physics, and hypergraph structures. Shows higher-order correlations beyond pairwise can be captured through this unified framework.

entry.title: LLMs Should Not Yet Be Credited with Decision Explanation

author.name: Wenshuo Wang

entry.summary: Argues that LLMs should not be credited with decision explanation, distinguishing between prediction, rationale generation, and genuine causal explanation, cautioning against conflating these different capabilities.

entry.title: Truth or Tribe: How In-group Favoritism Prioritize Facts in Persona Agents

author.name: Shijun Lei, Hongyu Wang, Yunji Liang, Haowen Zheng, Bin Guo, Zhiwen Yu

entry.summary: Studies in-group favoritism bias in LLM persona agents when faced with misinformation, proposing a simulation framework and evaluating how group identity affects information acceptance.

entry.title: Latent State Design for World Models under Sufficiency Constraints

author.name: Keon Woo Kim

entry.summary: Proposes a functional taxonomy for world model latent state design organized by purpose (prediction, control, planning, memory, grounding, counterfactual), rather than by architecture or domain.

entry.title: DataEvolver: Let Your Data Build and Improve Itself via Goal-Driven Loop Agents

author.name: Qisong Zhang (School of Artificial Intelligence, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications), Wenzhuo Wu (School of Artificial Intelligence, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications), Zhuangzhuang Jia (School of Artificial Intelligence, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications), Yunhao Yang (School of Artificial Intelligence, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications), Huayu Zhang (Institute of Artificial Intelligence), Xianghao Zang (Institute of Artificial Intelligence), Zhixiang He (Institute of Artificial Intelligence), Zhongjiang He (Institute of Artificial Intelligence), Kongming Liang (School of Artificial Intelligence, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications), Zhanyu Ma (School of Artificial Intelligence, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications)

entry.summary: Introduces DataEvolver, a closed-loop visual data engine for constructing controllable visual data through iterative generation, inspection, correction, and export cycles organized around explicit goals.

entry.title: Reliable AI Needs to Externalize Implicit Knowledge: A Human-AI Collaboration Perspective

author.name: Hengyu Liu, Tianyi Li, Zhihong Cui, Yushuai Li, Zhangkai Wu, Torben Bach Pedersen, Kristian Torp, Christian S. Jensen

entry.summary: Position paper arguing that reliable AI requires infrastructure for externalizing and validating implicit knowledge (reasoning patterns, debugging processes) through structured 'Knowledge Objects.'

entry.title: EngiAgent: Fully Connected Coordination of LLM Agents for Solving Open-ended Engineering Problems with Feasible Solutions

author.name: Xiyuan Zhou, Ruixi Zou, Xinlei Wang, Yuheng Cheng, Yan Xu, Junhua Zhao, Jinjin Gu

entry.summary: Proposes EngiAgent, a multi-agent LLM system for solving open-ended engineering problems that ensures feasibility under physical and data constraints. Uses a fully connected coordinator to simulate expert workflows.

entry.title: Position: How can Graphs Help Large Language Models?

author.name: Xiyuan Wang, Yi Hu, Yanbo Wang, Chuan Shi, Muhan Zhang

entry.summary: Position paper examining how graphs can help LLMs from three perspectives: reducing hallucinations via knowledge graphs, enhancing reasoning via graph-based prompting (CoT/ToT/GoT), and improving understanding of structured data.

entry.title: Foundation-Model-Based Agents in Industrial Automation: Purposes, Capabilities, and Open Challenges

author.name: Vincent Henkel, Felix Gehlhoff, David Kube, Asaad Almutareb, Luis Cruz, Bernd Hellingrath, Philip Koch, Christoph Legat, Florian Mohr, Michael Oberle, Felix Ocker, Thorsten Schoeler, Mario Thron, Nico Andre T\"opfer, Lucas Vogt, Yuchen Xia

entry.summary: Systematic literature survey of foundation-model-based agents in industrial automation, screening 2,341 publications and synthesizing 88. Finds systems are predominantly at prototype stage with significant gaps in real-world deployment.

entry.title: Fine-Grained Graph Generation through Latent Mixture Scheduling

author.name: Nidhi Vakil, Hadi Amiri

entry.summary: Introduces a conditional VAE for fine-grained structural control in graph generation using a mixture scheduler that progressively integrates graph and control priors for property-constrained generation.

entry.title: HAAS: A Policy-Aware Framework for Adaptive Task Allocation Between Humans and Artificial Intelligence Systems

author.name: Vicente Pelechanoa, Antoni Mestre, Manoli Albert, Miriam Gil

entry.summary: Presents HAAS, a framework for adaptive task allocation between humans and AI combining a rule-based expert system for governance constraints with a contextual-bandit learner for dynamic optimization in software engineering and manufacturing.

entry.title: Foundation Model Guided Dual-Branch Co-Adaptation for Source-Free EEG Decoding

author.name: Peiliang Gong, Han Zhang, Zhen Jiang, Chenyu Liu, Ziyu Jia, Xinliang Zhou, Daoqiang Zhang, Xiaoli Li

entry.summary: Proposes FUSED, a source-free domain adaptation framework for EEG decoding that integrates a foundation model with a specialist model via dual-branch co-adaptation, addressing cross-subject EEG variability without source data access.

entry.title: SCARV: Structure-Constrained Aggregation for Stable Sample Ranking in Redundant NLP Datasets

author.name: Xu Zheng, Feiyu Wu, Linhong Wu, Zhuocheng Wang, Hui Li

entry.summary: Proposes SCARV, a framework for stable sample-level ranking in redundant NLP datasets. Combines robust multi-seed aggregation with structure-aware allocation to handle duplicates and near-duplicates in data curation.

entry.title: Governing What the EU AI Act Excludes: Accountability for Autonomous AI Agents in Smart City Critical Infrastructure

author.name: Talal Ashraf Butt, Muhammad Iqbal, Razi Iqbal

entry.summary: Analyzes gaps in EU AI Act coverage for autonomous AI agents in smart city critical infrastructure, particularly where multiple AI systems create combined effects without clear accountability.

entry.title: Interpretable Difficulty-Aware Knowledge Tracing in Tutor-Student Dialogues

author.name: Shuyan Huang, Alexander Scarlatos, Jaewook Lee, Andrew Lan

entry.summary: Proposes interpretable difficulty-aware knowledge tracing in tutor-student dialogues, explicitly modeling student abilities and task difficulty at each turn using LLMs. Provides interpretable predictions for personalized tutoring.

entry.title: Rhamba: Region-Aware Hybrid Attention-Mamba Framework for Self-Supervised Learning in Resting-State fMRI

author.name: Ruthwik Reddy Doodipala, Pankaj Pandey, Pratheek Eranki, Carolina Torres-Rojas, Manob Jyoti Saikia, Ranganatha Sitaram

entry.summary: Introduces Rhamba, a region-aware pretraining framework for resting-state fMRI that integrates anatomically guided masking with hybrid Attention-Mamba architectures. Tests multiple masking strategies and architectural variants.

entry.title: A Target-Free Harmonization Method for MRI

author.name: Minjun Kim (Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Seoul National University, Seoul, Republic of Korea), Dong Ju Mun (Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Seoul National University, Seoul, Republic of Korea), Hwihun Jeong (Department of Psychiatry, Brigham and Women's Hospital, Harvard Medical School, Boston, MA, USA), Hangyeol Park (Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Seoul National University, Seoul, Republic of Korea), Haechang Lee (Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Seoul National University, Seoul, Republic of Korea), Se Young Chun (Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Seoul National University, Seoul, Republic of Korea), Jongho Lee (Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Seoul National University, Seoul, Republic of Korea)

entry.summary: Proposes a target-free MRI harmonization method that doesn't require access to target domain data during training or testing. Addresses domain shifts across scanners while preserving biological information.

entry.title: Using LLMs in Software Design: An Empirical Study of GitHub and A Practitioner Survey

author.name: Yifei Wang, Ruiyin Li, Peng Liang, Yangxiao Cai, Zengyang Li, Mojtaba Shahin, Arif Ali Khan, Qiong Feng

entry.summary: This empirical study examines how software developers use LLMs for software design tasks through mining 291 ChatGPT conversations on GitHub and surveying 65 practitioners. It identifies nine categories of design tasks supported by LLMs and reveals associated benefits and drawbacks. Provides practical insights into real-world LLM adoption in software engineering.

entry.title: Practical Limits of Autonomous Test Repair: A Multi-Agent Case Study with LLM-Driven Discovery and Self-Correction

author.name: Hyukjoo Lee

entry.summary: Industrial case study of a multi-agent autonomous UI testing system using LLMs with LangGraph orchestration, Playwright execution, and RAG knowledge base. The system discovers 100+ testable features across 10 UI screens without explicit targets. Reveals practical limits including ~30% failure rate on novel UI patterns without human fallback.

entry.title: From Cortical Synchronous Rhythm to Brain Inspired Learning Mechanism: An Oscillatory Spiking Neural Network with Time-Delayed Coordination

author.name: Tingting Dan, Guorong Wu

entry.summary: Proposes a brain-inspired learning mechanism where cognition-level neural synchrony emerges through iterative interactions between micro-scale spiking neuron dynamics and macro-scale oscillatory synchronization. Models cortical regions as spiking neurons in a connectivity scaffold with temporal grouping. Bridges neuroscience concepts with computational learning.

entry.title: BIM Information Extraction Through LLM-based Adaptive Exploration

author.name: Sylvain Hellin, Suhyung Jang, Stefan Fuchs, Stavros Nousias, Andr\'e Borrmann

entry.summary: Proposes an LLM-based adaptive exploration approach for BIM information extraction where an agent iteratively executes code to discover model structure at runtime. Introduces ifc-bench v2, a benchmark of 1,027 tasks across 37 IFC models. Addresses the failure of static query approaches due to BIM heterogeneity.

entry.title: TMD-Bench: A Multi-Level Evaluation Paradigm for Music-Dance Co-Generation

author.name: Xiaoda Yang, Majun Zhang, Changhao Pan, Nick Huang, Yang Yuguang, Fan Zhuo, Pengfei Zhou, Jin Zhou, Sizhe Shan, Shan Yang, Miles Yang, Yang You, Zhou Zhao

entry.summary: TMD-Bench introduces a benchmark for text-driven music-dance co-generation that assesses unimodal quality, instruction adherence, and cross-modal rhythmic alignment. Addresses the gap between generic audio-visual metrics and the specific requirements of music-dance synchronization. Integrates computable metrics for fine temporal resolution.

entry.title: ShiftLIF: Efficient Multi-Level Spiking Neurons with Power-of-Two Quantization

author.name: Kaiwen Tang, Di Yu, Jiaqi Zheng, Changze Lv, Qianhui Liu, Zhanglu Yan, Weng-Fai Wong

entry.summary: ShiftLIF proposes multi-level spiking neurons using logarithmically-spaced power-of-two spike sets, replacing costly multiplications with bit-shifts. Provides finer representation in the dense small-amplitude regime of membrane potentials. Designed for efficient edge deployment.

entry.title: AFFormer: Adaptive Feature Fusion Transformer for V2X Cooperative Perception under Channel Impairments

author.name: Xi Zhou, Tao Huang, Qing-Long Han, Rana Abbas, Mostafa Rahimi Azghadi

entry.summary: AFFormer proposes an Adaptive Feature Fusion Transformer for V2X cooperative perception that handles channel impairments (noise, fading, interference) by modeling temporal, inter-agent, and spatial correlations. Mitigates corrupted features in cooperative autonomous driving. Transformer-based approach for robust shared perception.

entry.title: VILAS: A VLA-Integrated Low-cost Architecture with Soft Grasping for Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Zijian An (Luna), Hadi Khezam (Luna), Bill Cai (Luna), Ran Yang (Luna), Shijie Geng (Luna), Yiming Feng (Luna), Yue (Luna), Zheng, Lifeng Zhou

entry.summary: VILAS presents a low-cost modular robotic manipulation platform integrating vision-language-action (VLA) policy learning with a novel kirigami-based soft compliant gripper for safe manipulation of fragile objects without force sensing.

entry.title: Combining Trained Models in Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Ujjwal Patil, Javad Ghofrani

entry.summary: Presents a PRISMA-guided systematic review of methods for combining pretrained models in deep reinforcement learning, covering transfer, distillation, ensemble, and federated approaches across 589 papers.

entry.title: When Stress Becomes Signal: Detecting Antifragility-Compatible Regimes in Multi-Agent LLM Systems

author.name: Jose Manuel de la Chica, Juan Manuel Vera, Jairo Rodr\'iguez

entry.summary: CAFE introduces a statistical framework for detecting 'antifragility-compatible regimes' in multi-agent LLM systems, studying whether semantic stress can expose structured variation that supports future learning.

entry.title: Benchmarking Retrieval Strategies for Biomedical Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Controlled Empirical Study

author.name: Devi Prasad Bal, Subhashree Puhan

entry.summary: Systematically compares five retrieval strategies for biomedical RAG (dense, hybrid, cross-encoder, multi-query, MMR) using a fixed generation model, finding that strategy choice significantly impacts answer quality.

entry.title: A Semantic Autonomy Framework for VLM-Integrated Indoor Mobile Robots: Hybrid Deterministic Reasoning and Cross-Robot Adaptive Memory

author.name: Bogdan Felician Abaza, Andrei-Alexandru Staicu, Cristian Vasile Doicin

entry.summary: Proposes a semantic autonomy stack for indoor robots combining VLMs with deterministic reasoning and cross-robot adaptive memory, addressing VLM inference latency and session amnesia for practical deployment.

entry.title: Dependency Parsing Across the Resource Spectrum: Evaluating Architectures on High and Low-Resource Languages

author.name: Kevin Guan, Happy Buzaaba, Christiane Fellbaum

entry.summary: Evaluates dependency parsers across high and low-resource languages, finding that Biaffine LSTM consistently outperforms transformers in low-resource regimes, with a crossover point typical of under-resourced treebanks.

entry.title: SAIL: Structure-Aware Interpretable Learning for Anatomy-Aligned Post-hoc Explanations in OCT

author.name: Tienyu Chang, Tianhao Li, Ruogu Fang, Jiang Bian, Yu Huang

entry.summary: SAIL proposes a structure-aware interpretable learning framework for OCT image analysis that integrates retinal layer segmentation with post-hoc explanations to produce anatomy-aligned saliency maps.

entry.title: Enhancing RL Generalizability in Robotics through SHAP Analysis of Algorithms and Hyperparameters

author.name: Lingxiao Kong, Cong Yang, Oya Deniz Beyan, Zeyd Boukhers

entry.summary: Proposes an explainable framework using SHAP values to quantify how RL algorithm and hyperparameter choices contribute to generalization gaps across robotic environments. Establishes theoretical connections between Shapley values and generalizability.

entry.title: A Framework for Exploring and Disentangling Intersectional Bias: A Case Study in Fetal Ultrasound

author.name: Aya Elgebaly, Joris Fournel, Benjamin Laine J{\o}nch Jurgensen, Kamil Mikolaj, Anders Christensen, Martin Tolsgaard, Claes Ladefoged, Aasa Feragen

entry.summary: Proposes a structured framework to explore and detect intersectional bias in medical AI by disentangling demographic, clinical, and acquisition-related factors, demonstrated on fetal ultrasound where image quality confounds demographic disparities.

entry.title: Analytic Bridge Diffusions for Controlled Path Generation

author.name: Michael Chertkov

entry.summary: Identifies an analytically solvable class of bridge diffusions based on linear-quadratic-Gaussian control that provides closed-form scores, marginals, and gradients without neural networks in the optimization loop.

entry.title: Taming the Curses of Multiagency in Robust Markov Games with Large State Space through Linear Function Approximation

author.name: Jingchu Gai, Laixi Shi

entry.summary: Addresses distributionally robust Markov games with large state spaces through linear function approximation, tackling both robustness and data efficiency (curse of multiagency) simultaneously.

entry.title: Instance-Level Costs for Nuanced Classifier Evaluation

author.name: Kabir Kang, Stephen Mussmann

entry.summary: Proposes normalized excess cost (NEC), a metric that weights classification errors by per-example costs (e.g., annotator agreement), revealing that models' errors concentrate on ambiguous low-cost examples.

entry.title: Ortho-Hydra: Orthogonalized Experts for DiT LoRA

author.name: Seunghyun Ji

entry.summary: Presents Ortho-Hydra, a re-parameterization for multi-expert LoRA in diffusion transformers that uses OFT-style Cayley-orthogonal shared basis with disjoint output subspaces to prevent style bleed and expert collapse.

entry.title: Local Truncation Error-Guided Neural ODEs for Large Scale Traffic Forecasting

author.name: Xiao Zhang, Yafei Li, Ruixiang Wang, Wei Wei, Shuo He, Mingliang Xu

entry.summary: Proposes a Neural ODE framework guided by local truncation error for large-scale traffic forecasting, addressing the over-smoothing problem when handling abrupt anomalies in spatiotemporal data.

entry.title: Disentangling Shared and Task-Specific Representations from Multi-Modal Clinical Data

author.name: He Lyu, Huolin Zeng, Junren Wang, Huazhen Yang, Linchao He, Yong Chen, Zhirui Li, Andreas Maier, Siming Bayer, Huan Song

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-task framework with Orthogonal Task Decomposition (OrthTD) for clinical multimodal data, splitting patient representations into shared and task-specific subspaces to avoid negative transfer.

entry.title: A Domain Incremental Continual Learning Benchmark for ICU Time Series Model Transportability

author.name: Ryan King, Conrad Krueger, Ethan Veselka, Tianbao Yang, Bobak J. Mortazavi

entry.summary: Proposes a continual learning benchmark for ICU time series model transportability across hospitals, showing notable distribution differences and evaluating domain incremental learning approaches.

entry.title: Memory-Efficient Continual Learning with CLIP Models

author.name: Ryan King, Gang Li, Bobak Mortazavi, Tianbao Yang

entry.summary: Proposes memory-efficient continual learning for CLIP models using distributionally robust reweighting per class during training, tested on class and domain incremental settings.

entry.title: A Closed-Form Adaptive-Landmark Kernel for Certified Point-Cloud and Graph Classification

author.name: Sushovan Majhi, Atish Mitra, \v{Z}iga Virk, Pramita Bagchi

entry.summary: Introduces PALACE, a data-adaptive kernel for certified point-cloud and graph classification using persistence-based features with closed-form guarantees on distortion bounds and budget reduction.

entry.title: Imbalanced Classification under Capacity Constraints

author.name: Daniel Fraiman, Ricardo Fraiman

entry.summary: Proposes a classification framework for imbalanced data with capacity constraints on positive predictions, where decisions must be made sequentially. Controls the rate of positive predictions while optimizing classification quality.

entry.title: APEX: Large-scale Multi-task Aesthetic-Informed Popularity Prediction for AI-Generated Music

author.name: Jaavid Aktar Husain, Dorien Herremans

entry.summary: Proposes APEX, the first large-scale multi-task learning framework for predicting popularity of AI-generated music, trained on 211k songs from Suno and Udio. Jointly predicts engagement signals and perceptual aesthetic quality dimensions.

entry.title: Parametrizing Convex Sets Using Sublinear Neural Networks

author.name: Eloi Martinet

entry.summary: Proposes neural parameterization of convex sets by learning sublinear (positively homogeneous and convex) functions, implicitly representing support and gauge functions. Proves universal approximation theorem and demonstrates on shape optimization tasks.

entry.title: How Well Can We Decode Vowels from Auditory EEG -- A Rigorous Cross-Subject Benchmark with Honest Assessment

author.name: Xiaoyang Li

entry.summary: Presents a cross-subject EEG vowel decoding benchmark with rigorous anti-leakage controls, finding best accuracy of ~25.5% (chance: 20%) across 14 pipelines. Provides honest assessment of current limitations.

entry.title: Tibetan-TTS:Low-Resource Tibetan Speech Synthesis with Large Model Adaptation

author.name: Jiaxu He, Chao Wang, Jie Lian, Yuqing Cai, Yongxiang Li, Renzeg Duojie, Jie Li

entry.summary: Presents what's claimed to be the first large-model-based Tibetan TTS system, integrating data quality enhancement, Tibetan-oriented tokenization, and cross-lingual adaptive training for low-resource synthesis.

entry.title: Boundary-Aware Uncertainty Quantification for Wildfire Spread Prediction

author.name: Jonas V. Funk

entry.summary: Introduces Fire-Centered Evaluation Region framework for uncertainty quantification in wildfire spread prediction, comparing ensemble vs distilled student model with spatially conditioned evaluation.

entry.title: Tracing Like a Clinician: Anatomy-Guided Spatial Priors for Cephalometric Landmark Detection

author.name: Sidhartha Mohapatra, Pallavi Mohanty

entry.summary: Presents an anatomy-guided pipeline for cephalometric landmark detection that mimics clinical orthodontist workflow, achieving 1.04mm mean radial error on 25 landmarks - surpassing prior SOTA by 15.4%.

entry.title: MASRA: MLLM-Assisted Semantic-Relational Consistent Alignment for Video Temporal Grounding

author.name: Ran Ran, Jiwei Wei, Shuchang Zhou, Yitong Qin, Shiyuan He, Zeyu Ma, Yuyang Zhou, Yang Yang

entry.summary: Proposes MASRA, using MLLMs during training to generate textual priors (event descriptions and clip captions) for improved video temporal grounding through semantic-relational consistent alignment.

entry.title: First Shape, Then Meaning: Efficient Geometry and Semantics Learning for Indoor Reconstruction

author.name: Remi Chierchia, L\'eo Lebrat, David Ahmedt-Aristizabal, Olivier Salvado, Clinton Fookes, Rodrigo Santa Cruz

entry.summary: Introduces FSTM, a two-step approach for indoor 3D reconstruction that first optimizes geometry from RGB inputs, then estimates semantic fields, improving efficiency over joint optimization methods.

entry.title: deSEO: Physics-Aware Dataset Creation for High-Resolution Satellite Image Shadow Removal

author.name: Lorenzo Beltrame, Jules Salzinger, Filip Svoboda, Phillipp Fanta-Jende, Jasmin Lampert, Radu Timofte, Marco K\"orner

entry.summary: Introduces deSEO, the first geometry-aware and physics-informed methodology for creating paired shadow/shadow-free satellite imagery datasets for training shadow removal models.

entry.title: The Detector Teaches Itself: Lightweight Self-Supervised Adaptation for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection

author.name: Yazhe Wan (Queen Mary University of London), Changjae Oh (Queen Mary University of London)

entry.summary: Presents DAT (Decoupled Adaptivity Training), a self-supervised fine-tuning approach to improve VLMs for cooperative open-vocabulary object detection by constructing region-aware pseudo-labels from pre-trained models.

entry.title: GeoTopoDiff: Learning Geometry--Topology Graph Priors through Boundary-Constrained Mixed Diffusion for Sparse-Slice 3D Porous Reconstruction

author.name: Yue Shi, Peng Wang, Mingzhe Yu, Yunlong Zhao, Li Liu, Gareth D Hatton, Yan Lyu, Liangxiu Han

entry.summary: Proposes GeoTopoDiff, a graph diffusion framework for reconstructing 3D porous microstructures from sparse CT slices, working in a mixed graph state space that captures both continuous pore morphology and discrete topology.

entry.title: Task-Aware Scanning Parameter Configuration for Robotic Inspection Using Vision Language Embeddings and Hyperdimensional Computing

author.name: Zhiling Chen, David Gorsich, Matthew P. Castanier, Yang Zhang, Jiong Tang, Farhad Imani

entry.summary: Proposes instruction-conditioned sensing parameter recommendation for robotic laser profiling, using VLM embeddings and hyperdimensional computing to infer optimal scanner configurations from RGB observation and natural language instructions.

entry.title: Benchmarking Local Language Models for Social Robots using Edge Devices

author.name: Dorian Lamouille, Matev\v{z} B. Zorec, Farnaz Baksh, Karl Kruusam\"ae

entry.summary: Benchmarks 25 open-source language models for local deployment on edge hardware (Raspberry Pi 4) for social-educational robots, evaluating inference efficiency, knowledge, and pedagogical quality.

entry.title: Robust Visual SLAM for UAV Navigation in GPS-Denied and Degraded Environments: A Multi-Paradigm Evaluation and Deployment Study

author.name: Prasoon Kumar, Akshay Deepak, Sandeep Kumar

entry.summary: Systematic comparative evaluation of five Visual SLAM systems across classical, deep learning, and ViT paradigms under degraded visual conditions for UAV navigation. Shows learning-based methods significantly outperform classical ORB-SLAM3 under severe degradation.

entry.title: Evaluating Generative Models as Interactive Emergent Representations of Human-Like Collaborative Behavior

author.name: Shinas Shaji, Teena Chakkalayil Hassan, Sebastian Houben, Alex Mitrevski

entry.summary: Evaluates whether embodied LLM agents exhibit emergent collaborative behaviors indicating mental models of collaborators in a 2D color-matching game. Studies coordination capabilities of foundation models in embodied settings.

entry.title: Codesign for Legibility (to AI and Everyone Else)

author.name: Adam Chlipala

entry.summary: Argues for 'codesign for legibility' - modifying systems to be easier to model and verify, making them amenable to fast symbolic methods. Connects formal verification with AI systems design.

entry.title: TRIMMER: A New Paradigm for Video Summarization through Self-Supervised Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Pritam Mishra, Coloma Ballester, Dimosthenis Karatzas

entry.summary: TRIMMER proposes a self-supervised reinforcement learning approach for video summarization that doesn't require manual annotations. Uses temporal relative information maximization with multi-objective efficient reinforcement learning. Addresses computational cost and generalization issues of existing supervised approaches.

entry.title: Federated Semi-Supervised Graph Neural Networks with Prototype-Guided Pseudo-Labeling for Privacy-Preserving Gestational Diabetes Mellitus Prediction

author.name: G. Victor Daniela, A. Mallikarjuna Reddya, Uday Kumar Addankia, Sridhar Reddy Gogua, Sravanth Kumar Ramakuria

entry.summary: FedTGNN-SS proposes a federated semi-supervised framework for clinical tabular EHR using graph neural networks with prototype-guided pseudo-labeling for GDM prediction. Each hospital builds local patient similarity graphs and trains GNN encoders. Addresses both label scarcity and data privacy in healthcare.

entry.title: Leveraging Data Symmetries to Select an Optimal Subset of Training Data under Label Noise

author.name: Kumar Shubham, Pavan Karjol, Kiran M K, Prathosh AP

entry.summary: Establishes that k-NN accuracy affects subset selection under label noise via cutstats, and demonstrates that leveraging data symmetries in high-dimensional settings improves k-NN performance and thus subset selection. Provides formal analysis connecting data geometry to noise-robust training.

entry.title: DocSync: Agentic Documentation Maintenance via Critic-Guided Reflexion

author.name: Sidhesh Badrinarayan, Adithya Parthasarathy

entry.summary: DocSync is an agentic workflow for documentation maintenance that uses AST-based structural grounding and critic-guided reflexion to keep documentation semantically consistent with code as it evolves.

entry.title: StateSMix: Online Lossless Compression via Mamba State Space Models and Sparse N-gram Context Mixing

author.name: Roberto Tacconelli

entry.summary: Presents StateSMix, a fully self-contained lossless compressor combining online-trained Mamba-style SSMs with sparse n-gram context mixing and arithmetic coding. Requires no pre-trained weights, no GPU, and no external dependencies.

entry.title: Learning Discriminative Signed Distance Functions from Multi-scale Level-of-detail Features for 3D Anomaly Detection

author.name: Haibo Xiao, Hanzhe Liang, Jie Zhou, Jinbao Wang, Can Gao

entry.summary: Proposes a surface-based method for 3D anomaly detection using discriminative signed distance functions with multi-scale level-of-detail features. Introduces noisy point generation and multi-scale feature extraction for point cloud anomaly detection.

entry.title: A Systematic Exploration of Text Decomposition and Budget Distribution in Differentially Private Text Obfuscation

author.name: Stephen Meisenbacher, Angelo Kleinert, Florian Matthes

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates text decomposition and privacy budget distribution techniques for differentially private text obfuscation at document level, testing how different chunking and budget allocation methods interact.

entry.title: MK-ResRecon: Multi-Kernel Residual Framework for Texture-Aware 3D MRI Refinement from Sparse 2D Slices

author.name: Prajyot Pyati, Sapna Sachan, Amulya Kumar Mahto, Pranjal Phukan

entry.summary: Proposes MK-ResRecon for reconstructing 3D MRI volumes from only 12.5% of axial slices using multi-kernel texture-aware loss, with a refinement network for the full 3D volume.

entry.title: Enhancing Visual Question Answering with Multimodal LLMs via Chain-of-Question Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Quanxing Xu, Ling Zhou, Xian Zhong, Xiaohua Huang, Rubing Huang, Chia-Wen Lin

entry.summary: Proposes CoVQD, combining Chain-of-Thought reasoning with Visual Question Decomposition to guide retrieval-augmented generation for visual question answering with multimodal LLMs.

entry.title: Compute Optimal Tokenization

author.name: Tomasz Limisiewicz, Artidoro Pagnoni, Srini Iyer, Mike Lewis, Sachin Mehta, Alisa Liu, Margaret Li, Gargi Ghosh, Luke Zettlemoyer

entry.summary: As covered in Research yesterday, Systematically investigates how token compression rate affects scaling trends by training 988 BLT models (50M-7B parameters). Reveals compute-optimal configurations show model parameters scale proportionally to data size in bytes, with implications for tokenizer design.

entry.title: InfoLaw: Information Scaling Laws for Large Language Models with Quality-Weighted Mixture Data and Repetition

author.name: Fengze Liu, Weidong Zhou, Binbin Liu, Ping Guo, Zijun Wang, Bingni Zhang, Yifan Zhang, Yifeng Yu, Xiaohuan Zhou, Taifeng Wang

entry.summary: As covered in Research yesterday, Introduces InfoLaw, a data-aware scaling framework predicting loss from tokens, model size, mixture weights, and repetition. Models pretraining as information accumulation where quality controls density and repetition shows diminishing returns.

entry.title: Class-Aware Adaptive Differential Privacy in Deep Learning for Sensor-Based Fall Detection

author.name: Joydeb Kumar Sana

entry.summary: Proposes Class-Aware Adaptive Differential Privacy (CA-ADP) that dynamically adjusts noise magnitude based on class composition during training, integrated with 3D CNN-BiLSTM for fall detection. Addresses limitation of uniform noise application that degrades prediction in imbalanced healthcare settings. Maintains privacy guarantees while improving minority class detection.

entry.title: When Prompts Interact: Assessing Prompt Arithmetic for Deconfounding under Distribution Shift

author.name: Zhecheng Sheng, Yongsen Tan, Xiruo Ding, Trevor Cohen, Serguei Pakhomov

entry.summary: Investigates prompt arithmetic (task arithmetic applied to prompts) for deconfounding under distribution shift, finding it can reduce reliance on confounders but with limitations compared to full model-level task arithmetic.

entry.title: TabSurv: Adapting Modern Tabular Neural Networks to Survival Analysis

author.name: Stanislav Kirpichenko, Andrei Konstantinov, Lev Utkin

entry.summary: Proposes TabSurv, adapting modern tabular architectures to survival analysis using Weibull or non-parametric predictions with a novel histogram loss for censored data. Includes parallel deep ensembles.

entry.title: Exact and Approximate Algorithms for Polytree Learning

author.name: Juha Harviainen, Frank Sommer, Manuel Sorge

entry.summary: Studies exact and approximate algorithms for learning optimal polytrees (directed forest Bayesian networks). Devises O((2+ε)^n) algorithm improving over O(3^n) for bounded in-degree, and provides polynomial-time approximation algorithms.

entry.title: On Computing Total Variation Distance Between Mixtures of Product Distributions

author.name: Weiming Feng, Yucheng Fu, Minji Yang, Anqi Zhang

entry.summary: Provides randomized algorithm for approximating total variation distance between mixtures of product distributions in poly((nq)^{k1+k2}, 1/ε) time. Shows exact computation is #P-hard for general mixtures of subcubes.

entry.title: Quantifying and Predicting Disagreement in Graded Human Ratings

author.name: Leixin Zhang, \c{C}a\u{g}r{\i} \c{C}\"oltekin

entry.summary: Investigates annotation disagreement patterns in graded human ratings for inappropriate language, proposing the Opposition Index to quantify perspective opposition and examining predictability of contentious instances.

entry.title: 2026 Roadmap on Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning for Smart Manufacturing

author.name: Jay Lee, Hanqi Su, Marco Macchi, Adalberto Polenghi, Wei Wu, Zhiheng Zhao, George Q. Huang, Kiva Allgood, Devendra Jain, Benedikt Gieger, Vibhor Pandhare, Soumyabrata Bhattacharjee, Ram Mohril, Lingbao Kong, Qiyuan Wang, Xinlan Tang, Sungjong Kim, Chan Hee Park, Byeng D. Youn, Guo Dong Goh, Xi Huang, Wai Yee Yeong, Yung C Shin, He Zhang, Zitong Wang, Fei Tao, Jagjit Singh Srai, Satyandra K. Gupta, Byung Gun Joung, Albin John, John W. Sutherland, Sang Won Lee, Olga Fink, Vinay Sharma, Faez Ahmed, Wei Chen, Mark Fuge, Arild Waaler, Martin G. Skj{\ae}veland, Dimitris Kyritsis, Wei Chen, VispiNevile Karkaria, Yi-Ping Chen, Ying-Kuan Tsai, Joseph Cohen, Xun Huan, Jing Lin, Liangwei Zhang, Gregory W. Vogl, Aaron W. Cornelius, Xiaodong Jia, Dai-Yan Ji, Takanobu Minami, Ruoxin Wang

entry.summary: A comprehensive roadmap paper from dozens of authors outlining the current state, challenges, and future directions of AI/ML in smart manufacturing. Covers topics from industrial big data to trustworthy AI in high-stakes manufacturing environments.

entry.title: ClinicBot: A Guideline-Grounded Clinical Chatbot with Prioritized Evidence RAG and Verifiable Citations

author.name: Navapat Nananukul, Mayank Kejriwal

entry.summary: Introduces ClinicBot, a clinical chatbot that prioritizes evidence from structured clinical guidelines using a novel RAG approach with explicit provenance tracking and verifiable citations to reduce hallucination.

entry.title: Towards Multi-Agent Autonomous Reasoning in Hydrodynamics

author.name: Jinpai Zhao, Albert Cerrone, Joannes Westerink, Clint Dawson

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-agent system for hydrodynamics scientific workflows using a Layer Execution Graph to coordinate specialized agents, addressing context window limitations of single-agent systems.

entry.title: NEURON: A Neuro-symbolic System for Grounded Clinical Explainability

author.name: Anuradha Chandrasekaran, Dimitrios Zikos, Mutlu Mete, Alan Pang, Brady D. Lund, Kewei Sha

entry.summary: Presents NEURON, a neuro-symbolic system combining SNOMED CT ontology with ML models and RAG-grounded LLMs to generate clinically interpretable natural language explanations from SHAP attributions.

entry.title: Artificial Jagged Intelligence as Uneven Optimization Energy Allocation Capability Concentration, Redistribution, and Optimization Governance

author.name: Wesley Shu, Peng Wei

entry.summary: Develops a formal theory of 'Artificial Jagged Intelligence' (AJI) explaining why AI systems develop uneven capability profiles, modeling this as anisotropic optimization energy allocation across parameter space directions.

entry.title: Model Routing as a Trust Problem: Route Receipts for Adaptive AI Systems

author.name: Vincent Schmalbach

entry.summary: Proposes 'route receipts' - compact runtime transparency artifacts documenting the routing path that served an AI request, addressing trust concerns when routing changes cost, quality, or accountability.

entry.title: Moira: Language-driven Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Pair Trading

author.name: Polydoros Giannouris, Yuechen Jiang, Lingfei Qian, Yuyan Wang, Xueqing Peng, Jimin Huang, Guojun Xiong, Sophia Ananiadou

entry.summary: Proposes Moira, a hierarchical RL framework for pair trading where both high-level (asset selection) and low-level (execution) policies are parameterized by LLMs, addressing credit assignment in semantic reasoning.

entry.title: 12 Angry AI Agents: Evaluating Multi-Agent LLM Decision-Making Through Cinematic Jury Deliberation

author.name: Ahmet Bahaddin Ersoz
