author.name: Hada Melino Muhammad, Zechen Li, Flora Salim, Ahmed A. Metwally

entry.summary: Proposes CGM-JEPA, a self-supervised pretraining framework for continuous glucose monitoring that learns consistent representations across multiple views (CGM time series, OGTT, Glucodensity) for metabolic subphenotype detection.

entry.title: Physiology-Aware Masked Cross-Modal Reconstruction for Biosignal Representation Learning

author.name: Hao Zhou, Simon A. Lee, Cyrus Tanade, Keum San Chun, Juhyeon Lee, Migyeong Gwak, Megha Thukral, Justin Sung, Eugene Hwang, Mehrab Bin Morshed, Li Zhu, Viswam Nathan, Md Mahbubur Rahman, Subramaniam Venkatraman, Sharanya Arcot Desai

entry.summary: Introduces xMAE, a biosignal pretraining framework using masked cross-modal reconstruction between temporally ordered signals (ECG and PPG), leveraging the directional temporal relationship between cardiac signals.

entry.title: Multi-Perspective Transformers in ARC-AGI-2 Challenge

author.name: Caleb Talley, Vedant Tibrewal, Seun Adekunle, Weiwen Dong, Xinyu Wu, Fariha Sheikh

entry.summary: Presents an approach to ARC-AGI-2 puzzles using TinyLM with test-time training and Products of Experts, achieving 21.7% on the evaluation set. Demonstrates flexible application of fine-tuning strategies for abstract reasoning.

entry.title: Attention Sinks in Massively Multilingual Neural Machine Translation:Discovery, Analysis, and Mitigation

author.name: Hillary Mutisya, John Mugane

entry.summary: Discovers and characterizes 'attention sinks' in NLLB-200 cross-attention where non-content tokens capture 83-91% of attention mass, proposes filtering to correct this artifact that causes raw similarity metrics to underestimate content alignment by nearly half.

entry.title: Mesh Based Simulations with Spatial and Temporal awareness

author.name: Paul Garnier, Vincent Lannelongue, Elie Hachem

entry.summary: Identifies that ML surrogates for CFD are limited by naive training paradigms (node-wise supervision, explicit Euler) rather than architecture, and proposes a unified framework bridging geometric deep learning with rigorous FEM training.

entry.title: Importance-Guided Basis Selection for Low-Rank Decomposition of Large Language Models

author.name: Daniel Agyei Asante, Ernie Chang, Yang Li

entry.summary: Proposes BSI (Basis Selection with Importance) for LLM compression via low-rank decomposition, ranking singular vector bases by estimated loss increase from removal using second-order Taylor expansion rather than magnitude-based heuristics.

entry.title: Perturb and Correct: Post-Hoc Ensembles using Affine Redundancy

author.name: Eleanor Quint

entry.summary: Introduces Perturb-and-Correct (P&C), a post-hoc method for creating epistemically diverse predictors from a single network using random hidden perturbations with least-squares corrections, producing predictors that agree in-distribution but disagree under shift.

entry.title: Benchmarking Single-Pose Docking, Consensus Rescoring, and Supervised ML on the LIT-PCBA Library: A Critical Evaluation of DiffDock, AutoDock-GPU, GNINA, and DiffDock-NMDN

author.name: Youssef Abo-Dahab, Xiaoiang Xiang, Xiaoiang Xiang, Xiaoiang Xiang

entry.summary: Performs large-scale benchmarking of docking and scoring methods on LIT-PCBA (578K ligand-target pairs), finding AutoDock-GPU with GNINA rescoring outperforms AI-based DiffDock, and that supervised ML achieves best results overall.

entry.title: Multi-User Dueling Bandits: A Fair Approach using Nash Social Welfare

author.name: Maheed H. Ahmed, Mahsa Ghasemi

entry.summary: Proposes a fair multi-user dueling bandits framework using Nash Social Welfare to balance fairness across users with potentially distinct preferences. Addresses the problem that training on average preferences can be unfair to minority groups.

entry.title: GETA-3DGS: Automatic Joint Structured Pruning and Quantization for 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Baobing Zhang, Wanxin Sui

entry.summary: GETA-3DGS proposes the first end-to-end automatic joint structured pruning and quantization framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting, allowing users to specify target rate/quality budgets rather than relying on hand-tuned heuristics.

entry.title: On the Optimal Sample Complexity of Offline Multi-Armed Bandits with KL Regularization

author.name: Kaixuan Ji, Qiwei Di, Heyang Zhao, Qingyue Zhao, Quanquan Gu

entry.summary: Provides sharp sample complexity analysis for KL-regularized offline multi-armed bandits, showing different complexities under large vs. small regularization regimes and proving optimality of KL-PCB algorithm.

entry.title: Differentiable Kernel Ridge Regression for Deep Learning Pipelines

author.name: Jean-Marc Mercier, Gabriele Santin

entry.summary: Introduces Sparse Kernels (SKs), a differentiable, localized variant of kernel ridge regression integrated as modular PyTorch layers that defer training to inference time and expose learnable feature representations, targets, and evaluation points.

entry.title: Isotropic Fourier Neural Operators

author.name: Michael F. Staddon

entry.summary: Proposes Isotropic Fourier Neural Operators that modify linear transformations to respect spatial symmetries (isotropy) of physical systems, improving model performance and convergence for PDE solving.

entry.title: CARD: Coarse-to-fine Autoregressive Modeling with Radix-based Decomposition for Transferable Free Energy Estimation

author.name: Ziyang Yu, Yi He, Wenbing Huang, Wen Yan, Yang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes CARD, a generative framework for estimating free energy differences in molecular interactions using a novel radix-based decomposition that converts 3D coordinates into mixed discrete-continuous sequences for autoregressive modeling. This enables transferable estimation across different molecular systems.

entry.title: MAD-OPD: Breaking the Ceiling in On-Policy Distillation via Multi-Agent Debate

author.name: Jianze Wang, Ying Liu, Jinlong Chen, Xuchun Hu, Qilong Zhang, Yu Cao, Jun Wang, Hua Yang, Yong Xie, Qianglong Chen

entry.summary: Proposes MAD-OPD, which replaces single-teacher on-policy distillation with multi-agent debate among multiple teachers, breaking the capability ceiling of individual teachers. Teachers debate over student's on-policy states to produce collective intelligence supervision.

entry.title: Minimum Specification Perturbation: Robustness as Distance-to-Falsification in Causal Inference

author.name: Hoang Dang, Luan Pham, Minh Nguyen

entry.summary: Introduces Minimum Specification Perturbation (MSP), measuring how many analyst decisions must change before a causal effect estimate's confidence interval contains zero. Provides a distance-to-falsification metric for robustness of causal claims.

entry.title: Learn-to-learn on Arbitrary Textual Conditioning: A Hypernetwork-Driven Meta-Gated LLM

author.name: Luo Ji, Qi Qin, Ningyuan Xi, Teng Chen, Qingqing Gu, Hongyan Li

entry.summary: Proposes a hypernetwork-driven meta-gating mechanism for LLMs that dynamically produces the β parameter in SwiGLU blocks based on textual conditions, enabling meta-controllability across tasks, domains, personas, and styles.

entry.title: The Model Knows, the Decoder Finds: Future Value Guided Particle Power Sampling

author.name: Tu Nguyen, Rasul Tutunov, Xiaotong Ji, Matthieu Zimmer

entry.summary: APPS introduces Auxiliary Particle Power Sampling for LLM decoding, using blockwise particle algorithms to approximate sequence-level power targets with bounded populations of partial solutions.

entry.title: Can AI Debias the News? LLM Interventions Improve Cross-Partisan Receptivity but LLMs Overestimate Their Own Effectiveness

author.name: Faisal Feroz, Jonas R. Kunst

entry.summary: Two pre-registered experiments show that LLM-based substantive reframing (but not subtle lexical changes) of liberal news can improve conservative readers' trust and engagement, though LLMs overestimate their own debiasing effectiveness.

entry.title: Beyond Semantic Relevance: Counterfactual Risk Minimization for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Peiyang Liu, Qiang Yan, Ziqiang Cui, Di Liang, Xi Wang, Wei Ye

entry.summary: CoRM-RAG addresses the 'Relevance-Robustness Gap' in RAG systems by using counterfactual risk minimization and causal intervention to align retrieval with decision safety rather than mere similarity, particularly for biased queries.

entry.title: Auditing demographic bias in AI-based emergency police dispatch: a cross-lingual evaluation of eleven large language models

author.name: William Guey, Wei Zhang, Pierrick Bougault, Yi Wang, Bertan Ucar, Vitor D. de Moura, Jos\'e O. Gomes

entry.summary: Introduces a cross-lingual audit framework for LLM demographic bias in emergency police dispatch, testing 11 frontier models across 19,800 outputs and finding systematic bias when incident severity is ambiguous.

entry.title: Compositional Multi-hop Factual Error Correction via Decomposition-and-Injection

author.name: Lei Zhu, Xiaobao Wang, Jianbiao Yang, Chenyang Wang, Dongxiao He, Longbiao Wang, Jianwu Dang

entry.summary: Proposes CECoR, a framework for multi-hop factual error correction that decomposes claims into interpretable reasoning steps and injects corrections at each step. Addresses the challenge of compositional reasoning across multiple evidence sources for error correction.

entry.title: A multilingual hallucination benchmark: MultiWikiQHalluA

author.name: Freja Thoresen, Dan Saattrup Smart

entry.summary: Creates synthetic hallucination datasets for 306 languages using the LettuceDetect framework and trains token-level hallucination classifiers for 30 European languages. Evaluates hallucination rates for Qwen3 models across English, Danish, German, and Icelandic.

entry.title: Graph Query Generation with Constraint-guided Large Language Agents

author.name: Mengying Wang, Nicolaas Jedema, Rahul Pandey, RaviKiran Krishnan, Jens Lehmann, Yinghui Wu

entry.summary: Proposes UniQGen, a constraint-based framework using LLM agents for knowledge graph question answering that works across query languages (SPARQL, Cypher). Extends Chase & Backchase algorithms with dynamic reasoning over query constraints.

entry.title: WindowQuant: Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization based on Window-Level Similarity for VLMs Inference Optimization

author.name: Wei Tao, Xiaoyang Qu, Peiqiang Wang, Guokuan Li, Jiguang Wan, Kai Lu, Jianzong Wang

entry.summary: Proposes WindowQuant, a window-level mixed-precision KV cache quantization method for video language models based on window-level similarity. Reduces search time and improves hardware efficiency compared to token-level approaches.

entry.title: Retrieval-Guided Generation for Safer Histopathology Image Captioning

author.name: Md. Enamul Hoq, Wataru Uegami, Saghir Alfasly, Ghazal Alabtah, Sahar Rahimi Malakshan, Armita Kazemi, Alex T. Schmitgen, Fred Prior, H. R. Tizhoosh

entry.summary: Investigates retrieval-guided generation (RGG) as a safer alternative to direct generation for histopathology image captioning, showing improved semantic alignment and fewer hallucinations compared to models like MedGemma.

entry.title: EmoMM: Benchmarking and Steering MLLM for Multimodal Emotion Recognition under Conflict and Missingness

author.name: Yueru Sun, Yimeng Zhang, Haoyu Gu, Nuo Chen, Dong She, Xianrong Yao, Yang Gao, Zhanpeng Jin

entry.summary: Introduces EmoMM benchmark for multimodal emotion recognition under modality conflict and missingness. Discovers 'Video Contribution Collapse' where MLLMs marginalize video evidence, and proposes CHASE attention steering mechanism to address it.

entry.title: CSGuard: Toward Forgery-Resistant Watermarking in Diffusion Models via Compressed Sensing Constraint

author.name: Jiewei Lai, Lan Zhang, Chen Tang, Pengcheng Sun, Zhaopeng Zhang, Yunhao Wang, Hui Jin

entry.summary: Proposes CSGuard, the first forgery-resistant watermarking scheme for diffusion models using compressed sensing to bind watermark generation and verification to a secret matrix, preventing forgery attacks.

entry.title: VAnim: Rendering-Aware Sparse State Modeling for Structure-Preserving Vector Animation

author.name: Guotao Liang, Zhangcheng Wang, Chuang Wang, Juncheng Hu, Haitao Zhou, Junhua Liu, Jing Zhang, Dong Xu, Qian Yu

entry.summary: Presents VAnim, the first LLM-based framework for open-domain text-to-SVG animation, reconceptualizing animation as Sparse State Updates on a persistent SVG DOM tree rather than sequence generation.

entry.title: Certified vs. Empirical Adversarial Robust-ness via Hybrid Convolutions with Attention Stochasticity

author.name: Joy Dhar, Song Xia, Manish Kumar Pandey, Maryam Haghighat, Azadeh Alavi, Ferdous Sohel, Wenyu Zhang, Nayyar Zaidi

entry.summary: Introduces HyCAS, combining 1-Lipschitz spectrally normalized convolutions with stochastic components to narrow the gap between provable L2 robustness certificates and empirical robustness against L∞ attacks.

entry.title: Omni-Fake: Benchmarking Unified Multimodal Social Media Deepfake Detection

author.name: Tianxiao Li, Zhenglin Huang, Haiquan Wen, Yiwei He, Xinze Li, Bingyu Zhu, Wuhui Duan, Congang Chen, Zeyu Fu, Yi Dong, Baoyuan Wu, Jason Li, Guangliang Cheng

entry.summary: Presents Omni-Fake, a large-scale unified benchmark (1M+ samples) for multimodal deepfake detection spanning image, audio, video, and audio-video modalities, with an out-of-distribution test set for generalization evaluation.

entry.title: Motion-Aware Caching for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation

author.name: Jing Xu, Yuexiao Ma, Songwei Liu, Xuzhe Zheng, Shiwei Liu, Chenqian Yan, Xiawu Zheng, Rongrong Ji, Fei Chao, Xing Wang

entry.summary: MotionCache proposes a motion-aware caching framework for autoregressive video generation that assigns more denoising steps to high-motion pixels and aggressively caches static regions, with theoretical backing linking cache errors to residual instability.

entry.title: MedScribe: Clinically Grounded CT Reporting through Agentic Workflows

author.name: Giuseppe A. Orlando, Paolo Papotti, Maria A. Zuluaga, Olivier Humbert, Marco Lorenzi

entry.summary: MedScribe reformulates CT report generation as an iterative hypothesis-driven evidence acquisition process, where an LLM dynamically invokes pathology-specific diagnostic tools to extract localized volumetric features rather than relying on single-pass global encoding.

entry.title: DP-SfM: Dual-Pixel Structure-from-Motion without Scale Ambiguity

author.name: Lilika Makabe, Kohei Ashida, Hiroaki Santo, Fumio Okura, Yasuyuki Matsushita

entry.summary: DP-SfM demonstrates that dual-pixel sensor images can automatically resolve scale ambiguity in multi-view 3D reconstruction without reference objects, using defocus blur information from DP images paired with reconstructed depth maps.

entry.title: Rethinking the Need for Source Models: Source-Free Domain Adaptation from Scratch Guided by a Vision-Language Model

author.name: Zhou Bingtao, Xiang Mian, Ning Qian

entry.summary: VODA proposes a truly source-free domain adaptation setting that eliminates all dependencies on source domain, using only a randomly initialized model, a Vision-Language model, and unlabeled target data. The key insight is that different source models yield minimal variation in final results when guided by VLMs.

entry.title: Checkerboard: A Simple, Effective, Efficient and Learning-free Clean Label Backdoor Attack with Low Poisoning Budget

author.name: Yi Yang, Jinyang Huang, Binbin Liu, Feng-Qi Cui, Xiaokang Zhou, Zhi Liu, Jie Zhang, Meng Li

entry.summary: Checkerboard presents a theoretically grounded, learning-free clean-label backdoor attack derived in closed form from a linear separability formulation, requiring no optimization or surrogate model training.

entry.title: DynoSLAM: Dynamic SLAM with Generative Graph Neural Networks for Real-World Social Navigation

author.name: Danil Tokhchukov, Veronika Morozova, Gonzalo Ferrer

entry.summary: DynoSLAM integrates socially-aware Graph Neural Networks into factor graph SLAM optimization, treating pedestrian motion forecasting as a stochastic world model with Monte Carlo rollouts to capture multimodal human dynamics.

entry.title: SixthSense: Task-Agnostic Proprioception-Only Whole-Body Wrench Estimation for Humanoids

author.name: Xingzhou Chen, Xiayan Xu, Yan Ning, Jiyu Yu, Yizheng Zhang, Siyi Qian, Lingzhu Xiang, Jiahao Chen, Yuquan Wang, Haodong Zhang, Ling Shi

entry.summary: SixthSense estimates whole-body contact timing, location, and wrenches for humanoids using only proprioception and IMU data, enabling practical force-interaction capabilities without specialized force sensors.

entry.title: Action Agent: Agentic Video Generation Meets Flow-Constrained Diffusion

author.name: Jeffrin Sam, Nguyen Khang, Yara Mahmoud, Miguel Altamirano Cabrera, Dzmitry Tsetserukou

entry.summary: Action Agent combines agentic navigation video generation (via LLM-orchestrated diffusion models achieving 86% success) with FlowDiT, a Flow-Constrained Diffusion Transformer converting goal videos to velocity commands for multi-embodiment robot navigation.

entry.title: Irretrievability; or, Murphy's Curse of Oneshotness upon ASI

author.name: Eliezer Yudkowsky

entry.summary: Yudkowsky argues about 'irretrievability' in ASI development, using the Viking 1 lander as analogy for how software bugs in one-shot systems can be catastrophic. Emphasizes that ASI development may not allow iterative debugging like normal software.

entry.title: Learn where to Click from Yourself: On-Policy Self-Distillation for GUI Grounding

author.name: Yan Zhang, Daiqing Wu, Huawen Shen, Yu Zhou, Can Ma

entry.summary: GUI-SD is the first on-policy self-distillation framework for GUI grounding (mapping instructions to visual coordinates). Uses a teacher with privileged visual context to provide dense token-level supervision from a single rollout, avoiding expensive multiple rollouts of RL methods.

entry.title: A Survey of Reasoning-Intensive Retrieval: Progress and Challenges

author.name: Yiyang Wei, Tingyu Song, Siyue Zhang, Yilun Zhao

entry.summary: A survey systematizing Reasoning-Intensive Retrieval (RIR) - settings where relevance requires latent inferential links rather than semantic similarity. Organizes benchmarks, retrievers, and rerankers leveraging LLM reasoning capabilities.

entry.title: RSAT: Structured Attribution Makes Small Language Models Faithful Table Reasoners

author.name: Jugal Gajjar, Kamalasankari Subramaniakuppusamy

entry.summary: RSAT trains small language models (1-8B) to produce step-by-step reasoning with cell-level citations for table QA. Two-phase approach using SFT then GRPO improves faithfulness 3.7× over SFT alone while achieving near-perfect citation validity.

entry.title: AlphaInventory: Evolving White-Box Inventory Policies via Large Language Models with Deployment Guarantees

author.name: Chenyu Huang, Jianghao Lin, Zhengyang Tang, Bo Jiang, Ruoqing Jiang, Benyou Wang, Lai Wei

entry.summary: AlphaInventory uses LLM-based evolutionary search (inspired by AlphaEvolve) to evolve white-box inventory policies in online non-stationary environments. Includes confidence-interval-based certification for deployment guarantees.

entry.title: Hierarchical Abstract Tree for Cross-Document Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Ziwen Zhao, Menglin Yang

entry.summary: Proposes Ψ-RAG, a tree-RAG framework for cross-document multi-hop questions that addresses poor distribution adaptability, structural isolation, and coarse abstraction limitations of existing tree-based RAG methods.

entry.title: Learning Multimodal Energy-Based Model with Multimodal Variational Auto-Encoder via MCMC Revision

author.name: Jiali Cui, Zhiqiang Lao, Heather Yu

entry.summary: Proposes combining multimodal energy-based models with multimodal VAEs through MCMC revision, addressing the poor mixing of Langevin dynamics in joint data space and the limited expressiveness of Gaussian latent generators.

entry.title: InpaintSLat: Inpainting Structured 3D Latents via Initial Noise Optimization

author.name: Jaeyoung Chung, Suyoung Lee, Kyoung Mu Lee

entry.summary: Presents a training-free approach for controllable 3D inpainting via initial noise optimization in structured 3D latent diffusion frameworks, ensuring high-fidelity alignment with existing context.

entry.title: GeoContra: From Fluent GIS Code to Verifiable Spatial Analysis with Geography-Grounded Repair

author.name: Yinhao Xiao, Rongbo Xiao, Yihan Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces GeoContra, a verification and repair framework for LLM-driven GIS workflows that enforces geographic rules (coordinate semantics, topology, units) through executable geospatial contracts and bounded repair loops.

entry.title: PhaseNet++: Phase-Aware Frequency-Domain Anomaly Detection for Industrial Control Systems via Phase Coherence Graphs

author.name: Raviteja Bommireddy, Varshith Bandaru, Lohith Pakala, Pradeep Kumar B

entry.summary: Introduces PhaseNet++, a frequency-domain anomaly detection system for industrial control systems that uses phase coherence information from STFT alongside magnitude, arguing phase is an overlooked detection modality.

entry.title: Deep Variational Inference Symbolic Regression

author.name: James Butterworth, Gevik Grigorian, Alejandro DiazDelaO

entry.summary: Introduces Deep Variational Inference Symbolic Regression (DVISR), extending Deep Symbolic Regression with variational Bayesian inference to obtain posterior distributions over symbolic expressions rather than point estimates.

entry.title: Almost for Free: Crafting Adversarial Examples with Convolutional Image Filters

author.name: Alexander Warnecke, Konrad Rieck

entry.summary: Proposes adversarial image filters based on classic edge detection algorithms that craft adversarial examples with a single forward pass, achieving 30-80% untargeted attack success rates with 3x3 filters.

entry.title: Metric-Normalized Posterior Leakage (mPL): Attacker-Aligned Privacy for Joint Consumption

author.name: Gaoyi Chen, Minghao Li, Weishi Shi, Yan Huang, Yusheng Wei, Sourabh Yadav, Chenxi Qiu

entry.summary: Introduces metric-normalized posterior leakage (mPL), an attacker-aligned privacy measure that accounts for evidence aggregation under joint observation, showing that metric differential privacy alone may not prevent leakage when correlated items are observed together.

entry.title: Arbitrarily Conditioned Hierarchical Flows for Spatiotemporal Events

author.name: Keyan Chen, Qiwei Yuan, Zhitong Xu, Bin Shen, Shandian Zhe

entry.summary: Introduces ARCH, a hierarchical flow matching framework for spatiotemporal event modeling that supports flexible conditioning for tasks like inverse inference and trajectory reconstruction, going beyond standard autoregressive point process models.

entry.title: Model-Based Proactive Cost Generation for Learning Safe Policies Offline with Limited Violation Data

author.name: Ruiqi Xue, Lei Yuan, Kainuo Cheng, Jing-Wen Yang, Yang Yu

entry.summary: Uses LLMs to proactively generate cost labels for safe-but-infeasible states in offline safe RL when violation data is scarce, addressing the deployment failure mode where models treat all data as uniformly safe.

entry.title: Model Merging: Foundations and Algorithms

author.name: Donato Crisostomi

entry.summary: A thesis on model merging that introduces C²M³ (cycle-consistent merging via Frank-Wolfe) for single-task setting and multi-task merging approaches, studying how to combine independently trained networks in weight space without retraining.

entry.title: Towards Efficient and Expressive Offline RL via Flow-Anchored Noise-conditioned Q-Learning

author.name: Sungyoung Lee, Dohyeong Kim, Eshan Balachandar, Zelal Su Mustafaoglu, Keshav Pingali

entry.summary: Proposes FAN (Flow-Anchored Noise-conditioned Q-Learning) for efficient offline RL, using single-iteration flow policies and single-sample distributional critics to achieve high performance at much lower computational cost than prior methods.

entry.title: Floating-Point Networks with Automatic Differentiation Can Represent Almost All Floating-Point Functions and Their Gradients

author.name: Sejun Park, Yeachan Park, Geonho Hwang

entry.summary: Proves that neural networks under floating-point arithmetic with automatic differentiation can represent almost all floating-point functions and their gradients, bridging theoretical universal approximation results to practical implementations.

entry.title: Beyond ECE: Calibrated Size Ratio, Risk Assessment, and Confidence-Weighted Metrics

author.name: Fernando Martin-Maroto, Nabil Abderrahaman, Gonzalo G. de Polavieja

entry.summary: Shows that ECE can remain small under arbitrarily large overconfidence risk, proposes Calibrated Size Ratio (CSR) as an alternative calibration metric, and derives confidence-weighted metrics that assess discriminative value of calibration.

entry.title: Selector-Guided Autonomous Curriculum for One-Shot Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards

author.name: Rudray Dave, Vedang Dubey, Smit Deoghare, Sudhakar Mishra

entry.summary: Proposes SGAC for one-shot RLVR, using a learnable selector on multi-dimensional features (success probability, entropy, difficulty) to choose optimal training instances, replacing the static reward variance heuristic.

entry.title: Robust Conditional Conformal Prediction via Branched Normalizing Flow

author.name: Rui Xu, Xingyuan Chen, Wenxing Huang, Minxuan Huang, Weiyan Chen, Sihong Xie, Hui Xiong

entry.summary: Bounds conditional conformal prediction invalidity under distribution shift via Wasserstein distance and proposes using branched normalizing flows for invertible transport to minimize conditional coverage error.

entry.title: DBLP: Phase-Aware Bounded-Loss Transport for Burst-Resilient Distributed ML Training

author.name: Zechen Ma, Zixi Qu, Jinyan Yi, David Lin, Yashar Ganjali

entry.summary: DBLP proposes a training-phase-aware transport protocol for distributed ML that handles transient network congestion by differentiating gradient importance across training phases. Reduces tail latency and training-time variability.

entry.title: DR-SNE: Density-Regularized Stochastic Neighbor Embedding

author.name: Maksim Kazanskii

entry.summary: DR-SNE reformulates dimensionality reduction as joint alignment of conditional structure and relative density structure, introducing a density regularization term that directly matches normalized log-density estimates unlike prior approaches.

entry.title: Adversarial Update-Based Federated Unlearning for Poisoned Model Recovery

author.name: Wenwei Zhao, Xiaowen Li, Yao Liu, Zhuo Lu

entry.summary: FAUN proposes a lightweight federated unlearning framework that uses adversarial optimization on a proxy dataset to derive updates eliminating malicious directions from poisoned models, followed by benign fine-tuning.

entry.title: H-Probes: Extracting Hierarchical Structures From Latent Representations of Language Models

author.name: Cutter Dawes, Aryan Sharma, Angelos Ioannis Lagos, Shivam Raval

entry.summary: Develops H-probes, linear probes that extract hierarchical structure (depth and pairwise distance) from LLM latent representations. Shows that hierarchy-containing subspaces are causally necessary for task completion in synthetic tree traversal tasks.

entry.title: Active Reasoning Vision-Language Models via Sequential Experimental Design

author.name: Anjie Liu, Ziqin Gong, Yan Song, Yuxiang Chen, Xiaolong Liu, Hengtong Lu, Kaike Zhang, Chen Wei

entry.summary: Frames overcoming the perceptual bandwidth bottleneck in VLMs as a sequential Bayesian optimal experimental design problem, inspired by active vision. Derives tractable approximations for balancing spatial coverage against resolution in gigapixel images.

entry.title: Anticipation-VLA: Solving Long-Horizon Embodied Tasks via Anticipation-based Subgoal Generation

author.name: Zhilong Zhang, Wenyu Luo, Haonan Wang, Yifei Sheng, Yidi Wang, Hanyuan Guo, Haoxiang Ren, Xinghao Du, Yuhan Che, Tongtong Cao, Lei Yuan, Yang Yu

entry.summary: Anticipation-VLA introduces an anticipation model that adaptively and recursively generates future subgoals for long-horizon robotic tasks, adjusting as execution unfolds rather than using fixed-granularity decomposition.

entry.title: GeoSAE: Geometric Prior-Guided Layer-Wise Sparse Autoencoder Annotation of Brain MRI Foundation Models

author.name: Favour Nerrise (Stanford University), Lucy Yin (Stanford University), Mohammad H. Abbasi (Stanford University), Kilian M. Pohl (Stanford University), Ehsan Adeli (Stanford University)

entry.summary: GeoSAE uses geometry-guided sparse autoencoders to interpret brain MRI foundation models, preventing feature collapse in deep transformer layers and annotating features via age-deconfounded partial correlations for Alzheimer's research.

entry.title: Extrapolation in Statistical Learning with Extreme Value Theory

author.name: Sebastian Engelke, Nicola Gnecco, Anne Sabourin

entry.summary: Comprehensive review synthesizing developments at the intersection of extreme value theory and statistical/machine learning, covering tail extrapolation for regression, classification, dimension reduction, generative AI, and anomaly detection.

entry.title: Anon: Extrapolating Optimizer Adaptivity Across the Real Spectrum

author.name: Yiheng Zhang, Kaiyan Zhao, Shaowu Wu, Yiming Wang, Jiajun Wu, Leong Hou U, Steve Drew, Xiaoguang Niu

entry.summary: Anon proposes an optimizer with continuously tunable adaptivity interpolating between SGD-like and Adam-like behaviors, addressing the generalization gap between adaptive and non-adaptive optimizers.

entry.title: ARA: Agentic Reproducibility Assessment For Scalable Support Of Scientific Peer-Review

author.name: Kevin Riehl, Andres L. Marin, Nikofors Zacharof, Fan Wu, Patrick Langer, Robert Jakob, Anastasios Kouvelas, Georgios Fontaras, Michail A. Makridis

entry.summary: Introduces ARA, a system that formalizes reproducibility assessment as structured reasoning over scientific documents by extracting workflow graphs and evaluating reconstructability using structural and content-based scores.

entry.title: Lost in the Tower of Babel: The Adverse Effects of Incidental Multilingualism in LLMs

author.name: Anjishnu Mukherjee, Chutong Meng, Antonios Anastasopoulos

entry.summary: Argues that contemporary multilingual LLMs are only incidentally multilingual (from web data) rather than by design, producing unequal and brittle behavior across languages, with empirical evidence of self-reporting vs actual language support gaps.

entry.title: Less is More: Geometric Unlearning for LLMs with Minimal Data Disclosure

author.name: Chenchen Tan, Xinghao Li, Shujie Cui, Youyang Qu, Cunjian Chen, Longxiang Gao

entry.summary: Geometric Unlearning (GU) operates on model planning states without access to training data, using geometric displacement in representation space for selective knowledge removal from LLMs.

entry.title: A Multimodal Dataset for Visually Grounded Ambiguity in Machine Translation

author.name: Jingheng Pan, Xintong Wang, Longyue Wang, Liang Ding, Weihua Luo, Chris Biemann

entry.summary: Presents VIDA, a dataset of 2,500 curated instances for multimodal machine translation where resolving ambiguous source spans requires visual evidence. Addresses quality issues in prior disambiguation benchmarks and proposes evaluation better suited to broader ambiguity types in open-ended translation.

entry.title: SemEval-2026 Task 7: Everyday Knowledge Across Diverse Languages and Cultures

author.name: Nedjma Ousidhoum, Junho Myung, Carla Perez-Almendros, Jiho Jin, Amr Keleg, Meriem Beloucif, Yi Zhou, Rodrigo Agerri, Vladimir Araujo, Naomi Baes, James Barry, Joanne Boisson, Nancy F. Chen, Christine de Kock, Aleksandra Edwards, Joseba Fernandez de Landa, Mohamed Fazli Imam, Huda Hakami, Shu-Kai Hsieh, Joseph Marvin Imperial, Roy Ka-Wei Lee, Zhengyuan Liu, Chenyang Lyu, Younes Samih, Johan Sjons, Bryan Tan, Asahi Ushio, Weihua Zheng, Alice Oh, Jose Camacho-Collados

entry.summary: Presents SemEval-2026 Task 7 on evaluating LLM adaptability across 30+ language-culture pairs, predominantly low-resource languages. Includes Short-Answer and Multiple-Choice question tracks testing everyday knowledge across diverse cultures.

entry.title: RECAP: An End-to-End Platform for Capturing, Replaying, and Analyzing AI-Assisted Programming Interactions

author.name: Keyu He, Qianou Ma, Valerie Chen, Wayne Chi, Tongshuang Wu

entry.summary: Presents RECAP, an open-source platform for capturing, replaying, and analyzing AI-assisted programming interactions in VS Code. Records AI chat sessions and code edits, merges them into a unified timeline for research analysis.

entry.title: CP-SynC: Multi-Agent Zero-Shot Constraint Modeling in MiniZinc with Synthesized Checkers

author.name: Yuliang Song, Eldan Cohen

entry.summary: Introduces CP-SynC, a multi-agent workflow for zero-shot constraint programming in MiniZinc. Coordinates modeling agents with validation agents that synthesize semantic checkers to provide feedback on model correctness.

entry.title: GRAIL: A Deep-Granularity Hybrid Resonance Framework for Real-Time Agent Discovery via SLM-Enhanced Indexing

author.name: Jinliang Xu

entry.summary: Proposes GRAIL, a framework achieving sub-400ms agent discovery latency for multi-agent systems using SLM-enhanced prediction, replacing heavy LLM parsers for intent parsing in agent discovery.

entry.title: PubMed-Ophtha: An open resource for training ophthalmology vision-language models on scientific literature

author.name: Verena Jasmin Hallitschke, Carsten Eickhoff, Philipp Berens

entry.summary: Presents PubMed-Ophtha, a hierarchical dataset of 102,023 ophthalmological image-caption pairs extracted from open-access PubMed articles. Provides full-resolution panel decomposition, modality annotation, and mark status indicators.

entry.title: Validation of Whole-Slide Foundation Models for Image Retrieval in TCGA Data

author.name: Tianhao Lei, Parsa Esmaeilkhani, Saghir Alfasly, Wataru Uegami, Judy C. Boughey, Matthew P. Goetz, Krishna R. Kalari, H. R. Tizhoosh

entry.summary: Benchmarks ten retrieval pipelines (including slide foundation models like TITAN) on 9,387 TCGA slides across 17 organs. Finds performance varies more across organs than architectures, and even dense patch retrieval matches slide-level models with sufficient sampling.

entry.title: WildTableBench: Benchmarking Multimodal Foundation Models on Table Understanding In the Wild

author.name: Junzhe Huang, Xiaoxiao Sun, Yan Yang, Yuxuan Hou, Ruotian Zhang, Sirui Li, Hehe Fan, Serena Yeung-Levy, Xin Yu

entry.summary: Introduces WildTableBench, the first QA benchmark for naturally occurring table images from real-world settings, with 402 high-density table images and 920 QA pairs testing multimodal foundation models on visual table understanding.

entry.title: Colinearity Decay: Training Quantization-Friendly ViTs with Outlier Decay

author.name: Jin Tong, Guang Liang, Peilin Sun, Jianxin Wu

entry.summary: Introduces Colinearity-Decay, a structural regularizer for Vision Transformers that controls cross-matrix alignment amplification to make models more quantization-friendly, rather than simply suppressing outliers.

entry.title: VISTA: Video Interaction Spatio-Temporal Analysis Benchmark

author.name: Alejandro Aparcedo, Akash Kumar, Aaryan Garg, Dalton Pham, Wen-Kai Chen, Anirudh Bharadwaj, Aman Chadha, Yogesh Rawat

entry.summary: Introduces VISTA benchmark for evaluating VLMs on open-set, multi-entity, multi-action spatio-temporal understanding in videos, decomposing videos into entities, actions, and relationships for systematic failure analysis.

entry.title: SwiftPie: Lightning-fast Subject-driven Image Personalization via One step Diffusion

author.name: Huy Duong, Trong-Tung Nguyen, Cuong Pham, Anh Tran, Khoi Nguyen, Minh Hoai

entry.summary: Presents SwiftPie, the first one-step diffusion image personalization tool using a dual-branch identity injection mechanism for real-time personalized image generation.

entry.title: Robust Fundamental Matrix Estimation from Single Image Motion Blur

author.name: Bao-Long Tran, Per-Erik Forss\'en, Fredrik Viksten

entry.summary: Introduces a method to extract fundamental matrices from single motion-blurred images by establishing correspondences between time instances within the camera exposure window, modifying the 8-point algorithm for per-smear direction ambiguity.

entry.title: GEASS: Training-Free Caption Steering for Hallucination Mitigation in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Zeshang Li, Shuoyang Zhang, Jiashen Ding

entry.summary: GEASS proposes a training-free method to selectively steer VLMs using self-generated captions, finding that captions can harm rather than help and that their utility is per-query rather than per-corpus. Uses gated evidence-aware selective steering to mitigate hallucination.

entry.title: Multi-Scale Gaussian-Language Map for Zero-shot Embodied Navigation and Reasoning

author.name: Sixian Zhang, Yiyao Wang, Xinhang Song, Keming Zhang, Zijian Xu, Shuqiang Jiang

entry.summary: GLMap proposes a multi-scale Gaussian-Language Map for embodied navigation that combines explicit 3D Gaussian geometry with natural language descriptions at multiple semantic scales, providing a native interface for large models without additional training.

entry.title: From Where Things Are to What They Are For: Benchmarking Spatial-Functional Intelligence in Multimodal LLMs

author.name: Le Zhang, Jihan Yang, Soundarya Krishnan, Jimit Majmudar, Xiou Ge, Prasoon Puri, Prathamesh Nandkishor Saraf, Shruti Bhargava, Dhivya Piraviperumal, Yinan Ling, Cindy Pan, Hong Yu, Aishwarya Agrawal, Bo-Hsiang Tseng

entry.summary: SFI-Bench introduces a video-based benchmark evaluating spatial-functional intelligence in MLLMs, testing whether models understand not just where things are but what they are for, with structured spatial reasoning and functional inference dimensions.

entry.title: Video Generation with Predictive Latents

author.name: Yian Zhao, Feng Wang, Qiushan Guo, Chang Liu, Xiangyang Ji, Jian Zhang, Jie Chen

entry.summary: Introduces a predictive reconstruction objective for Video VAE that unifies predictive learning with reconstruction, improving the diffusability of video latents for generative modeling rather than just optimizing reconstruction quality.

entry.title: OphMAE: Bridging Volumetric and Planar Imaging with a Foundation Model for Adaptive Ophthalmological Diagnosis

author.name: Tienyu Chang, Zhen Chen, Renjie Liang, Jinyu Ding, Jie Xu, Sunu Mathew, Amir Reza Hajrasouliha, Andrew J. Saykin, Ruogu Fang, Yu Huang, Jiang Bian, Qingyu Chen

entry.summary: OphMAE is a multi-imaging foundation model for ophthalmology that bridges 3D OCT and 2D fundus photography using masked autoencoders, enabling diagnosis even when advanced 3D imaging hardware is unavailable in resource-limited settings.

entry.title: Perceptual Flow Network for Visually Grounded Reasoning

author.name: Yangfu Li, Yuning Gong, Hongjian Zhan, Teng Li, Yuanhuiyi Lyu, Tianyi Chen, Qi Liu, Ziyuan Huang, Zhihang Zhong, Dandan Zheng, Yue Lu

entry.summary: PFlowNet proposes a perceptual flow network that decouples perception from reasoning in large vision-language models to achieve interpretable visual reasoning, addressing language bias and hallucination without rigid alignment to geometric expert priors.

entry.title: Decompose and Recompose: Reasoning New Skills from Existing Abilities for Cross-Task Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Xitie Zhang, Aming Wu, Yahong Han

entry.summary: Proposes a skill reasoning framework for cross-task robotic manipulation that decomposes demonstrations into atomic skill-action pairs, enabling models to reason about novel skill compositions for unseen tasks.

entry.title: Generative Modeling with Orbit-Space Particle Flow Matching

author.name: Sinan Wang, Jinjin He, Shenyifan Lu, Ruicheng Wang, Greg Turk, Bo Zhu

entry.summary: Presents Orbit-Space Geometric Probability Paths (OGPP), a particle-native flow-matching framework for generative modeling that handles permutation symmetries and encodes geometric attributes like surface normals in flow terminal velocities.

entry.title: TAIL-Safe: Task-Agnostic Safety Monitoring for Imitation Learning Policies

author.name: Riad Ahmed, Momotaz Begum

entry.summary: TAIL-Safe identifies safe sets for trained imitation learning policies from which the policy can reliably execute tasks as demonstrated, addressing the deployment safety gap for flow-matching and diffusion policies.

entry.title: Cut-In Gap Acceptance Toward Autonomous vs. Human-Driven Vehicles: Evidence from the Waymo Open Motion Dataset

author.name: Abdulaziz Alhuraish, Yuhang Wang, Hao Zhou

entry.summary: Analyzes cut-in gap acceptance behavior toward autonomous vs. human-driven vehicles using Waymo Open Motion Dataset, finding drivers accept 1.99 meter shorter gaps when cutting in front of AVs, confirming exploitation of AV conservatism.

entry.title: Token Arena: A Continuous Benchmark Unifying Energy and Cognition in AI Inference

author.name: Yuxuan Gao, Megan Wang, Yi Ling Yu

entry.summary: Introduces TokenArena, a continuous benchmark measuring AI inference at endpoint granularity (provider, model, SKU) across five axes including speed, price, context, and quality. Synthesizes these into composites like joules per correct answer and dollars per correct answer.

entry.title: Hyperspherical Forward-Forward with Prototypical Representations

author.name: Shalini Sarode, Brian Moser, Joachim Folz, Federico Raue, Tobias Nauen, Stanislav Frolov, Andreas Dengel

entry.summary: Hyperspherical Forward-Forward (HFF) reformulates the Forward-Forward algorithm's local objective from binary goodness-of-fit to multi-class classification in hyperspherical space using class prototypes. Eliminates the computational bottleneck of requiring separate forward passes per class.

entry.title: Fair Dataset Distillation via Cross-Group Barycenter Alignment

author.name: Mohammad Hossein Moslemi, Nima Hosseini Dashtbayaz, Zhimin Mei, Boyu Wang, Bissan Ghaddar

entry.summary: Addresses fairness in dataset distillation, showing that different demographic groups' distinct predictive patterns cause the distillation process to lose subgroup information regardless of group balance. Proposes cross-group barycenter alignment using optimal transport.

entry.title: DynamicPO: Dynamic Preference Optimization for Recommendation

author.name: Xingyu Hu, Kai Zhang, Jiancan Wu, Shuli Wang, Chi Wang, Wenshuai Chen, Yinhua Zhu, Haitao Wang, Xingxing Wang, Xiang Wang

entry.summary: DynamicPO addresses preference optimization collapse in LLM-based recommendation, where increasing negative samples degrades performance due to gradient suppression from easily discriminable negatives dominating boundary-critical ones.

entry.title: "What Are You Really Trying to Do?": Co-Creating Life Goals from Everyday Computer Use

author.name: Shardul Sapkota, Matthew J\"orke, Zane Sabbagh, Omar Shaikh, Grace Wang, James A. Landay

entry.summary: Introduces 'striving co-creation,' a process for inferring broader life goals from observations of everyday computer use, using Activity Theory and personal strivings framework to build hierarchical activity representations.

entry.title: Fairness of Classifiers in the Presence of Constraints between Features

author.name: Martin C. Cooper, Imane Bousdira

entry.summary: Proposes a fairness definition based on fair explanations using prime-implicant reasons that account for constraints between features, showing that ignoring constraints can completely change fairness assessments.

entry.title: Hierarchical Federated Learning for Networked AI: From Communication Saving to Architecture-Aware Design

author.name: Seyed Mohammad Azimi-Abarghouyi, Mehdi Bennis, Leandros Tassiulas

entry.summary: Argues that hierarchical federated learning should be viewed as an architecture-aware design framework rather than just a communication-saving protocol, organizing around architectural parameters, optimization decomposition, and communication design.

entry.title: EventADL: Open-Box Anomaly Detection and Localization Framework for Events in Cloud-Based Service Systems

author.name: Luan Pham, Victor Nicolet, Joey Dodds, Hui Guan, Daniel Kroening

entry.summary: Proposes EventADL, the first event-based anomaly detection and localization framework for cloud systems, analyzing 520 real incidents to understand how anomalies manifest through event data.

entry.title: Topological Neural Tangent Kernel

author.name: Sanjukta Krishnagopal

entry.summary: Introduces Topological Neural Tangent Kernel (TopoNTK), extending graph NTK theory to simplicial complexes with higher-order interactions via Hodge theory. This enables distinguishing complexes with identical graphs but different filled simplices.

entry.title: GraphSculptor: Sculpting Pre-training Coreset for Graph Self-supervised Learning

author.name: Chuang Liu, Zelin Yao, Xueqi Ma, Luzhi Wang, Mukun Chen, Pinghua Xu, Wenbin Hu

entry.summary: Introduces GraphSculptor for constructing efficient pre-training coresets for graph self-supervised learning, showing that 50% subsampling retains 96%+ performance and providing principled selection via structural diversity and contextual semantics.

entry.title: Rethinking Multi-Label Node Classification: Do Tuned Classic GNNs Suffice?

author.name: Yuxuan Xiao, Shengzhong Zhang

entry.summary: Shows that carefully tuned classic GNNs (GCN, SSGConv, GCNII) with standard techniques can match or outperform complex label-aware designs for multi-label node classification, questioning whether specialized designs are truly necessary.

entry.title: Adversarial Imitation Learning with General Function Approximation: Theoretical Analysis and Practical Algorithms

author.name: Tian Xu, Zhilong Zhang, Zexuan Chen, Ruishuo Chen, Yihao Sun, Yang Yu

entry.summary: Introduces OPT-AIL, a framework for adversarial imitation learning with general function approximation that bridges theory and practice, combining online optimization for rewards with optimism-regularized policy optimization.

entry.title: How Label Imbalance Shapes Geometry: A General Spectral Analysis of Multi-Label Neural Collapse

author.name: Xiaoxuan Ma, Yixuan Yang, Song Li, Xiangyun Hui

entry.summary: Resolves the multiplicity-one imbalance conjecture for multi-label Neural Collapse, showing that higher-multiplicity prototypes follow class-frequency-weighted synthesis rather than uniform averaging, providing spectral analysis under general label correlations.

entry.title: Misclassification Rate and Privacy-Utility Trade-offs in Graph Convolutional Networks via Subsampling Stability

author.name: Yexin Zhang, Zhongtian Ma, Qiaosheng Zhang, Zhen Wang

entry.summary: Studies differential privacy in Graph Convolutional Networks through subsampling stability, deriving upper bounds on misclassification rate dependent on subsampling probability and characterizing the privacy-utility trade-off with feasible ranges.

entry.title: Manifold-Aligned Guided Integrated Gradients for Reliable Feature Attribution

author.name: Soyeon Kim, Seongwoo Lim, Kyowoon Lee, Jaesik Choi

entry.summary: Proposes Manifold-Aligned Guided Integrated Gradients (MA-GIG) that constructs attribution paths in VAE latent space rather than input space, keeping intermediate points on the data manifold for more reliable feature attributions.

entry.title: ZNO: Stable Rational Neural Operators in the Z-Domain for Discrete-Time Dynamic

author.name: Xianli Zhu, Jia Yin

entry.summary: ZNO introduces a Z-domain neural operator with stable low-rank MIMO rational filters for discrete-time system identification, expressing stability as a unit-disk pole constraint with directly readable learned poles.

entry.title: Selective Prediction from Agreement: A Lipschitz-Consistent Version Space Approach

author.name: Mohamadsadegh Khosravani

entry.summary: Proposes selective prediction through version space agreement: given Lipschitz margin constraints in embedding space, predicts only when all consistent classification heads agree, and abstains otherwise.

entry.title: SpecKV: Adaptive Speculative Decoding with Compression-Aware Gamma Selection

author.name: Shikhar Shukla

entry.summary: Introduces SpecKV, a lightweight adaptive controller for speculative decoding that dynamically selects the speculation length (gamma) per step based on draft model signals, rather than using a fixed value. Profiles performance across task types and compression levels.

entry.title: Rethinking Model Selection in VLM Through the Lens of Gromov-Wasserstein Distance

author.name: Muyang Li, Yucheng Liu, Jianbo Ma, Elliot Osborne, Bo Han, Tongliang Liu

entry.summary: Investigates vision encoder selection for VLMs using Gromov-Wasserstein distance, showing that common heuristics (largest size, highest zero-shot accuracy) fail to predict VLM performance. GW distance better captures structural alignment suitability.

entry.title: Stable Localized Conformal Prediction via Transduction

author.name: Yinjie Min, Liuhua Peng, Changliang Zou

entry.summary: Proposes Stable Conformal Prediction (StCP), a transfer learning approach that reduces variability in prediction set sizes by leveraging labeled source-task data and unlabeled target data. Formalizes 'set stability' as variance of conditional expectation of set size.

entry.title: The (Marginal) Value of a Search Ad: An Online Causal Framework for Repeated Second-price Auctions

author.name: Yuxiao Wen, Zihao Hu, Yanjun Han, Yuan Yao, Zhengyuan Zhou

entry.summary: Models ad value as a treatment effect (difference between winning/losing auction) rather than raw revenue, developing rate-optimal regret algorithms for bidding in second-price auctions under this causal perspective.

entry.title: Planner Matters! An Efficient and Unbalanced Multi-agent Collaboration Framework for Long-horizon Planning

author.name: Wenyi Wu, Sibo Zhu, Kun Zhou, Biwei Huang

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-agent framework for long-horizon planning with systematic compute-allocation analysis showing planning is the dominant factor, while execution and memory need less compute.

entry.title: Metric Unreliability in Multimodal Machine Unlearning: A Systematic Analysis and Principled Unified Score

author.name: Abdullah Ahmad Khan, Hamid Laga, Ferdous Sohel

entry.summary: Presents first systematic study of metric reliability in multimodal machine unlearning, showing standard metrics yield conflicting rankings. Proposes a unified score combining opposing metric clusters.

entry.title: ANO: A Principled Approach to Robust Policy Optimization

author.name: Yiheng Zhang, Yiming Wang, Kaiyan Zhao, Zhenglin Wan, Jiayu Chen, Leong Hou U

entry.summary: ANO derives a principled policy optimization method using redescending influence functions, resolving the PPO dilemma between clipping (losing gradient info) and no clipping (unbounded gradients).

entry.title: Decoding-Time Debiasing via Process Reward Models: From Controlled Fill-in to Open-Ended Generation

author.name: Muneeb Ur Raheem Khan

entry.summary: Proposes decoding-time debiasing using Process Reward Models as judges scoring candidates for fairness and fluency, without touching model weights. Three schemes of increasing sophistication.

entry.title: Focus on the Core: Empowering Diffusion Large Language Models by Self-Contrast

author.name: Jinyuan Feng, Xin Yu, Yiqun Chen, Xiaochi Wei, Yan Gao, Yi Wu, Yao Hu, Zhiqiang Pu

entry.summary: FoCore identifies high-information-density tokens in Diffusion LLMs that converge early, and conditions generation on them via self-contrast to improve output quality without additional training.

entry.title: The grip of grammar on meaning uncertainty: cross-linguistic evidence, neural correlates, and clinical relevance

author.name: Rui He, Claudio Palominos, Samuele Vallisa, Ni Yang, Han Zhang, Miguel \'Angel Santos Santos, Neguine Rezaii, Sergi Valero, Yonghua Huang, Huan Li, Hong Jiang, Yongjun Peng, Maria Francisca Alonso-S\'anchez, Frederike Stein, Tilo Kircher, Philipp Homan, Iris Sommer, Lena Palaniyappan, Wolfram Hinzen

entry.summary: Proposes that grammar compresses meaning uncertainty cross-linguistically, with evidence from 20 languages, fMRI data, and clinical populations showing this compression is reflected in brain activity and disrupted in disorders.

entry.title: Prosa: Rubric-Based Evaluation of LLMs on Real User Chats in Brazilian Portuguese

author.name: Roseval Malaquias Junior, Giovana Kerche Bon\'as, Thales Sales Almeida, Hugo Abonizio, Thiago Laitz, Ramon Pires, Marcos Piau, Celio Larcher, Rodrigo Nogueira

entry.summary: Prosa benchmark shows that switching from holistic LLM-as-judge scoring to binary rubric scoring with multi-judge filtering produces perfectly consistent rankings across judge models for Brazilian Portuguese conversations.

entry.title: An Information-theoretic Propagation Denoising and Fusion Framework for Fake News Detection

author.name: Mengyang Chen, Lingwei Wei, Wei Zhou, Songlin Hu

entry.summary: Proposes InfoPDF, an information-theoretic framework for fake news detection that addresses unreliability of LLM-simulated propagation data. Uses mutual information perspective to denoise and fuse real and synthetic propagation signals.

entry.title: Is It Novel and Why? Fine-Grained Patent Novelty Prediction Based on Passage Retrieval

author.name: Valentin Knappich, Anna H\"atty, Simon Razniewski, Annemarie Friedrich

entry.summary: Introduces FiNE-Patents, a dataset of 3,658 patent claims annotated with fine-grained, feature-level prior art references for novelty assessment. Moves beyond binary classification to provide granular, passage-level novelty prediction.

entry.title: Shadow-Loom: Causal Reasoning over Graphical World Model of Narratives

author.name: David Wilmot

entry.summary: Introduces Shadow-Loom, a framework that converts narratives into versioned graphical world models and applies causal physics (Pearl's ladder, counterfactual calculus) alongside narrative physics (mystery, irony, suspense, surprise) for story understanding.

entry.title: Intervention-Based Self-Supervised Learning: A Causal Probe Paradigm for Remote Photoplethysmography

author.name: Zhiyi Niu, Xiaoguang Tu, Bo Zhao, Junzhe Cao, Dan Guo, Zitong Yu

entry.summary: Proposes Physiological Causal Probing (PCP), a self-supervised learning paradigm for remote photoplethysmography that uses causal intervention rather than passive correlation learning to extract faint rPPG signals from video, avoiding the 'correlation trap' of learning dominant noise.

entry.title: When Good OCR Is Not Enough: Benchmarking OCR Robustness for Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Lin Sun, Wang Dexian, Jingang Huang, Linglin Zhang, Change Jia, Zhengwei Cheng, Xiangzheng Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces an OCR benchmark for industrial RAG systems covering 11 challenging document types, showing that current SOTA OCR models degrade significantly on realistic industrial documents with complex layouts, watermarks, and formulas.

entry.title: VoxAfford: Multi-Scale Voxel-Token Fusion for Open-Vocabulary 3D Affordance Detection

author.name: Haowen Sun, Shaolong Zhang, Mingyang Li, Chengzhong Ma, Xinzhe Chen, Qiongjie Cui, Xingyu Chen, Zeyang Liu, Xuguang Lan

entry.summary: Proposes VoxAfford for open-vocabulary 3D affordance detection, injecting multi-scale geometric features from a frozen 3D VQVAE into MLLM output tokens to overcome spatial impoverishment of autoregressive token generation.

entry.title: RADMI: Latent Information Aggregation as a Proxy for Model Uncertainty

author.name: William Stevens, Mohit Prabhushankar, Ghassan AlRegib

entry.summary: Proposes RADMI, a single-pass uncertainty estimation method measuring mutual information between consecutive decoder layers, observing that elevated inter-layer MI correlates with prediction uncertainty at ambiguous regions.

entry.title: TrajRAG: Retrieving Geometric-Semantic Experience for Zero-Shot Object Navigation

author.name: Yiyao Wang, Sixian Zhang, Keming Zhang, Xinhang Song, Songjie Du, Shuqiang Jiang

entry.summary: TrajRAG proposes a retrieval-augmented generation framework for zero-shot object navigation that accumulates and retrieves geometric-semantic experiences from past episodes using a topological-polar trajectory representation.

entry.title: Referring Multiple Regions with Large Multimodal Models via Contextual Latent Steering

author.name: Yun Xing, Hanyuan Liu, Jiahao Nie, Shijian Lu

entry.summary: CSteer introduces a training-free approach for guiding LMMs to refer to multiple regions contextually by pre-computing contextual vectors representing visual referring behaviors like differentiation among regions and attention to global contexts.

entry.title: Exploring Data-Free LoRA Transferability for Video Diffusion Models

author.name: Yuchen Wang, Wenliang Zhong, Lichen Bai, Zikai Zhou, Shitong Shao, Bojun Cheng, Shuo Chen, Shuo Yang, Zeke Xie

entry.summary: Investigates LoRA transferability across video diffusion model variants (step-distilled, causal-distilled), identifying that incompatibility stems from spectral interference in shared functional clusters and proposing solutions.

entry.title: Automated In-the-Wild Data Collection for Continual AI Generated Image Detection

author.name: Thanasis Pantsios, Dimitrios Karageorgiou, Christos Koutlis, George Karantaidis, Olga Papadopoulou, Symeon Papadopoulos

entry.summary: Proposes a data-centric continual adaptation framework for AI-generated image detection, combining automated in-the-wild dataset construction through fact-check article retrieval with generator-driven data for continual detector updates.

entry.title: AutoFocus: Uncertainty-Aware Active Visual Search for GUI Grounding

author.name: Ruilin Yao, Shegnwu Xiong, Tianyu Zou, Shili Xiong, Yi Rong

entry.summary: AutoFocus introduces a training-free, uncertainty-aware active visual search framework for GUI grounding that uses token-level perplexity in coordinate generation to determine where spatial refinement is needed for VLMs on high-resolution interfaces.

entry.title: Unified Map Prior Encoder for Mapping and Planning

author.name: Zongzheng Zhang, Sizhe Zou, Guantian Zheng, Zhenxin Zhu, Yu Gao, Guoxuan Chi, Shuo Wang, Yuwen Heng, Zhigang Sun, Yiru Wang, Hao Sun, Chao Ma, Zhen Li, Anqing Jiang, Hao Zhao

entry.summary: UMPE presents a Unified Map Prior Encoder for autonomous driving that can ingest any subset of four map types (HD/SD vector maps, rasterized SD maps, satellite imagery) and fuse them with BEV features for both mapping and planning tasks.

entry.title: Toward Fine-Grained Speech Inpainting Forensics:A Dataset, Method, and Metric for Multi-Region Tampering Localization

author.name: Tung Vu, Yen Nguyen, Hai Nguyen, Cuong Pham, Cong Tran

entry.summary: Introduces MIST, a large-scale multilingual dataset for detecting multiple independently inpainted speech segments, addressing a critical gap in audio deepfake detection for partial speech manipulation.

entry.title: LLM-Foraging: Large Language Models for Decentralized Swarm Robot Foraging

author.name: Peihan Li, Joanna Gutierrez, Fabian Hernandez, Qi Lu, Lifeng Zhou

entry.summary: LLM-Foraging augments decentralized swarm robot foraging with LLM decision-making at structured decision points, using only locally observable state without retraining when deployment conditions change.

entry.title: Phone2Act: A Low-Cost, Hardware-Agnostic Teleoperation System for Scalable VLA Data Collection

author.name: Om Mandhane, Bipin Yadav, Sangeetha Prasanna Ram, Gopalakrishnan Narayanan

entry.summary: Presents Phone2Act, a low-cost teleoperation framework that uses a commodity smartphone as a 6-DoF robot controller via Google ARCore for VLA data collection. Built on modular ROS 2 architecture supporting multiple robot platforms without code modification.

entry.title: Agent Capsules: Quality-Gated Granularity Control for Multi-Agent LLM Pipelines

author.name: Aninda Ray

entry.summary: Agent Capsules is an adaptive runtime for multi-agent LLM pipelines that optimizes the tradeoff between merged (cheaper) and separate (higher quality) agent execution. Gates mode switches on rolling quality metrics and finds that more context in merged calls can worsen rather than help.

entry.title: Spectral Graph Sparsification Preserves Representation Geometry in Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Sanjukta Krishnagopal

entry.summary: Proves that spectral graph sparsification preserves the geometry of learned GNN embeddings, showing O(epsilon) perturbations in filters, representations, and Gram matrices for polynomial-filter GNNs.

entry.title: RamanBench: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Machine Learning on Raman Spectroscopy

author.name: Mario Koddenbrock, Christoph Lange, Robin Legner, Martin J\"ager, Martin K\"ogler, Mariano N. Cruz Bournazou, Peter Neubauer, Felix Biessmann, Erik Rodner

entry.summary: RamanBench introduces the first large-scale reproducible benchmark for ML on Raman spectroscopy, unifying 74 datasets across four domains with 325,668 spectra, standardized evaluation protocols, and a live leaderboard.

entry.title: Measuring Differences between Conditional Distributions using Kernel Embeddings

author.name: Peter Moskvichev, Siu Lun Chau, Dino Sejdinovic

entry.summary: Establishes a unified framework for kernel-based conditional maximum mean discrepancy (CMMD), providing coherent theoretical treatment of previously fragmented methods for comparing conditional distributions.

entry.title: SCARV: Structure-Constrained Aggregation for Stable Sample Ranking in Redundant NLP Datasets

author.name: Xu Zheng, Feiyu Wu, Linhong Wu, Zhuocheng Wang, Hui Li

entry.summary: Proposes SCARV, a framework for stable sample-level ranking in redundant NLP datasets. Combines robust multi-seed aggregation with structure-aware allocation to handle duplicates, near-duplicates, and paraphrases that cause unstable orderings.

entry.title: InterPhys: Physics-aware Human Motion Synthesis in a Dynamic Scene

author.name: Chaoyue Xing, Wei Mao, Miaomiao Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a physics-aware human motion generation framework that explicitly models full spectrum of human-related forces (human-object, human-scene, internal body dynamics) in dynamic scenes, using soft physical constraints for force and torque balance.

entry.title: Recall to Predict: Grounding Motion Forecasting in Interpretable Motion Bank

author.name: Abhishek Vivekanandan, Ahmed Abouelazm, J. Marius Z\"ollner

entry.summary: Proposes a motion forecasting framework grounded in a 'motion bank' - a structured embedding space of physically realizable trajectories - using contrastive learning and a novel Anchor Retrieval Layer with Dual-Level Gated Cross-Attention.

entry.title: Registration-Free Learnable Multi-View Capture of Faces in Dense Semantic Correspondence

author.name: Panagiotis P. Filntisis, George Retsinas, Radek Dan\v{e}\v{c}ek, Vanessa Sklyarova, Petros Maragos, Timo Bolkart

entry.summary: Presents MOCHI, a multi-view 3D face prediction framework that trains without registered data by enforcing topological consistency through pseudo-linear inverse kinematics and 2D landmark-guided semantic alignment.

entry.title: Towards Visual Query Localization in the 3D World

author.name: Liang Peng, Bohan Tan, Zhipeng Zhang, Haobo Li, Yifan Jiao, Xingping Dong, Libo Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces 3DVQL, the first benchmark for visual query localization in 3D space with 2,002 sequences, multiple modalities (point clouds, RGB, depth), supporting research on spatio-temporal localization in 3D environments.

entry.title: Decouple and Cache: KV Cache Construction for Streaming Video Understanding

author.name: Zhanzhong Pang, Dibyadip Chatterjee, Fadime Sener, Angela Yao

entry.summary: DSCache proposes a training-free decoupled cache construction mechanism for streaming video understanding that adapts pretrained offline models to unbounded video streams, separating the concerns of what to cache from how to evict.

entry.title: Enhancing Multimodal In-Context Learning via Inductive-Deductive Reasoning

author.name: Haoyu Wang, Haonan Wang, Yuyan Chen, Jun Chen, Gang Liu, Qian Wang, Jiahong Yan, Yanghua Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes restructuring multimodal in-context learning as an inductive-deductive process to address the gap where models produce correct answers from flawed reasoning, also tackling redundant visual tokens and skewed attention.

entry.title: Active Sampling for Ultra-Low-Bit-Rate Video Compression via Conditional Controlled Diffusion

author.name: Amirhosein Javadi, Shirin Saeedi Bidokhti, Tara Javidi

entry.summary: ActDiff-VC presents a diffusion-based ultra-low-bitrate video compression framework that partitions videos into variable-length segments, transmits keyframes only when needed, and uses tracked point trajectories to condition frame synthesis.

entry.title: To Do or Not to Do: Ensuring the Safety of Visuomotor Policies Learned from Demonstrations

author.name: Riad Ahmed, Moniruzzaman Akash, Momotaz Begum

entry.summary: Addresses safety-performance trade-off in imitation learning for field robotics, arguing that robots should not execute policies when safety cannot be guaranteed, establishing safety definitions for IL.

entry.title: ESARBench: A Benchmark for Agentic UAV Embodied Search and Rescue

author.name: Daoxuan Zhang, Ping Chen, Jianyi Zhou, Shuo Yang

entry.summary: ESARBench introduces a benchmark for embodied UAV search and rescue requiring autonomous exploration, clue identification, and victim location reasoning using multimodal LLMs.

entry.title: Hyp2Former: Hierarchy-Aware Hyperbolic Embeddings for Open-Set Panoptic Segmentation

author.name: Yao Lu, Rohit Mohan, Florian Drews, Yakov Miron, Abhinav Valada

entry.summary: Hyp2Former proposes hyperbolic embeddings for open-set panoptic segmentation, encoding hierarchical semantic similarities to distinguish unknown objects without explicit modeling of unknowns during training.

entry.title: Assistance Without Interruption: A Benchmark and LLM-based Framework for Non-Intrusive Human-Robot Assistance

author.name: Yuedi Zhang, Shuanghao Bai, Wanqi Zhou, Haoran Zhang, Qi Zhang, Zhirong Luan, Badong Chen

entry.summary: Formalizes non-intrusive assistance as an HRI paradigm where robots proactively help humans without interrupting ongoing activities, establishing NIABench simulation benchmark and new evaluation metrics.

entry.title: TUR-DPO: Topology- and Uncertainty-Aware Direct Preference Optimization

author.name: Abdulhady Abas Abdullah, Fatemeh Daneshfar, Seyedali Mirjalili, Mourad Oussalah

entry.summary: TUR-DPO extends Direct Preference Optimization by incorporating reasoning topology and uncertainty awareness. It rewards how answers are derived, not just what they say, using lightweight reasoning topologies combined with semantic faithfulness and utility into a calibrated uncertainty signal.

entry.title: TimeRFT: Stimulating Generalizable Time Series Forecasting for TSFMs via Reinforcement Finetuning

author.name: Siyang Li, Yize Chen, Zijie Zhu, Yuxin Pan, Yan Guo, Ming Huang, Hui Xiong

entry.summary: TimeRFT applies reinforcement learning finetuning to Time Series Foundation Models to improve generalization across downstream forecasting tasks. Addresses distribution shift and varying data availability challenges that supervised finetuning methods struggle with.

entry.title: XekRung Technical Report

author.name: Jiutian Zeng, Junjie Li, Chengwei Dai, Jie Liang, Zhaoyu Hu, Yiliang Zhang, Ziang Weng, Longtao Huang, Dongjie Zhang, Libin Dong, Yang Ge, Yuanda Wang, Kaiwen Lv Kacuila, Bingyu Zhu, Jing Wang, Jin Xu

entry.summary: XekRung is a frontier LLM for cybersecurity with diverse data synthesis pipelines, complete training pipeline (CPT, SFT, RL), and multi-dimensional evaluation. Designed for comprehensive security capabilities.

entry.title: The $\textit{Silicon Society}$ Cookbook: Design Space of LLM-based Social Simulations

author.name: Aur\'elien B\"uck-Kaeffer (McGill University, Mila - Quebec Artificial Intelligence Institute, Ubisoft La Forge), Sneheel Sarangi (McGill University, Mila - Quebec Artificial Intelligence Institute), Maximilian Puelma Touzel (McGill University, Universit\'e de Montr\'eal), Reihaneh Rabbany (McGill University, Mila - Quebec Artificial Intelligence Institute), Zachary Yang (McGill University, Mila - Quebec Artificial Intelligence Institute, Ubisoft La Forge), Jean-Fran\c{c}ois Godbout (Mila - Quebec Artificial Intelligence Institute, Universit\'e de Montr\'eal)

entry.summary: Systematically analyzes the design space of LLM-based social simulations ('Silicon Societies'), examining consequences of base model choice and agent connectivity. Finds non-trivial geometry in the design space using surveys as proxy for agent opinions.

entry.title: MemRouter: Memory-as-Embedding Routing for Long-Term Conversational Agents

author.name: Tianyu Hu, Weikai Lin, Weizhi Zhang, Jing Ma, Song Wang

entry.summary: MemRouter decouples memory admission from answer generation in long-term conversational agents. Uses embedding-based routing with lightweight classification heads (12M parameters) instead of autoregressive LLM generation for memory management decisions.

entry.title: Skills as Verifiable Artifacts: A Trust Schema and a Biconditional Correctness Criterion for Human-in-the-Loop Agent Runtimes

author.name: Alfredo Metere

entry.summary: Proposes treating agent skills as untrusted code that requires verification before runtime loading, establishing a trust schema and biconditional correctness criterion for human-in-the-loop agent systems.

entry.title: Scalable Context-Aware Graph Attention for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection in Large-Scale Mobile Networks

author.name: Sara Malacarne, Eirik Hoel-H{\o}iseth, Erlend Aune, David Zsolt Bir\'o, Massimiliano Ruocco

entry.summary: Proposes C-MTAD-GAT, an unsupervised anomaly detection framework for large-scale mobile networks that combines temporal and feature-wise graph attention with context conditioning to operate as a shared model across many network elements.

entry.title: BlenderRAG: High-Fidelity 3D Object Generation via Retrieval-Augmented Code Synthesis

author.name: Massimo Rondelli, Francesco Pivi, Maurizio Gabbrielli

entry.summary: Presents BlenderRAG, a retrieval-augmented generation system for 3D object creation that uses a curated multimodal dataset of 500 examples to improve Blender code generation success rates from 40.8% to 70.0%.

entry.title: Born-Qualified: An Autonomous Framework for Deploying Advanced Energy and Electronic Materials

author.name: Steven R. Spurgeon, Milad Abolhasani, Frederick Baddour, Ryan B. Comes, Vinayak P. Dravid, Hilary Egan, Patrick Emami, Robert W. Epps, Davi M. F\'ebba, Renae Gannon, E. Ashley Gaulding, Ayana Ghosh, Kenny Gruchalla, Grace Guinan, Taro Hitosugi, Michael Holden, Sergei V. Kalinin, Yangang Liang, John S. Mangum, Matthew J. Olszta, Nathaniel H. Park, Axel Palmstrom, Michelle A. Smeaton, Brooks Tellekamp, Nicholas E. Thornburg, Raymond R. Unocic, Daniela Ushizima, Rama K. Vasudevan, Robert White, Andrew Young, Andriy Zakutayev

entry.summary: Proposes 'born-qualified' autonomous materials development that embeds manufacturability, cost, and durability constraints from the outset, addressing the 'valley of death' between lab discovery and industrial deployment.

entry.title: Reinforcement Learning with Markov Risk Measures and Multipattern Risk Approximation

author.name: Andrzej Ruszczynski, Tiangang Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces mini-batch risk measures and multipattern risk-averse problems for risk-averse MDPs, proving regret bounds for a Q-learning method with multipattern approximation.

entry.title: Meritocratic Fairness in Budgeted Combinatorial Multi-armed Bandits via Shapley Values

author.name: Shradha Sharma, Swapnil Dhamal, Shweta Jain

entry.summary: Proposes K-Shapley value for meritocratic fairness in budgeted combinatorial multi-armed bandits with full-bandit feedback, proving uniqueness properties and designing a fairness-aware algorithm.

entry.title: Directed Social Regard: Surfacing Targeted Advocacy, Opposition, Aid, Harms, and Victimization in Online Media

author.name: Scott Friedman, Ruta Wheelock, Sonja Schmer-Galunder, Drisana Iverson, Jake Vasilakes, Joan Zheng, Jeffrey Rye, Vasanth Sarathy, Christopher Miller

entry.summary: Presents Directed Social Regard (DSR), an NLP approach for multi-dimensional sentiment analysis that detects span-level targets of both pro-social and anti-social sentiments coexisting in the same message.

entry.title: Fast Log-Domain Sinkhorn Optimal Transport with Warp-Level GPU Reductions

author.name: Hao Xiao

entry.summary: Presents FastSinkhorn, a native CUDA implementation of log-domain Sinkhorn using warp-level shuffle reductions and shared-memory tiling, achieving high GPU utilization with numerical stability for small regularization.

entry.title: Graph Rewiring in GNNs to Mitigate Over-Squashing and Over-Smoothing: A Survey

author.name: Hugo Attali, Nathalie Pernelle, Davide Buscaldi, Fragkiskos D. Malliaros

entry.summary: Surveys graph rewiring techniques designed to mitigate over-squashing and over-smoothing in GNNs, providing comprehensive review of approaches and their theoretical foundations.

entry.title: Networked Information Aggregation for Binary Classification

author.name: MohammadHossein Bateni, Zahra Hadizadeh, MohammadTaghi Hajiaghayi, Mahdi JafariRaviz, Shayan Taherijam

entry.summary: Studies networked binary classification on DAGs where agents with partial feature access sequentially share predictions, proving conditions for information aggregation in logistic regression settings.

entry.title: Forager: a lightweight testbed for continual learning with partial observability in RL

author.name: Steven Tang, Xinze Xiong, Anna Hakhverdyan, Andrew Patterson, Jacob Adkins, Jiamin He, Esraa Elelimy, Parham Mohammad Panahi, Martha White, Adam White

entry.summary: Introduces Forager, a lightweight partially-observable environment for continual reinforcement learning that emphasizes the role of memory/recurrence, addressing the gap where most CRL experiments focus only on plasticity loss in fully observable settings.

entry.title: Robust Parameter Learning for Uncertain MDPs

author.name: Yannik Schnitzer, Alessandro Abate, David Parker

entry.summary: Proposes learning parametric MDPs (pMDPs) for robust verification of unknown MDPs, projecting statistical uncertainty onto the parameter space to capture dependencies between transition probabilities that interval-based methods miss.

entry.title: PACE: Parameter Change for Unsupervised Environment Design

author.name: Fang Yuan, Quanjun Yin, Siqi Shen, Yuxiang Xie, Junqiang Yang, Long Qin, Junjie Zeng, Qinglun Li

entry.summary: Proposes PACE for unsupervised environment design in RL, evaluating environments by the policy parameter change they induce rather than indirect proxy signals like regret or value errors.

entry.title: Evaluating LLMs on Large-Scale Graph Property Estimation via Random Walks

author.name: Sunil Kumar Maurya, Xin Liu

entry.summary: Evaluates LLMs' ability to estimate large-scale graph properties using random walk-based representations that fit within context length, creating benchmarks that test reasoning on realistic-scale graphs rather than tiny synthetic ones.

entry.title: Chebyshev-Augmented One-Shot Transfer Learning for PINNs on Nonlinear Differential Equations

author.name: Yiqi Rao, Pavlos Protopapas

entry.summary: Extends one-shot transfer learning for PINNs to nonlinear differential equations using Chebyshev polynomial augmentation, enabling closed-form adaptation that was previously unavailable due to nonconvex output-layer optimization.

entry.title: Stability and Generalization for Decentralized Markov SGD

author.name: Jiahuan Wang, Ziqing Wen, Ping Luo, Dongsheng Li, Tao Sun

entry.summary: Analyzes stability and generalization of decentralized SGD and SGDA under Markov chain sampling, characterizing how Markovian dependence and decentralized communication jointly influence generalization through network topology and mixing.

entry.title: PepSpecBench: A Unified Evaluation Benchmark for Peptide Tandem Mass Spectrometry Prediction

author.name: Zhiwen Yang, Pan Liu, Yifan Li, Yunhua Zhong, Jun Xia

entry.summary: PepSpecBench provides the first unified benchmark for ML-based peptide tandem mass spectrometry prediction, addressing inconsistent preprocessing, flawed data splitting that permits sequence leakage, and lack of cross-species evaluation. Unifies evaluation across the computational proteomics field.

entry.title: Towards Systematic Generalization for Power Grid Optimization Problems

author.name: Zeeshan Memon, Yijiang Li, Hongwei Jin, Kibaek Kim, Liang Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes a learning framework that jointly models AC Optimal Power Flow and Security-Constrained Unit Commitment through shared representations, enabling systematic generalization across these related power grid optimization problems.

entry.title: LUMINA: A Grid Foundation Model for Benchmarking AC Optimal Power Flow Surrogate Learning

author.name: Hongwei Jin, Keunju Song, Zeeshan Memon, Yijiang Li, Stefano Fenu, Hongseok Kim, Liang Zhao, Kibaek Kim

entry.summary: LUMINA-Bench provides a comprehensive benchmark for ACOPF surrogate learning covering multi-topology pretraining, transfer, and adaptation, with unified metrics capturing both predictive accuracy and physics constraint violations.

entry.title: HELIX: Hybrid Encoding with Learnable Identity and Cross-dimensional Synthesis for Time Series Imputation

author.name: Fengming Zhang, Wenjie Du, Huan Zhang, Ke Yu, Shen Qu

entry.summary: HELIX proposes learnable feature identity embeddings for time series imputation that serve as persistent anchors across attention layers, enabling consistent feature dependency learning without predefined graph topology.

entry.title: Graph Federated Unlearning for Privacy Preservation

author.name: Ruotong Ma, Wentao Yu, Qizhou Wang, Jie Yang, Chen Gong

entry.summary: Explores machine unlearning for graph federated learning to address privacy leakage during user withdrawal, proposing methods to thoroughly remove user information while mitigating performance degradation.

entry.title: Bolek: A Multimodal Language Model for Molecular Reasoning

author.name: Frederic Grabowski, Jacek Szczerbi\'nski, Maciej Ja\'skowski, Kalina Jasi\'nska-Kobus, Pawe{\l} D\k{a}browski-Tuma\'nski, Tomasz Jetka, Bartosz Topolski

entry.summary: Introduces Bolek, a compact multimodal language model that grounds molecular reasoning in structure by injecting Morgan fingerprint embeddings into a text decoder. Fine-tuned on molecular alignment tasks and evaluated on drug discovery classification with chain-of-thought reasoning anchored in molecular properties.

entry.title: Synthetic Designed Experiments for Diagnosing Vision Model Failure

author.name: Krisanu Sarkar
