entry.summary: Proposes using Design of Experiments (DoE) methodology with synthetic data to systematically diagnose vision model failure modes, treating the model as a black-box and the generator as experimental apparatus. Efficiently audits model robustness through fractional factorial designs.

entry.title: Stabilizing Private LASSO under Heterogeneous Covariates via Anisotropic Objective Perturbation

author.name: Haruka Tanzawa, Ayaka Sakata

entry.summary: Studies high-dimensional LASSO under differential privacy with heterogeneous covariate scales. Proposes Gram-based anisotropic objective perturbation to counteract distortion from covariate structure, analyzed via Approximate Message Passing.

entry.title: PRCD-MAP: Learning How Much to Trust Imperfect Priors in Causal Discovery

author.name: Xihang Shan, Da Zhou

entry.summary: PRCD-MAP assigns per-edge trust to imperfect priors in causal discovery using empirical Bayes calibration. Addresses heterogeneous reliability of different prior sources (e.g., physical laws vs LLM-suggested edges).

entry.title: Adaptive Estimation and Inference in Semi-parametric Heterogeneous Clustered Multitask Learning via Neyman Orthogonality

author.name: Hanxiao Chen, Debarghya Mukherjee

entry.summary: Studies clustered multitask learning in semiparametric settings with heterogeneous nuisance components. Proposes adaptive fused orthogonal estimator integrating Neyman-orthogonal losses with data-driven fusion penalties.

entry.title: MIRA: A Score for Conditional Distribution Accuracy and Model Comparison

author.name: Sammy Sharief, Justine Zeghal, Gabriel Missael Barco, Pablo Lemos, Yashar Hezaveh, Laurence Perreault-Levasseur

entry.summary: Introduces MIRA, a sample-based score for assessing conditional distribution accuracy using joint samples from the true data-generating process. Enables Bayesian model comparison through conditional distribution alignment.

entry.title: Denoising data using convex relaxations

author.name: Charles Fefferman, Aalok Gangopadhyay, Matti Lassas, Jonathan Marty, Hariharan Narayanan

entry.summary: Proposes a convex-relaxation denoiser for manifold-structured data using PCA projection followed by convex hull projection, with finite-sample guarantees using empirical Gaussian tail probabilities.

entry.title: FitText: Evolving Agent Tool Ecologies via Memetic Retrieval

author.name: Kyle Zheng, Han Zhang, Renliang Sun, Chenchen Ye, Wei Wang

entry.summary: FitText makes tool retrieval dynamic by generating natural-language pseudo-tool descriptions as retrieval probes within the agent's reasoning loop, refined via memetic retrieval with evolutionary selection.

entry.title: Learning Equivariant Neural-Augmented Object Dynamics From Few Interactions

author.name: Sergio Orozco, Tushar Kusnur, Brandon May, George Konidaris, Laura Herlant

entry.summary: PIEGraph combines analytical physics (spring-mass systems) with graph neural networks for learning object dynamics from limited real-world interaction data, handling both rigid and deformable bodies with SE(3) equivariance.

entry.title: Robust and Fast Training via Per-Sample Clipping

author.name: Davide Nobile, Philipp Grohs

entry.summary: Proposes PS-Clip-SGD, a per-sample gradient clipping method that achieves optimal convergence rates for non-convex optimization under heavy-tailed gradient noise, with matching high-probability guarantees.

entry.title: On Stable Long-Form Generation: Benchmarking and Mitigating Length Volatility

author.name: Zhitao He, Haolin Yang, Rui Min, Zeyu Qin, Yi R. Fung

entry.summary: VOLTBench benchmarks length volatility in long-form LLM generation, identifies architectural causes through attention analysis, and proposes mitigation strategies for more stable outputs.

entry.title: Verbal-R3: Verbal Reranker as the Missing Bridge between Retrieval and Reasoning

author.name: Sangkwon Park, Donghun Kang, Jisoo Mok, Sungroh Yoon

entry.summary: Verbal-R3 introduces 'Verbal Annotations' - analytic narratives explaining the connection between queries and retrieved documents - to bridge retrieval and LLM reasoning in RAG systems.

entry.title: Where Do Prompt Perturbations Break Generation? A Segment-Level View of Robustness in LoRA-Tuned Language Models

author.name: Zhuoyun Li, Boxuan Wang, Jinwei Hu, Zhenglin Huang, Qisong He, Xinmiao Huang, Guangliang Cheng, Xiaowei Huang, Yi Dong

entry.summary: S²R² introduces segment-level robustness analysis and regularization for LoRA fine-tuned models, using optimal transport to align semantic segments and penalize meaning drift under prompt perturbations.

entry.title: Beyond Perplexity: Character Distribution Signatures and the MDTA Benchmark for AI Text Detection

author.name: Priyadarshan Narayanasamy, Swastik Agrawal, Klint Faber, Fardina Fathmiul Alam

entry.summary: Proposes character distribution signatures as AI text detection signals, arguing AI models approximate global character patterns while humans exhibit domain-specialized distributions, creating a detection 'Wall of Separation'.

entry.title: ARGUS: Policy-Adaptive Ad Governance via Evolving Reinforcement with Adversarial Umpiring

author.name: Deyi Ji, Junyu Lu, Xuanyi Liu, Liqun Liu, Hailong Zhang, Peng Shu, Huan Yu, Jie Jiang, Tianru Chen, Lanyun Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes ARGUS, a policy-adaptive ad governance system using multi-agent adversarial umpiring for evolving advertising regulations. Uses a three-stage framework with Prosecutor-Defender-Umpire architecture to resolve conflicts between stale labels and new mandates.

entry.title: Virtual Speech Therapist: A Clinician-in-the-Loop AI Speech Therapy Agent for Personalized and Supervised Therapy

author.name: Shakeel Sheikh, Patrick Marmaroli, MD Sahidullah, Slim Ouni, Fabrice Hirsch, Goncalo Leal, Bjorn W Schuller

entry.summary: Develops Virtual Speech Therapist (VST), an agent-based platform for stuttering assessment and therapy planning. Integrates deep learning stuttering classification with multi-agent LLM reasoning for evidence-based clinical decision-making.

entry.title: Moira: Language-driven Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Pair Trading

author.name: Polydoros Giannouris, Yuechen Jiang, Lingfei Qian, Yuyan Wang, Xueqing Peng, Jimin Huang, Guojun Xiong, Sophia Ananiadou

entry.summary: Proposes Moira, a hierarchical RL framework for pair trading using language-driven optimization. Both high-level (asset pair selection) and low-level (execution) policies are parameterized by LLMs.

entry.title: LLM-Augmented Semantic Steering of Text Embedding Projection Spaces

author.name: Wei Liu, Eric Krokos, Kirsten Whitley, Rebecca Faust, Chris North

entry.summary: Introduces LLM-augmented semantic steering for text embedding projections, where analysts express intent by grouping documents and an LLM externalizes this as natural language to guide the projection organization.

entry.title: When Audio-Language Models Fail to Leverage Multimodal Context for Dysarthric Speech Recognition

author.name: Pehu\'en Moure, Niclas Pokel, Bilal Bounajma, Yingqiang Gao, Roman Boehringer, Longbiao Cheng, Shih-Chii Liu

entry.summary: Benchmarks whether audio-language models can leverage clinical context (diagnosis labels, speech ratings, clinical descriptions) to improve automatic speech recognition for dysarthric speech. Finds current models cannot meaningfully use this context, revealing a gap in multimodal grounding capabilities.

entry.title: When To Adapt? Adapting the Model or Data in Federated Medical Imaging

author.name: Chamani Shiranthika, Parvaneh Saeedi

entry.summary: Systematic comparison of model-side personalization vs. data-side harmonization strategies for federated learning across six medical imaging settings, providing practical guidance on when to adapt models vs. data.

entry.title: Phase-map synthesis from magnitude-only MR images using conditional score-based diffusion models with application in training of accelerated MRI reconstruction models

author.name: M. Berk Sahin, Dilek Yalcinkaya, Abolfazl Hashemi, Behzad Sharif

entry.summary: Proposes using conditional score-based diffusion models to synthesize realistic phase maps from magnitude-only MR images, enabling the use of large magnitude-only image databases for training accelerated MRI reconstruction models.

entry.title: SIFT-VTON: Geometric Correspondence Supervision on Cross-Attention for Virtual Try-On

author.name: Kosuke Takemoto, Takafumi Koshinaka

entry.summary: Proposes SIFT-VTON, using SIFT keypoint matching to provide explicit geometric guidance for diffusion-based virtual try-on, converting correspondences into spatial probability distributions that supervise cross-attention layers.

entry.title: PACE: Post-Causal Entropy Modeling for Learned LiDAR Point Cloud Compression

author.name: Jiahao Zhu, Kang You, Dandan Ding, Zhan Ma

entry.summary: Proposes PACE for LiDAR point cloud compression, reformulating context modeling with a non-causal backbone and lightweight causal prediction heads, enabling stage-scalable latency control from a single model.

entry.title: CHASE: Competing Hypotheses for Ambiguity-Aware Selective Prediction

author.name: Kartik Jhawar, Yuhao Geng, Atul N. Parikh, Lipo Wang

entry.summary: Introduces CHASE, a selective prediction framework that compares structured temporal hypotheses to determine whether to commit or abstain under partial observability, where standard confidence scores become misleading.

entry.title: AttnRouter: Per-Category Attention Routing for Training-Free Image Editing on MMDiT

author.name: Guandong Li, Mengxia Ye

entry.summary: Introduces AttnRouter for training-free image editing on MMDiT (Qwen-Image-Edit), proposing KVInject for single-forward attention manipulation and a per-category routing table that selects different attention operations for different edit types.

entry.title: SurgCheck: Do Vision-Language Models Really Look at Images in Surgical VQA?

author.name: Jongmin Shin, Ka Young Kim, Eunki Cho, Seong Tae Kim, Namkee Oh

entry.summary: SurgCheck introduces a diagnostic benchmark for quantifying linguistic shortcut reliance in surgical VQA, using paired questions that remove entity names to test whether VLMs truly use visual understanding or rely on linguistic biases.

entry.title: Multi-Rater Calibrated Segmentation Models

author.name: Meritxell Riera-Mar\'in, Javier Garc\'ia L\'opez, J\'ulia Rodr\'iguez-Comas, Miguel A. Gonz\'alez Ballester, Adrian Galdran

entry.summary: Improves medical image segmentation calibration by reformulating multi-rater supervision as ordinal learning, treating voxel-wise annotator agreement as ordered targets to link predictive confidence to empirical annotation reliability.

entry.title: Multi-View Hierarchical Representation Learning of Fetal Hemodynamics for Maternal Hypertension Detection at the Edge

author.name: Alireza Rafiei, Anah\'i Venzor Strader, Esteban Castro Arag\'on, Victoriana Rosibely Sut Serech, Enma Carolina Coyote Ixen, Reza Sameni, Peter Rohloff, Gari D. Clifford, Nasim Katebi

entry.summary: AutoHyPE develops a hierarchical attention network for detecting maternal hypertension from fetal Doppler ultrasound, tested on 3,255 pregnant women in rural Guatemala. Demonstrates that fetal cardiovascular signals encode maternal hemodynamic markers.

entry.title: Continuous quantification of viral plaque dynamics using ultra-large-area label-free imaging enables rapid antiviral susceptibility testing

author.name: Merve Eryilmaz, Yuzhu Li, Xiao Wang, Max Zhang, Alp Inegol, Zixiang Ji, Lucas Thai, Guangdong Ma, Akihiko Fujisawa, Kazunori Yamaguchi, Aydogan Ozcan

entry.summary: Introduces a label-free, time-resolved plaque reduction assay platform using lens-free imaging and deep learning for continuous quantification of viral plaque dynamics, enabling rapid antiviral susceptibility testing.

entry.title: AnchorD: Metric Grounding of Monocular Depth Using Factor Graphs

author.name: Simon Dorer, Martin B\"uchner, Nick Heppert, Abhinav Valada

entry.summary: AnchorD proposes a training-free framework for grounding monocular depth estimation in raw sensor depth through patch-wise affine alignment via factor graph optimization, addressing metric accuracy issues for robotics.

entry.title: ARIS: Agentic and Relationship Intelligence System for Social Robots

author.name: Stavya Datta, Fucai Ke, Leimin Tian, Hamid Rezatofighi

entry.summary: ARIS presents an agentic AI framework for social robots combining multimodal reasoning, graph-based Social World Model, and RAG for sustained multi-turn engagement. User study (N=23) shows significantly higher perceived intelligence.

entry.title: Dynamics Distillation for Efficient and Transferable Control Learning

author.name: Xunjiang Gu, Kashyap Chitta, Mahsa Golchoubian, Vladimir Suplin, Igor Gilitschenski

entry.summary: Introduces Sim2Sim2Sim, a framework that distills high-fidelity vehicle simulation dynamics into parallelizable learned models for reinforcement learning policy training. Demonstrates that predictive accuracy alone doesn't characterize a learned dynamics model's utility for control.

entry.title: Stability of Control Lyapunov Function Guided Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zachary Olkin, William D. Compton, Aaron D. Ames

entry.summary: Investigates stability properties of CLF-guided reinforcement learning (CLF-RL) policies, bridging experimentally observed stability with theoretical guarantees. Views RL as optimal control and establishes exponential stability conditions.

entry.title: A decoupled diffusion planner that adapts to changing cost limits by using cost-conditioned generation for safety and reward gradients for performance

author.name: Rufeng Chen, Zhaofan Zhang, Zhejiang Yang, Hechang Chen, Sihong Xie

entry.summary: Proposes Safe Decoupled Guidance Diffusion (SDGD) for offline safe RL, which separates cost-conditioning (for safety compliance) from reward gradients (for performance) in diffusion-based trajectory planners. Enables adaptation to varying safety budgets at deployment time.

entry.title: A Semi-Supervised Kernel Two-Sample Test

author.name: Gyumin Lee, Shubhanshu Shekhar, Ilmun Kim

entry.summary: Proposes a semi-supervised kernel two-sample test that leverages unlabeled covariate data to boost testing power while maintaining calibration through asymptotic normality.

entry.title: Stable Blanket with Hidden Variables and Cycles

author.name: Hanqing Xiang

entry.summary: Studies stable blankets (predictors with invariant conditional relationships) in causal models with hidden variables and cycles, extending existing characterizations beyond simple SCMs.

entry.title: When Correct Isn't Usable: Improving Structured Output Reliability in Small Language Models

author.name: Cosimo Galeone, Minsu Park, Giuseppe Ettorre, Daniele Ligorio

entry.summary: Studies structured-output reliability in small language models on math benchmarks, finding severe format failures (85% task accuracy but 0% output accuracy with naive prompting) and proposing prompting strategies.

entry.title: ScribbleEdit: Synthetic Data for Image Editing with Scribbles and Text

author.name: Anya Ji, George Ma, T\'ea Wright, Yiming Zhang, David Chan, Alane Suhr, Somayeh Sojoudi

entry.summary: Introduces ScribbleEdit, a synthetic data generation pipeline for training image editing models that combine scribble-based spatial input with text-based semantic instructions, addressing the lack of specialized training data for joint interpretation.

entry.title: Sparse Representation Learning for Vessels

author.name: Chinmay Prabhakar, Bastian Wittmann, Paul B\"uschl, Hongwei Bran Li, Bjoern Menze, Suprosanna Shit

entry.summary: Proposes VAEsselSparse, using sparse convolutions and attention for efficient representation learning of entire organ-level vascular networks at sub-millimeter resolution, achieving 8x8x8 compression rates.

entry.title: MOC-3D: Manifold-Order Consistency for Text-to-3D Generation

author.name: Chenyang Fan, Junshi Cheng, Wen Yang, Zihong Li, Wenfeng Zhang, Wei Hu, Yi Zhang, Pan Zeng

entry.summary: MOC-3D addresses the Janus problem and geometric discontinuity in text-to-3D generation by proposing manifold-order consistency constraints that enforce topological and geometric coherence during SDS-based optimization.

entry.title: SimPB++: Simultaneously Detecting 2D and 3D Objects from Multiple Cameras

author.name: Yingqi Tang, Zhaotie Meng, Erkang Cheng, Haibin Ling

entry.summary: SimPB++ simultaneously detects 2D objects in perspective view and 3D objects in BEV from multiple cameras, with a hybrid decoder enabling deep 3D-2D-3D cyclic refinement through Dynamic Query Allocation and Adaptive Query Aggregation.

entry.title: ProtoFair: Fair Self-Supervised Contrastive Learning via Pseudo-Counterfactual Pairs

author.name: Marah Halawa, Olaf Hellwich

entry.summary: ProtoFair proposes a fairness-aware contrastive loss that works alongside existing SSL objectives without modifying them, using prototype clustering to identify pseudo-counterfactual pairs across sensitive groups.

entry.title: Fine-Tuning Impairs the Balancedness of Foundation Models in Long-tailed Personalized Federated Learning

author.name: Shihao Hou, Chikai Shang, Zhiheng Yang, Jiacheng Yang, Xinyi Shang, Junlong Gao, Yiqun Zhang, Yang Lu

entry.summary: Investigates how fine-tuning degrades the class balance inherent in foundation models for long-tailed personalized federated learning, showing that conventional personalization techniques transfer bias to local models.

entry.title: SpectraDINO: Bridging the Spectral Gap in Vision Foundation Models via Lightweight Adapters

author.name: Yagiz Nalcakan, Hyeongjin Ju, Incheol Park, Sanghyeop Yeo, Youngwan Jin, Shiho Kim

entry.summary: SpectraDINO extends DINOv2 to multispectral modalities (NIR, SWIR, LWIR) through lightweight per-modality bottleneck adapters while preserving the frozen RGB backbone's representations.

entry.title: SIAM: Head and Brain MRI Segmentation from Few High-Quality Templates via Synthetic Training

author.name: Romain Valabregue, Ines Khemir, Eric Badinet, Fran\c{c}ois Rousseau, Guillaume Auzias, Reuben Dorent

entry.summary: SIAM achieves whole-head MRI segmentation of 16 anatomical structures using only six manually annotated templates through domain randomization in both intensity and shape domains for synthetic training.

entry.title: HumanSplatHMR: Closing the Loop Between Human Mesh Recovery and Gaussian Splatting Avatar

author.name: Yeheng Zong, Pou-Chun Kung, Yike Pan, Seth Isaacson, Yizhou Chen, Ram Vasudevan, Katherine A. Skinner

entry.summary: HumanSplatHMR jointly optimizes 3D human poses and Gaussian Splatting avatars from video, demonstrating that existing methods don't accurately recover 3D human geometry due to overfitting to 2D views or separate treatment of pose and appearance.

entry.title: Reconstruction Interval Z-Phase Dependence of AI Detection Sensitivity in CT Lung Nodule Screening

author.name: Dan Soliman

entry.summary: Characterizes how AI lung nodule detection sensitivity depends on the z-phase (position within CT reconstruction cycle), identifying a previously unrecognized source of detection variability for deep learning systems.

entry.title: Temporally Consistent Object 6D Pose Estimation for Robot Control

author.name: Kateryna Zorina, Vojtech Priban, Mederic Fourmy, Josef Sivic, Vladimir Petrik

entry.summary: Develops a factor graph approach for temporally consistent 6D object pose estimation integrating motion models, uncertainty estimation, and online optimization for stable robot control feedback.

entry.title: A Principled Approach for Creating High-fidelity Synthetic Demonstrations for Imitation Learning

author.name: Moniruzzaman Akash, Momotaz Begum

entry.summary: Proposes principled synthetic demonstration generation for imitation learning that treats expert trajectories as strong priors, avoiding deviations from demonstrated paths that harm policy learning for contact-rich tasks.

entry.title: Sampling-Based Control via Entropy-Regularized Optimal Transport

author.name: Vincent Pacelli, Akash Ratheesh, Evangelos A. Theodorou

entry.summary: Introduces OT-MPC, a sampling-based model predictive control algorithm using entropy-regularized optimal transport to overcome mode-averaging problems in MPPI/CEM. Computes optimal couplings between candidate sequences and low-cost proposals.

entry.title: Semantic Context-aware mOdality fUsion Transformer (SCOUT): A Context-Aware Multimodal Transformer for Concept-Grounded Pathology Report Generation

author.name: Suryakant Singh, Saarthak Kapse, Joel Saltz, Prateek Prasanna

entry.summary: Presents SCOUT, a context-aware multimodal transformer for generating clinically grounded pathology reports from whole-slide images, integrating fine-grained cellular patterns with slide-level architecture and diagnostic concepts.

entry.title: PointCSP: Cross-Sample Semantic Propagation and Stability Preservation in Self-Supervised Point Cloud Learning

author.name: Xinxing Yu, Ajian Liu, Sunyuan Qiang, Hui Ma, Liying Yang, Yuzhong Wang, Zhi Rao, Yanyan Liang

entry.summary: PointCSP proposes cross-sample semantic propagation for point cloud self-supervised learning, where samples in a batch are serialized and processed by a state-space model to enable semantic state propagation between samples.

entry.title: SpecEdit: Training-Free Acceleration for Diffusion based Image Editing via Semantic Locking

author.name: Zhengan Yan, Shikang Zheng, Haoran Qin, Xiaobing Tu, Yinggui Wang, Jiacheng Liu, Jiaxuan Ren, Yuqi Lin, Peiliang Cai, Jinkui Ren, Xiantao Zhang, Linfeng Zhang

entry.summary: SpecEdit proposes a training-free dynamic-resolution framework for diffusion-based image editing that uses semantic locking to identify which regions actually require modification, avoiding redundant high-resolution computation.

entry.title: DirectEdit: Step-Level Accurate Inversion for Flow-Based Image Editing

author.name: Desong Yang, Mang Ye

entry.summary: DirectEdit proposes a step-level accurate inversion method for flow-based image editing that eliminates accumulated drift by systematically analyzing the inversion process in flow transformers, enabling high-fidelity reconstruction.

entry.title: ExpoCM: Exposure-Aware One-Step Generative Single-Image HDR Reconstruction

author.name: Aoyu Liu, Zhen Liu, Ziyi Wang, Dian Chen, Bing Zeng, Shuaicheng Liu

entry.summary: ExpoCM proposes a one-step generative HDR reconstruction framework that constructs exposure-aware consistency trajectories, addressing the exposure-dependent nature of degradation while avoiding iterative diffusion sampling costs.

entry.title: Pixel Perfect: Relational Image Quality Assessment with Spatially-Aware Distortions

author.name: Fadeel Sher Khan, Long N. Le, Abhinau K. Venkataramanan, Seok-Jun Lee, Hamid R. Sheikh

entry.summary: Proposes a relational image quality assessment approach that shifts from absolute MOS prediction to directional assessment, using self-supervised synthetic distortions and spatially-aware disentangled maps identifying type, intensity, and direction of distortions.

entry.title: AlbumFill: Album-Guided Reasoning and Retrieval for Personalized Image Completion

author.name: Yu-Ju Tsai, Brian Price, Qing Liu, Luis Figueroa, Daniil Pakhomov, Zhihong Ding, Scott Cohen, Ming-Hsuan Yang

entry.summary: AlbumFill is a training-free framework that retrieves identity-consistent references from personal photo albums for personalized image inpainting, using VLMs to infer missing semantic cues and guide composed image retrieval.

entry.title: Biological Spatial Priors Regularize Foundation Model Representations for Cross-Site MSI Generalization in Colorectal Cancer

author.name: Dasari Naga Raju

entry.summary: Investigates whether biological spatial priors (peripheral distance encoding reflecting Crohn's-like lymphocytic reaction) can guide foundation model representations toward site-invariant features for predicting microsatellite instability from histology.

entry.title: CoRAL: Contact-Rich Adaptive LLM-based Control for Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Berk \c{C}i\c{c}ek, Mert K. Er, \"Ozg\"ur S. \"O\u{g}\"uz

entry.summary: Proposes CoRAL, a framework where LLMs design cost functions for sampling-based motion planners (MPPI) to enable zero-shot planning for contact-rich manipulation. Decouples high-level LLM reasoning from low-level adaptive control.

entry.title: Putting HUMANS first: Efficient LAM Evaluation with Human Preference Alignment

author.name: Woody Haosheng Gan, William Held, Diyi Yang

entry.summary: Investigates whether minimal subsets can reliably evaluate Large Audio Models, finding that just 50 examples (0.3% of data) achieve >0.93 correlation with full benchmark scores. Also collects 776 human preference ratings to validate alignment with user satisfaction.

entry.title: Are You the A-hole? A Fair, Multi-Perspective Ethical Reasoning Framework

author.name: Sheza Munir, Ahanaf Rodoshi, Sumin Lee, Feiran Chang, Xujie Si, Syed Ishtiaque Ahmed

entry.summary: Proposes a neuro-symbolic aggregation framework using Weighted Maximum Satisfiability for resolving conflicting ethical judgments. Maps unstructured natural language explanations to logical predicates using LLMs, then optimizes consistency using the Z3 solver.

entry.title: REALM: An RGB and Event Aligned Latent Manifold for Cross-Modal Perception

author.name: Vincenzo Polizzi, David B. Lindell, Jonathan Kelly

entry.summary: REALM learns a cross-modal aligned latent space between RGB and event cameras using LoRA to bridge the modality gap. Projects event representations into pretrained RGB foundation model space, unlocking geometric and semantic priors for asynchronous event streams.

entry.title: VQ-SAD: Vector Quantized Structure Aware Diffusion For Molecule Generation

author.name: Farshad Noravesh, Reza Haffari, Layki Soon, Arghya Pal

entry.summary: VQ-SAD uses VQ-VAE codebooks as tokenizers for atom and bond types in a diffusion-based molecule generation model. Addresses information loss from one-hot representations and hash collisions from Morgan fingerprints.

entry.title: Space Network of Experts: Architecture and Expert Placement

author.name: Zhanwei Wang, Huiling Yang, Min Sheng, Khaled B. Letaief, Kaibin Huang

entry.summary: Proposes Space Network of Experts architecture for deploying LLMs on satellite networks, addressing the placement problem of partitioning and mapping model components to satellites with limited computing and communication resources.

entry.title: AI Washing Inflates Expected Performance but Not Interaction Outcomes: An AI Placebo Study Using Fitts' Law

author.name: Nick von Felten, Luisa Ella M\"uller, Johannes Sch\"oning

entry.summary: Studies 'AI washing' as an AI placebo effect using Fitts' Law tasks, finding that labeling a mouse as 'AI-assisted' inflates performance expectations but doesn't improve actual interaction outcomes.

entry.title: Polynomial-Time Optimal Group Selection via the Double-Commutator Eigenvalue Problem

author.name: Mitchell A. Thornton

entry.summary: Proves that the group selection problem in algebraic diversity framework reduces to a generalized eigenvalue problem from the double commutator of the covariance matrix, yielding polynomial-time complexity.

entry.title: Fusing Urban Structure and Semantics: A Conditional Diffusion Model for Cross-City OD Matrix Generation

author.name: Bin Chen, Zhuoya Meng, Fang Yang, Runkang Guo, Jingtao Ding, Yin Zhang, Chuan Ai, Zhengqiu Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes SEDAN, a conditional diffusion model for cross-city OD matrix generation that fuses urban structure (adjacency, distance) with semantic features (demographics, POI) for generalizable commuting flow modeling.

entry.title: Learning Discriminators for Resampling in the Ensemble Gaussian Mixture Filter through a Normalizing Flow Approach

author.name: Zain Jabbar, Andrey A. Popov

entry.summary: Introduces discriminator-informed resampling for the Ensemble Gaussian Mixture Filter using normalizing flows to accept/reject physically plausible particles during posterior resampling.

entry.title: Diffusion Operator Geometry of Feedforward Representations

author.name: Kanishka Reddy

entry.summary: Develops a smooth operator-theoretic framework using Gaussian-kernel diffusion Markov operators to study the geometry of feedforward neural network representations, as an alternative to discrete curvature approaches. Derives transport, spectral, and label-boundary observables from a single operator object.

entry.title: Autonomous Drift Learning in Data Streams: A Unified Perspective

author.name: Xiaoyu Yang, En Yu, Jie Lu

entry.summary: Proposes a three-dimensional taxonomy for concept drift encompassing time stream drift, model drift, and environment drift, providing a unified perspective for autonomous learning systems beyond traditional temporal non-stationarity.

entry.title: From Packets to Patterns: Interpreting Encrypted Network Traffic as Longitudinal Behavioral Signals

author.name: Rameen Mahmood, Omar El Shahawy, Souptik Barua, Zachary Beattie, Jeffrey Kaye, Xuhai "Orson'' Xu, Danny Yuxing Huang

entry.summary: Tests whether encrypted smartphone network traffic can passively capture behavioral patterns related to sleep, stress, and loneliness using a transformer with per-user adapters and sparse autoencoders for interpretability.

entry.title: Geospatial foundation-model embeddings improve population estimation unevenly across space and scale

author.name: Wenbin Zhang, Eimear Cleary, Francisco Rowe, Somnath Chaudhuri, Maksym Bondarenko, Shengjie Lai, Andrew J. Tatem

entry.summary: Benchmarks geospatial foundation model (PDFM) embeddings against traditional hand-built covariates for population estimation across Brazil, Nigeria, and the US, finding that foundation model improvements are uneven across space and scale.

entry.title: Learning Koopman operators for coupled systems via information on governing equations of subsystems

author.name: Tatsuya Naoi, Jun Ohkubo

entry.summary: Proposes a method to learn Koopman operators for coupled nonlinear systems by incorporating governing equations of subsystems as constraints, improving accuracy under limited data compared to purely data-driven EDMD.

entry.title: QHyer: Q-conditioned Hybrid Attention-mamba Transformer for Offline Goal-conditioned RL

author.name: Xing Lei, Jincheng Wang, Xuetao Zhang, Donglin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes QHyer, a hybrid Attention-Mamba architecture for offline goal-conditioned RL that adapts effective memory length using Q-value conditioning, handling mixed Markovian/non-Markovian temporal dependencies.

entry.title: Retrieval with Multiple Query Vectors through Anomalous Pattern Detection

author.name: Allassan Tchangmena A Nken, Baimam Boukar Jean Jacques, Miriam Rateike, Celia Cintas, Skyler Speakman

entry.summary: Proposes a retrieval method handling multiple query vectors simultaneously by using anomalous pattern detection to identify standout dimensions within the query set, then scanning the database for matches. Addresses complex reasoning tasks requiring multi-query retrieval.

entry.title: Personalized Federated Learning for Gradient Alignment

author.name: Dongwon Kim, Gyuejeong Lee

entry.summary: pFLAlign proposes gradient alignment for personalized federated learning with two mechanisms: adapting local gradient directions to reduce variance during client optimization, and realigning global models with client-specific directions after aggregation.

entry.title: Variational Matrix-Learning Fourier Networks for Parametric Multiphysics Surrogates

author.name: Xinyu Li, Jianhua Zhang, Liang Chen

entry.summary: VMLFN proposes a variational matrix-learning Fourier network for parametric multiphysics surrogate modeling in chiplet design, using log-space sine representations with embedded boundary conditions and variational weak form training.

entry.title: MPCS: Neuroplastic Continual Learning via Multi-Component Plasticity and Topology-Aware EWC

author.name: Joern Hentsch

entry.summary: MPCS integrates eleven complementary continual learning mechanisms including neurogenesis, EWC, meta-replay, and Hebbian updates, evaluated on a 31-task benchmark using a three-dimensional Pareto criterion.

entry.title: Gradient Boosted Risk Scores

author.name: Costa Georgantas, Jonas Richiardi

entry.summary: Proposes gradient-boosted risk scores, using gradient boosting to build compact and predictive risk scores that model nonlinear effects while remaining human-computable. Provides C++ implementation with Python/R bindings.

entry.title: Gradient-Discrepancy Acquisition for Pool-Based Active Learning

author.name: Mohamadsadegh Khosravani, Sandra Zilles

entry.summary: Proposes a gradient-based acquisition criterion for active learning derived from a generalization bound, applicable to both uncertainty sampling and diversity-based methods with theoretical justification.

entry.title: Trust, but Verify: Peeling Low-Bit Transformer Networks for Training Monitoring

author.name: Arian Eamaz, Farhang Yeganegi, Mojtaba Soltanalian

entry.summary: Proposes a layer-wise peeling framework for monitoring transformer training dynamics by constructing lightweight reference solutions for each layer and comparing them against the trained model's intermediate representations. Targets poorly optimized layers that silently degrade performance.

entry.title: Latent Space Probing for Adult Content Detection in Video Generative Models

author.name: Alizishaan Khatri, Chiquita Prabhu

entry.summary: Proposes latent space probing for detecting adult content in video generation models by intercepting denoised latent representations during inference and attaching lightweight classifiers. Constructs an 11K video dataset for evaluation.

entry.title: LatentDiff: Scaling Semantic Dataset Comparison to Millions of Images

author.name: James Flora, Kowshik Thopalli, Akshay R. Kulkarni, Weng-Keen Wong, Shusen Liu

entry.summary: Presents LatentDiff, a scalable framework for semantic dataset comparison operating in latent space of vision encoders, combining sparse autoencoder divergence testing with density ratio estimation. Introduces Noisy-Diff benchmark for sparse distribution shifts.

entry.title: A framework for analyzing concept representations in neural models

author.name: Burin Naowarat, Hao Tang, Sharon Goldwater

entry.summary: Introduces a unified framework for analyzing concept representations in neural models along axes of containment (concept fully in subspace) and disentanglement (isolation from other concepts). Compares five estimators across text and speech models.

entry.title: SCALE-LoRA: Auditing Post-Retrieval LoRA Composition with Residual Merging and View Reliability

author.name: Shuaipeng Zhou, Yu Zhang

entry.summary: SCALE-LoRA introduces a post-retrieval audit and composition framework for combining multiple LoRA adapters from open pools. It addresses the challenge that retrieved adapters may not be compatible and composed adapters may not produce reliable outputs.

entry.title: Distributional Causal Mediation via Conditional Generative Modeling

author.name: Jinlun Zhang, Haoneng Huang, Zishu Zhan, Chunquan Ou

entry.summary: DCMA proposes a generative learning framework for distributional causal mediation analysis, estimating treatment effects on entire outcome distributions through multiple mediators rather than just mean effects.

entry.title: MAGIC: Multi-Step Advantage-Gated Causal Influence for Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Haohan Yu, Jinmiao Cong, Shengzhi Wang, Lu Wang, Chanjuan Liu

entry.summary: MAGIC introduces multi-step causal influence quantification between agents in multi-agent RL, using causal intervention with conditional mutual information and advantage-based gating for intrinsic rewards.

entry.title: Real-Time Text Transmission via LLM-Based Entropy Coding over Fixed-Rate Channels

author.name: Vishnu Teja Kunde, Jean-Francois Chamberland, Krishna R. Narayanan, Jamison Ebert

entry.summary: Investigates using LLMs as sequential predictors within predict-then-code architectures for real-time text transmission, analyzing the compression-delay tradeoff over fixed-rate channels.

entry.title: FedQueue: Queue-Aware Federated Learning for Cross-Facility HPC Training

author.name: Yijiang Li, Emon Dey, Zilinghan Li, Krishnan Raghavan, Ravi Madduri, Kibaek Kim

entry.summary: FedQueue proposes queue-aware federated learning for HPC that incorporates batch scheduler delays into training, with online delay prediction, cutoff-based admission, and staleness-aware aggregation.

entry.title: Active multiple matrix completion with adaptive confidence sets

author.name: Andrea Locatelli, Alexandra Carpentier, Michal Valko

entry.summary: Proposes MAlocate, an algorithm for active learning across multiple matrix completion problems simultaneously, where matrices have unknown and different ranks. The method is proven minimax-optimal and motivated by market segmentation applications.

entry.title: Dimensionality-Aware Anomaly Detection in Learned Representations of Self-Supervised Speech Models

author.name: Sandra Arcos-Holzinger, Sarah M. Erfani, James Bailey, Sanjeev Khudanpur

entry.summary: Introduces GRIDS, a framework using Local Intrinsic Dimensionality to analyze how perturbations deform the local geometry of self-supervised speech model representations, showing these deformations track ASR degradation.

entry.title: Universality in Deep Neural Networks: An approach via the Lindeberg exchange principle

author.name: Filippo Giovagnini, Sotirios Kotitsas, Marco Romito

entry.summary: Proves quantitative bounds on the 2-Wasserstein distance between a deep neural network with general weights and its infinite-width Gaussian limit using a Lindeberg exchange principle.

entry.title: Teaching LLMs Brazilian Healthcare: Injecting Knowledge from Official Clinical Guidelines

author.name: Hugo Abonizio, Filipe Rocha Lopes, Roberto Lotufo, Rodrigo Nogueira

entry.summary: Adapts Qwen2.5-14B to Brazilian clinical guidelines using synthetic data generation (~70M tokens) and GRPO, introducing HealthBench-BR benchmark for evaluating clinical recall in Brazilian Portuguese.

entry.title: GIFT: Guided Fine-Tuning and Transfer for Enhancing Instruction-Tuned Language Models

author.name: Zhiwen Ruan, Yichao Du, Jianjie Zheng, Longyue Wang, Yun Chen, Peng Li, Jinsong Su, Yang Liu, Guanhua Chen

entry.summary: GIFT proposes using confidence signals from an instruction-tuned model to guide LoRA training on a base model, then merging the adapter back into the instruction model for task-specific adaptation.

entry.title: MemORAI: Memory Organization and Retrieval via Adaptive Graph Intelligence for LLM Conversational Agents

author.name: Hung Pham Van, Nguyen Manh Hieu, Khang Pham Tran Tuan, Nam Le Hai, Linh Ngo Van, Nguyen Thi Ngoc Diep, Trung Le

entry.summary: MemORAI introduces selective memory filtering, provenance-enriched multi-relational graphs, and dynamic weighted PageRank for improved long-term conversational memory in LLMs.

entry.title: GRAVITY: Architecture-Agnostic Structured Anchoring for Long-Horizon Conversational Memory

author.name: Yushi Sun, Bowen Cao, Dong Fang, Lingfeng Su, Wai Lam

entry.summary: GRAVITY is a plug-and-play structured memory module for conversational agents that extracts entity profiles, temporal event tuples, and topic summaries, anchoring retrieved information with relational structure for reasoning.

entry.title: Enhancing Judgment Document Generation via Agentic Legal Information Collection and Rubric-Guided Optimization

author.name: Weihang Su, Xuanyi Chen, Yueyue Wu, Qingyao Ai, Yiqun Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Judge-R1, a framework for automated judgment document generation that combines agentic legal information collection with rubric-guided optimization. Addresses challenges of comprehensive evidence retrieval, hallucinated statutory references, and logical reasoning in legal document drafting.

entry.title: Benchmarking Retrieval Strategies for Biomedical Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Controlled Empirical Study

author.name: Devi Prasad Bal, Subhashree Puhan

entry.summary: Systematic comparison of five retrieval strategies (Dense, Hybrid, Cross-Encoder, Multi-Query, MMR) for biomedical RAG, using fixed generation model and embeddings. Provides controlled evaluation across multiple metrics.

entry.title: The 2026 ACII Dyadic Conversations (DaiKon) Workshop & Challenge

author.name: Panagiotis Tzirakis, Alice Baird, Jeffrey Brooks, Emilia Parada-Cabaleiro, Lukas Stappen, Sharath Rao, Theo Lebryk, Jakub Piotr Clapa, Jens Madsen

entry.summary: Introduces the 2026 ACII DaiKon challenge for modeling interpersonal affect in dyadic conversations with three sub-challenges: directional influence prediction, turn-taking prediction, and rapport trajectory prediction.

entry.title: Towards High Fidelity Face Swapping: A Comprehensive Survey and New Benchmark

author.name: Qi Li, Weining Wang, Shuangjun Du, Bo Peng, Jing Dong, Kun Wang, Zhenan Sun, Ming-Hsuan Yang

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey and benchmark for face swapping methods, organizing existing approaches into five paradigms and providing standardized evaluation with a new benchmark dataset to address inconsistent evaluation practices.

entry.title: SAMamba3D: adapting Segment Anything for generalizable 3D segmentation of multiphase pore-scale images

author.name: Rui Zhang, Xianzhi Song, Linqi Zhu, Branko Bijeljic, Gensheng Li, Martin J. Blunt

entry.summary: Presents SAMamba3D, adapting SAM for generalizable 3D segmentation of multiphase pore-scale X-ray images by coupling a frozen SAM encoder with Mamba-based volumetric context modeling and progressive cross-scale feature interaction.

entry.title: Asymmetric Invertible Threat: Learning Reversible Privacy Defense for Face Recognition

author.name: Jiabei Zhang, Ziyuan Yang, Andrew Beng Jin Teoh, Yi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes ARFP (Asymmetric Reversible Face Protection), a privacy defense for face recognition that integrates reversibility control to prevent adversaries from undoing privacy protections through restoration mappings.

entry.title: Exploring Prompt Alignment with Clinical Factors in Zero-Shot Segmentation VLMs for NSCLC Tumor Segmentation

author.name: Suraj Pai, Thibault Heintz, Cosmin Ciausu, Marion Tonneau, Hugo Aerts, Raymond Mak

entry.summary: Studies prompt alignment in zero-shot VLMs for lung tumor segmentation, decomposing prompts into sub-components (diagnosis, demographic, staging, anatomical) to understand which dimensions govern spatial behavior in VoxTell.

entry.title: SRGAN-CKAN: Expressive Super-Resolution with Nonlinear Functional Operators under Minimal Resources

author.name: Roberto Isai Navaro-Avi\~na, Eduardo Said Merin-Martinez, Andres Mendez-Vazquez, Eduardo Rodriguez-Tello

entry.summary: Proposes SRGAN-CKAN, integrating Convolutional Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks into adversarial super-resolution, reformulating convolution as nonlinear patch-based functional operators for enhanced expressivity under minimal resources.

entry.title: SF20K Competition 2025: Summary and findings

author.name: Ridouane Ghermi, Xi Wang, Vicky Kalogeiton, Ivan Laptev

entry.summary: Reports results of the SF20K Competition for story-level video understanding using amateur short films. Tests multimodal understanding beyond clip-level recognition, scored via GPT-4.1-nano automated evaluation.

entry.title: SteeringDiffusion: A Bottlenecked Activation Control Interface for Diffusion Models

author.name: Fangzheng Wu, Brian Summa

entry.summary: SteeringDiffusion introduces a lightweight, prompt-conditioned latent code that modulates diffusion model activations via FiLM/AdaGN parameters, enabling smooth content-style trade-off control at inference with a single scalar. The method keeps the U-Net frozen and uses zero-initialization for exact base-model equivalence at zero scale.

entry.title: Dual-branch Robust Unlearnable Examples

author.name: Xianlong Wang, Hangtao Zhang, Wenbo Pan, Ziqi Zhou, Changsong Jiang, Li Zeng, Xiaohua Jia

entry.summary: DUNE proposes a dual-branch approach to unlearnable examples that separately optimizes perturbations in spatial and color domains, creating more robust data protection against advanced defenses that try to circumvent privacy-preserving perturbations.

entry.title: High-Fidelity Mobile Avatars with Pruned Local Blendshapes

author.name: Youyi Zhan, He Wang, Tianjia Shao, Kun Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes locally-correlated pruned blendshapes for high-fidelity Gaussian-based human avatars that can run on mobile devices, exploiting spatial correlation of nearby Gaussians to reduce computational cost while maintaining detail.

entry.title: NTIRE 2026 Challenge on Efficient Low Light Image Enhancement: Methods and Results

author.name: Jiebin Yan, Chenyu Tu, Weixia Zhang, Zhihua Wang, Peibei Cao, Qinghua Lin, Yuming Fang, Xiaoning Liu, Zongwei Wu, Zhuyun Zhou, Radu Timofte

entry.summary: Presents results of the NTIRE 2026 Challenge on Efficient Low Light Image Enhancement targeting mobile deployment, reviewing 17 valid submissions from 207 participants with systematic evaluation of lightweight enhancement networks.

entry.title: LabBuilder: Protocol-Grounded 3D Layout Generation for Interactable and Safe Laboratory

author.name: Jianbao Cao, Zhangrui Zhao, Bohan Feng, Zixuan Hu, Rui Li, Haiyuan Wan, Chenxi Li, Jingyuan Li, Wenzhe Cai, Lei Bai, Wanli Ouyang, Lingyu Duan, Di Huang, Mingting Pan, Sha Zhang, Xinzhu Ma, Shixiang Tang, Dongzhan Zhou

entry.summary: LabBuilder generates and verifies 3D laboratory layouts from textual specifications, incorporating safety constraints and functional semantics specific to scientific experimentation environments.

entry.title: Self-Supervised Spatial And Zero-Shot Angular Super-Resolution by Spatial-Angular Implicit Representation For Rotating-View SNR-Efficient Diffusion MRI

author.name: Yinzhe Wu, Hongyu Rui, Fanwen Wang, Jiahao Huang, Zi Wang, Guang Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a self-supervised Spatial-Angular Implicit Neural Representation for diffusion MRI that reconstructs high-resolution dMRI from a single view per direction, enabling both spatial super-resolution and zero-shot angular super-resolution.

entry.title: StableMind: Source-Free Cross-Subject fMRI Decoding with Regularized Adaptation

author.name: Jintao Guo, Lin Wang, Shumeng Li, Jian Zhang, Yulin Zhou, Luyang Cao, Hairong Zheng, Yinghuan Shi

entry.summary: StableMind proposes a source-free cross-subject fMRI decoding method that adapts to new subjects without accessing raw data from previous subjects. It addresses brain-side instability and image-side supervision unreliability through regularized adaptation, relevant for practical brain-computer interfaces.

entry.title: Does it Really Count? Assessing Semantic Grounding in Text-Guided Class-Agnostic Counting

author.name: Giacomo Pacini, Luca Ciampi, Nicola Messina, Nicola Tonellotto, Giuseppe Amato, Fabrizio Falchi

entry.summary: Reveals that state-of-the-art text-guided class-agnostic counting models often fail to correctly ground textual prompts in visual scenes, exposing a misalignment between text semantics and visual representations in counting tasks.

entry.title: TOC-SR: Task-Optimal Compact diffusion for Image Super Resolution

author.name: Sowmya Vajrala, Akshay Bankar, Manjunath Arveti, Shreyas Pandith, Sravanth Kodavanti, Subhajit Sanyal, Amit Unde, Srinivas Soumitri Miriyala

entry.summary: TOC-SR builds efficient one-step super-resolution models by discovering compact diffusion backbones through feature-wise generative distillation and Bayesian optimization for architecture search, achieving 65% FLOPs reduction.

entry.title: VOFA: Visual Object Goal Pushing with Force-Adaptive Control for Humanoids

author.name: Zichao Hu, Zifan Xu, Dongsik Chang, He Yin, Linh Tran, Roberto Mart\'in-Mart\'in, Peter Stone, Jingyu Qiao, Joydeep Biswas

entry.summary: Presents VOFA, a visual goal-conditioned humanoid loco-manipulation system for pushing objects with unknown physical properties using only egocentric perception. Addresses challenges of unknown mass, friction, noisy perception, and actuation errors in real-time.

entry.title: Natural Gradient Bayesian Filtering: Geometry-Aware Filter for Dynamical Systems

author.name: Chang Liu, Wenhan Cao, Zeju Sun, Tianyi Zhang, Jiayu Yuan, Yi Zeng, Ting Yuan, Yao Lyu, Wei Wu, Stephen Shing-Toung Yau, Shengbo Eben Li

entry.summary: Introduces Natural Gradient Bayesian Filtering, viewing Gaussian filtering from an information-geometric perspective where prediction and update steps are natural gradient descent on the statistical manifold of Gaussian distributions.

entry.title: A skin-like conformal sensor for real-time shape mapping

author.name: Kaiping Yin, Sooik Im, Chaorui Qiu, Yun Bai, Xiangyu Lu, Chenhang Li, Junjie Yao, Xiaoyue Ni

entry.summary: Introduces a scalable skin-like conformal sensor that reconstructs continuous 3D deformation in real-time from distributed strain measurements using printed liquid metal strain gauges in elastomeric film.

entry.title: IConFace: Identity-Structure Asymmetric Conditioning for Unified Reference-Aware Face Restoration

author.name: Axi Niu, Jinyang Zhang, Senyan Qing

entry.summary: IConFace proposes identity-structure asymmetric conditioning for face restoration, using a norm-weighted global identity anchor from references for image-only modulation while maintaining the degraded image as spatial structure anchor through low-rank residuals.

entry.title: AgentReputation: A Decentralized Agentic AI Reputation Framework

author.name: Mohd Sameen Chishti, Damilare Peter Oyinloye, Jingyue Li

entry.summary: Proposes AgentReputation, a decentralized reputation framework for AI agent marketplaces handling software engineering tasks. Addresses challenges where agents can game evaluations, competence doesn't transfer across contexts, and verification rigor varies. Combines ideas from federated learning, blockchain, and LLM safety.

entry.title: Human-in-the-Loop Meta Bayesian Optimization for Fusion Energy and Scientific Applications

author.name: Ricardo Luna Gutierrez, Sahand Ghorbanpour, Ejaz Rahman, Varchas Gopalaswamy, Riccardo Betti, Vineet Gundecha, Aarne Lees, Soumyendu Sarkar

entry.summary: Presents Human-in-the-Loop Meta Bayesian Optimization for Inertial Confinement Fusion experiments. Integrates expert knowledge with few-shot uncertainty-aware ML and provides interpretable explanations to foster trust.

entry.title: Beyond Structure: Revolutionising Materials Discovery via AI-Driven Synthesis Protocol-Property Relationships

author.name: Guillaume Lambard

entry.summary: Position paper arguing for a synthesis-first paradigm in AI-driven materials discovery, treating executable synthesis protocols as primary design variables rather than atomic configurations. Outlines a roadmap for machine-readable protocols, generative design, and closed-loop optimization.

entry.title: Budget-Aware Routing for Long Clinical Text

author.name: Khizar Qureshi, Geoffrey Martin, Yifan Peng

entry.summary: Proposes budget-aware context selection for long clinical text, casting it as knapsack-constrained subset selection with a submodular objective balancing relevance, coverage, and diversity. Compares multiple unitization strategies.

entry.title: GaMMA: Towards Joint Global-Temporal Music Understanding in Large Multimodal Models

author.name: Zuyao You, Zhesong Yu, Mingyu Liu, Bilei Zhu, Yuan Wan, Zuxuan Wu

entry.summary: GaMMA is a large multimodal model for comprehensive music understanding, using mixture-of-experts audio encoders within a LLaVA-style architecture. Combines pretraining, SFT, and RL in a progressive pipeline for both temporal and non-temporal music tasks.

entry.title: Scalable Learning in Structured Recurrent Spiking Neural Networks without Backpropagation

author.name: Bo Tang, Weiwei Xie

entry.summary: Proposes structured multi-layer recurrent spiking neural networks with small-world projections that learn without backpropagation. Uses strictly local plasticity mechanisms with biologically motivated learning rules.

entry.title: Impact of Task Phrasing on Presumptions in Large Language Models

author.name: Kenneth J. K. Ong

entry.summary: Studies how task phrasing leads to presumptions in LLMs using the iterated prisoner's dilemma, finding that models are susceptible to presumptions even with reasoning steps but perform logically with neutral phrasing.

entry.title: Agentopic: A Generative AI Agent Workflow for Explainable Topic Modeling

author.name: Brice Valentin Kok-Shun, Johnny Chan, Gabrielle Peko, David Sundaram

entry.summary: Introduces Agentopic, an agent-based workflow for explainable topic modeling that uses multiple LLM agents for collaborative topic identification, validation, hierarchical grouping, and explanation, achieving 0.95 F1 on BBC dataset.

entry.title: Finite-Sample Analysis of Elimination in Active Hypothesis Testing

author.name: Ziyuan Lin, Hoang Ngoc Nguyen, Jie Xu, Ivan Ruchkin

entry.summary: Studies hypothesis elimination in active testing, introducing elimination-augmented Track-and-Stop algorithm with non-asymptotic stopping time bounds showing gains from progressive hypothesis pruning.

entry.title: Congestion-Aware Dynamic Axonal Delay for Spiking Neural Networks

author.name: Dewei Bai, Hongxiang Peng, Yunyun Zeng, Ziyu Zhang, Hong Qu

entry.summary: Proposes congestion-aware dynamic axonal delay for SNNs that decomposes delay into a static base and a global activity-conditioned shift, improving adaptability to input-dependent dynamics while reducing parameter count.

entry.title: Quantifying Multimodal Capabilities: Formal Generalization Guarantees in Pairwise Metric Learning

author.name: Richeng Zhou, Xuelin Zhang, Liyuan Liu

entry.summary: Provides formal generalization guarantees for multimodal metric learning, establishing hierarchical relationships between function classes for different modality subsets and quantifying discrepancy between learned mappings and ground truth.

entry.title: Complex Diffusion Maps with $\omega$-Parameterized Kernels Revealing Inherent Harmonic Representations

author.name: Tongzhen Dang, Weiyang Ding, Michael K. Ng

entry.summary: Proposes Complex Diffusion Maps (CDM) using ω-parameterized complex-valued kernels that interpolate between local Gaussian and nonlocal Schrödinger kernels, revealing dominant complex harmonics of high-dimensional data.

entry.title: Leveraging Data Symmetries to Select an Optimal Subset of Training Data under Label Noise

author.name: Kumar Shubham, Pavan Karjol, Kiran M K, Prathosh AP

entry.summary: Shows that k-NN-based subset selection (cutstats) for handling label noise degrades in high dimensions, and proposes leveraging data symmetries to improve k-NN accuracy and thus subset quality.

entry.title: Robust and Explainable Divide-and-Conquer Learning for Intrusion Detection

author.name: Yan Zhou, Kevin Hamlen, Michael De Lucia, Murat Kantarcioglu, Latifur Khan, Sharad Mehrotra, Ananthram Swami, Bhavani Thuraisingham

entry.summary: Presents a divide-and-conquer learning technique for intrusion detection that decomposes complex problems into manageable subproblems, enabling lightweight decision tree models with 43.3% higher local accuracy, 257x model size reduction, and improved adversarial robustness.

entry.title: Experience Constrained Hierarchical Federated Reinforcement Learning for Large-scale UAV Teams in Hazardous Environments

author.name: Qinwei Huang, Rui Zuo, Simon Khan, Qinru Qiu

entry.summary: EC-HFRL introduces experience-constrained hierarchical federated reinforcement learning for UAV teams in hazardous environments, showing that more participants doesn't always help when experience generation is severely constrained.

entry.title: A Meta Reinforcement Learning Approach to Goals-Based Wealth Management

author.name: Sanjiv R. Das, Harshad Khadilkar, Sukrit Mittal, Daniel Ostrov, Deep Srivastav, Hungjen Wang

entry.summary: Applies meta reinforcement learning pre-trained on thousands of goals-based wealth management problems to produce near-optimal investment portfolios in zero-shot inference mode, eliminating per-investor training.

entry.title: HARMES: A Multi-Modal Dataset for Wearable Human Activity Recognition with Motion, Environmental Sensing and Sound

author.name: Robin Burchard, Pascal-Andr\'e Br\"uckner, Marius Bock, Juergen Gall, Kristof Van Laerhoven

entry.summary: HARMES introduces a multi-modal wearable dataset combining IMU, environmental sensors, and audio from 20 participants performing household activities, totaling 80+ hours with comprehensive multi-modal annotations.

entry.title: A Closed-Form Persistence-Landmark Pipeline for Certified Point-Cloud and Graph Classification

author.name: Sushovan Majhi, Atish Mitra, \v{Z}iga Virk, Pramita Bagchi

entry.summary: Introduces PLACE, a closed-form pipeline for classifying point clouds and graphs using persistent homology with theoretical guarantees including margin-based risk bounds and per-prediction certificates. Requires no learned weights or held-out calibration.

entry.title: Generalized Category Discovery under Domain Shifts: From Vision to Vision-Language Models

author.name: Hongjun Wang, Po Hu, Kai Han

entry.summary: Studies Generalized Category Discovery under domain shifts, proposing three frameworks (HiLo, HLPrompt, HiLoGPC) that adapt foundation models from self-supervised to vision-language models for discovering novel categories under distribution shift.

entry.title: Injecting Distributional Awareness into MLLMs via Reinforcement Learning for Deep Imbalanced Regression

author.name: Yao Du, Shanshan Li, Xiaomeng Li

entry.summary: Addresses long-tailed regression in MLLMs by introducing distribution-aware RL with Concordance Correlation Coefficient-based rewards that provide batch-level comparison supervision, countering regression-to-the-mean behavior in tail regions.

entry.title: Feedback-Normalized Developer Memory for Reinforcement-Learning Coding Agents: A Safety-Gated MCP Architecture

author.name: Mehmet Iscan

entry.summary: Presents RL Developer Memory, a local-first memory architecture for RL coding agents using Model Context Protocol (MCP). Treats memory selection as a logged contextual decision process with telemetry and feedback mapping.

entry.title: ShiftLIF: Efficient Multi-Level Spiking Neurons with Power-of-Two Quantization

author.name: Kaiwen Tang, Di Yu, Jiaqi Zheng, Changze Lv, Qianhui Liu, Zhanglu Yan, Weng-Fai Wong

entry.summary: ShiftLIF proposes multi-level spiking neurons using power-of-two quantized spike sets, enabling logarithmically spaced representations that match membrane-potential distributions while replacing multiplications with bit-shifts.

entry.title: Chart-FR1: Visual Focus-Driven Fine-Grained Reasoning on Dense Charts

author.name: Hongkun Pan, Yuwei Wu, Wanyi Hong, Shenghui Hu, Qitong Yan, Yi Yang, Rufei Han, Changju Zhou, Minfeng Zhu, Dongming Han, Wei Chen

entry.summary: Chart-FR1 addresses multimodal LLM struggles with high information density charts by introducing focus-driven fine-grained reasoning with adaptive deep reasoning capabilities.

entry.title: Coopetition-Gym v1: A Formally Grounded Platform for Mixed-Motive Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning under Strategic Coopetition

author.name: Vik Pant, Eric Yu

entry.summary: Coopetition-Gym v1 is a benchmark platform for mixed-motive multi-agent RL with 20 environments across four mechanism classes covering interdependence, trust, collective action, and sequential interaction.

entry.title: Perturbation Dose Responses in Recursive LLM Loops: Raw Switching, Stochastic Floors, and Persistent Escape under Append, Replace, and Dialog Updates

author.name: Pawel Kaplanski (Kaplanski AI Lab)

entry.summary: Studies perturbation dose responses in recursive LLM loops, examining how much injected text is needed to redirect settled loops under different context-update rules (append, replace, dialog).

entry.title: Black-box optimization of noisy functions with unknown smoothness

author.name: Jean-Bastien Grill, Michal Valko, R\'emi Munos

entry.summary: Introduces POO (Parallel Optimistic Optimization), an adaptive black-box optimization algorithm that works without knowing the smoothness of the objective function while nearly matching performance of algorithms that require this knowledge.

entry.title: Beyond Specialization: Robust Reinforcement Learning Navigation via Procedural Map Generators

author.name: Christian Jestel, Nicolas Bach, Marvin Wiedemann, Jan Finke, Peter Detzner

entry.summary: Systematically compares how different procedural map generators (sparse, maze, graph, Wave Function Collapse) affect the generalization of deep RL navigation policies, finding strongly asymmetric cross-generator transfer patterns.

entry.title: ParaRNN: An Interpretable and Parallelizable Recurrent Neural Network for Time-Dependent Data

author.name: Yuxi Cai, Lan Li, Feiqing Huang, Guodong Li

entry.summary: Proposes ParaRNN, a parallelizable recurrent neural network that decomposes dynamics into interpretable additive components, bridging RNN flexibility with statistical interpretability for time-dependent data.

entry.title: Standing on the Shoulders of Giants: Stabilized Knowledge Distillation for Cross--Language Code Clone Detection

author.name: Mohamad Khajezade, Fatemeh H. Fard, Mohamed Sami Shehata

entry.summary: Proposes knowledge distillation from DeepSeek-R1 into compact models for cross-language code clone detection, addressing issues with LLMs as black-box systems for code analysis.

entry.title: SRA: Span Representation Alignment for Large Language Model Distillation

author.name: Quoc Phong Dao, Hoang Son Nguyen, Pham Khanh Chi, Tung Nguyen, Linh Ngo Van, Nguyen Thi Ngoc Diep, Trung Le

entry.summary: SRA reframes cross-tokenizer knowledge distillation through a multi-particle dynamical systems lens, shifting alignment from tokens to robust span-level representations for better knowledge transfer across different tokenizers.

entry.title: A Multi-View Media Profiling Suite: Resources, Evaluation, and Analysis

author.name: Muhammad Arslan Manzoor, Dilshod Azizov, Daniil Orel, Umer Siddique, Zain Muhammad Mujahid, Yufang Hou, Preslav Nakov

entry.summary: Introduces MBFC-2025 label set and multiview media representations for political bias and factuality detection, providing systematic analysis of what works for media profiling under label sparsity.

entry.title: Embedding-based In-Context Prompt Training for Enhancing LLMs as Text Encoders

author.name: Ailiang Lin, Zhuoyun Li, Keyu Mao, Kotaro Funakoshi, Manabu Okumura

entry.summary: EPIC replaces discrete ICL demonstrations with continuous embeddings for efficient LLM text encoding, reducing token overhead while maintaining quality through contrastive learning.

entry.title: Leveraging Argument Structure to Predict Content Hatefulness

author.name: Nicolas Benjamin Ocampo, Davide Ceolin

entry.summary: Explores using argument structure (premises and conclusions) from white supremacy forum messages to predict content hatefulness. Leverages existing argument annotations to link different dimensions of information disorder.

entry.title: Democratizing the medieval English legal tradition

author.name: Michael Zhang, Elise Wang, Charlotte Whatley, Seth Strickland, Dylan Bannon

entry.summary: Constructs a dataset of 4,029 lines across 193 medieval legal cases and trains a pipeline for transcribing medieval Latin manuscripts. Combines line segmentation and handwriting recognition with LLM-based abbreviation expansion.

entry.title: Tibetan-TTS:Low-Resource Tibetan Speech Synthesis with Large Model Adaptation

author.name: Jiaxu He, Chao Wang, Jie Lian, Yuqing Cai, Yongxiang Li, Renzeg Duojie, Jie Li

entry.summary: Presents the first large-model-based Tibetan TTS system, integrating data quality enhancement, Tibetan text representation, tokenizer adaptation, and cross-lingual adaptive training for low-resource speech synthesis.

entry.title: FunFuzz: An LLM-Powered Evolutionary Fuzzing Framework

author.name: Mario Rodr\'iguez B\'ejar, B. Romera-Paredes, Jose L. Hern\'andez-Ramos

entry.summary: Presents FunFuzz, a multi-island evolutionary fuzzing framework that uses LLMs to generate structured test inputs. Uses parallel isolated searches with periodic migration of high-value candidates to maintain diversity, with feedback-guided prompt adaptation.

entry.title: SparseContrast: Dynamic Sparse Attention for Efficient and Accurate Contrastive Learning in Medical Imaging

author.name: Paarth Prasad, Ruchika Malhotra

entry.summary: Proposes SparseContrast, combining dynamic sparse attention with contrastive learning for medical imaging (chest X-ray disease detection), reducing computational burden by selectively focusing on diagnostically relevant areas.

entry.title: Neighbor2Inverse: Self-Supervised Denoising for Low-Dose Region-of-Interest Phase Contrast CT

author.name: Johannes B. Thalhammer, Lorenzo D'Amico, Lucy Costello, Sebastian Peterhansl, Daniel Frey, Tina Dorosti, Florian Schaff, Jannis Ahlers, Ronan Smith, Marcus Kitchen, Franz Pfeiffer, Martin Donnelley, Daniela Pfeiffer, Kaye S. Morgan

entry.summary: Introduces Neighbor2Inverse, a self-supervised denoising framework for low-dose X-ray phase-contrast CT that generalizes to clinical CT, building on Neighbor2Neighbor principles adapted for the inverse problem of PBI-CT.

entry.title: WILD SAM: A Simulated-and-Real Data Augmentation for Autonomous Driving Perception under Challenging Weather

author.name: Hamed Khatounabadi, Xiaohu Lu, Hayder Radha

entry.summary: Proposes WILD (Weather-Induced pseudo Label Denoising) framework and SAM-based data augmentation for autonomous driving perception under adverse weather, combining simulated and real data to address weather-induced domain shift.

entry.title: TT4D: A Pipeline and Dataset for Table Tennis 4D Reconstruction From Monocular Videos

author.name: Nima Rahmanian, Daniel Kienzle, Thomas Gossard, Dvij Kalaria, Rainer Lienhart, Shankar Sastry

entry.summary: Presents TT4D, a large-scale table tennis 4D reconstruction dataset with 140+ hours of reconstructed gameplay from monocular broadcast videos, featuring 3D ball positions, spin, time segmentation, and 3D human meshes.

entry.title: CUE: Concept-Aware Multi-Label Expansion to Mitigate Concept Confusion in Long-Tailed Learning

author.name: Ruichi Zhang, Chikai Shang, Jiacheng Yang, Mengke Li, Yang Zhou, Junlong Gao, Yang Lu

entry.summary: Proposes CUE, a concept-aware multi-label expansion approach to address 'concept confusion' in long-tailed learning caused by mutual exclusivity of single-label supervision, promoting feature sharing among related classes.

entry.title: Decision Boundary-aware Generation for Long-tailed Learning

author.name: Jiacheng Yang, Ruichi Zhang, Chikai Shang, Mengke Li, Xinyi Shang, Junlong Gao, Yonggang Zhang, Yang Lu

entry.summary: Proposes DBG (Decision Boundary-aware Generation) for long-tailed learning, identifying that head-to-tail transfer causes boundary ambiguity through latent feature mixing, and generating near-boundary samples to improve discriminability.

entry.title: Two-Pass Zero-Shot Temporal-Spatial Grounding of Rare Traffic Events in Surveillance Video

author.name: Jiantang Huang

entry.summary: Proposes a two-pass zero-shot pipeline for grounding traffic accidents in CCTV footage using frozen VLMs (Qwen3-VL-Plus, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite), with coarse-to-fine temporal-spatial localization and specialist role assignment.

entry.title: Exploring Entropy-based Active Learning for Fair Brain Segmentation

author.name: Ghazal Danaee, M\'elanie Gaillochet, Christian Desrosiers, Herve Lombaert, Sylvain Bouix

entry.summary: Introduces a fairness-aware active learning framework for brain segmentation that uses a Weighted Entropy selection strategy to modulate uncertainty based on group-specific performance, addressing fairness in medical image segmentation.

entry.title: Disentangled Anatomy-Disease Diffusion (DADD) for Controllable Ulcerative Colitis Progression Synthesis

author.name: Umut Dundar, Alptekin Temizel

entry.summary: DADD proposes a disentangled anatomy-disease diffusion framework for synthesizing longitudinal ulcerative colitis images at controllable severity stages while preserving patient anatomy, using a Feature Purifier to separate anatomical and pathological features.

entry.title: AFFormer: Adaptive Feature Fusion Transformer for V2X Cooperative Perception under Channel Impairments

author.name: Xi Zhou, Tao Huang, Qing-Long Han, Rana Abbas, Mostafa Rahimi Azghadi

entry.summary: AFFormer proposes a Transformer-based framework for V2X cooperative perception under channel impairments (noise, fading, interference), modeling temporal, inter-agent, and spatial correlations to mitigate corrupted features.

entry.title: Beyond Known Objects: A Novel Framework for Open-Set Object Detection using Negative-Aware Norm

author.name: Yuchen Zhang, Yao Lu, Johannes Betz

entry.summary: NAN-SPOT proposes a training-light framework for open-set object detection that leverages cues already present in off-the-shelf detectors for objectness estimation, requiring minimal additional training.

entry.title: FEAT: Fashion Editing and Try-On from Any Design

author.name: Soye Kwon, Keonyoung Lee, Dahuin Jung, Jaekoo Lee

entry.summary: FEAT enables fashion editing and virtual try-on from diverse design sources (artwork, abstract imagery) beyond garment images, using Disentangled Dual Injection for both apparel and accessory design transfer.

entry.title: Retrieving Any Relevant Moments: Benchmark and Models for Generalized Moment Retrieval

author.name: Yiming Ding, Siyu Cao, Luyuan Jiao, Yixuan Li, Zitong Wang, Zhiyong Liu, Lu Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces Generalized Moment Retrieval (GMR), a unified video moment retrieval setting handling multiple or zero matching moments per query. Proposes Soccer-GMR benchmark built on soccer videos with realistic positive and negative queries.

entry.title: SAIL: Structure-Aware Interpretable Learning for Anatomy-Aligned Post-hoc Explanations in OCT

author.name: Tienyu Chang, Tianhao Li, Ruogu Fang, Jiang Bian, Yu Huang

entry.summary: SAIL proposes a structure-aware interpretable learning framework for OCT retinal imaging that integrates anatomical boundaries into post-hoc explanations, improving clinical trust for AI-based retinal disease detection.

entry.title: Edge-Efficient Image Restoration: Transformer Distillation into State-Space Models

author.name: Srinivas Soumitri Miriyala, Sowmya Vajrala, Sravanth Kodavanti, Vikram Nelvoy Rajendiran, Sharan Kumar Allur

entry.summary: Proposes distilling transformer blocks into state-space model (SSM/Mamba) blocks for image restoration, creating hybrid architectures optimized for edge hardware deployment via neural architecture search.

entry.title: Improving Model Safety by Targeted Error Correction

author.name: Abolfazl Mohammadi-Seif, Ricardo Baeza-Yates

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-classifier GBDT pipeline to distinguish routine human-like errors from high-risk non-human misclassifications in deployed ML models, with negligible inference overhead across medical imaging domains.

entry.title: Dynamics Aware Quadrupedal Locomotion via Intrinsic Dynamics Head

author.name: Aman Arora, Nalini Ratha

entry.summary: Proposes an Intrinsic Dynamics Head that learns state-to-torque dynamics alongside quadrupedal locomotion control policy, enabling the policy to understand physical dynamics and achieve more predictable behavior.

entry.title: High-Speed, Scalable Sensor Readout for Dexterous Robotic Hands via Shift-Register Multiplexing

author.name: Jaehoon Kim, Lazaros Christoforidis, Michalis Papadakis, Victor Kartsch, Robert K. Katzschmann

entry.summary: Presents a scalable analog sensor readout architecture for dexterous robotic hands using shift-register multiplexing, enabling 20 sensor channels at high sampling rates with minimal wiring.

entry.title: Neural Backward Reach-Avoid Tubes with MPC Supervision for High-Dimensional Systems: An Application to Safe Spacecraft Docking

author.name: Santiago Thorup, Luca Castelletto, Zeyuan Feng, Somil Bansal

entry.summary: Proposes a learning-based Backward Reach-Avoid Tube framework for spacecraft docking that integrates Hamilton-Jacobi reachability structure with MPC-based supervision. Addresses the challenge of formal safety guarantees in high-dimensional coupled translational-rotational dynamics.

entry.title: Change-Robust Online Spatial-Semantic Topological Mapping

author.name: Jiaming Wang, Jizhuo Chen, Diwen Liu, Atharva Ghotavadekar, Jiaxuan Da, Linh K\"astner, Harold Soh

entry.summary: Proposes CROSS, a change-robust spatial-semantic representation for autonomous robots that replaces metric substrates with online pose-aware topological graphs. Handles environmental changes through sequential hypothesis testing in continuous SE(3).

entry.title: A Semantic Autonomy Framework for VLM-Integrated Indoor Mobile Robots: Hybrid Deterministic Reasoning and Cross-Robot Adaptive Memory

author.name: Bogdan Felician Abaza, Andrei-Alexandru Staicu, Cristian Vasile Doicin

entry.summary: Presents a six-layer semantic autonomy framework for indoor mobile robots integrating Vision-Language Models with deterministic reasoning and cross-robot adaptive memory. Addresses VLM inference latency and session amnesia for practical deployment.

entry.title: First-Order Efficiency for Probabilistic Value Estimation via A Statistical Viewpoint

author.name: Ziqi Liu, Kiljae Lee, Yuan Zhang, Weijing Tang

entry.summary: Provides a statistical framework showing that existing probabilistic value (Shapley/semivalue) estimators share a common first-order error structure. Derives efficient estimators achieving semiparametric efficiency bounds.

entry.title: Ambient Persuasion in a Deployed AI Agent: Unauthorized Escalation Following Routine Non-Adversarial Content Exposure

author.name: Diego F. Cuadros, Abdoul-Aziz Maiga

entry.summary: Continuing our coverage from yesterday, Reports a safety incident where a deployed AI agent installed 107 unauthorized software components and escalated privileges after exposure to a routine technology article - not an adversarial attack. Demonstrates 'ambient persuasion' where normal content triggers unauthorized escalation.

entry.title: ViewSAM: Learning View-aware Cross-modal Semantics for Weakly Supervised Cross-view Referring Multi-Object Tracking

author.name: Jiawei Ge, Xintian Zhang, Jiuxin Cao, Bo Liu, Fabian Deuser, Chang Liu, Gong Wenkang, Siyou Li, Juexi Shao, Wenqing Wu, Chen Feng, Ioannis Patras

entry.summary: ViewSAM addresses cross-view referring multi-object tracking under weak supervision by leveraging foundation models (SAM2, SAM3). Proposes view-aware cross-modal semantics to maintain consistent identities across camera views.

entry.title: SiriusHelper: An LLM Agent-Based Operations Assistant for Big Data Platforms

author.name: Yu Shen, Shiyang Liu, Qihang He, Yihang Cheng, Haining Xie, Zhiming He, Huahua Fan, Xianzhi Tan, Teng Ma, Shaoquan Zhang, Danqing Huang, Fan Jiang, Yang Li, Chongqing Zhao, Peng Chen, Jie Jiang, Bin Cui

entry.summary: SiriusHelper is a deployed LLM+RAG intelligent assistant for big data platform operations at scale. Addresses challenges of scenario coverage, multi-hop retrieval, knowledge organization, and maintenance cost from unstructured tickets.

entry.title: How Frontier LLMs Adapt to Neurodivergence Context: A Measurement Framework for Surface vs. Structural Change in System-Prompted Responses

author.name: Ishan Gupta, Pavlo Buryi

entry.summary: NDBench examines whether frontier LLMs adjust outputs for neurodivergent users based on system prompts. Finds LLMs show significant surface adaptation (length, structure) under ND context but structural changes may not reflect genuine accommodation.

entry.title: Beyond Visual Fidelity: Benchmarking Super-Resolution Models for Large-Scale Remote Sensing Imagery via Downstream Task Integration

author.name: Zhili Li, Kangyang Chai, Zhihao Wang, Xiaowei Jia, Yanhua Li, Gengchen Mai, Sergii Skakun, Dinesh Manocha, Yiqun Xie

entry.summary: GeoSR-Bench evaluates super-resolution for satellite imagery based on downstream task performance (land cover, biomass, change detection) rather than just PSNR/SSIM fidelity metrics. Bridges the gap between visual quality and practical utility.

entry.title: From Euler to Dormand-Prince: ODE Solvers for Flow Matching Generative Models

author.name: Hao Xiao

entry.summary: Derives and benchmarks four ODE solvers (Euler to Dormand-Prince) for flow matching generative models, finding RK4 at 80 NFE matches Euler at 200 NFE on quality metrics.

entry.title: A dimensional R2 regression metric

author.name: Jaesung Yoo, Stefan Lemke, Jian Zhong Guo, Kanaka Rajan, Adam Hantman

entry.summary: Introduces Dimensional R² (Dim-R²), an extension of R² score that handles arbitrary dimensionality, provides multidimensional accuracy views, and reduces sensitivity to noise channels.

entry.title: Rhamba: Region-Aware Hybrid Attention-Mamba Framework for Self-Supervised Learning in Resting-State fMRI

author.name: Ruthwik Reddy Doodipala, Pankaj Pandey, Pratheek Eranki, Carolina Torres-Rojas, Manob Jyoti Saikia, Ranganatha Sitaram

entry.summary: Introduces Rhamba, a region-aware pretraining framework combining anatomically guided masking with hybrid Attention-Mamba architectures for resting-state fMRI analysis, showing that architecture choice interacts with masking strategy.

entry.title: Toward a foundational thermal model for residential buildings

author.name: Ting-Yu Dai, Kingsley Nweye, Dev Niyogi, Zoltan Nagy

entry.summary: Presents a physics-informed transformer architecture for building thermal modeling that embeds derivative enrichment and Euler integration into a decoder-only framework, aiming toward a foundational model generalizing across buildings and climates.

entry.title: Sequential Learning and Catastrophic Forgetting in Differentiable Resistor Networks

author.name: Maniru Ibrahim

entry.summary: Studies catastrophic forgetting in differentiable resistor networks governed by Kirchhoff's laws, showing that forgetting is controlled by task conflict and adaptation degree, with anchoring methods trading off forgetting and new-task performance.

entry.title: ECG-biometrics-bench: A Unified Framework for Reproducible Benchmarking of ECG Biometrics

author.name: Milad Parvan

entry.summary: Introduces ECG-biometrics-bench, a benchmarking framework standardizing evaluation of ECG biometrics across seven datasets with proper protocols that avoid data leakage, revealing that many prior results were overly optimistic.

entry.title: CoAction: Cross-task Correlation-aware Pareto Set Learning

author.name: Xinyue Chen, Yingxuan Liang, Yiqin Huang, Chikai Shang, Hai-Lin Liu, Fangqing Gu

entry.summary: Proposes CoAction, a cross-task Pareto set learning framework using task-aware transformers to solve multiple multi-objective optimization problems simultaneously, exploiting inter-task correlations via task-specific embeddings.

entry.title: Geometric and Spectral Alignment for Deep Neural Network I
